    function escapeHTML(value){return String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));}
    function escapeAttr(value){return escapeHTML(value).replace(/`/g,'&#96;');}
    function cleanPlainText(value,max=500){return String(value??'').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g,' ').replace(/[<>]/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,max);}
    function cleanPersonName(value){return cleanPlainText(value,80);}
    function safeExternalUrl(value){try{const u=new URL(String(value||''),location.href);return /^https?:$/.test(u.protocol)?u.href:'';}catch(e){return '';}}
    function cleanMultilineText(value,max=5000){return String(value??'').replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g,'').replace(/[<>]/g,'').trim().slice(0,max);}
    function sanitizeTicketHTML(input){
      const template=document.createElement('template');template.innerHTML=String(input??'');
      const allowed=new Set(['B','STRONG','I','EM','U','S','STRIKE','UL','OL','LI','BR','P','DIV','SPAN','PRE','FONT']);
      const drop=new Set(['SCRIPT','STYLE','IFRAME','OBJECT','EMBED','SVG','MATH','LINK','META','IMG','VIDEO','AUDIO','FORM','INPUT','BUTTON']);
      Array.from(template.content.querySelectorAll('*')).forEach(el=>{
        const tag=el.tagName;
        if(drop.has(tag)){el.remove();return;}
        if(!allowed.has(tag)){el.replaceWith(...Array.from(el.childNodes));return;}
        Array.from(el.attributes).forEach(attr=>{
          const n=attr.name.toLowerCase(),v=attr.value;
          const ok=(tag==='FONT'&&n==='color'&&/^(#[0-9a-f]{3,8}|[a-z]{3,20})$/i.test(v))||(tag==='FONT'&&n==='size'&&/^[1-7]$/.test(v));
          if(!ok)el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
        });
      });
      return template.innerHTML.slice(0,12000);
    }

    function standaloneEmailKey(email){return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(String(email||'').trim().toLowerCase()))).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');}
    async function standaloneUpdateIdentity(d){const old=(await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).once('value')).val()||{},up={[`users/${d.uid}/name`]:d.name,[`users/${d.uid}/email`]:d.email,[`users/${d.uid}/mobile`]:d.mobile,[`registered_users/${d.uid}/name`]:d.name,[`registered_users/${d.uid}/email`]:d.email,[`registered_users/${d.uid}/mobile`]:d.mobile,[`email_index/${standaloneEmailKey(d.email)}`]:{uid:d.uid,email:String(d.email).toLowerCase()}};if(old.email&&String(old.email).toLowerCase()!==String(d.email).toLowerCase())up[`email_index/${standaloneEmailKey(old.email)}`]=null;await database.ref().update(up);return{ok:true,profileOnly:true};}
    async function standaloneDeleteUser(d){const profile=(await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).once('value')).val()||{},up={[`users/${d.uid}`]:null,[`registered_users/${d.uid}`]:null,[`user_order_stats/${d.uid}`]:null,[`api_logs/${d.uid}`]:null,[`blocked_users/${d.uid}`]:{deletedAt:Date.now(),by:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'}};if(profile.email)up[`email_index/${standaloneEmailKey(profile.email)}`]=null;if(profile.apiKey)up[`api_key_index/${profile.apiKey}`]=null;for(const [node,field] of [['tickets','userId'],['panel_orders','userId'],['notifications','user_id'],['orders_index','userId'],['adminPanel/fundRequests','userId'],['adminPanel/massOrders','userId']]){const q=await database.ref(node).orderByChild(field).equalTo(d.uid).once('value').catch(()=>null);if(q)q.forEach(c=>up[`${node}/${c.key}`]=null);}await database.ref().update(up);return{ok:true,removed:Object.keys(up).length,softDelete:true};}
    async function standaloneFundStatus(d){
      let result=null;const now=Date.now();
      const tx=await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).transaction(user=>{
        if(!user?.fundRequests?.[d.reqId])return;
        const r=user.fundRequests[d.reqId],amount=Number(r.amount)||0,credited=r.balanceCredited===true;
        user.balance=Number(user.balance)||0;let delta=0;
        if(d.status==='approved'&&!credited){user.balance+=amount;r.balanceCredited=true;delta=amount;}
        if(d.status!=='approved'&&credited){user.balance=Math.max(0,user.balance-amount);r.balanceCredited=false;delta=-amount;}
        r.status=d.status;r.updatedAt=now;
        if(d.status==='approved')r.approvedAt=now;else r.approvedAt=null;
        result={amount,changedBy:delta,balance:user.balance,adminKey:r.adminKey||null,requestKey:d.reqId};
        return user;
      });
      if(!tx.committed||!result)throw new Error('Fund request not found');
      let adminKey=result.adminKey;
      if(!adminKey){
        const q=await database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByChild('userId').equalTo(d.uid).once('value').catch(()=>null);
        if(q)q.forEach(c=>{const v=c.val()||{};if(!adminKey&&(v.requestKey===d.reqId||c.key===d.reqId))adminKey=c.key;});
      }
      if(adminKey){
        await database.ref(`adminPanel/fundRequests/${adminKey}`).update({status:d.status,updatedAt:now,approvedAt:d.status==='approved'?now:null,balanceCredited:d.status==='approved'});
        if(!result.adminKey)await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}/fundRequests/${d.reqId}/adminKey`).set(adminKey).catch(()=>{});
      }
      mirrorUserWallet(d.uid);return{ok:true,...result,adminKey};
    }
    async function standaloneOrderRefund(d){
      let result=null,wrongStatus='';const target=d.action==='cancel'?'cancelled':'rejected',now=Date.now(),by=auth.currentUser?.email||'admin';
      const tx=await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).transaction(user=>{
        const o=user?.orders?.[d.orderId];if(!o)return;
        const amount=Number(o.amount)||0,old=o.status||'pending';
        if(['rejected','cancelled'].includes(old)&&old!==target){wrongStatus=old;return;}
        if(old===target){result={amount:Math.max(0,Number(o.refundAmount??o.amount)||0),spentDelta:Math.max(0,Number(o.refundSpentDelta)||0),refunded:false,refundApplied:o.refundApplied===true,status:target,balance:Number(user.balance)||0,oldStatus:old,batchId:o.batchId||null,orderNumber:o.orderNumber||d.orderId};return user;}
        const refund=o.refundApplied!==true&&!['rejected','cancelled'].includes(old);
        user.balance=Number(user.balance)||0;user.spent=Number(user.spent)||0;
        let spentDelta=0;
        if(refund){const beforeSpent=user.spent;user.balance+=amount;user.spent=Math.max(0,beforeSpent-amount);spentDelta=beforeSpent-user.spent;o.refundApplied=true;o.refundedAt=now;o.refundAmount=amount;o.refundSpentDelta=spentDelta;o.statusBeforeRefund=old;o.refundedBy=by;}
        o.status=target;o.cancelRequested=false;if(target==='rejected')o.rejectedAt=now;else o.cancelledAt=now;
        o.lastStatusChange={from:old,to:target,at:now,by};
        result={amount,spentDelta,refunded:refund,refundApplied:o.refundApplied===true,status:target,balance:user.balance,oldStatus:old,batchId:o.batchId||null,orderNumber:o.orderNumber||d.orderId};return user;
      });
      if(!tx.committed||!result)throw new Error(wrongStatus?`Order is already ${wrongStatus}`:'Order not found');
      const fields={status:target,cancelRequested:false,refundApplied:result.refundApplied,refundedAt:now,refundAmount:result.amount,refundSpentDelta:result.spentDelta,statusBeforeRefund:result.oldStatus,refundedBy:by,lastStatusChange:{from:result.oldStatus,to:target,at:now,by}};
      if(target==='rejected')fields.rejectedAt=now;else fields.cancelledAt=now;
      await database.ref(`orders_index/${d.orderId}`).update(fields);
      if(result.batchId)await database.ref(`adminPanel/massOrders/${result.batchId}/items/${d.orderId}`).update(fields);
      _bumpOrderStatus(result.oldStatus,target);_bumpUserOrderStat(d.uid,result.oldStatus,target);mirrorUserWallet(d.uid);if(result.oldStatus==='completed')await standaloneReferral(d.uid,d.orderId,{status:'completed'},target);return{ok:true,...result};
    }

    // Restore only REJECTED → PROCESSING and reverse the earlier refund.
    // Wallet + spent are changed in the same user-root transaction, so a
    // double-click/retry cannot charge twice. Index/mass mirrors are verified;
    // any mirror failure rolls the user transaction back to Rejected.
    async function standaloneRestoreRejectedOrder(d){
      const now=Date.now(),by=auth.currentUser?.email||'admin',revision=now.toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);let result=null,reason='',available=0,required=0;
      const tx=await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).transaction(user=>{
        reason='';const o=user?.orders?.[d.orderId];if(!o){reason='not-found';return;}
        const old=o.status||'pending';if(old!=='rejected'){reason='wrong-status:'+old;return;}
        const amount=Math.max(0,Number(o.refundAmount??o.amount)||0),refundApplied=o.refundApplied===true,spentDelta=Math.max(0,Number(o.refundSpentDelta??amount)||0);required=amount;
        user.balance=Number(user.balance)||0;user.spent=Number(user.spent)||0;available=user.balance;
        if(refundApplied&&user.balance+0.000001<amount&&d.force!==true){reason='insufficient';return;}
        if(refundApplied){user.balance=Math.round((user.balance-amount)*10000)/10000;user.spent=Math.round((user.spent+spentDelta)*10000)/10000;}
        o.status='processing';o.refundApplied=false;o.refundReversedAt=now;o.refundReversedBy=by;o.restoredFromRejected=true;o.restoreNoticeManagedByAdmin=true;o.restoredAt=now;o.restoredBy=by;o.restoreRevision=revision;o.processingAt=now;o.completedAt=null;o.cancelRequested=false;
        o.lastStatusChange={from:'rejected',to:'processing',at:now,by,refundReversed:refundApplied};
        result={amount,spentDelta,refundReversed:refundApplied,balance:user.balance,batchId:o.batchId||null,orderNumber:o.orderNumber||d.orderId,forced:d.force===true&&refundApplied&&available<amount};return user;
      });
      if(!tx.committed||!result){const e=new Error(reason==='insufficient'?`Refund was ₹${required.toFixed(2)}, but user wallet currently has only ₹${available.toFixed(2)}.`:reason.startsWith('wrong-status:')?`Only Rejected orders can be restored (current: ${reason.split(':')[1]}).`:'Order not found');e.code=reason==='insufficient'?'insufficient-balance':reason;e.balance=available;throw e;}
      const mirror={status:'processing',refundApplied:false,refundReversedAt:now,refundReversedBy:by,restoredFromRejected:true,restoreNoticeManagedByAdmin:true,restoredAt:now,restoredBy:by,restoreRevision:revision,processingAt:now,completedAt:null,cancelRequested:false,lastStatusChange:{from:'rejected',to:'processing',at:now,by,refundReversed:result.refundReversed}};
      try{
        await database.ref(`orders_index/${d.orderId}`).update(mirror);
        if(result.batchId)await database.ref(`adminPanel/massOrders/${result.batchId}/items/${d.orderId}`).update(mirror);
        const [own,index]=await Promise.all([database.ref(`users/${d.uid}/orders/${d.orderId}`).once('value'),database.ref(`orders_index/${d.orderId}`).once('value')]);
        if(own.val()?.status!=='processing'||index.val()?.status!=='processing'||own.val()?.restoreRevision!==revision)throw new Error('Live mirror verification failed');
      }catch(error){
        await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).transaction(user=>{const o=user?.orders?.[d.orderId];if(!o||o.restoreRevision!==revision||o.status!=='processing')return;if(result.refundReversed){user.balance=Math.round(((Number(user.balance)||0)+result.amount)*10000)/10000;user.spent=Math.max(0,Math.round(((Number(user.spent)||0)-result.spentDelta)*10000)/10000);}o.status='rejected';o.refundApplied=result.refundReversed;o.restoreRollbackAt=Date.now();o.lastStatusChange={from:'processing',to:'rejected',at:Date.now(),by:'automatic rollback'};return user;}).catch(()=>{});
        const rollbackMirror={status:'rejected',refundApplied:result.refundReversed,restoreRollbackAt:Date.now(),lastStatusChange:{from:'processing',to:'rejected',at:Date.now(),by:'automatic rollback'}};
        await database.ref(`orders_index/${d.orderId}`).update(rollbackMirror).catch(()=>{});if(result.batchId)await database.ref(`adminPanel/massOrders/${result.batchId}/items/${d.orderId}`).update(rollbackMirror).catch(()=>{});
        throw new Error('Restore rolled back safely: '+error.message);
      }
      _bumpOrderStatus('rejected','processing');_bumpUserOrderStat(d.uid,'rejected','processing');mirrorUserWallet(d.uid);
      const noticeKey=database.ref('notifications').push().key;
      await database.ref(`notifications/${noticeKey}`).set({user_id:d.uid,title:'↩️ Order Restored to Processing',message:`Order #${result.orderNumber} was restored by Admin and is processing again.`,type:'order',meta:{order_id:result.orderNumber,restored_from_rejected:true},is_read:false,created_at:now}).catch(e=>console.warn('Restore notification:',e.message));
      return{ok:true,...result,status:'processing'};
    }
    async function standaloneDeleteOrder(d){let result=null;const tx=await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}`).transaction(user=>{const o=user?.orders?.[d.orderId];if(!o)return;const amount=Number(o.amount)||0,old=o.status||'pending',refund=['pending','processing'].includes(old)&&o.refundApplied!==true;user.balance=Number(user.balance)||0;user.spent=Number(user.spent)||0;if(refund){user.balance+=amount;user.spent=Math.max(0,user.spent-amount);}result={amount,refund,oldStatus:old,orderNumber:o.orderNumber,balance:user.balance,batchId:o.batchId||null};delete user.orders[d.orderId];return user;});if(!tx.committed||!result)throw new Error('Order not found');const up={[`orders_index/${d.orderId}`]:null};if(result.orderNumber)up[`order_id_index/${result.orderNumber}`]=null;if(result.batchId)up[`adminPanel/massOrders/${result.batchId}/items/${d.orderId}`]=null;await database.ref().update(up);_bumpOrderStatus(result.oldStatus,null);_bumpUserOrderStat(d.uid,result.oldStatus,null);mirrorUserWallet(d.uid);if(result.oldStatus==='completed')await standaloneReferral(d.uid,d.orderId,{status:'completed'},'deleted');return{ok:true,...result};}
    async function standaloneUpdateOrderStatus(d){const old=(await database.ref(`users/${d.uid}/orders/${d.orderId}`).once('value')).val();if(!old)throw new Error('Order not found');const up={[`users/${d.uid}/orders/${d.orderId}/status`]:d.status,[`users/${d.uid}/orders/${d.orderId}/completedAt`]:d.status==='completed'?Date.now():(old.completedAt||null),[`orders_index/${d.orderId}/status`]:d.status,[`orders_index/${d.orderId}/completedAt`]:d.status==='completed'?Date.now():(old.completedAt||null)};if(old.batchId)up[`adminPanel/massOrders/${old.batchId}/items/${d.orderId}/status`]=d.status;await database.ref().update(up);_bumpOrderStatus(old.status||'pending',d.status);_bumpUserOrderStat(d.uid,old.status||'pending',d.status);await standaloneReferral(d.uid,d.orderId,old,d.status);return{ok:true,status:d.status};}
    async function standaloneReferral(uid,orderId,order,status){const stateRef=database.ref(`referral_commission_state/${orderId}`);const state=(await stateRef.once('value')).val();if(status==='completed'&&state?.status!=='credited'){const p=(await database.ref(`users/${uid}`).once('value')).val()||{},rid=p.referrer_user_id;if(!rid)return;const pct=Number((await database.ref('admin_settings/referral/commission_percent').once('value')).val())||5,amount=Math.round((Number(order.amount)||0)*pct)/100;let won=false;const c=await stateRef.transaction(v=>{if(v?.status==='credited')return;won=true;return{status:'processing',at:Date.now()};});if(c.committed&&won){await database.ref(`users/${rid}/balance`).transaction(b=>(Number(b)||0)+amount);mirrorUserWallet(rid);await stateRef.set({status:'credited',referrerUid:rid,amount,creditedAt:Date.now()});await database.ref(`referral_commissions/${orderId}`).set({referrer_user_id:rid,referee_user_id:uid,order_id:orderId,commission_amount:amount,status:'completed',created_at:Date.now()});}}else if(order.status==='completed'&&status!=='completed'&&state?.status==='credited'){await database.ref(`users/${state.referrerUid}/balance`).transaction(b=>(Number(b)||0)-Number(state.amount||0));mirrorUserWallet(state.referrerUid);await stateRef.update({status:'reversed',reversedAt:Date.now()});await database.ref(`referral_commissions/${orderId}`).update({status:'reversed',reversed_at:Date.now()});}}
    async function standaloneMigrateNotifications(){
      const flag=await database.ref('_migrations/unifiedNotificationsStandaloneV15').once('value');if(flag.exists())return{ok:true,migrated:flag.val().migrated||0};
      const users=(await database.ref('users').once('value')).val()||{},updates={};let migrated=0;
      Object.entries(users).forEach(([uid,u])=>Object.entries((u||{}).notifications||{}).forEach(([id,n])=>{const k='legacy_'+uid.slice(0,8)+'_'+id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'').slice(-20);updates[`notifications/${k}`]={user_id:uid,title:n.title||'Notification',message:n.message||'',type:n.type==='panel_order_placed'?'order':(n.type||'announcement'),meta:{...(n.meta||{}),order_id:n.orderId||null,migrated:true},is_read:n.is_read===true||n.read===true,created_at:n.created_at||n.timestamp||Date.now()};updates[`users/${uid}/notifications/${id}`]=null;migrated++;}));
      if(Object.keys(updates).length)await database.ref().update(updates);await database.ref('_migrations/unifiedNotificationsStandaloneV15').set({migrated,completedAt:Date.now()});return{ok:true,migrated};
    }

    // 🔢 UNIFIED ID DISPLAY HELPER (mirrors the one in the User Panel)
    // NEW orders/fund-requests carry a short `orderNumber`/`requestNumber`
    // (e.g. "195645") and are shown as-is. OLDER records made before this
    // feature keep showing exactly like before: "#" + first 8 chars of the
    // Firebase key, uppercased — nothing changes for old history.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function formatShortId(item, numberField) {
      if (item[numberField]) return item[numberField];
      return '#' + (item.id || '').substring(0, 8).toUpperCase();
    }

    function updateDateTime() {
      const now = new Date();
      const options = { 
        day: '2-digit', 
        month: 'short', 
        year: 'numeric', 
        hour: '2-digit', 
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true 
      };
      document.getElementById('currentDateTime').textContent = now.toLocaleString('en-IN', options);
    }

    function directElements(parent){return Array.from(parent?.children||[]).filter(x=>x.nodeType===1);}
    function containsAnchor(el,id){return el.id===id||!!el.querySelector('#'+id);}
    function focusFormGroups(formId,anchors){const form=document.getElementById(formId);if(!form)return;directElements(form).forEach(el=>{const submit=el.matches('button[type="submit"],button.btn-success:last-child'),show=submit||anchors.some(id=>containsAnchor(el,id));el.style.display=show?'':'none';});}

    // Load Dashboard Stats
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 📊 DASHBOARD — SINGLE LIVE SOURCE OF TRUTH
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⚡ MASTER 'users' DATA SUBSCRIPTION (single Firebase listener, shared)
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // PROBLEM THIS FIXES: Dashboard, Users page, All Signup Users page,
    // Orders page, Fund Requests page, and API Usage Overview EACH used to
    // attach their OWN separate `database.ref('users').on('value', ...)`
    // listener — meaning the (potentially large) entire 'users' tree was
    // downloaded from Firebase 6 SEPARATE TIMES on every single page load,
    // and re-downloaded again on every single database change. This was
    // the #1 cause of the Admin Panel feeling slow / laggy.
    //
    // FIX: ONE shared listener downloads 'users' ONCE. Every page that
    // needs it calls `onUsersDataUpdate(callback)` instead of attaching its
    // own listener — callback fires immediately with the latest cached data
    // (if already loaded) AND every time the data changes afterwards, so
    // every page still stays perfectly live — just without the duplicate
    // network downloads.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    let _usersMasterCache = null;
    let _usersMasterCallbacks = [];
    let _usersMasterListenerAttached = false;

    function onUsersDataUpdate(callback) {
      _usersMasterCallbacks.push(callback);
      if (!_usersMasterListenerAttached) {
        _usersMasterListenerAttached = true;
        database.ref('users').on('value', snapshot => {
          _usersMasterCache = snapshot.val() || {};
          _usersMasterCallbacks.forEach(cb => {
            try { cb(_usersMasterCache); } catch (e) { console.error('onUsersDataUpdate callback error:', e); }
          });
        });
      } else if (_usersMasterCache !== null) {
        // Data already loaded — fire immediately so this new subscriber
        // doesn't have to wait for the next database change to render.
        callback(_usersMasterCache);
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🩹 SHARED 'registered_users' SUBSCRIPTION (safety-net mirror)
    // 'users' is the master record, but a few legacy/edge accounts can
    // exist ONLY in 'registered_users' (the welcome-email mirror). To make
    // sure the "All Signup Users" list never misses anyone, we keep ONE
    // shared listener on 'registered_users' too and UNION it with 'users'.
    // registered_users holds profile fields only (no orders), so it stays
    // tiny even when 'users' is tens of MB.
    let _regUsersMasterCache = null;
    let _regUsersMasterCallbacks = [];
    let _regUsersMasterListenerAttached = false;

    function onRegisteredUsersDataUpdate(callback) {
      _regUsersMasterCallbacks.push(callback);
      if (!_regUsersMasterListenerAttached) {
        _regUsersMasterListenerAttached = true;
        database.ref('registered_users').on('value', snapshot => {
          _regUsersMasterCache = snapshot.val() || {};
          _regUsersMasterCallbacks.forEach(cb => {
            try { cb(_regUsersMasterCache); } catch (e) { console.error('onRegisteredUsersDataUpdate callback error:', e); }
          });
        });
      } else if (_regUsersMasterCache !== null) {
        callback(_regUsersMasterCache);
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Everything on the Dashboard (stat cards, Analytics, Recent Orders,
    // Recent Signups, Recent Fund Requests) is now computed from ONE single
    // real-time listener on 'users' (using .on('value'), not .once()) so:
    //   1) Every card updates INSTANTLY the moment anything changes in the
    //      database — no refresh needed, no stale numbers.
    //   2) "Total Orders" is always the actual live COUNT of every order
    //      that exists under users/*/orders in the database right now —
    //      this exactly matches what the User Panel calculates too, so the
    //      two panels can never show different numbers again.
    //   3) It also self-heals the old 'stats/totalOrders' counter (used by
    //      the User Panel's own dashboard + the Reseller API) so that even
    //      if it ever drifted out of sync in the past, it gets corrected
    //      automatically and kept perfectly accurate going forward.
    let _dashboardUsersCache = {};

    function loadDashboardStats() {
      // ⚡ LIGHT & LIVE (v9) — every number binds to a tiny counter node or a
      // last-few-rows listener. The old version subscribed to the ENTIRE
      // users tree — after the 159k-order legacy migration that tree is tens
      // of MB, so the dashboard looked permanently frozen. These listeners
      // stay instant no matter how big the database gets.
      let _activeOrderTotal = 0;
      let _legacyOrderTotal = 0;
      const renderTotalOrders = () => {
        // 🛡️ Double-count-safe lifetime total (same formula as the User Panel)
        const lifetime = _activeOrderTotal + (_activeOrderTotal < _legacyOrderTotal ? _legacyOrderTotal : 0);
        setText('totalOrders', lifetime.toLocaleString('en-IN'));
      };
      database.ref('stats/totalOrders').on('value', snap => {
        const v = snap.val() || {};
        window._lifetimeOrderTotal = Number(v.total) || 0;
        _activeOrderTotal = Number(v.total) || 0;
        window._activeOrderBaseline = Number(v.baseline) || 0;
        window._orderStatsLoaded = true;
        renderTotalOrders();
        if (window._pendingOrderStatsSync) {
          const p = window._pendingOrderStatsSync; window._pendingOrderStatsSync = null;
          syncGlobalOrderStats(p.total, p.pending);
        }
      });
      // Legacy archive total — used only for the double-count-safe floor.
      try {
        databaseOld.ref('stats/totalOrders').on('value', snap => {
          const v = snap.val() || {};
          _legacyOrderTotal = Number(v && typeof v === 'object' ? v.total : v) || 0;
          renderTotalOrders();
        });
      } catch (e) {}
      database.ref('stats/orderStatusCounts').on('value', snap => {
        const v = snap.val() || {};
        setText('pendingOrders', (v.pending || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
        setText('processingOrders', (v.processing || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
        setText('analyticsCompletedOrders', (v.completed || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
      });
      database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('status').equalTo('processing').on('value', snap => {
        const el=document.getElementById('processingOrders');if(el)el.textContent=Object.keys(snap.val()||{}).length.toLocaleString('en-IN');
      }, err => console.warn('Processing count query:',err&&err.message));
      database.ref('stats/revenueTotal').on('value', snap => {
        const v = Number(snap.val()) || 0;
        setText('totalRevenue', `₹ ${v.toFixed(2)}`);
        setText('analyticsRevenue', `₹ ${v.toFixed(2)}`);
      });
      database.ref('stats/fundsApproved').on('value', snap => {
        const v = Number(snap.val()) || 0;
        setText('analyticsApprovedFunds', `₹ ${v.toFixed(2)}`);
      });

      // Total users — cheap shallow REST count, refreshed every 30 seconds
      const refreshUserCountBadge = async () => {
        try {
          if(!auth.currentUser)return;const token=await auth.currentUser.getIdToken();const r=await fetch(firebaseConfig.databaseURL+'/users.json?shallow=true&auth='+encodeURIComponent(token));
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && typeof j === 'object' && !j.error) {
            const n = Object.keys(j).length.toLocaleString('en-IN');
            setText('totalUsers', n);
            setText('analyticsActiveUsers', n);
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      };
      refreshUserCountBadge();
      setInterval(refreshUserCountBadge, 30000);

      // 🔴 Pending fund requests — small indexed query (status index in rules)
      database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByChild('status').equalTo('pending')
        .on('value', snap => setText('pendingFunds', Object.keys(snap.val() || {}).length),
            () => {
              database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').on('value', s2 => {
                setText('pendingFunds', Object.values(s2.val() || {}).filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length);
              });
            });

      // 🧾 Recent orders — live tail of the flat orders_index mirror
      database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('createdAt').limitToLast(6)
        .on('value', snap => {
          const rows = Object.entries(snap.val() || {}).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }));
          rows.sort(_cmpOrdersDesc);
          renderRecentOrdersTable(rows.slice(0, 5));
        });

      // 💰 Recent fund requests — last 6 by push key (chronological order)
      database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByKey().limitToLast(6)
        .on('value', snap => {
          const rows = Object.entries(snap.val() || {}).map(([id, r]) => ({ id, ...r }));
          rows.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
          renderRecentFundRequestsTable(rows.slice(0, 5));
        });

      // 👋 Recent signups — indexed by createdAt (NEW project rules ✅)
      database.ref('users').orderByChild('createdAt').limitToLast(11)
        .on('value', snap => {
          const rows = Object.entries(snap.val()||{}).filter(([,u])=>u&&typeof u==='object').map(([uid,u])=>({
            uid: uid, name: u.name || 'Unknown', email: u.email || 'N/A',
            phone: u.mobile || u.phone || 'N/A', balance: u.balance || 0,
            createdAt: u.createdAt || 0, signupDate: u.signupDate || u.createdAt || 0
          }));
          rows.sort((a, b) => (b.signupDate || 0) - (a.signupDate || 0));
          renderRecentSignupUsersTable(rows.slice(0, 10));
        }, err => console.warn('recent signups:', err && err.message));

      // Active Services (own live listener)
      database.ref('services').on('value', snapshot => {
        const services = snapshot.val() || {};
        const activeCount = Object.values(services).filter(svc=>svc&&typeof svc==='object'&&svc.enabled!==false).length;
        const el = document.getElementById('activeServices');
        if (el) el.textContent = activeCount;
      });
    }

    // 📊 Counter helpers — fire-and-forget transactions (never block the UI)
    function _bumpOrderStatus(oldS, newS) {
      _bumpOrderStatusN(oldS, newS, 1);
    }
    function _bumpOrderStatusN(oldS, newS, n) {
      if (oldS === newS || !n) return;
      if (oldS) database.ref('stats/orderStatusCounts/' + oldS).transaction(v => Math.max(0, (v || 0) - n)).catch(() => {});
      if (newS) database.ref('stats/orderStatusCounts/' + newS).transaction(v => (v || 0) + n).catch(() => {});
    }
    function _bumpRevenue(delta) {
      if (!delta) return;
      database.ref('stats/revenueTotal').transaction(v => Math.max(0, Math.round((v || 0) * 100 + Math.round(delta * 100)) / 100)).catch(() => {});
    }

    // 📊 Per-user order counter (lightweight mirror, used by the Admin user
    // lists so we never need to download the whole users/*/orders tree).
    // oldS = status BEFORE, newS = status AFTER (null = created/deleted).
    function _bumpUserOrderStat(uid, oldS, newS, n) {
      if (!uid || oldS === newS) return;
      n = Number(n) || 1;
      database.ref('user_order_stats/' + uid).transaction(v => {
        v = (v && typeof v === 'object') ? Object.assign({}, v) : {};
        if (oldS) v[oldS] = Math.max(0, (Number(v[oldS]) || 0) - n);
        if (newS) v[newS] = (Number(v[newS]) || 0) + n;
        return v;
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
    // 🪞 Mirror a user's wallet (balance/spent/lastLogin) into the lightweight
    // registered_users profile, so the Admin user lists stay fresh without
    // pulling the whole users tree. Self-correcting (reads live values).
    async function mirrorUserWallet(uid) {
      if (!uid) return;
      try {
        const s = await database.ref('users/' + uid).once('value');
        const u = s.val() || {};
        await database.ref('registered_users/' + uid).update({
          balance: Number(u.balance) || 0,
          spent: Number(u.spent) || 0,
          lastLogin: u.lastLogin || null
        }).catch(() => {});
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ♻️ Manual full rebuild of the live counters (orders, revenue, funds) —
    // paged key-walk, safe to run anytime, takes a few minutes on huge data.
    async function recalcOrderCounters() {
      if (!confirm('Re-scan ALL orders_index (1.5 lakh+ orders) and rebuild the live dashboard counters?\nThis takes a few minutes — keep this tab open.')) return;
      showToast('♻️ Recount started — watch the migration log on the Settings page…', 'success');
      const counts = {};
      let revenue = 0, scanned = 0, startKey = null, pages = 0;
      try {
        for (;;) {
          let q = database.ref('orders_index').orderByKey().limitToFirst(501);
          if (startKey) q = database.ref('orders_index').orderByKey().startAt(startKey).limitToFirst(501);
          const snap = await q.once('value');
          const val = snap.val() || {};
          const keys = Object.keys(val).sort();
          if (!keys.length) break;
          keys.slice(0, 500).forEach(k => {
            scanned++;
            const o = val[k] || {};
            const stt = o.status || 'pending';
            counts[stt] = (counts[stt] || 0) + 1;
            revenue += o.amount || 0;
          });
          pages++;
          if (keys.length < 501) break;
          startKey = keys[keys.length - 1];
        }
        await database.ref('stats/orderStatusCounts').set(counts).catch(() => {});
        await database.ref('stats/revenueTotal').set(Math.round(revenue * 100) / 100).catch(() => {});
        const fr = await database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').once('value').catch(() => null);
        let fa = 0;
        if (fr && fr.val()) Object.values(fr.val()).forEach(r => { if (r.status === 'approved') fa += r.amount || 0; });
        await database.ref('stats/fundsApproved').set(Math.round(fa * 100) / 100).catch(() => {});
        showToast(`✅ Counters rebuilt from ${scanned.toLocaleString('en-IN')} orders (₹${Math.round(revenue).toLocaleString('en-IN')} revenue, ${pages} pages)`, 'success');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('Recount failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // 🔁 Self-heal: rebuild the lightweight per-user order counts (user_order_stats)
    // + backfill a COMPLETE registered_users profile (name/email/mobile/photoURL/
    // loginMethod/createdAt + balance/spent/lastLogin) from the full users tree.
    // This guarantees every user in 'users' also exists in 'registered_users', so
    // the fast user lists never miss an account. One-time on demand. Safe to re-run.
    async function recountUserStats() {
      if (!confirm('Rebuild per-user order counts + backfill complete registered_users profiles?\nThis walks the full users tree once — takes a few minutes on large data. Keep this tab open.')) return;
      showToast('♻️ Rebuilding per-user stats…', 'success');
      let scanned = 0, startKey = null, batch = {};
      const flush = async () => { if (!Object.keys(batch).length) return; await database.ref().update(batch).catch(() => {}); batch = {}; };
      try {
        for (;;) {
          let q = database.ref('users').orderByKey().limitToFirst(401);
          if (startKey) q = database.ref('users').orderByKey().startAt(startKey).limitToFirst(401);
          const snap = await q.once('value');
          const val = snap.val() || {};
          const keys = Object.keys(val).sort();
          if (!keys.length) break;
          keys.slice(0, 400).forEach(k => {
            scanned++;
            const u = val[k] || {};
            // Per-user order counts (from the full order subtree)
            const os = { pending: 0, processing: 0, completed: 0, rejected: 0, cancelled: 0 };
            (u.orders ? Object.values(u.orders) : []).forEach(o => { const s = (o && o.status) || 'pending'; os[s] = (os[s] || 0) + 1; });
            batch['user_order_stats/' + k] = os;
            // 🩹 COMPLETE profile mirror via CHILD-PATH updates — fills in every
            // profile field WITHOUT wiping unrelated fields already present in
            // registered_users (referral_code, termsAgreedAt, welcomeEmailSentAt…).
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/name'] = u.name || 'Unknown';
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/email'] = u.email || '';
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/mobile'] = u.mobile || u.phone || '';
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/photoURL'] = u.photoURL || '';
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/loginMethod'] = u.loginMethod || u.authProvider || 'Email';
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/createdAt'] = u.createdAt || u.signupDate || 0;
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/balance'] = Number(u.balance) || 0;
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/spent'] = Number(u.spent) || 0;
            batch['registered_users/' + k + '/lastLogin'] = u.lastLogin || null;
          });
          if (Object.keys(batch).length >= 300) await flush();
          if (keys.length < 401) break;
          startKey = keys[keys.length - 1];
        }
        await flush();
        showToast(`✅ Rebuilt order counts + full profiles for ${scanned.toLocaleString('en-IN')} users.`, 'success');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('Recount failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Recompute EVERY dashboard number + table from the current live 'users' snapshot.
    function renderDashboardFromUsers(users) {
      let totalOrdersLive = 0;
      let totalRevenue = 0;
      let pendingOrdersCount = 0;
      let completedOrdersCount = 0;
      let pendingFundsCount = 0;
      let approvedFundsAmount = 0;

      const recentOrders = [];
      const recentFunds = [];
      const signupUsersList = [];

      Object.entries(users).forEach(([userId,user])=>{user=user&&typeof user==='object'?user:{};
        // --- Orders ---
        if (user.orders) {
          Object.entries(user.orders).forEach(([orderId, order]) => {
            totalOrdersLive++;
            totalRevenue += order.amount || 0;
            if (order.status === 'pending') pendingOrdersCount++;
            if (order.status === 'completed') completedOrdersCount++;
            recentOrders.push({
              id: orderId,
              userId: userId,
              userName: user.name || 'Unknown',
              userEmail: user.email || 'N/A',
              ...order
            });
          });
        }

        // --- Fund Requests ---
        if (user.fundRequests) {
          Object.entries(user.fundRequests).forEach(([reqId, req]) => {
            if (req.status === 'pending') pendingFundsCount++;
            if (req.status === 'approved') approvedFundsAmount += req.amount || 0;
            recentFunds.push({
              id: reqId,
              userId: userId,
              userName: user.name || 'Unknown',
              userEmail: user.email || 'N/A',
              ...req
            });
          });
        }

        // --- Signups ---
        signupUsersList.push({
          uid: userId,
          name: user.name || 'Unknown',
          email: user.email || 'N/A',
          phone: user.mobile || user.phone || 'N/A',
          balance: user.balance || 0,
          createdAt: user.createdAt || Date.now(),
          signupDate: user.signupDate || user.createdAt || Date.now()
        });
      });

      // ── Stat cards ──
      setText('totalUsers', Object.keys(users).length);
      setText('analyticsActiveUsers', Object.keys(users).length);
      setText('totalOrders', Number(window._lifetimeOrderTotal || totalOrdersLive).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
      setText('totalRevenue', `₹ ${totalRevenue.toFixed(2)}`);
      setText('pendingOrders', pendingOrdersCount);
      setText('analyticsRevenue', `₹ ${totalRevenue.toFixed(2)}`);
      setText('analyticsCompletedOrders', completedOrdersCount);
      setText('pendingFunds', pendingFundsCount);
      setText('analyticsApprovedFunds', `₹ ${approvedFundsAmount.toFixed(2)}`);

      // ── Self-heal the shared 'stats/totalOrders' counter used by the User
      // Panel's own dashboard + the Reseller API, so BOTH panels always show
      // the exact same "Total Orders" number, live, with zero drift.
      syncGlobalOrderStats(totalOrdersLive, pendingOrdersCount);

      // ── Recent Orders table (live) ──
      recentOrders.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
      renderRecentOrdersTable(recentOrders.slice(0, 5));

      // ── Recent Fund Requests table (live) ──
      recentFunds.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
      renderRecentFundRequestsTable(recentFunds.slice(0, 5));

      // ── Recent Signup Users table (live) ──
      signupUsersList.sort((a, b) => (b.signupDate || 0) - (a.signupDate || 0));
      renderRecentSignupUsersTable(signupUsersList.slice(0, 10));
    }

    // Small helper — safely set textContent only if the element exists
    function setText(id, value) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) el.textContent = value;
    }

    // Keep settings/stats/totalOrders (used by the User Panel dashboard and
    // the Reseller API) perfectly in sync with the LIVE count computed here.
    // This runs on every dashboard update, so any historical drift between
    // the two panels self-corrects automatically and never comes back.
    let _lastSyncedOrderStats = null;
    function syncGlobalOrderStats(total, pending) {
      if (!window._orderStatsLoaded) {
        window._pendingOrderStatsSync = { total:Number(total)||0, pending:Number(pending)||0 };
        return;
      }
      const baseline = Number(window._activeOrderBaseline) || 0;
      const lifetimeTotal = baseline + Number(total || 0);
      const key = lifetimeTotal + ':' + pending + ':' + baseline;
      if (_lastSyncedOrderStats === key) return;
      _lastSyncedOrderStats = key;
      database.ref('stats/totalOrders').update({ total:lifetimeTotal, pending, baseline }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Render Recent Orders table (called live, every time data changes)
    function renderRecentOrdersTable(recentOrders) {
      recentOrders=(recentOrders||[]).filter(o=>o.source!=='mass'&&o.massOrder!==true);
      const container = document.getElementById('recentOrders');
      if (!container) return;

      if (recentOrders.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">📋</div><div class="empty-text">No recent orders</div></div>';
        return;
      }

      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Order ID</th><th>User</th><th>Service</th><th>Amount</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      recentOrders.forEach(order => {
        html += `
          <tr>
            <td class="cell-order-id">${formatShortId(order, 'orderNumber')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(order.userName||'N/A')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(order.serviceName || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td>₹ ${(order.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td><span class="status-badge status-${order.status}">${order.status}</span></td>
            <td>${new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' })}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Render Recent Fund Requests table (called live, every time data changes)
    function renderRecentFundRequestsTable(recentFunds) {
      const container = document.getElementById('recentFundRequests');
      if (!container) return;

      if (recentFunds.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">💰</div><div class="empty-text">No recent fund requests</div></div>';
        return;
      }

      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Request ID</th><th>User</th><th>Amount</th><th>Method</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      recentFunds.forEach(req => {
        html += `
          <tr>
            <td class="cell-order-id">${formatShortId(req, 'requestNumber')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(req.userName||'N/A')}</td>
            <td>₹ ${(req.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(req.method || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td><span class="status-badge status-${req.status}">${req.status}</span></td>
            <td>${new Date(req.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' })}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Render Recent Signup Users table (called live, every time data changes)
    function renderRecentSignupUsersTable(signupUsers) {
      const container = document.getElementById('recentSignupUsers');
      if (!container) return;

      if (signupUsers.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">👤</div><div class="empty-text">No users signed up yet</div></div>';
        return;
      }

      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table">';
      html += '<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Email</th><th>Phone</th><th>Balance</th><th>Signup Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

      signupUsers.forEach((user, index) => {
        const signupDate = new Date(user.signupDate);
        const formattedDate = signupDate.toLocaleString('en-IN', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric',
          hour: '2-digit',
          minute: '2-digit'
        });

        html += `
          <tr>
            <td><strong>${index + 1}</strong></td>
            <td><strong style="color: var(--primary-color);">${escapeHTML(user.name)}</strong></td>
            <td>${user.email !== 'N/A' ? user.email : '<span style="color: var(--error); font-size: 11px;">⚠️ Missing</span>'}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(user.phone||'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${user.balance.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${formattedDate}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });

      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // ========== ALL SIGNUP USERS WITH PAGINATION ==========
    let allSignupUsersData = [];
    let filteredSignupUsers = [];
    let currentPage = 1;
    const usersPerPage = 20;
    let showAllSignupUsers = false; // "Show all on one page" toggle

    // Load All Signup Users (with live order stats per user)
    // ⚡ v25.2: reads the LIGHTWEIGHT registered_users mirror + user_order_stats
    // counter instead of the whole users/*/orders tree — the user list no
    // longer downloads tens of MB of order data. Sorted newest → oldest.
    let _signupOrderStatsListenerAttached = false;
    function loadAllSignupUsers() {
      onRegisteredUsersDataUpdate(reg => { _signupRegUsersCache = reg || {}; rebuildAllSignupUsers(); });
      // 🩹 Attach the lightweight per-user order-stats listener only ONCE
      // (refreshAllSignupUsers can call loadAllSignupUsers again — no dupes).
      if (!_signupOrderStatsListenerAttached) {
        _signupOrderStatsListenerAttached = true;
        database.ref('user_order_stats').on('value', snap => { _signupOrderStatsCache = snap.val() || {}; rebuildAllSignupUsers(); });
      }
    }

    let _signupRegUsersCache = null;
    let _signupOrderStatsCache = null;

    function rebuildAllSignupUsers() {
      const reg = _signupRegUsersCache || {};
      const stats = _signupOrderStatsCache || {};

      allSignupUsersData = [];

      Object.entries(reg).forEach(([userId,user])=>{user=user&&typeof user==='object'?user:{};
        // Per-user order counts come from the lightweight user_order_stats mirror
        const os = (stats[userId] && typeof stats[userId] === 'object') ? stats[userId] : {};
        const totalOrders = Object.keys(os).reduce((a, k) => a + (Number(os[k]) || 0), 0);

        allSignupUsersData.push({
          uid: userId,
          name: user.name || 'Unknown',
          email: user.email || '',
          phone: user.mobile || user.phone || 'N/A',
          photoURL: user.photoURL || '',
          balance: Number(user.balance) || 0,
          totalSpent: Number(user.spent || user.totalSpent) || 0,
          createdAt: user.createdAt || 0,
          signupDate: user.signupDate || user.createdAt || 0,
          loginMethod: user.loginMethod || user.authProvider || 'Email',
          lastLogin: user.lastLogin || null,
          totalOrders,
          pendingOrders: Number(os.pending) || 0,
          processingOrders: Number(os.processing) || 0,
          completedOrders: Number(os.completed) || 0,
          rejectedOrders: (Number(os.rejected) || 0) + (Number(os.cancelled) || 0)
        });
      });

      // Sort by signup date — newest to oldest (most recently registered user shown first)
      allSignupUsersData.sort((a, b) => b.signupDate - a.signupDate);

      // Re-apply any active search filter, keeping the newest-first order
      filteredSignupUsers = searchAllSignupUsersActiveTerm
        ? applySignupUserSearch(allSignupUsersData, searchAllSignupUsersActiveTerm)
        : [...allSignupUsersData];

      // Reset to page 1 only on a fresh load (not on every real-time update)
      if (!_signupUsersLoadedOnce) {
        currentPage = 1;
        _signupUsersLoadedOnce = true;
      }

      // Update stats
      const totalEl = document.getElementById('totalSignupUsers');
      if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = allSignupUsersData.length;

      // Display current page (real-time refresh)
      displayAllSignupUsers();
    }

    let _signupUsersLoadedOnce = false;
    let searchAllSignupUsersActiveTerm = '';

    // Shared search logic (used both on filter input and on real-time refresh)
    function applySignupUserSearch(list, search) {
      return list.filter(user => {
        return (
          user.name.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
          user.email.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
          user.phone.includes(search) ||
          user.loginMethod.toLowerCase().includes(search)
        );
      });
    }

    // Display All Signup Users with Pagination
    function displayAllSignupUsers() {
      const container = document.getElementById('allSignupUsersContainer');
      
      if (filteredSignupUsers.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">👤</div><div class="empty-text">No signup users found</div></div>';
        document.getElementById('paginationControls').style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      // Calculate pagination (respects the "Show all" toggle)
      const perPage = showAllSignupUsers ? Infinity : usersPerPage;
      const totalPages = showAllSignupUsers ? 1 : Math.ceil(filteredSignupUsers.length / perPage);
      const safePage = Math.min(Math.max(1, currentPage), Math.max(1, totalPages));
      currentPage = safePage;
      const startIndex = showAllSignupUsers ? 0 : (safePage - 1) * perPage;
      const endIndex = showAllSignupUsers ? filteredSignupUsers.length : startIndex + perPage;
      const currentUsers = filteredSignupUsers.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

      // Update pagination info
      document.getElementById('currentPageNumber').textContent = safePage;
      document.getElementById('totalPagesCount').textContent = totalPages;
      document.getElementById('totalPagesDisplay').textContent = totalPages;
      document.getElementById('jumpToPage').value = safePage;
      document.getElementById('jumpToPage').max = totalPages;

      // Enable/disable pagination buttons
      document.getElementById('prevPageBtn').disabled = safePage === 1;
      document.getElementById('nextPageBtn').disabled = safePage === totalPages;

      // Show pagination controls (hidden when "Show all" is on)
      document.getElementById('paginationControls').style.display = showAllSignupUsers ? 'none' : 'block';

      // Build table HTML
      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table">';
      html += '<thead><tr>';
      html += '<th>#</th>';
      html += '<th>Photo</th>';
      html += '<th>Name</th>';
      html += '<th>Email</th>';
      html += '<th>Phone</th>';
      html += '<th>Login Method</th>';
      html += '<th>Balance</th>';
      html += '<th>Total Spent</th>';
      html += '<th>Orders (Total/Pending/Processing/Completed/Rejected)</th>';
      html += '<th>Signup Date</th>';
      html += '<th>Last Login</th>';
      html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      currentUsers.forEach((user, index) => {
        const globalIndex = startIndex + index + 1;
        
        const signupDate = new Date(user.signupDate);
        const formattedSignupDate = user.signupDate
          ? signupDate.toLocaleString('en-IN', { 
              day: '2-digit', 
              month: 'short',
              year: 'numeric',
              hour: '2-digit',
              minute: '2-digit',
              hour12: true
            })
          : 'Unknown';

        let lastLoginFormatted = 'Never';
        if (user.lastLogin) {
          const lastLoginDate = new Date(user.lastLogin);
          lastLoginFormatted = lastLoginDate.toLocaleString('en-IN', { 
            day: '2-digit', 
            month: 'short',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            hour12: true
          });
        }

        // Login method badge color
        let methodColor = 'var(--primary-color)';
        if (user.loginMethod.toLowerCase().includes('google')) {
          methodColor = '#ea4335';
        } else if (user.loginMethod.toLowerCase().includes('gmail')) {
          methodColor = '#4285f4';
        }

        // 📷 Profile photo (Google DP) — image with a graceful fallback avatar
        const avatarHTML = user.photoURL
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttr(user.photoURL)}" alt="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" style="width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:2px solid var(--border-color);" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'),{style:'width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#22d3ee);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;',textContent:'${escapeAttr((user.name||'?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()||'?')}'}));">`
          : `<span style="width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#22d3ee);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;">${escapeHTML((user.name||'?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()||'?')}</span>`;

        html += `
          <tr>
            <td><strong style="color: var(--primary-color);">${globalIndex}</strong></td>
            <td style="text-align:center;">${avatarHTML}</td>
            <td><strong>${escapeHTML(user.name)}</strong></td>
            <td>
              ${user.email ? escapeHTML(user.email) : `
                <span style="color: var(--error); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;">⚠️ Missing</span>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:3px 8px;font-size:10px;margin-left:4px;" onclick="openEditUserProfileById('${escapeAttr(user.uid)}')">Fix</button>
              `}
            </td>
            <td>${user.phone}</td>
            <td><span style="background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: ${methodColor};">${escapeHTML(user.loginMethod)}</span></td>
            <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${user.balance.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--warning); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${user.totalSpent.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td style="font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap;">
              <strong>${user.totalOrders}</strong> total
              <br>⏳ ${user.pendingOrders} • ⚙️ ${user.processingOrders} • ✅ ${user.completedOrders} • ❌ ${user.rejectedOrders}
            </td>
            <td>${formattedSignupDate}</td>
            <td style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-gray);">${lastLoginFormatted}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });

      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Go to Next Page
    function goToNextPage() {
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredSignupUsers.length / usersPerPage);
      if (currentPage < totalPages) {
        currentPage++;
        displayAllSignupUsers();
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }

    // Go to Previous Page
    function goToPreviousPage() {
      if (currentPage > 1) {
        currentPage--;
        displayAllSignupUsers();
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }

    // Jump to Specific Page
    function jumpToSpecificPage() {
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredSignupUsers.length / usersPerPage);
      const pageInput = document.getElementById('jumpToPage');
      let newPage = parseInt(pageInput.value);

      if (newPage < 1) newPage = 1;
      if (newPage > totalPages) newPage = totalPages;

      pageInput.value = newPage;
      currentPage = newPage;
      displayAllSignupUsers();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Filter All Signup Users
    function filterAllSignupUsers() {
      const search = document.getElementById('searchAllSignupUsers').value.toLowerCase();
      searchAllSignupUsersActiveTerm = search; // remember across real-time refreshes

      filteredSignupUsers = search
        ? applySignupUserSearch(allSignupUsersData, search)
        : [...allSignupUsersData];

      // Reset to page 1 when filtering
      currentPage = 1;
      displayAllSignupUsers();
    }

    // Refresh All Signup Users
    function refreshAllSignupUsers() {
      loadAllSignupUsers();
      showToast('All signup users refreshed!', 'success');
    }

    // 📜 Toggle "Show all users on one page" (no pagination)
    function toggleShowAllSignupUsers() {
      showAllSignupUsers = document.getElementById('showAllSignupUsersToggle').checked === true;
      currentPage = 1;
      displayAllSignupUsers();
    }

    // Load Users (🩹 UNION of 'users' + 'registered_users' so no account is missed)
    let _usersPageRegCache = null;
    function loadUsers() {
      // ⚡ v25.2: lightweight registered_users mirror — no full users download.
      onRegisteredUsersDataUpdate(reg => { _usersPageRegCache = reg || {}; rebuildUsersPage(); });
    }
    function rebuildUsersPage() {
      const reg = _usersPageRegCache || {};
      allUsers = Object.entries(reg).filter(([,user]) => user && typeof user === 'object').map(([uid, user]) => ({ uid, ...user }));
      displayUsers(allUsers);
    }

    // Display Users
    function displayUsers(users) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('usersTableBody');
      
      if (users.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">👥</div><div class="empty-text">No users found</div></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      // Newest → oldest (same order as "All Signup Users")
      const sorted = [...users].sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));

      let html = '';
      sorted.forEach(user => {
        const emailMissing = !user.email;
        const initial = (user.name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
        const avatarHTML = user.photoURL
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttr(user.photoURL)}" alt="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:2px solid var(--border-color);" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'),{style:'width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#22d3ee);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;',textContent:'${escapeAttr(initial)}'}));">`
          : `<span style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#22d3ee);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;">${escapeHTML(initial)}</span>`;
        html += `
          <tr>
            <td>#${(user.uid||'').substring(0, 8).toUpperCase()}</td>
            <td style="text-align:center;">${avatarHTML}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(user.name||'N/A')}</td>
            <td>${emailMissing ? '<span style="color: var(--error); font-weight: 600;">⚠️ Missing</span>' : escapeHTML(user.email)}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(user.mobile||'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${(user.balance || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--primary-color); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${(user.spent || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${new Date(user.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</td>
            <td>
              <div class="action-buttons">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openEditBalanceModal('${user.uid}', ${user.balance || 0})">💰 Balance</button>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openEditUserProfileById('${escapeAttr(user.uid)}')">✏️ Profile</button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="deleteUserSafe('${escapeAttr(user.uid)}')">🗑️</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Filter Users
    function filterUsers() {
      const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchUsers').value.toLowerCase();
      const filtered = allUsers.filter(user => 
        (user.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
        (user.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
      );
      displayUsers(filtered);
    }

    // Refresh Users
    function refreshUsers() {
      loadUsers();
      showToast('Users refreshed successfully!', 'success');
    }

    // Open Edit Balance Modal
    function openEditBalanceModal(userId, currentBalance) {
      document.getElementById('editBalanceUserId').value = userId;
      document.getElementById('currentBalance').value = `₹ ${currentBalance.toFixed(2)}`;
      document.getElementById('editBalanceModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Open Edit User Profile Modal — used to fix name/email/mobile
    // (mainly for older accounts where Google Sign-In didn't save email correctly)
    function openEditUserProfileById(uid){const user=(allUsers||[]).find(x=>(x.uid||x.id)===uid);if(user)openEditUserProfileModal(user);}
    function deleteUserSafe(uid){const user=(allUsers||[]).find(x=>(x.uid||x.id)===uid);deleteUser(uid,cleanPersonName(user?.name||'this user'));}

    function openEditUserProfileModal(user) {
      document.getElementById('editProfileUserId').value = user.uid;
      document.getElementById('editProfileName').value = user.name || '';
      document.getElementById('editProfileEmail').value = user.email || '';
      document.getElementById('editProfileMobile').value = user.mobile || '';
      document.getElementById('editUserProfileModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Save the corrected profile fields directly to the database
    async function updateUserProfile(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const btn = event.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      const old = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      const data = {
        uid: document.getElementById('editProfileUserId').value,
        name: cleanPersonName(document.getElementById('editProfileName').value),
        email: document.getElementById('editProfileEmail').value.trim(),
        mobile: document.getElementById('editProfileMobile').value.trim()
      };
      if (!data.name || !data.email) return showToast('Name and Email are required!', 'error');
      try {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Updating Auth + Profile…'; }
        await callSecureAdminFunction('adminUpdateUserIdentity', data);
        showToast('✅ Database profile email/name updated. In No-Deploy mode the Firebase Auth login email remains unchanged.', 'success');
        closeModal('editUserProfileModal');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ ' + error.message, 'error');
      } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = old; }
      }
    }

    // Update User Balance
    async function updateUserBalance(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      
      const userId = document.getElementById('editBalanceUserId').value;
      const action = document.getElementById('balanceAction').value;
      const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('balanceAmount').value);

      if (!amount || amount <= 0) {
        return showToast('Please enter valid amount!', 'error');
      }

      try {
        const balanceRef = database.ref(`users/${userId}/balance`);
        const snapshot = await balanceRef.once('value');
        const currentBalance = snapshot.val() || 0;

        let newBalance = currentBalance;
        if (action === 'add') {
          newBalance = currentBalance + amount;
        } else if (action === 'deduct') {
          newBalance = currentBalance - amount;
          if (newBalance < 0) newBalance = 0;
        } else if (action === 'set') {
          newBalance = amount;
        }

        await balanceRef.set(newBalance);
        mirrorUserWallet(userId);
        showToast(`Balance updated successfully! New balance: ₹${newBalance.toFixed(2)}`, 'success');
        closeModal('editBalanceModal');
        document.getElementById('editBalanceForm').reset();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to update balance!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Delete User
    async function deleteUser(userId, userName) {
      if (!confirm(`Permanently delete “${userName}”?\n\nThis securely deletes Firebase Authentication plus profile, orders, tickets, notifications, panel orders and indices. This cannot be undone.`)) return;
      try {
        showToast('⏳ Securely deleting Auth account and all related data…', 'warning');
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminDeleteUser', { uid: userId });
        showToast(`✅ User data removed and account blocked (${result.removed || 0} paths). Firebase Auth record remains in No-Deploy mode but cannot enter the panel.`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Complete user deletion failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }
