    const SERVICE_LOGO_KEYS=Object.freeze(['none',...Object.keys(SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS)]);
    function getServiceLogoHTML(logo){
      const key=String(logo||'none').trim().toLowerCase(),entry=SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS[key];if(!entry)return '';
      return `<span class="svc-logo-badge svc-logo-${escapeAttr(key)}" style="background:${entry.bg}" title="${escapeAttr(entry.label)}" aria-label="${escapeAttr(entry.label)} logo">${entry.svg}</span>`;
    }
    function serviceLogoOptionsHTML(selected='none'){return SERVICE_LOGO_KEYS.map(k=>`<option value="${escapeAttr(k)}"${k===selected?' selected':''}>${k==='none'?'None':SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS[k].label}</option>`).join('');}


    function updateAdminServiceLogoPreview(mode){const id=mode==='edit'?'editServiceLogo':'newServiceLogo',box=document.getElementById(id+'Preview'),key=document.getElementById(id)?.value||'none';if(box)box.innerHTML=getServiceLogoHTML(key)+(key==='none'?'<span>No platform logo selected</span>':`<strong>${escapeHTML(SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS[key]?.label||key)}</strong>`);}
    // Load Services
    function loadServices() {
      database.ref('services').on('value', snapshot => {
        const services = snapshot.val() || {};
        displayServices(services);
      });
    }

    // Display Services — XSS-safe, live ordered, drag/drop + ↑↓ + position.
    function serviceSortRows(obj){return Object.entries(obj||{}).filter(([,v])=>v&&typeof v==='object').map(([id,v])=>({id,...v,order:Number.isFinite(Number(v.order))?Number(v.order):999999})).sort((x,y)=>(x.order-y.order)||((x.createdAt||0)-(y.createdAt||0))||x.id.localeCompare(y.id));}
    function displayServices(services) {
      const container=document.getElementById('servicesContainer');services=services&&typeof services==='object'?services:{};window._adminServicesById=services;
      const servicesArray=serviceSortRows(services);if(!servicesArray.length){container.innerHTML='<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">📦</div><div class="empty-text">No services found</div><div class="empty-text" style="font-size:14px;margin-top:10px;">Click “Add New Service” to create your first service</div></div>';return;}
      let html='<div style="margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;"><button class="btn btn-success" onclick="saveAllServiceOrders()">💾 Save Positions</button><span class="form-info" style="align-self:center;">Drag cards, use ↑↓, or enter a position number.</span></div>';
      servicesArray.forEach((service,index)=>{
        const sid=escapeAttr(service.id),packages=service.packages&&typeof service.packages==='object'?service.packages:{},packagesArray=serviceSortRows(packages),logo=getServiceLogoHTML(service.logo),name=escapeHTML(service.name||'Unnamed Service');
        html+=`<div class="service-list-item service-sort-card" draggable="true" data-service-id="${sid}" ondragstart="adminServiceDragStart(event,'${sid}')" ondragover="event.preventDefault()" ondrop="adminServiceDrop(event,'${sid}')">
          <div class="service-drag-handle" title="Drag to reorder">⋮⋮</div>
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:15px;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;min-width:240px;">${logo||`<span style="font-size:30px">${escapeHTML(service.icon||'📱')}</span>`}<div><h3 style="color:var(--primary-color);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:4px;">${name}</h3><p style="color:var(--text-gray);font-size:12px;">${packagesArray.length} packages · position ${index}</p></div></div>
            <div class="service-admin-actions"><label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray);">Position</label><input type="number" class="order-input service-order-input" data-service-id="${sid}" value="${index}" min="0"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="moveService('${sid}',-1)" title="Move up">↑</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="moveService('${sid}',1)" title="Move down">↓</button><label class="toggle-switch"><input type="checkbox" ${service.enabled!==false?'checked':''} onchange="toggleService('${sid}',this.checked)"><span class="toggle-slider"></span></label><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openEditServiceById('${sid}')">✏️ Edit</button><button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="openAddPackageModal('${sid}')">➕ Package</button><button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="deleteServiceSafe('${sid}')">🗑️</button></div>
          </div>`;
        if(packagesArray.length){html+=`<div class="package-sort-list" data-service-id="${sid}" style="margin-left:24px;border-top:2px solid var(--border-color);padding-top:12px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;"><h4 style="color:var(--text-gray);">📦 Packages</h4><button class="btn btn-success" onclick="savePackageOrders('${sid}')">💾 Save Package Positions</button></div>`;
          packagesArray.forEach((pkg,pi)=>{const pid=escapeAttr(pkg.id),qty=Number(pkg.quantity)||1000,rate=Number(pkg.pricePerK||0)/qty,base=Number(pkg.basePricePerK)||Number(pkg.pricePerK)||0,mt=pkg.marginType||'none',mv=Number(pkg.marginValue)||0;let marginTxt='Margin: none';if(mt==='percent'&&mv>0)marginTxt=`Margin: +${mv}%`;else if(mt==='fixed'&&mv>0)marginTxt=`Margin: +₹${mv.toFixed(4)}`;html+=`<div class="package-list-item package-sort-card" draggable="true" data-service-id="${sid}" data-package-id="${pid}" ondragstart="adminPackageDragStart(event,'${sid}','${pid}')" ondragover="event.preventDefault()" ondrop="adminPackageDrop(event,'${sid}','${pid}')"><div class="package-drag-handle">⋮⋮</div><div style="flex:1;min-width:240px;"><div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text-white);">${escapeHTML(pkg.name||'Unnamed Package')}</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray);">Base: ₹${base.toFixed(4)} · ${marginTxt} · <strong style="color:var(--success);">Final: ₹${Number(pkg.pricePerK||0).toFixed(4)}</strong></div><div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray);">Rate: ₹${rate.toFixed(4)}/unit · Qty: ${qty} · Min: ${Number(pkg.min)||0} · Max: ${Number(pkg.max)||0} · ${escapeHTML(pkg.avgTime||'N/A')}</div></div><div class="package-admin-actions"><input type="number" class="order-input package-order-input" data-service-id="${sid}" data-package-id="${pid}" value="${pi}" min="0"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="movePackage('${sid}','${pid}',-1)">↑</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="movePackage('${sid}','${pid}',1)">↓</button><label class="toggle-switch"><input type="checkbox" ${pkg.enabled!==false?'checked':''} onchange="togglePackage('${sid}','${pid}',this.checked)"><span class="toggle-slider"></span></label><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openEditPackageById('${sid}','${pid}')">✏️</button><button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="deletePackageSafe('${sid}','${pid}')">🗑️</button></div></div>`;});html+='</div>';}
        html+='</div>';
      });container.innerHTML=html;
    }
    function openEditServiceById(id){const s=window._adminServicesById?.[id];if(s)openEditServiceModal({id,...s});}
    function openEditPackageById(serviceId,packageId){const pkg=window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages?.[packageId];if(pkg)openEditPackageModal(serviceId,{id:packageId,...pkg});}
    function deleteServiceSafe(id){deleteService(id,window._adminServicesById?.[id]?.name||'this service');}
    function deletePackageSafe(serviceId,packageId){deletePackage(serviceId,packageId,window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages?.[packageId]?.name||'this package');}
    async function persistServiceSequence(ids){const up={};ids.forEach((id,i)=>up[`services/${id}/order`]=i);await database.ref().update(up);}
    async function persistPackageSequence(serviceId,ids){const up={};ids.forEach((id,i)=>up[`services/${serviceId}/packages/${id}/order`]=i);await database.ref().update(up);}
    async function moveService(id,delta){const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById).map(x=>x.id),from=ids.indexOf(id),to=Math.max(0,Math.min(ids.length-1,from+delta));if(from<0||from===to)return;ids.splice(to,0,ids.splice(from,1)[0]);try{await persistServiceSequence(ids);showToast('Service position updated live.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Position update failed: '+e.message,'error');}}
    async function movePackage(serviceId,id,delta){const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages).map(x=>x.id),from=ids.indexOf(id),to=Math.max(0,Math.min(ids.length-1,from+delta));if(from<0||from===to)return;ids.splice(to,0,ids.splice(from,1)[0]);try{await persistPackageSequence(serviceId,ids);showToast('Package position updated live.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Position update failed: '+e.message,'error');}}
    let draggedServiceId='',draggedPackage=null;
    function adminServiceDragStart(e,id){draggedServiceId=id;e.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain',id);if(e.dataTransfer)e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';}
    async function adminServiceDrop(e,target){e.preventDefault();const source=draggedServiceId||e.dataTransfer?.getData('text/plain');draggedServiceId='';if(!source||source===target)return;const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById).map(x=>x.id),from=ids.indexOf(source),to=ids.indexOf(target);if(from<0||to<0)return;ids.splice(to,0,ids.splice(from,1)[0]);try{await persistServiceSequence(ids);showToast('Service reordered live.','success');}catch(err){showToast('Drag reorder failed: '+err.message,'error');}}
    function adminPackageDragStart(e,serviceId,id){draggedPackage={serviceId,id};e.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain',id);}
    async function adminPackageDrop(e,serviceId,target){e.preventDefault();const d=draggedPackage;draggedPackage=null;if(!d||d.serviceId!==serviceId||d.id===target)return;const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages).map(x=>x.id),from=ids.indexOf(d.id),to=ids.indexOf(target);if(from<0||to<0)return;ids.splice(to,0,ids.splice(from,1)[0]);try{await persistPackageSequence(serviceId,ids);showToast('Package reordered live.','success');}catch(err){showToast('Drag reorder failed: '+err.message,'error');}}


    // Open Add Service Modal
    function openAddServiceModal() {
      document.getElementById('addServiceForm').reset();document.getElementById('newServiceOrder').value=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById).length;document.getElementById('newServiceLogo').value='none';updateAdminServiceLogoPreview('new');document.getElementById('addServiceModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Add New Service
    async function addNewService(event) {
      event.preventDefault();const name=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('newServiceName').value,120),icon=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('newServiceIcon').value,8)||'📱',enabled=document.getElementById('newServiceEnabled').checked,logoRaw=document.getElementById('newServiceLogo').value,logo=SERVICE_LOGO_KEYS.includes(logoRaw)?logoRaw:'none';
      if(!name)return showToast('Please enter a safe service name!','error');
      try{const rows=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById),desired=Math.max(0,Math.min(rows.length,parseInt(document.getElementById('newServiceOrder').value)||0)),ref=database.ref('services').push(),ids=rows.map(x=>x.id);ids.splice(desired,0,ref.key);const updates={};ids.forEach((id,i)=>{if(id!==ref.key)updates[`services/${id}/order`]=i;});updates[`services/${ref.key}`]={name,icon,logo,enabled,order:desired,createdAt:Date.now(),platform:((window.TSMX&&TSMX.pickedPlatform)?TSMX.pickedPlatform('new'):'')||null};await database.ref().update(updates);showToast('Service inserted at position '+desired+' and published live.','success');closeModal('addServiceModal');event.target.reset();}catch(error){showToast('Failed to add service: '+error.message,'error');}
    }

    // Toggle Service
    async function toggleService(serviceId, enabled) {
      try {
        await database.ref(`services/${serviceId}/enabled`).set(enabled);
        showToast(`Service ${enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'} successfully!`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to update service!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Delete Service
    async function deleteService(serviceId, serviceName) {
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete service "${serviceName}" and all its packages?`)) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        await database.ref(`services/${serviceId}`).remove();
        showToast('Service deleted successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to delete service!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Open Add Package Modal
    function openAddPackageModal(serviceId) {
      document.getElementById('addPackageForm').reset();document.getElementById('packageServiceId').value=serviceId;document.getElementById('newPackageOrder').value=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages).length;document.getElementById('newPackageQuantity').value=1000;document.getElementById('newPackageEnabled').checked=true;updateAddPackageFinalPreview();document.getElementById('addPackageModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Add New Package
    // ── 📈 MARGIN ENGINE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Base cost + margin (percent or fixed ₹) = FINAL selling price that is
    // stored in `pricePerK` and shown to users. Base/margin are kept as extra
    // fields so the Admin can always see exactly what margin is on which
    // package. All amounts use 4-decimal precision.
    function round4(x){return Math.round((Number(x)||0)*10000)/10000;}
    function computeFinalPricePerK(base, type, value){
      base=Number(base)||0; value=Math.max(0,Number(value)||0);
      if(type==='percent') return round4(base*(1+value/100));
      if(type==='fixed') return round4(base+value);
      return round4(base);
    }
    function readPackageMarginFields(prefix){
      const base=Number(String((document.getElementById(prefix+'Price')||{}).value||'').replace(/[,\s_]/g,''));
      const type=document.getElementById(prefix+'MarginType').value||'none';
      const value=Number(document.getElementById(prefix+'MarginValue').value)||0;
      return {base,type,value};
    }
    function updateAddPackageFinalPreview(){const m=readPackageMarginFields('newPackage');const el=document.getElementById('newPackageFinalPreview');if(el)el.textContent='₹ '+computeFinalPricePerK(m.base,m.type,m.value).toFixed(4);}
    function updateEditPackageFinalPreview(){const m=readPackageMarginFields('editPackage');const el=document.getElementById('editPackageFinalPreview');if(el)el.textContent='₹ '+computeFinalPricePerK(m.base,m.type,m.value).toFixed(4);}

    async function addNewPackage(event) {
      event.preventDefault();const _pn=id=>{const r=String((document.getElementById(id)||{}).value||'').replace(/[,\s_]/g,'');return r===''?NaN:Number(r);};const serviceId=document.getElementById('packageServiceId').value,name=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('newPackageName').value,220),quantity=Math.max(1,Math.round(_pn('newPackageQuantity'))||1000),min=Math.round(_pn('newPackageMin')),max=Math.round(_pn('newPackageMax')),avgTime=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('newPackageTime').value,100),description=cleanMultilineText(document.getElementById('newPackageDesc').value,5000),enabled=document.getElementById('newPackageEnabled').checked,cancelable=document.getElementById('newPackageCancelable').checked,refillable=document.getElementById('newPackageRefillable').checked;
      const m=readPackageMarginFields('newPackage');const finalPrice=computeFinalPricePerK(m.base,m.type,m.value);
      if(!serviceId||!name||!Number.isFinite(m.base)||m.base<0||!Number.isFinite(min)||!Number.isFinite(max)||!avgTime)return showToast('Please fill all required fields correctly. Use 0.0000 to make this package FREE.','error');if(min>max)return showToast('Minimum quantity cannot be greater than maximum quantity.','error');
      try{const rows=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages),desired=Math.max(0,Math.min(rows.length,parseInt(document.getElementById('newPackageOrder').value)||0)),ref=database.ref(`services/${serviceId}/packages`).push(),ids=rows.map(x=>x.id);ids.splice(desired,0,ref.key);const updates={};ids.forEach((id,i)=>{if(id!==ref.key)updates[`services/${serviceId}/packages/${id}/order`]=i;});updates[`services/${serviceId}/packages/${ref.key}`]={...(window.TSMX&&TSMX.collectPkgExtras?TSMX.collectPkgExtras('newPackage'):{}),name,pricePerK:finalPrice,basePricePerK:m.base,marginType:m.type,marginValue:m.value,quantity,min,max,avgTime,description,enabled,cancelable,refillable,order:desired,createdAt:Date.now()};await database.ref().update(updates);showToast('Package inserted at position '+desired+' and published live.','success');closeModal('addPackageModal');event.target.reset();updateAddPackageFinalPreview();}catch(error){showToast('Failed to add package: '+error.message,'error');}
    }

    }

    // Update Service
    async function updateService(event) {
      event.preventDefault();const serviceId=document.getElementById('editServiceIdField').value,logoRaw=document.getElementById('editServiceLogo').value,name=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('editServiceName').value,120),icon=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('editServiceIcon').value,8)||'📱',desired=Math.max(0,parseInt(document.getElementById('editServiceOrder').value)||0);if(!name)return showToast('Safe service name is required.','error');
      try{await database.ref(`services/${serviceId}`).update({name,icon,logo:SERVICE_LOGO_KEYS.includes(logoRaw)?logoRaw:'none',platform:((window.TSMX&&TSMX.pickedPlatform)?TSMX.pickedPlatform('edit'):'')||null});const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById).map(x=>x.id).filter(id=>id!==serviceId);ids.splice(Math.min(desired,ids.length),0,serviceId);await persistServiceSequence(ids);showToast('Service updated and reordered live.','success');closeModal('editServiceModal');}catch(error){showToast('Failed to update service: '+error.message,'error');}
    }


    // Open Edit Package Modal
    function openEditPackageModal(serviceId, pkg) {
      document.getElementById('editPackageServiceId').value = serviceId;
      document.getElementById('editPackageId').value = pkg.id;
      document.getElementById('editPackageName').value = pkg.name || '';
      // 🩹 Base cost = basePricePerK when present (new), else fall back to pricePerK
      document.getElementById('editPackagePrice').value = (pkg.basePricePerK ?? pkg.pricePerK) || '';
      document.getElementById('editPackageMarginType').value = pkg.marginType || 'none';
      document.getElementById('editPackageMarginValue').value = pkg.marginValue || '';
      updateEditPackageFinalPreview();
      document.getElementById('editPackageQuantity').value = pkg.quantity || 1000;
      document.getElementById('editPackageMin').value = pkg.min || '';
      document.getElementById('editPackageMax').value = pkg.max || '';
      document.getElementById('editPackageTime').value = pkg.avgTime || '';
      document.getElementById('editPackageDesc').value = pkg.description || '';
      document.getElementById('editPackageCancelable').checked = !!pkg.cancelable;
      document.getElementById('editPackageRefillable').checked=!!pkg.refillable;document.getElementById('editPackageOrder').value=Number.isFinite(Number(pkg.order))?Number(pkg.order):0;document.getElementById('editPackageModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Update Package
    async function updatePackage(event) {
      event.preventDefault();const _pn=id=>{const r=String((document.getElementById(id)||{}).value||'').replace(/[,\s_]/g,'');return r===''?NaN:Number(r);};const serviceId=document.getElementById('editPackageServiceId').value,packageId=document.getElementById('editPackageId').value,name=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('editPackageName').value,220),quantity=Math.max(1,Math.round(_pn('editPackageQuantity'))||1000),min=Math.round(_pn('editPackageMin')),max=Math.round(_pn('editPackageMax')),avgTime=cleanPlainText(document.getElementById('editPackageTime').value,100),description=cleanMultilineText(document.getElementById('editPackageDesc').value,5000),desired=Math.max(0,parseInt(document.getElementById('editPackageOrder').value)||0);
      const m=readPackageMarginFields('editPackage');const finalPrice=computeFinalPricePerK(m.base,m.type,m.value);
      if(!name||!Number.isFinite(m.base)||m.base<0||!Number.isFinite(min)||!Number.isFinite(max)||min>max)return showToast('Check the package name, price and Min/Max. Minimum may EQUAL Maximum for a fixed-quantity package. Use 0.0000 for a FREE package.','error');
      try{await database.ref(`services/${serviceId}/packages/${packageId}`).update({...(window.TSMX&&TSMX.collectPkgExtras?TSMX.collectPkgExtras('editPackage'):{}),name,pricePerK:finalPrice,basePricePerK:m.base,marginType:m.type,marginValue:m.value,quantity,min,max,avgTime,description,cancelable:document.getElementById('editPackageCancelable').checked,refillable:document.getElementById('editPackageRefillable').checked});const ids=serviceSortRows(window._adminServicesById?.[serviceId]?.packages).map(x=>x.id).filter(id=>id!==packageId);ids.splice(Math.min(desired,ids.length),0,packageId);await persistPackageSequence(serviceId,ids);showToast('Package updated and reordered live.','success');closeModal('editPackageModal');}catch(error){showToast('Failed to update package: '+error.message,'error');}
    }
    // Save All Service Orders
    async function saveAllServiceOrders(){const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.service-order-input')].map((el,i)=>({id:el.dataset.serviceId,pos:parseInt(el.value)||0,i})).sort((x,y)=>(x.pos-y.pos)||(x.i-y.i));try{await persistServiceSequence(rows.map(x=>x.id));showToast('All service positions normalized and saved live.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Failed to save service positions: '+e.message,'error');}}


    // Save Package Orders for a specific service
    async function savePackageOrders(serviceId){const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll(`.package-order-input[data-service-id="${serviceId}"]`)].map((el,i)=>({id:el.dataset.packageId,pos:parseInt(el.value)||0,i})).sort((x,y)=>(x.pos-y.pos)||(x.i-y.i));try{await persistPackageSequence(serviceId,rows.map(x=>x.id));showToast('Package positions normalized and saved live.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Failed to save package positions: '+e.message,'error');}}


    // Load Orders
    // 🔔 Live-mirror of admin_notifications (e.g. new panel-order alerts sent
    // by the user panel) — keeps the "Panel Orders" sidebar badge accurate.
    // This is what actually SURFACES those notifications in the Admin UI —
    // previously they were written to the database but never displayed anywhere.
    function loadAdminNotificationsBadge() {
      database.ref('admin_notifications').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        const unreadPanelOrders = Object.values(data).filter(n => n.type === 'new_panel_order' && !n.read).length;
        const badgeEl = document.getElementById('sidebarPanelOrderBadge');
        if (badgeEl) {
          if (unreadPanelOrders > 0) { badgeEl.textContent = unreadPanelOrders; badgeEl.style.display = 'inline-block'; }
          else badgeEl.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    // Mark all unread "new panel order" admin notifications as read —
    // called when Admin opens the Panel Orders page.
    async function markPanelOrderNotificationsRead() {
      try {
        const snap = await database.ref('admin_notifications').once('value');
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        const updates = {};
        Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, n]) => {
          if (n.type === 'new_panel_order' && !n.read) updates[`admin_notifications/${key}/read`] = true;
        });
        if (Object.keys(updates).length > 0) {
          await database.ref().update(updates);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error marking panel order notifications read:', error);
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 📋 ORDERS — paginated from the lightweight `orders_index` mirror,
    // NOT from the full 'users' tree. This is the fix for the page
    // crashing at 140k+ orders: the old code downloaded every user's
    // entire order history (tens of MB) and rendered every row into the
    // DOM in one shot. The new code asks Firebase for only the ~100
    // orders that need to be on screen right now, newest first, and
    // fetches older ones on demand ("Load Older"). No matter how large
    // the site grows, this page always opens instantly.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
    let ordersCurrentBatch = [];        // orders on screen right now
    let ordersPageCursors = [null];     // createdAt cursor used to reach each page (index 0 = newest/no cursor)
    let ordersCurrentPageIndex = 0;
    let ordersHasMoreOlder = true;
    let ordersTotalCount = null;          // live total (shallow REST count)
    let _ordersTotalAt = 0;
    let ordersStatusFilterActive = 'all';

    // 🛡️ FALLBACK MODE — if the Firebase rules have no ".indexOn" yet, the
    // server REJECTS orderByChild queries (and the page would break). The
    // fallback pages by PUSH-KEY (orderByKey needs NO index and push keys
    // are chronological) — fast, server-side, no giant downloads. Add the
    // index rules from the README to switch back to full mode.
    let ordersKeyMode = false;
    let ordersKeyCursors = [null];      // first push-key of each visited page
    let ordersFullCache = { at: 0, rows: null };
    let _idxHintShown = false;

    function _firebaseIndexHint(what) {
      if (_idxHintShown) return;
      _idxHintShown = true;
      console.warn('%c⚠️ Firebase ".indexOn" missing for ' + what, 'color:#b45309;font-weight:700',
        '— fallback mode is ON so nothing breaks. For full speed add the index rules from README-SETUP.md.');
    }

    async function _ordersAllRows(force) {
      if (!force && ordersFullCache.rows && (Date.now() - ordersFullCache.at) < 60000) return ordersFullCache.rows;
      const snap = await database.ref('orders_index').once('value');
      const data = snap.val() || {};
      ordersFullCache = { at: Date.now(), rows: Object.entries(data).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o })) };
      return ordersFullCache.rows;
    }

    // Index-free server-side paging via push keys (chronological order).
    async function _ordersPageFallback(err) {
      if (err) console.warn('Orders page: indexed query rejected — switching to key-paging fallback', err.message || err);
      _firebaseIndexHint('orders_index/createdAt');
      ordersKeyMode = true;
      try {
        const cursorKey = ordersKeyCursors[ordersCurrentPageIndex];
        let q = database.ref('orders_index').orderByKey();
        if (cursorKey) q = q.endBefore(cursorKey);
        const snap = await q.limitToLast(ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE + 1).once('value');
        let batch = Object.entries(snap.val() || {}).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }));
        batch.sort(_cmpOrdersDesc);
        ordersHasMoreOlder = batch.length > ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE;
        if (ordersHasMoreOlder) batch = batch.slice(0, ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE);
        ordersCurrentBatch = batch;
        displayOrders(batch);
        updateOrdersPaginationControls();
        refreshOrdersTotalCount(false);
      } catch (e2) {
        console.error('Orders key-paging fallback failed:', e2);
        showToast('Failed to load orders!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Status filter has no key-based alternative → one full read, filtered
    // locally (cached 60s). Runs only while the index rule is missing.
    async function _ordersStatusFallback(status, err) {
      console.warn('Orders status filter: indexed query rejected — using local filter fallback', err && (err.message || err));
      _firebaseIndexHint('orders_index/status');
      try {
        const rows = (await _ordersAllRows())
          .filter(o => (o.status || 'pending') === status)
          .sort((a, b) => ((b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0)) || (a.id < b.id ? 1 : -1))
          .slice(0, 300);
        ordersCurrentBatch = rows;
        ordersHasMoreOlder = false;
        displayOrders(rows);
        updateOrdersPaginationControls();
      } catch (e2) {
        console.error('Orders status fallback failed:', e2);
        showToast('Failed to filter orders!', 'error');
      }
    }

    function loadOrders() {
      ordersStatusFilterActive = 'all';
      document.getElementById('orderStatusFilter').value = 'all';
      document.getElementById('searchOrders').value = '';
      ordersPageCursors = [null];
      ordersCurrentPageIndex = 0;
      ordersKeyMode = false;
      ordersKeyCursors = [null];
      ordersTotalCount = null;
      refreshOrdersTotalCount(true);
      fetchOrdersPage(null);
    }

    // Newest-first comparator, robust to EQUAL timestamps (key tiebreak) —
    // thousands of migrated orders can share the same createdAt millisecond.
    function _cmpOrdersDesc(a, b) {
      return ((b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0)) || (a.id < b.id ? 1 : (a.id > b.id ? -1 : 0));
    }

    // 🔗 Compact link label — domain + first path chunk, ellipsis (like the
    // user panel's compact chips). Full URL stays on hover + copy button.
    function _shortOrderLink(u) {
      try {
        const x = new URL(u);
        let s = x.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
        const p = (x.pathname || '/').split('/').filter(Boolean)[0];
        if (p) s += '/' + p;
        if (s.length > 30) s = s.slice(0, 28) + '…';
        return s;
      } catch (e) {
        return (u && u.length > 32) ? u.slice(0, 30) + '…' : (u || '');
      }
    }

    // 📊 Live total orders (cheap REST shallow count — no big download)
    async function refreshOrdersTotalCount(force) {
      if (!force && ordersTotalCount !== null && (Date.now() - _ordersTotalAt) < 15000) {
        updateOrdersPaginationControls();
        return;
      }
      try {
        if(!auth.currentUser)return;const token=await auth.currentUser.getIdToken();const r=await fetch(firebaseConfig.databaseURL+'/orders_index.json?shallow=true&auth='+encodeURIComponent(token));
        const j = await r.json();
        if (j && typeof j === 'object' && !j.error) {
          ordersTotalCount = Object.keys(j).length;
          _ordersTotalAt = Date.now();
          updateOrdersPaginationControls();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Paged fetch with a COMPOUND cursor (createdAt + push key) — pages are
    // contiguous even when many orders share the same timestamp (v8 fix:
    // the old numeric cursor silently SKIPPED orders with equal createdAt).
    function fetchOrdersPage(cursor) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('ordersTableBody');
      if (ordersKeyMode) { _ordersPageFallback(null); return; }
      if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="13" style="text-align:center;padding:40px;"><div class="loading">Loading orders...</div></td></tr>';

      let query = database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('createdAt');
      if (cursor) query = query.endAt(cursor.ts, cursor.id);

      // PAGE+2 rows: the boundary row (dropped) + one full page + one
      // look-ahead row that answers "is there an older page?".
      query.limitToLast(ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE + 2).once('value').then(snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        let batch = Object.entries(data).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }));
        if (cursor) batch = batch.filter(r => r.id !== cursor.id); // drop boundary
        batch.sort(_cmpOrdersDesc); // newest first on screen, stable on equal ts

        ordersHasMoreOlder = batch.length > ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE;
        if (ordersHasMoreOlder) batch = batch.slice(0, ORDERS_PAGE_SIZE);

        ordersCurrentBatch = batch;
        if (batch.length === 0 && cursor) {
          if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="13" style="text-align:center;padding:34px;color:#64748b;">— End of list — no older orders —</td></tr>';
          ordersHasMoreOlder = false;
        } else {
          displayOrders(batch);
        }
        updateOrdersPaginationControls();
        refreshOrdersTotalCount(false);
      }).catch(err => _ordersPageFallback(err));
    }

    function loadOlderOrders() {
      if (!ordersHasMoreOlder || ordersCurrentBatch.length === 0) return;
      if (ordersKeyMode) {
        const firstKey = ordersCurrentBatch.map(o => o.id).sort()[0];
        if (ordersCurrentPageIndex === ordersKeyCursors.length - 1) ordersKeyCursors.push(firstKey);
        ordersCurrentPageIndex++;
        _ordersPageFallback(null);
        return;
      }
      const oldestOnScreen = ordersCurrentBatch[ordersCurrentBatch.length - 1];
      const cursor = { ts: oldestOnScreen.createdAt || 0, id: oldestOnScreen.id }; // compound — never skips equal timestamps
      if (ordersCurrentPageIndex === ordersPageCursors.length - 1) ordersPageCursors.push(cursor);
      ordersCurrentPageIndex++;
      fetchOrdersPage(ordersPageCursors[ordersCurrentPageIndex]);
    }

    function loadNewerOrders() {
      if (ordersCurrentPageIndex === 0) return;
      ordersCurrentPageIndex--;
      if (ordersKeyMode) { _ordersPageFallback(null); return; }
      fetchOrdersPage(ordersPageCursors[ordersCurrentPageIndex]);
    }

    function updateOrdersPaginationControls() {
      const info = document.getElementById('ordersPaginationInfo');
      const olderBtn = document.getElementById('ordersLoadOlderBtn');
      const newerBtn = document.getElementById('ordersLoadNewerBtn');
      if (olderBtn) olderBtn.disabled = !ordersHasMoreOlder || ordersStatusFilterActive !== 'all';
      if (newerBtn) newerBtn.disabled = ordersCurrentPageIndex === 0 || ordersStatusFilterActive !== 'all';
      if (info) {
        const totalTxt = ' · Standard Orders only';
        info.textContent = ordersStatusFilterActive !== 'all'
          ? `Showing latest ${ordersCurrentBatch.length} "${ordersStatusFilterActive}" orders${totalTxt}`
          : `Page ${ordersCurrentPageIndex + 1} · showing ${ordersCurrentBatch.length}${totalTxt}${ordersKeyMode ? ' · fallback' : ''}`;
      }
    }

    // 🚫 Cancel-request queue — a small, TARGETED index query (only orders
    // where cancelRequested === true), so this is always complete across
    // the whole site — not just whatever happens to be on the currently
    // displayed Orders page — without ever downloading everything.
    let cancelRequestsQueue = [];
    function _applyCancelRequestsData(data) {
      cancelRequestsQueue = Object.entries(data)
        .map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }))
        .filter(o => o.status === 'pending' && o.source !== 'mass' && o.massOrder !== true)
        .sort((a, b) => (b.cancelRequestedAt || b.createdAt || 0) - (a.cancelRequestedAt || a.createdAt || 0));

      const badgeEl = document.getElementById('sidebarOrdersCancelBadge');
      if (badgeEl) {
        if (cancelRequestsQueue.length > 0) { badgeEl.textContent = cancelRequestsQueue.length; badgeEl.style.display = 'inline-block'; }
        else badgeEl.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    function watchCancelRequests() {
      const q = database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('cancelRequested').equalTo(true);
      q.on('value', snap => _applyCancelRequestsData(snap.val() || {}), err => {
        // 🛡️ index missing → plain node watch + client-side filter
        _firebaseIndexHint('orders_index/cancelRequested');
        if (window._cancelPlainWatch) return;
        window._cancelPlainWatch = true;
        try { q.off(); } catch (e) {}
        console.warn('Cancel-requests: indexed watch rejected — plain watch fallback active', err && (err.message || err));
        database.ref('orders_index').on('value', snap => {
          const data = snap.val() || {};
          const filtered = {};
          Object.keys(data).forEach(k => { if (data[k] && data[k].cancelRequested === true) filtered[k] = data[k]; });
          _applyCancelRequestsData(filtered);
        });
      });
    }

    // Quick-filter button: show only pending cancel requests in the main
    // Orders table, regardless of which page was previously open.
    function showCancelRequestsOnly() {
      document.getElementById('orderStatusFilter').value = 'all';
      document.getElementById('searchOrders').value = '';
      ordersStatusFilterActive = 'cancelRequests';
      ordersCurrentBatch = cancelRequestsQueue;
      displayOrders(cancelRequestsQueue);
      updateOrdersPaginationControls();
    }

    // 📋 One-click COPY of the full order link (Orders Management).
    function copyOrderLink(btn) {
      const link = btn.getAttribute('data-link') || '';
      if (!link) return;
      const done = () => {
        const oldTxt = btn.textContent;
        btn.textContent = '✅';
        showToast('📋 Full link copied to clipboard!', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = oldTxt || '📋'; }, 1300);
      };
      const fallback = () => {
        try {
          const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
          ta.value = link;
          ta.style.position = 'fixed';
          ta.style.opacity = '0';
          document.body.appendChild(ta);
          ta.focus();
          ta.select();
          document.execCommand('copy');
          document.body.removeChild(ta);
          done();
        } catch (e) {
          showToast('Copy failed — please long-press the link.', 'error');
        }
      };
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(done).catch(fallback);
      } else {
        fallback();
      }
    }

    // Display Orders
    function displayOrders(orders) {
      // Mass Order lines are managed only on the dedicated Mass Orders page.
      orders = (orders || []).filter(order => order.source !== 'mass' && order.massOrder !== true);
      const tbody = document.getElementById('ordersTableBody');
      
      if (orders.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="12"><div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">📋</div><div class="empty-text">No orders found</div></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      let html = '';
      orders.forEach(order => {
        // Defensive fallbacks — a single malformed order should never break the whole table
        const orderLink=safeExternalUrl(order.link);
        const orderLinkSafe=escapeAttr(orderLink);
        const orderStatus = order.status || 'pending';
        const orderCreatedAt = order.createdAt || Date.now();
        const hasCancelRequest = !!order.cancelRequested && orderStatus === 'pending';

        html += `
          <tr${hasCancelRequest ? ' style="background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08);"' : ''}>
            <td class="cell-order-id">${formatShortId(order, 'orderNumber')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(order.userName || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-gray);">${escapeHTML(order.userEmail || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(order.serviceName || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(order.packageName || 'N/A')}</td>
            <td class="order-link-cell">${orderLink ? `<div class="order-link-wrap2"><a href="${orderLink}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="order-link-short" title="${orderLinkSafe}">${_shortOrderLink(orderLink)}</a><button type="button" class="copy-link-btn" data-link="${orderLinkSafe}" onclick="copyOrderLink(this)" title="Copy full link">📋</button><a href="${orderLink}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="order-open-btn" title="Open link in new tab">🔗</a></div>` : '<span style="color: var(--text-gray); font-size: 11px;">N/A</span>'}</td>
            <td>${order.quantity || 0}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹ ${(order.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>
              <span class="status-badge status-${orderStatus}">${orderStatus}</span>
              ${hasCancelRequest ? '<br><span class="status-badge status-cancel-requested" style="margin-top:4px;">🚫 Cancel Req</span>' : ''}
              ${orderStatus==='rejected'&&order.refundApplied===true?'<br><span class="status-badge" style="margin-top:4px;background:#e0f2fe;color:#0369a1;">💸 Refunded</span>':''}
              ${order.restoredFromRejected===true?'<br><span class="status-badge" style="margin-top:4px;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;">↩️ Restored</span>':''}
            </td>
            <td style="font-size: 11px;">${new Date(orderCreatedAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</td>
            <td>
              <input type="text" class="admin-label-input" value="${(order.adminLabel || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" placeholder="e.g. 1, VIP..." title="Personal note for Admin only — never shown to the user" onblur="saveOrderLabel('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', this.value)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){this.blur();}">
            </td>
            <td>
              <div class="action-buttons">
                ${hasCancelRequest ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="approveCancelRequest('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', ${order.amount || 0})" title="Approve Cancel &amp; Refund">✅ Cancel</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="denyCancelRequest('${order.userId}', '${order.id}')" title="Deny Cancel Request">✖ Deny</button>
                ` : ''}
                ${orderStatus === 'pending' ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="updateOrderStatus('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', 'processing')">⚡</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="updateOrderStatus('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', 'completed')">✅</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="rejectOrder('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', ${order.amount || 0})">❌</button>
                ` : orderStatus === 'processing' ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="updateOrderStatus('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', 'completed')">✅</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="rejectOrder('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', ${order.amount || 0})">❌</button>
                ` : orderStatus === 'completed' ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="updateOrderStatus('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', 'processing')" title="Revert completed order to Processing">↩️</button>
                ` : orderStatus === 'rejected' ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="restoreRejectedOrder('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', ${Number(order.amount)||0})" title="Restore Rejected → Processing and reverse refund">↩️ Processing</button>
                ` : ''}
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="TSMX.opOpen('${order.userId}', '${order.id}', '${order.batchId || ''}')" title="Edit Start, Remains and Target End">📊 Progress</button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="deleteOrder('${order.userId}', '${order.id}')">🗑️</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // 🏷️ Admin-only personal note per order (e.g. a reminder number) —
    // purely for Admin's own reference, never shown anywhere in the user panel.
    async function saveOrderLabel(userId, orderId, value) {
      try {
        await database.ref().update({
          [`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/adminLabel`]: value.trim(),
          [`orders_index/${orderId}/adminLabel`]: value.trim()
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving order label:', error);
      }
    }

    // Filter Orders — search checks the currently-loaded page first (instant),
    // and if the term looks like a full Order ID that isn't on this page, also
    // does a direct order_id_index lookup so ANY specific order can still be
    // found instantly without downloading the other 100k+ orders. Status
    // filter runs a targeted indexed query on orders_index instead of
    // filtering an in-memory full list (which no longer exists).
    async function filterOrders() {
      const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchOrders').value.trim();
      const statusFilter = document.getElementById('orderStatusFilter').value;
      ordersStatusFilterActive = statusFilter;

      if (searchTerm) {
        const lower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        let matches = ordersCurrentBatch.filter(order =>
          order.id.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
          (order.orderNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
          (order.userName || '').toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
          (order.userEmail || '').toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
          (order.serviceName || '').toLowerCase().includes(lower)
        );

        // Looks like an exact Order ID and isn't already in the results?
        // Look it up directly via order_id_index — a single tiny read.
        if (/^\d{4,}$/.test(searchTerm) && !matches.some(o => o.orderNumber === searchTerm)) {
          try {
            const idxSnap = await database.ref('order_id_index/' + searchTerm).once('value');
            if (idxSnap.exists()) {
              const { uid, orderKey } = idxSnap.val();
              const orderSnap = await database.ref(`users/${uid}/orders/${orderKey}`).once('value');
              if (orderSnap.exists()) {
                const userSnap = await database.ref(`users/${uid}`).once('value');
                const u = userSnap.val() || {};
                matches.unshift({ id: orderKey, userId: uid, userName: u.name || 'N/A', userEmail: u.email || 'N/A', ...orderSnap.val() });
              }
            }
          } catch (e) { console.error('Order ID lookup failed:', e); }
        }

        displayOrders(matches);
        return;
      }

      if (statusFilter === 'all') {
        loadOrders();
      } else {
        fetchOrdersByStatus(statusFilter);
      }
    }

    // Status-filtered view: a targeted indexed query, capped at the most
    // recent 300 matches. (Not further paginated for now — 300 rows is
    // still perfectly light for the browser; true multi-page pagination
    // per-status can be added later if a single status ever needs more
    // than that visible at once.)
    function fetchOrdersByStatus(status) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('ordersTableBody');
      if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center;padding:40px;"><div class="loading">Loading ' + status + ' orders...</div></td></tr>';

      database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('status').equalTo(status).limitToLast(300).once('value').then(snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        const batch = Object.entries(data).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }))
          .sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
        ordersCurrentBatch = batch;
        ordersHasMoreOlder = false;
        displayOrders(batch);
        updateOrdersPaginationControls();
      }).catch(err => _ordersStatusFallback(status, err));
    }

    // Refresh Orders
    function refreshOrders() {
      loadOrders();
      showToast('Orders refreshed successfully!', 'success');
    }

    // Update Order Status
    async function updateOrderStatus(userId, orderId, newStatus) {
      try {
        await callSecureAdminFunction('adminUpdateOrderStatus', { uid:userId, orderId, status:newStatus });
        showToast(`✅ Order status updated to ${newStatus}; referral ledger synchronized by the free Worker.`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to update order status: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⚙️ AUTO-COMPLETE PENDING ORDERS (Dashboard button) — the old
    // "Complete All" tried to update every pending/processing order in
    // ONE Firebase call, which is exactly the kind of single giant
    // operation that freezes/crashes the tab once there are thousands
    // of them. This replaces it with a throttled loop: pull a small
    // batch via the indexed orders_index status query, write it, rest a
    // few seconds, repeat — until nothing pending/processing is left.
    // Runs only while THIS browser tab stays open — there's no server
    // here to keep it going after the tab is closed — and can be
    // stopped at any time. NOTE: this only changes the status field in
    // the database; it doesn't deliver anything by itself, so only run
    // it for orders whose service has genuinely already been fulfilled.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE = 40;
    const AUTO_COMPLETE_REST_MS = 4000;
    let autoCompleteRunning = false;
    let autoCompleteStats = { done: 0 };

    async function toggleAutoCompletePending() {
      if (autoCompleteRunning) {
        autoCompleteRunning = false;
        updateAutoCompleteUI('stopped');
        return;
      }

      if (!confirm('This will mark every pending/processing order as COMPLETED, in small batches, running in the background while this tab stays open. Only continue if these orders have genuinely already been fulfilled. Continue?')) {
        return;
      }

      autoCompleteRunning = true;
      autoCompleteStats = { done: 0 };
      updateAutoCompleteUI('running');
      runAutoCompleteLoop();
    }

    async function runAutoCompleteLoop() {
      while (autoCompleteRunning) {
        let batch = [];
        try {
          const pendingSnap = await database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('status').equalTo('pending').limitToFirst(AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE).once('value');
          batch = Object.entries(pendingSnap.val() || {}).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }));

          if (batch.length < AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE) {
            const processingSnap = await database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('status').equalTo('processing').limitToFirst(AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE - batch.length).once('value');
            batch = batch.concat(Object.entries(processingSnap.val() || {}).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o })));
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // 🛡️ FALLBACK: no status index → page recent keys and filter locally
          _firebaseIndexHint('orders_index/status');
          console.warn('Auto-complete: indexed fetch rejected — key-window fallback active', e && (e.message || e));
          try {
            const snap2 = await database.ref('orders_index').orderByKey().limitToLast(4000).once('value');
            const rows = Object.entries(snap2.val() || {}).map(([id, o]) => ({ id, ...o }));
            const pend = rows.filter(o => (o.status || 'pending') === 'pending').slice(0, AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE);
            batch = pend.concat(rows.filter(o => o.status === 'processing').slice(0, AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE - pend.length));
          } catch (e2) {
            console.error('Auto-complete: fallback fetch failed too', e2);
            autoCompleteRunning = false;
            updateAutoCompleteUI('error');
            return;
          }
        }

        if (batch.length === 0) {
          autoCompleteRunning = false;
          updateAutoCompleteUI('done');
          showToast(`✅ Auto-Complete finished — ${autoCompleteStats.done} orders completed!`, 'success');
          return;
        }

        try {
          // Worker handles each completion so referral commission remains
          // completed-only and exactly-once even during bulk completion.
          await Promise.all(batch.map(order => callSecureAdminFunction('adminUpdateOrderStatus', {
            uid: order.userId, orderId: order.id, status: 'completed'
          })));
          autoCompleteStats.done += batch.length;
          const _grp = {};
          batch.forEach(o => { const os2 = o.status || 'pending'; _grp[os2] = (_grp[os2] || 0) + 1; });
          Object.keys(_grp).forEach(os2 => _bumpOrderStatusN(os2, 'completed', _grp[os2]));
          updateAutoCompleteUI('running');
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Auto-complete: batch write failed', e);
          autoCompleteRunning = false;
          updateAutoCompleteUI('error');
          return;
        }

        if (!autoCompleteRunning) break;
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, AUTO_COMPLETE_REST_MS));
      }
    }

    function updateAutoCompleteUI(state) {
      const btn = document.getElementById('autoCompleteToggleBtn');
      const info = document.getElementById('autoCompleteInfo');
      if (!btn) return;

      if (state === 'running') {
        btn.textContent = '⏸ Stop Auto-Complete';
        btn.classList.add('btn-danger');
        btn.classList.remove('btn-success');
        if (info) info.textContent = `Running… ${autoCompleteStats.done} completed so far (batches of ${AUTO_COMPLETE_BATCH_SIZE}, ${AUTO_COMPLETE_REST_MS/1000}s rest between batches). Keep this tab open.`;
      } else if (state === 'stopped') {
        btn.textContent = '▶️ Auto-Complete Pending Orders';
        btn.classList.remove('btn-danger');
        btn.classList.add('btn-success');
        if (info) info.textContent = `Stopped. ${autoCompleteStats.done} completed this run.`;
      } else if (state === 'done') {
        btn.textContent = '▶️ Auto-Complete Pending Orders';
        btn.classList.remove('btn-danger');
        btn.classList.add('btn-success');
        if (info) info.textContent = `✅ All caught up — ${autoCompleteStats.done} orders completed this run.`;
      } else if (state === 'error') {
        btn.textContent = '▶️ Auto-Complete Pending Orders';
        btn.classList.remove('btn-danger');
        btn.classList.add('btn-success');
        if (info) info.textContent = `⚠️ Stopped due to a connection error after completing ${autoCompleteStats.done}. Click to resume.`;
      }
    }

    // Reject Order (Refund)
    async function rejectOrder(userId, orderId, amount) {
      if (!confirm(`Reject this order and apply an exactly-once refund of ₹${Number(amount || 0).toFixed(2)}?`)) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminOrderRefundAction', {
          uid: userId, orderId, action: 'reject'
        });
        showToast(result.refunded
          ? `✅ Order rejected and ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} refunded atomically.`
          : '✅ Order rejected. Refund had already been processed earlier.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Reject/refund failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Restore an accidentally rejected order. If its refund was already
    // spent, Admin gets one explicit force-confirmation before a negative
    // wallet is allowed; otherwise no accounting inconsistency is possible.
    async function restoreRejectedOrder(userId,orderId,amount,noConfirm=false,force=false,silent=false){
      if(!noConfirm&&!confirm(`Restore this Rejected order to Processing?\n\nIf ₹${Number(amount||0).toFixed(2)} was refunded, that exact refund will be debited from the user's wallet and restored to Total Spent.`))return;
      try{
        const r=await callSecureAdminFunction('adminRestoreRejectedOrder',{uid:userId,orderId,amount:Number(amount)||0,force});
        if(!silent)showToast(r.refundReversed?`✅ Order restored to Processing live. ₹${Number(r.amount).toFixed(2)} refund reversed; wallet ₹${Number(r.balance).toFixed(2)}.`:'✅ Order restored to Processing live. No previous refund needed reversal.','success');return r;
      }catch(e){
        if(e.code==='insufficient-balance'&&!force){const ok=confirm(`${e.message}\n\nForce restore anyway? The wallet may become negative and the user cannot place new orders until funds are added.`);if(ok)return restoreRejectedOrder(userId,orderId,amount,true,true,silent);return;}
        showToast('❌ Rejected-order restore failed: '+e.message,'error');throw e;
      }
    }

    // Delete Order
    async function deleteOrder(userId, orderId) {
      if (!confirm('Permanently delete this order? If it is still Pending/Processing, the secure backend will refund it exactly once before deletion.')) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminDeleteOrder', { uid: userId, orderId });
        showToast(result.refund
          ? `✅ Order deleted and ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} refunded atomically.`
          : '✅ Order deleted securely.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Secure order deletion failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🚫 CANCEL REQUEST REVIEW (Admin side) — a user asked to cancel a
    // still-pending order; Admin approves (cancel + refund) or denies
    // (order continues normally).
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    // Approve Cancel Request — refunds the order amount and marks it cancelled
    async function approveCancelRequest(userId, orderId, amount) {
      if (!confirm(`Approve cancellation and apply an exactly-once refund of ₹${Number(amount || 0).toFixed(2)}?`)) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminOrderRefundAction', {
          uid: userId, orderId, action: 'cancel'
        });
        showToast(result.refunded
          ? `✅ Order cancelled and ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} refunded atomically.`
          : '✅ Order cancelled. Refund had already been processed earlier.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Cancellation/refund failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Deny Cancel Request — clears the flag, order continues normally
    async function denyCancelRequest(userId, orderId) {
      if (!confirm('Deny this cancellation request? The order will continue processing normally.')) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        await database.ref().update({
          [`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/cancelRequested`]: false,
          [`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/cancelDeniedAt`]: Date.now(),
          [`orders_index/${orderId}/cancelRequested`]: false
        });

        const notifRef = database.ref('notifications').push();
        await notifRef.set({
          user_id: userId,
          type: 'order',
          title: '❌ Cancellation Request Denied',
          message: 'Your cancellation request was reviewed but the order will continue processing as normal.',
          meta: { order_id: orderId, status: 'cancel_denied', icon: '❌' },
          created_at: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,
          is_read: false
        });

        showToast('Cancellation request denied — order will continue.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error denying cancel request:', error);
        showToast('Failed to deny cancellation request!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🔄 REFILL REQUESTS (Admin side) — a small, TARGETED live query on
    // orders_index (only orders where refillStatus === 'pending'), so this
    // is always complete across the whole site without ever downloading
    // every user's full order history.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    let refillRequestsSearchTerm='',refillRequestsQueue=[],refillHistoryMap={},legacyRefillMap={};
    function mergeRefillHistory(){const merged={...legacyRefillMap,...refillHistoryMap};refillRequestsQueue=Object.entries(merged).map(([id,o])=>({id,...o}));displayRefillRequests();}
    function watchRefillRequests(){
      database.ref('refill_requests').orderByChild('requestedAt').on('value',snap=>{refillHistoryMap=snap.val()||{};mergeRefillHistory();},err=>console.warn('Refill history:',err?.message||err));
      const q=database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('refillStatus').equalTo('pending');q.on('value',snap=>{legacyRefillMap={};Object.entries(snap.val()||{}).forEach(([id,o])=>{if(o&&!refillHistoryMap[id])legacyRefillMap[id]={...o,orderId:id,status:'pending',requestedAt:o.refillRequestedAt||Date.now(),legacy:true};});mergeRefillHistory();},err=>console.warn('Legacy refill watch:',err?.message||err));
    }
    function loadRefillRequests(){database.ref('refill_requests').once('value').then(snap=>{refillHistoryMap=snap.val()||{};mergeRefillHistory();}).catch(()=>displayRefillRequests());}
    function filterRefillRequestsAdmin(){refillRequestsSearchTerm=(document.getElementById('searchRefillRequests')?.value||'').toLowerCase();displayRefillRequests();}
    function displayRefillRequests(){
      const counts={pending:0,approved:0,rejected:0};refillRequestsQueue.forEach(o=>{const st=o.status||o.refillStatus||'pending';counts[st]=(counts[st]||0)+1;});
      const badge=document.getElementById('sidebarRefillBadge');if(badge){badge.textContent=counts.pending;badge.style.display=counts.pending?'inline-block':'none';}
      ['Pending','Approved','Rejected'].forEach(x=>{const el=document.getElementById('refillHistory'+x);if(el)el.textContent=counts[x.toLowerCase()]||0;});
      const tbody=document.getElementById('refillRequestsTableBody');if(!tbody)return;const sf=document.getElementById('refillAdminStatusFilter')?.value||'all',term=refillRequestsSearchTerm;
      let rows=refillRequestsQueue.filter(o=>{const st=o.status||o.refillStatus||'pending';return(sf==='all'||st===sf)&&(!term||formatShortId(o,'orderNumber').toLowerCase().includes(term)||(o.userName||'').toLowerCase().includes(term)||(o.userEmail||'').toLowerCase().includes(term));}).sort((a,b)=>(b.requestedAt||b.refillRequestedAt||0)-(a.requestedAt||a.refillRequestedAt||0));
      if(!rows.length){tbody.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">🔄</div><div class="empty-text">No matching refill history</div></div></td></tr>';return;}
      tbody.innerHTML=rows.map(o=>{const st=o.status||o.refillStatus||'pending',id=escapeAttr(o.orderId||o.id),uid=escapeAttr(o.userId||''),requested=o.requestedAt||o.refillRequestedAt||0;return `<tr><td class="cell-order-id">${escapeHTML(o.orderNumber||formatShortId(o,'orderNumber'))}${o.massOrder||o.source==='mass'?'<br><small style="color:#0891b2">📦 MASS</small>':''}</td><td>${escapeHTML(o.userName||'N/A')}</td><td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">${escapeHTML(o.userEmail||'N/A')}</td><td>${escapeHTML(o.serviceName||'N/A')}</td><td>${escapeHTML(o.packageName||'N/A')}</td><td style="color:var(--success);font-weight:bold">₹${Number(o.amount||0).toFixed(2)}</td><td style="font-size:11px">${o.completedAt?new Date(o.completedAt).toLocaleString('en-IN'):'N/A'}</td><td style="font-size:11px">${requested?new Date(requested).toLocaleString('en-IN'):'N/A'}</td><td><span class="status-badge status-${escapeAttr(st)}">${escapeHTML(st)}</span></td><td><div class="action-buttons">${st==='pending'?`<button class="btn btn-success" onclick="approveRefillRequest('${uid}','${id}')">✅ Approve</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="denyRefillRequest('${uid}','${id}')">✖ Reject</button>`:`<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">${st==='approved'?'Reviewed & approved':'Reviewed & rejected'}</span>`}</div></td></tr>`;}).join('');
    }
    async function reviewRefillRequest(userId,orderId,status){
      const now=Date.now(),orderSnap=await database.ref(`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}`).once('value'),order=orderSnap.val()||{},batchId=order.batchId||refillHistoryMap[orderId]?.batchId||null,updates={
        [`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/refillStatus`]:status,[`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/${status==='approved'?'refillApprovedAt':'refillDeniedAt'}`]:now,[`orders_index/${orderId}/refillStatus`]:status,[`refill_requests/${orderId}/status`]:status,[`refill_requests/${orderId}/reviewedAt`]:now,[`refill_requests/${orderId}/reviewedBy`]:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'};
      if(batchId){updates[`adminPanel/massOrders/${batchId}/items/${orderId}/refillStatus`]=status;updates[`adminPanel/massOrders/${batchId}/items/${orderId}/refillReviewedAt`]=now;}
      await database.ref().update(updates);
    }
    async function approveRefillRequest(userId,orderId){if(!confirm('Approve this refill request?'))return;try{await reviewRefillRequest(userId,orderId,'approved');showToast('✅ Refill approved and history preserved.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Refill approval failed: '+e.message,'error');throw e;}}
    async function denyRefillRequest(userId,orderId){if(!confirm('Reject this refill request? It will remain in history and the user can request again.'))return;try{await reviewRefillRequest(userId,orderId,'rejected');showToast('Refill rejected and history preserved.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Refill rejection failed: '+e.message,'error');throw e;}}


    // Load Fund Requests
    function loadFundRequests() {
      // ⚡ v25.2: reads the FLAT adminPanel/fundRequests mirror (already has
      // userId/userName/userEmail/amount/status) instead of walking the whole
      // users/*/fundRequests tree — no more full-users download.
      database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').on('value', snap => {
        allFundRequests = [];
        snap.forEach(child => {
          const req = child.val() || {};
          allFundRequests.push({
            ...req,
            id: req.requestKey || child.key,
            adminKey: child.key,
            userId: req.userId,
            userName: req.userName || 'Unknown',
            userEmail: req.userEmail || 'N/A'
          });
        });
        allFundRequests.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
        displayFundRequests(allFundRequests);
      });
    }

    // Display Fund Requests
    function displayFundRequests(requests) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('fundRequestsTableBody');
      
      if (requests.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">💰</div><div class="empty-text">No fund requests found</div></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      let html = '';
      requests.forEach(req => {
        html += `
          <tr>
            <td class="cell-order-id">${formatShortId(req, 'requestNumber')}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(req.userName||'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-gray);">${escapeHTML(req.userEmail||'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="font-family: monospace;">${escapeHTML(req.transactionId||'N/A')}</td>
            <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">
              ₹ ${(req.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}
              ${req.bonusAmount && req.bonusAmount > 0 ? `<br><span style="font-size: 10px; color: #db2777; font-weight: 700;">🎁 incl. ${req.bonusPercent}% bonus (₹${(req.bonusAmount || 0).toFixed(2)})</span>` : ''}
              ${req.originalCurrency && req.originalCurrency !== 'INR' ? `<br><span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-gray); font-weight: 500;">(${req.originalAmount} ${req.originalCurrency})</span>` : ''}
            </td>
            <td>${req.method || 'N/A'}</td>
            <td><span class="status-badge status-${req.status}">${req.status}</span></td>
            <td style="font-size: 11px;">${new Date(req.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</td>
            <td>
              <div class="action-buttons">
                ${req.status === 'pending' ? `
                  <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="approveFundRequest('${req.userId}', '${req.id}', ${req.amount})">✅ Approve</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="rejectFundRequest('${req.userId}', '${req.id}')">❌ Reject</button>
                ` : `
                  <button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="revertFundRequestToPending('${req.userId}', '${req.id}')" title="Change status back to Pending">🔄 Revert</button>
                  ${req.status !== 'approved' ? `<button class="btn btn-success" onclick="approveFundRequest('${req.userId}', '${req.id}', ${req.amount})">✅ Approve</button>` : ''}
                  ${req.status !== 'rejected' ? `<button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="rejectFundRequest('${req.userId}', '${req.id}')">❌ Reject</button>` : ''}
                `}
                <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="deleteFundRequest('${req.userId}', '${req.id}')">🗑️</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Filter Fund Requests
    function filterFundRequests() {
      const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchFunds').value.toLowerCase();
      const statusFilter = document.getElementById('fundStatusFilter').value;

      let filtered = allFundRequests;

      if (searchTerm) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(req => 
          (req.transactionId || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (req.requestNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (req.userName || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (req.userEmail || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        );
      }

      if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(req => req.status === statusFilter);
      }

      displayFundRequests(filtered);
    }

    // Refresh Fund Requests
    function refreshFundRequests() {
      loadFundRequests();
      showToast('Fund requests refreshed successfully!', 'success');
    }

    // Approve Fund Request — adds balance ONLY if it hasn't already been credited
    async function approveFundRequest(userId, reqId, amount) {
      if (!confirm(`Approve this request? The secure backend will credit it exactly once.`)) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminSetFundStatus', { uid: userId, reqId, status: 'approved' });
        showToast(result.changedBy > 0
          ? `✅ Approved — ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} credited exactly once.`
          : '✅ Approved — balance was already credited, so no duplicate credit was made.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Fund approval failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Reject Fund Request — deducts balance ONLY if it was previously credited
    // (e.g. rejecting a request that was auto-approved or previously admin-approved)
    async function rejectFundRequest(userId, reqId) {
      if (!confirm('Reject this fund request? Any previous credit will be reversed atomically.')) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminSetFundStatus', { uid: userId, reqId, status: 'rejected' });
        showToast(result.changedBy < 0
          ? `✅ Rejected — ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} previous credit reversed.`
          : '✅ Fund request rejected.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Fund rejection failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Revert an already-approved/rejected request back to Pending
    // (useful if Admin approved/rejected by mistake and wants to review again)
    async function revertFundRequestToPending(userId, reqId) {
      if (!confirm('Revert this request to Pending? Any credited balance will be reversed atomically.')) return;
      try {
        const result = await callSecureAdminFunction('adminSetFundStatus', { uid: userId, reqId, status: 'pending' });
        showToast(result.changedBy < 0
          ? `✅ Pending again — ₹${Number(result.amount).toFixed(2)} temporarily removed until approval.`
          : '✅ Fund request is Pending again.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('❌ Revert failed: ' + error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // Keep the admin-side tracking record (adminPanel/fundRequests) in sync
    // with the actual user-side request status, so both views always match.
    async function syncAdminFundRequestStatus(requestKey, status) {
      try {
        await database.ref(`adminPanel/fundRequests/${requestKey}`).update({ status });
      } catch (e) { /* non-blocking */ }
    }

    // Delete Fund Request
    async function deleteFundRequest(userId, reqId) {
      try {
        const reqSnap = await database.ref(`users/${userId}/fundRequests/${reqId}`).once('value');
        const reqData = reqSnap.val() || {};

        const warning = reqData.balanceCredited
          ? '\n\n⚠️ WARNING: Balance for this request was already credited to the user. Deleting this record will NOT automatically remove that balance — reject it first if you want to reverse the credit.'
          : '';

        if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this fund request?' + warning)) {
          return;
        }

        await database.ref(`users/${userId}/fundRequests/${reqId}`).remove();
        if (reqData.adminKey) {
          await database.ref(`adminPanel/fundRequests/${reqData.adminKey}`).remove().catch(() => {});
        } else {
          const q=await database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByChild('userId').equalTo(userId).once('value').catch(()=>null);
          const removals=[]; if(q)q.forEach(c=>{const v=c.val()||{};if(v.requestKey===reqId)removals.push(c.ref.remove());});
          await Promise.all(removals);
        }
        showToast('Fund request deleted successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error deleting fund request:', error);
        showToast('Failed to delete fund request!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Load Settings
    function loadSettings() {
      database.ref('settings').on('value', snapshot => {
        const settings = snapshot.val() || {};
        document.getElementById('settingPanelName').value = settings.panelName || '';
        document.getElementById('settingWhatsApp').value = settings.whatsappNumber || '';
        document.getElementById('settingJoinGroup').value = settings.joinGroupLink || '';

    // 🛠️ MAINTENANCE MODE
    // Stored at settings/maintenance = {
    //   enabled: true/false,
    //   message: "...",

    // `true`  = feature is ENABLED (works normally) during maintenance
    // `false` = feature is BLOCKED during maintenance
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const MAINTENANCE_FEATURES = [
      { key: 'newOrder',      label: '🚀 Place New Order',     hint: 'Block users from placing single SMM orders' },
