    function renderMaintenanceToggles(features) {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('maintenanceToggles');
      if (!wrap) return;
      wrap.innerHTML = MAINTENANCE_FEATURES.map(f => {
        const checked = features[f.key] !== false; // default ON (enabled)
        return `
          <label style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; background:#f8fafc; border:2px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; cursor:pointer; transition:.15s;">
            <input type="checkbox" class="mnt-feature" data-key="${f.key}" ${checked ? 'checked' : ''} style="width:20px; height:20px; margin-top:2px; accent-color:#0ea5e9; flex-shrink:0;">
            <span>
              <span style="display:block; font-weight:700; color:#0f172a; font-size:14px;">${f.label}</span>
              <span style="display:block; font-size:12px; color:#64748b; margin-top:2px;">${f.hint}</span>
            </span>
          </label>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function loadMaintenanceSettings() {
      renderMaintenanceToggles({});
      database.ref('settings/maintenance').on('value', snap => {
        const cfg = snap.val() || {};
        const enabled = cfg.enabled === true;
        const el = document.getElementById('mntMasterOn');
        if (el) el.checked = enabled;
        const msg = document.getElementById('mntMessage');
        if (msg && document.activeElement !== msg) msg.value = cfg.message || '';
        renderMaintenanceToggles(cfg.features || {});
        const badge = document.getElementById('maintenanceNavBadge');
        if (badge) badge.style.display = enabled ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
      });
    }

    async function saveMaintenanceSettings() {
      const btn = document.querySelector('#maintenancePage button[onclick="saveMaintenanceSettings()"]');
      const old = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      const enabled = document.getElementById('mntMasterOn').checked;
      const message = document.getElementById('mntMessage').value.trim() ||
        'We are performing scheduled maintenance. This feature is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.';
      const features = {};
      document.querySelectorAll('.mnt-feature').forEach(cb => { features[cb.dataset.key] = cb.checked; });
      const payload = {
        enabled, message, features,
        revision: Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
        updatedAt: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,
        updatedBy: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || 'admin'
      };
      try {
        if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.innerHTML='⏳ Saving & verifying…';}
        await database.ref('settings/maintenance').set(payload);
        const check=(await database.ref('settings/maintenance').once('value')).val()||{};
        if(check.revision!==payload.revision)throw new Error('Save verification failed');
        showToast(enabled ? '🛠️ Maintenance is LIVE — every selected restriction applied instantly.' : '✅ Maintenance OFF — all features restored instantly.', 'success');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e); showToast('❌ Maintenance settings failed: '+e.message,'error');
      } finally {if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.innerHTML=old;}}
    }

    let autoProcessingConfig={enabled:false,delayMs:300000};
    let autoProcessingPendingQueue=[];
    let autoProcessingTimer=null;
    let autoProcessingListenerAttached=false;
    function autoDelayMs(amount,unit){const n=Math.max(1,Number(amount)||1);return n*(unit==='hours'?3600000:unit==='minutes'?60000:1000);}
    function updateAutoProcessingPreview(){const a=document.getElementById('autoProcessingDelay')?.value||5,u=document.getElementById('autoProcessingUnit')?.value||'minutes',el=document.getElementById('autoProcessingPreview');if(el)el.textContent=`New orders: Pending → Processing after ${a} ${u}`;}
    document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target?.id==='autoProcessingDelay'||e.target?.id==='autoProcessingUnit')updateAutoProcessingPreview();});
    function configureAutoProcessingScheduler(cfg){
      cfg=cfg||{};autoProcessingConfig={enabled:cfg.enabled===true,delayMs:Number(cfg.delayMs)||autoDelayMs(cfg.delay,cfg.unit),delay:Number(cfg.delay)||5,unit:cfg.unit||'minutes'};
      if(!autoProcessingListenerAttached){autoProcessingListenerAttached=true;database.ref('orders_index').orderByChild('status').equalTo('pending').on('value',s=>{autoProcessingPendingQueue=Object.entries(s.val()||{}).map(([id,o])=>({id,...o}));});}
      clearInterval(autoProcessingTimer);autoProcessingTimer=setInterval(processDuePendingOrders,autoProcessingConfig.delayMs<60000?1000:5000);processDuePendingOrders();
    }
    async function processDuePendingOrders(){
      if(!autoProcessingConfig.enabled)return;const now=Date.now(),due=autoProcessingPendingQueue.filter(o=>Number(o.autoProcessingAt||0)>0&&Number(o.autoProcessingAt)<=now).slice(0,40);
      for(const o of due){try{let won=false;const tx=await database.ref(`users/${o.userId}/orders/${o.id}/status`).transaction(s=>{if(s!=='pending')return;won=true;return'processing';});if(tx.committed&&won){await database.ref(`orders_index/${o.id}`).update({status:'processing',processingAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,autoProcessed:true});if(o.batchId)await database.ref(`adminPanel/massOrders/${o.batchId}/items/${o.id}`).update({status:'processing',processingAt:Date.now()});_bumpOrderStatus('pending','processing');_bumpUserOrderStat(o.userId,'pending','processing');}}catch(e){console.warn('Auto processing:',e.message);}}
    }
    async function saveAutoProcessingSettings(event){
      event.preventDefault();const enabled=document.getElementById('autoProcessingEnabled').checked,delay=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('autoProcessingDelay').value)||1),unit=document.getElementById('autoProcessingUnit').value,delayMs=autoDelayMs(delay,unit),revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);const payload={enabled,delay,unit,delayMs,revision,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'};
      try{await database.ref('settings/autoOrderProcessing').set(payload);const v=(await database.ref('settings/autoOrderProcessing').once('value')).val()||{};if(v.revision!==revision)throw new Error('Verification failed');configureAutoProcessingScheduler(v);showToast(enabled?`⚡ New orders will auto-process after ${delay} ${unit}.`:'✅ Automatic Processing disabled.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Auto-Processing save failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 📈 ORDER COUNT BOOST — manual + auto (time-based) increase.
    // User Panel total = real (active + legacy) + manual + banked + live.
    // Auto-increase is computed from elapsed time, so it keeps climbing even
    // when the Admin browser is closed, and writes NOTHING per tick (saves
    // Firebase quota). Turning it off banks the accumulated value and stops.
    window._obCfg={manual:0,autoEnabled:false,autoIntervalSec:60,autoIncrement:1,autoAccumulated:0,autoStartedAt:0};
    window._obActiveTotal=0;window._obLegacyTotal=0;
    let _obTicker=null;
    function obIntervalSec(amount,unit){const n=Math.max(1,Number(amount)||1);return n*(unit==='hours'?3600:unit==='minutes'?60:1);}
    function obLiveAuto(cfg,now){cfg=cfg||{};if(cfg.autoEnabled!==true)return 0;const st=Number(cfg.autoStartedAt)||0,sec=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.autoIntervalSec)||60),inc=Math.max(0,Number(cfg.autoIncrement)||0);if(st>0&&inc>0&&now>st)return Math.floor((now-st)/(sec*1000))*inc;return 0;}
    function obBoostTotal(cfg,now){cfg=cfg||{};return Math.max(0,Number(cfg.manual)||0)+Math.max(0,Number(cfg.autoAccumulated)||0)+obLiveAuto(cfg,now);}
    function renderOrderBoostPreview(){
      const now=Date.now(),cfg=window._obCfg||{};
      // 🛡️ Double-count-safe real total (same formula as the User Panel dashboard)
      const active=(Number(window._obActiveTotal)||0),legacy=(Number(window._obLegacyTotal)||0);
      const real=active+(active<legacy?legacy:0);
      const manual=Math.max(0,Number(cfg.manual)||0),acc=Math.max(0,Number(cfg.autoAccumulated)||0),live=obLiveAuto(cfg,now);
      const s=(id,v)=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.textContent=v;};
      s('obRealOrders',real.toLocaleString('en-IN'));s('obManual',manual.toLocaleString('en-IN'));
      s('obAutoAcc',acc.toLocaleString('en-IN'));s('obAutoLive','+'+live.toLocaleString('en-IN'));
      s('obGrand',(real+manual+acc+live).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
    }

    async function saveOrderBoostSettings(event){
      event.preventDefault();
      const manual=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(document.getElementById('obManualInput').value)||0));
      const autoEnabled=document.getElementById('obAutoEnabled').checked===true;
      const autoIncrement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(document.getElementById('obAutoIncrement').value)||1));
      const amount=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('obAutoIntervalAmount').value)||1);
      const unit=document.getElementById('obAutoUnit').value;
      const autoIntervalSec=obIntervalSec(amount,unit);
      const old=window._obCfg||{};
      const bankedLive=old.autoEnabled===true?obLiveAuto(old,Date.now()):0;
      const autoAccumulated=Math.max(0,Number(old.autoAccumulated)||0)+bankedLive;
      const payload={manual,autoEnabled,autoIntervalSec,autoIncrement,autoAccumulated,autoStartedAt:autoEnabled?Date.now():0,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'};
      try{
        await database.ref('settings/orderBoost').set(payload);
        window._obCfg=payload;renderOrderBoostPreview();
        showToast(autoEnabled?`📈 Boost saved. Auto: +${autoIncrement} every ${amount} ${unit}.`:'📈 Boost saved. Manual boost = '+manual.toLocaleString('en-IN'),'success');
      }catch(e){showToast('Boost save failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }
    async function resetOrderBoost(){
      if(!confirm('Reset the entire boost (manual + auto) to 0?'))return;
      const payload={manual:0,autoEnabled:false,autoIntervalSec:60,autoIncrement:1,autoAccumulated:0,autoStartedAt:0,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'};
      try{
        await database.ref('settings/orderBoost').set(payload);
        window._obCfg=payload;
        const mi=document.getElementById('obManualInput');if(mi)mi.value=0;
        const ae=document.getElementById('obAutoEnabled');if(ae)ae.checked=false;
        renderOrderBoostPreview();showToast('🗑️ Boost reset to 0.','success');
      }catch(e){showToast('Reset failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }

    // 🎆 Festival Campaign helpers ======================================
    // epoch ms → "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" for <input type="datetime-local">
    function epochToLocalInput(ms) {
      ms = parseInt(ms);
      if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms <= 0) return '';
      const d = new Date(ms);
      const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()) + 'T' + p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes());
    }

    // Local datetime input → epoch ms ('' means keep default → remove)
    function localInputToEpoch(id) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const v = el ? el.value : '';
      if (!v) return null;
      const t = new Date(v).getTime();
      return Number.isFinite(t) ? t : null;
    }

    // 📺 "What the user panel is showing right now" — live chip (direct Firebase listener)
    function _fcChipPaint(id, fest, computeFn) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return;
      fest = fest || {};
      let ph; try { ph = computeFn(fest, Date.now()); } catch (e) { ph = 'off'; }
      const keyForChip = { fcNowChip: 'independence', fcRbNowChip: 'rakhi', fcTdNowChip: 'teachers' }[id];
      if (window._fcActiveCampaignKey && window._fcActiveCampaignKey !== keyForChip) ph = 'off';
      const LBL = { coming: '⏳ COMING SOON', live: '🎉 LIVE', ending: '🔥 ENDING SOON', off: '⚫ OFF (not showing)' };
      const COL = { coming: '#b45309', live: '#15803d', ending: '#b91c1c', off: '#475569' };
      el.textContent = '📺 Users see now: ' + (LBL[ph] || ph) + ' · [' + (fest.mode || 'auto').toUpperCase() + ']';
      el.style.background = COL[ph] || '#475569'; el.style.color = '#fff';
    }
    function _fcWireNowChips() {
      if (window._fcChipsWired) return; window._fcChipsWired = true;
      let paintTimer = null;
      const repaintAll = () => {
        clearTimeout(paintTimer);
        paintTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
          try {
            const all = await Promise.all([
              database.ref('settings/festival').once('value'),
              database.ref('settings/festivalRakhi').once('value'),
              database.ref('settings/festivalTeachers').once('value')
            ]);
            const vals = all.map(s => s.val() || {});
            const keys = ['independence', 'rakhi', 'teachers'];
            let winner = 0;
            for (let i = 1; i < vals.length; i++) {
              if ((Number(vals[i].updatedAt) || 0) > (Number(vals[winner].updatedAt) || 0)) winner = i;
            }
            window._fcActiveCampaignKey = keys[winner];
            _fcChipPaint('fcNowChip', vals[0], fcComputePhase);
            _fcChipPaint('fcRbNowChip', vals[1], fcRbComputePhase);
            _fcChipPaint('fcTdNowChip', vals[2], fcTdComputePhase);
          } catch (e) { console.warn('Festival status refresh failed:', e); }
        }, 80);
      };
      ['festival', 'festivalRakhi', 'festivalTeachers'].forEach(node => {
        try { database.ref('settings/' + node).on('value', repaintAll); } catch (e) {}
      });
      repaintAll();
      setInterval(repaintAll, 30000);
    }
    _fcWireNowChips();

    function fcComputePhase(fv, now) {
      fv = fv || {};
      if (fv.master === false || fv.master === 'false') return 'off';
      const mode = fv.mode || 'auto';
      if (mode !== 'auto') return mode === 'off' ? 'off' : mode;
      const liveAt   = parseInt(fv.liveAt)    || Date.parse('2026-08-15T00:00:00+05:30');
      const endingAt = parseInt(fv.endingAt)  || Date.parse('2026-08-16T00:00:00+05:30');
      const hardEnd  = parseInt(fv.hardEndAt) || Date.parse('2026-08-18T23:59:59+05:30');
      if (now < liveAt) return 'coming';
      if (now < endingAt) return 'live';
      if (now < hardEnd) return 'ending';
      return 'off';
    }

    // 🎓 Same phase math as the User Panel's TD engine (default schedule:
    // Teacher's Day — LIVE 5 Sep, Ending 6 Sep, ends 7 Sep 2026 IST)
    function fcTdComputePhase(td, now) {
      td = td || {};
      if (td.master === false || td.master === 'false') return 'off';
      const mode = td.mode || 'auto';
      if (mode !== 'auto') return mode === 'off' ? 'off' : mode;
      const liveAt   = parseInt(td.liveAt)    || Date.parse('2026-09-05T00:00:00+05:30');
      const endingAt = parseInt(td.endingAt)  || Date.parse('2026-09-06T00:00:00+05:30');
      const hardEnd  = parseInt(td.hardEndAt) || Date.parse('2026-09-07T23:59:59+05:30');
      if (now < liveAt) return 'coming';
      if (now < endingAt) return 'live';
      if (now < hardEnd) return 'ending';
      return 'off';
    }

    // 🧵 Same phase math as the User Panel's RB engine (default schedule:
    // Raksha Bandhan — LIVE 28 Aug, Ending 29 Aug, ends 30 Aug 2026 IST)
    function fcRbComputePhase(rb, now) {
      rb = rb || {};
      if (rb.master === false || rb.master === 'false') return 'off';
      const mode = rb.mode || 'auto';
      if (mode !== 'auto') return mode === 'off' ? 'off' : mode;

      const endingAt = parseInt(rb.endingAt)  || Date.parse('2026-08-29T00:00:00+05:30');
      const hardEnd  = parseInt(rb.hardEndAt) || Date.parse('2026-08-30T23:59:59+05:30');
      if (now < liveAt) return 'coming';
      if (now < endingAt) return 'live';
      if (now < hardEnd) return 'ending';
      return 'off';
    }

    // 🎓 Save the whole Teacher's Day Campaign to settings/festivalTeachers —
    // field names mirror the TD engine on the user panel exactly.

    function newCampaignSaveNonce() {
      const bytes = new Uint32Array(4);
      if (window.crypto && window.crypto.getRandomValues) window.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
      else for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) bytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffffffff);
      return Array.from(bytes).map(n => n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');
    }

    // ✅ Reliable campaign writer. A failed optional festivalPing or a root
    // multi-path restriction must never prevent the actual campaign node
    // from saving. Every write is read back and verified before success.
    async function saveCampaignVerified(writes, verifyPath, expectedNonce, label) {
      if (!auth.currentUser) throw new Error('Admin login session expired. Please login again.');
      let rootError = null;
      try {
        await database.ref().update(writes);
      } catch (e) {
        rootError = e;
        console.warn(label + ': atomic update failed; trying direct verified writes.', e);
        const failures = [];
        for (const [path, value] of Object.entries(writes)) {
          if (path === 'settings/festivalPing') continue; // optional wake-up signal
          try { await database.ref(path).set(value); }
          catch (err) { failures.push(path + ': ' + (err.code || err.message || err)); }
        }
        // Ping is best-effort; direct node listeners already make updates live.
        database.ref('settings/festivalPing').set(firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP).catch(() => {});
        if (failures.length) {
          throw new Error('Firebase rejected: ' + failures.join(' | '));
        }
      }

      const check = await database.ref(verifyPath).once('value');
      const saved = check.val() || {};
      if (!saved.saveNonce || saved.saveNonce !== expectedNonce) {
        const cause = rootError ? (' · first error: ' + (rootError.code || rootError.message || rootError)) : '';
        throw new Error('Save verification failed at ' + verifyPath + cause);
      }
      return saved;
    }

    function showCampaignSaveError(label, err) {
      const detail = (err && (err.code || err.message)) || String(err || 'Unknown error');
      console.error(label + ' save failed:', err);
      showToast('❌ ' + label + ' save failed: ' + detail, 'error');
      if (/permission|denied|auth|login/i.test(detail)) {
        alert('Firebase permission/login problem:\n\n' + detail + '\n\nPlease login again and verify Firebase Database Rules allow this Admin account to write under settings.');
      }
    }

    async function saveTeachersCampaign(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const g = (id) => (document.getElementById(id) ? document.getElementById(id).value.trim() : '');

      try {
        const t = (id, dft) => { const v = g(id); return v || TD_TXT[dft]; };
      // ⛔ OFF-mode guard — saving OFF by mistake leaves the user panel empty
      const __modeSel = (g('fcTdMode') || 'auto');
      if (__modeSel === 'off' && !confirm('⚫ Phase Mode = OFF\n\nWith this setting the user panel will show NOTHING for this festival — no banner, no popup, no theme. (This is the usual reason a festival appears "not updating".)\n\n💡 To show Coming Soon or LIVE, set Mode = AUTO or use the ⚡ one-click buttons above.\n\nSave with OFF anyway?')) { showToast('⛔ Save cancelled — Mode was OFF (try the one-click buttons)', 'info'); return; }

        const teachers = {
          master: c('fcTdMaster'),
          mode: g('fcTdMode') || 'auto',
          fx: c('fcTdFx'),
          coming: {
            banner: t('fcTdComingBanner', 'comingBanner'), headline: t('fcTdComingHeadline', 'comingHeadline'), subline: t('fcTdComingSubline', 'comingSubline'),
            popupTitle: t('fcTdComingPopupTitle', 'comingTitle'), popupSub: t('fcTdComingPopupSub', 'comingSub'), popupText: t('fcTdComingPopupText', 'comingOffer'),
            posterUrl: g('fcTdComingPoster'), posterFile: g('fcTdComingPosterFile'), posterConfigured: true, showPopup: c('fcTdComingShowPopup')
          },
          live: {
            bannerText: t('fcTdLiveBanner', 'banner'),
            greetingTitle: t('fcTdLiveGreetingTitle', 'greetingTitle'), greetingSub: t('fcTdLiveGreetingSub', 'greetingSub'),
            offerText: t('fcTdLiveOffer', 'offer'),
            popupTitle: t('fcTdLivePopupTitle', 'popupTitle'), popupSubtitle: t('fcTdLivePopupSub', 'popupSubtitle'),
            posterUrl: g('fcTdLivePoster'), posterFile: g('fcTdLivePosterFile'), posterConfigured: true, showPopup: c('fcTdLiveShowPopup')

    // Save Content Settings
    async function saveContentSettings(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      
      const latestNews = document.getElementById('settingLatestNews').value.trim();
      const bannerText = document.getElementById('settingBannerText').value.trim();
      const bannerSpeed = parseInt((document.getElementById('settingBannerSpeed') || {}).value) || 60;
      const bannerOn = !!(document.getElementById('settingBannerOn') || {}).checked;
      const bannerColorRaw = (((document.getElementById('settingBannerColor') || {}).value) || '').trim();
      const headerColorRaw=(document.getElementById('settingHeaderColor').value||'').trim();
      const headerTextColorRaw=(document.getElementById('settingHeaderTextColor').value||'').trim();
      const footerColorRaw=(document.getElementById('settingFooterColor').value||'').trim();
      const footerTextColorRaw=(document.getElementById('settingFooterTextColor').value||'').trim();
      const headerLogoUrl=document.getElementById('settingHeaderLogoUrl').value.trim();
      const headerLogoFile=document.getElementById('settingHeaderLogoFile').value.trim();
      const landingLogoUrl=document.getElementById('settingLandingLogoUrl').value.trim();
      const landingLogoFile=document.getElementById('settingLandingLogoFile').value.trim();
      const updateImageUrl=document.getElementById('settingUpdateImageUrl').value.trim();
      const updateImageFile=document.getElementById('settingUpdateImageFile').value.trim();
      const headerLogoSize = Math.min(180, Math.max(48, parseInt((document.getElementById('settingHeaderLogoSize') || {}).value) || 88));
      const landingLogoSize = Math.min(360, Math.max(100, parseInt((document.getElementById('settingLandingLogoSize') || {}).value) || 200));
      const headerBrandTextSize=Math.min(42,Math.max(10,parseInt(document.getElementById('settingHeaderBrandTextSize').value)||21));
      const landingBrandTextSize=Math.min(90,Math.max(20,parseInt(document.getElementById('settingLandingBrandTextSize').value)||46));
      const tutorialVideo = document.getElementById('settingTutorialVideo').value.trim();
      const fundVideo = document.getElementById('settingFundVideo').value.trim();
      const passwordVideo = document.getElementById('settingPasswordVideo').value.trim();

      try {
        const updates = {};
        updates['settings/latestNews'] = latestNews;
        updates['settings/topBanner'] = bannerText;
        updates['settings/bannerSpeed'] = bannerSpeed; // ⏱️ constant px/sec, any text length
        updates['settings/bannerOn'] = bannerOn;       // 🔔 instant hide/show in user panel
        updates['settings/bannerColor'] = /^#?[0-9a-fA-F]{3}([0-9a-fA-F]{3})?$/.test(bannerColorRaw)
          ? (bannerColorRaw.charAt(0) === '#' ? bannerColorRaw : '#' + bannerColorRaw) : '';
        updates['settings/headerColor']=/^#?[0-9a-fA-F]{3}([0-9a-fA-F]{3})?$/.test(headerColorRaw)?(headerColorRaw.startsWith('#')?headerColorRaw:'#'+headerColorRaw):'';
        updates['settings/headerTextColor']=/^#?[0-9a-fA-F]{3}([0-9a-fA-F]{3})?$/.test(headerTextColorRaw)?(headerTextColorRaw.startsWith('#')?headerTextColorRaw:'#'+headerTextColorRaw):'';
        updates['settings/footerColor']=/^#?[0-9a-fA-F]{3}([0-9a-fA-F]{3})?$/.test(footerColorRaw)?(footerColorRaw.startsWith('#')?footerColorRaw:'#'+footerColorRaw):'';
        updates['settings/footerTextColor']=/^#?[0-9a-fA-F]{3}([0-9a-fA-F]{3})?$/.test(footerTextColorRaw)?(footerTextColorRaw.startsWith('#')?footerTextColorRaw:'#'+footerTextColorRaw):'';
        updates['settings/headerLogoUrl']=headerLogoUrl;updates['settings/headerLogoFile']=headerLogoFile;updates['settings/headerLogoConfigured']=true;
        updates['settings/landingLogoUrl']=landingLogoUrl;updates['settings/landingLogoFile']=landingLogoFile;updates['settings/landingLogoConfigured']=true;
        updates['settings/updateImageUrl']=updateImageUrl;updates['settings/updateImageFile']=updateImageFile;updates['settings/updateImageConfigured']=true;
        updates['settings/headerLogoSize'] = headerLogoSize;
        updates['settings/landingLogoSize'] = landingLogoSize;
        updates['settings/headerBrandTextSize'] = headerBrandTextSize;
        updates['settings/landingBrandTextSize'] = landingBrandTextSize;
        updates['settings/logoSize'] = headerLogoSize; // backward compatibility for older user files
        updates['settings/tutorialVideo'] = tutorialVideo;
        updates['settings/fundVideo'] = fundVideo;
        updates['settings/passwordResetVideo'] = passwordVideo;
        const contentRevision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
        updates['settings/contentRevision']=contentRevision;
        updates['settings/contentUpdatedAt']=firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP;

        await database.ref().update(updates);
        const verify=(await database.ref('settings/contentRevision').once('value')).val();
        if(verify!==contentRevision)throw new Error('Live settings verification failed');
        showToast('✅ Content, header, footer and image sources saved — live update verified.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to save settings!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ========== 💱 CURRENCY SETTINGS MANAGEMENT ==========
    // Rate meaning: "1 unit of that currency = X INR" (e.g. USD: 87.5 → 1 USD = ₹87.5)
    // Stored at: settings/currency/rates  — used only for DISPLAY conversion on user panel.
    // All real billing/wallet/order amounts always remain in ₹ (INR).

    const CURRENCY_CODES = ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'AUD', 'CAD', 'AED', 'SGD', 'BDT', 'PKR'];

    // Load existing currency rates into the form
    function loadCurrencySettings() {
      database.ref('settings/currency').on('value', snapshot => {
        const data = snapshot.val() || {};
        const rates = data.rates || {};

        CURRENCY_CODES.forEach(code => {
          const input = document.getElementById('rate' + code);
          if (input && rates[code]) {
            input.value = rates[code];
          }
        });

        const infoEl = document.getElementById('currencyRateUpdatedInfo');
        if (infoEl) {
          if (data.updatedAt) {
            const d = new Date(data.updatedAt);
            infoEl.textContent = `🕒 Last updated: ${d.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
          } else {
            infoEl.textContent = '⚠️ No custom rates saved yet — system is using built-in default rates.';
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Save currency rates (Admin manual entry)
    async function saveCurrencyRates(event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const rates = {};
      let hasAtLeastOne = false;

      CURRENCY_CODES.forEach(code => {
        const input = document.getElementById('rate' + code);
        const val = parseFloat(input ? input.value : '');
        if (val && val > 0) {
          rates[code] = val;
          hasAtLeastOne = true;
        }
      });

      if (!hasAtLeastOne) {
        return showToast('Please enter at least one currency rate!', 'error');
      }

      try {
        await database.ref('settings/currency').set({
          rates: rates,
          updatedAt: Date.now()
        });
        showToast('💱 Currency rates saved successfully! Users will see updated prices instantly.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving currency rates:', error);
        showToast('Failed to save currency rates!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Optional convenience: fetch a free live exchange-rate API and pre-fill the form
    // (Admin must still review & click Save — nothing is auto-applied.)
    async function fetchLiveRatesSuggestion() {
      showToast('🌐 Fetching live rate suggestions...', 'success');
      try {
        const res = await fetch('https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/INR');
        const data = await res.json();
        const rates = data.rates || {}; // rates[code] = how many `code` per 1 INR

        CURRENCY_CODES.forEach(code => {
          if (rates[code]) {
            const inrPerUnit = 1 / rates[code]; // invert: 1 unit of code = ? INR
            const input = document.getElementById('rate' + code);
            if (input) input.value = inrPerUnit.toFixed(4);
          }
        });

        showToast('✅ Suggested live rates filled in. Review & click Save to apply!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Live rate fetch failed:', error);
        showToast('❌ Could not fetch live rates. Please enter rates manually.', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ========== 💳 PAYMENT METHODS MANAGEMENT ==========
    // Fully dynamic system — Admin can Add/Edit/Delete/Reorder/Enable-Disable
    // any payment method. Stored at: settings/paymentMethods/{methodId}
    // The user panel reads this in real-time and renders tabs + QR + form automatically.

    let allPaymentMethods = [];

    // Load & display all payment methods (real-time)
    // Fixed default UPI method definition — identical to the one seeded from user.html,
    // using the SAME fixed key ('default_upi') so there is never a duplicate entry,
    // no matter which file (user.html or admin.html) loads first.
    const DEFAULT_UPI_PAYMENT_METHOD = {
      name: 'UPI (India)',
      icon: '📱',
      qrUrl: 'qr-code.jpg',
      currencyCode: 'INR',
      currencySymbol: '₹',
      exchangeRateToINR: 1,
      minAmount: 1,
      instructions: 'PhonePe / PayTm / Gpay / FamPay [ All UPI Apps ]',
      txnLabel: 'UPI Transaction Number / UTR',
      txnMinLength: 12,
      sortOrder: 0,
      approvalMode: 'manual',
      bonusEnabled: false,
      bonusTiers: [],
      enabled: true
    };

    function loadPaymentMethods() {
      // Check the permanent "seeded" flag ONCE — mirrors user.html's logic exactly.
      // This guarantees the default UPI method is created exactly one time, ever.
      // If Admin deletes it afterwards on purpose, it will NOT come back.
      database.ref('settings/paymentMethodsSeeded').once('value').catch(e=>{console.warn('paymentMethodsSeeded read blocked:',e.message);return null;}).then(seededSnap => { if(!seededSnap) return;
        if (!seededSnap.exists()) {
          seedDefaultPaymentMethods();
        }
      });

      database.ref('settings/paymentMethods').on('value', snapshot => {
        const data = snapshot.val() || {};
        allPaymentMethods = Object.entries(data)
          .map(([id, m]) => ({ id, ...m }))
          .sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));

        displayPaymentMethods(allPaymentMethods);
      });
    }

    // Seed default UPI method (using existing qr-code.jpg) with a FIXED key so it's
    // idempotent — safe to call from both admin.html and user.html without ever
    // creating a duplicate entry, and it becomes a normal, fully editable/deletable
    // entry in the database from this moment on. Also flips a permanent
    // "settings/paymentMethodsSeeded" flag so this never runs again after Admin
    // deletes it intentionally.
    async function seedDefaultPaymentMethods() {
      try {
        await database.ref('settings/paymentMethods/default_upi').set({
          ...DEFAULT_UPI_PAYMENT_METHOD,
          createdAt: Date.now()
        });
        await database.ref('settings/paymentMethodsSeeded').set(true);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Default payment method seeding skipped:', error.message);
      }
    }

    // Render the payment methods list as cards
    function displayPaymentMethods(methods) {
      const container = document.getElementById('paymentMethodsContainer');
      if (!container) return;

      if (methods.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty-state">
            <div class="empty-icon">💳</div>
            <div class="empty-text">No payment methods added yet</div>
            <div style="font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-gray); margin-top: 8px;">Click "Add New Payment Method" to create your first one (e.g., UPI, Binance, PayPal)</div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = methods.map(m => `
        <div class="card" style="border: 2px solid ${m.enabled !== false ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--border-color)'}; margin-bottom: 15px; opacity: ${m.enabled !== false ? '1' : '0.6'};">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 15px;">
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">
              ${(m.qrUrl || m.qrFile) ? `<img src="${m.qrUrl || m.qrFile}" alt="QR" style="width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--border-color);background:#f8fafc;" onerror="this.style.display='none';">` : ''}
              <div>
                <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-white);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;">${window.TSMBRANDS ? TSMBRANDS.html(m,34) : (m.icon || '💳')} <span>${m.name}</span></div>
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-gray); margin-top: 3px;">${m.instructions || ''}</div>
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--primary-color); margin-top: 3px; font-weight: 600;">
                  💱 ${m.currencyCode || 'INR'} (${m.currencySymbol || '₹'}) • Min: ${m.currencySymbol || ''}${m.minAmount || 0} • Sort: ${m.sortOrder || 0}
                  ${m.currencyCode && m.currencyCode !== 'INR' ? ` • Rate: 1 ${m.currencyCode} = ₹${m.exchangeRateToINR || 1}` : ''}
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px;">
                  <span style="background: ${m.approvalMode === 'manual' ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.15)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)'}; color: ${m.approvalMode === 'manual' ? '#b45309' : '#059669'}; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700;">
                    ${m.approvalMode === 'manual' ? '🕓 Manual Approval' : '⚡ Auto-Approve'}
                  </span>
                  ${m.bonusEnabled && Array.isArray(m.bonusTiers) && m.bonusTiers.length > 0 ? `
                    <span style="background: rgba(236,72,153,0.15); color: #db2777; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 6px;">
                      🎁 Bonus: ${[...m.bonusTiers].sort((a,b)=>a.minAmount-b.minAmount).map(t => `${m.currencySymbol || ''}${t.minAmount}+ → ${t.percent}%`).join(' | ')}
                    </span>
                  ` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
              <span class="status-badge ${m.enabled !== false ? 'status-approved' : 'status-rejected'}">${m.enabled !== false ? '✅ Enabled' : '⛔ Disabled'}</span>
              <button class="btn ${m.enabled !== false ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-success'}" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px;" onclick="togglePaymentMethod('${m.id}', ${m.enabled === false})">
                ${m.enabled !== false ? '⛔ Disable' : '✅ Enable'}
              </button>
              <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px;" onclick='openEditPaymentMethodModal(${JSON.stringify(m).replace(/'/g, "&apos;")})'>✏️ Edit</button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px;" onclick="deletePaymentMethod('${m.id}', '${(m.name || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">🗑️ Delete</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Open "Add" modal (blank form)
    function openAddPaymentMethodModal() {
      document.getElementById('paymentMethodForm').reset();
      document.getElementById('pmMethodId').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pmEnabled').checked = true;
      document.getElementById('pmTxnMinLength').value = 6;
      document.getElementById('pmSortOrder').value = allPaymentMethods.length;
      document.getElementById('pmApprovalMode').value = 'auto';
      document.getElementById('pmExchangeRate').value = 1;
      document.getElementById('pmQrDisplaySize').value = 0;
      document.getElementById('pmQrFile').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pmQrBorderWidth').value = 4;
      document.getElementById('pmBonusEnabled').checked = false;
      renderBonusTierRows([]);
      togglePmBonusSection();
      document.getElementById('paymentMethodModalTitle').textContent = '➕ Add Payment Method';
      document.getElementById('paymentMethodModal').classList.add('active');
      updatePmRateFieldState();
    }

    // Open "Edit" modal (pre-filled)
    function openEditPaymentMethodModal(method) {
      document.getElementById('pmMethodId').value = method.id;
      document.getElementById('pmName').value = method.name || '';
      document.getElementById('pmIcon').value = method.icon || '';
      document.getElementById('pmQrUrl').value = method.qrUrl || '';
      document.getElementById('pmQrFile').value = method.qrFile || '';
      document.getElementById('pmCurrencyCode').value = method.currencyCode || '';
      document.getElementById('pmCurrencySymbol').value = method.currencySymbol || '';
      document.getElementById('pmMinAmount').value = method.minAmount || 0;
      document.getElementById('pmInstructions').value = method.instructions || '';
      document.getElementById('pmTxnLabel').value = method.txnLabel || '';
      document.getElementById('pmTxnMinLength').value = method.txnMinLength || 6;
      document.getElementById('pmPayId').value = method.payId || '';
      document.getElementById('pmPayIdLabel').value = method.payIdLabel || '';
      document.getElementById('pmSortOrder').value = method.sortOrder || 0;
      document.getElementById('pmApprovalMode').value = method.approvalMode === 'manual' ? 'manual' : 'auto';
      document.getElementById('pmExchangeRate').value = method.exchangeRateToINR || 1;
      document.getElementById('pmQrDisplaySize').value = (method.qrDisplaySize === undefined || method.qrDisplaySize === null) ? 0 : method.qrDisplaySize;
      document.getElementById('pmQrBorderWidth').value = (method.qrBorderWidth === undefined || method.qrBorderWidth === null) ? 4 : method.qrBorderWidth;
      document.getElementById('pmEnabled').checked = method.enabled !== false;
      document.getElementById('pmBonusEnabled').checked = method.bonusEnabled === true;
      renderBonusTierRows(Array.isArray(method.bonusTiers) ? method.bonusTiers : []);
      togglePmBonusSection();

      document.getElementById('paymentMethodModalTitle').textContent = '✏️ Edit Payment Method';
      document.getElementById('paymentMethodModal').classList.add('active');
      updatePmRateFieldState();
    }

    // Show/hide + relabel the Exchange Rate field based on the currency code
    // being INR or not (INR needs no conversion, so the field is hidden then).
    function updatePmRateFieldState() {
      const code = (document.getElementById('pmCurrencyCode').value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const symbol = (document.getElementById('pmCurrencySymbol').value || '').trim();
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pmRateFieldWrap');
      const rateInput = document.getElementById('pmExchangeRate');
      const suffix = document.getElementById('pmRateLabelSuffix');
      const helpText = document.getElementById('pmRateHelpText');
      const bonusHint = document.getElementById('pmBonusCurrencyHint');
      if (bonusHint) bonusHint.textContent = symbol || code || '₹';
      if (!wrap) return;

      if (!code || code === 'INR') {
        wrap.style.display = 'none';
        rateInput.required = false;
        rateInput.value = 1;
      } else {
        wrap.style.display = 'block';
        rateInput.required = true;
        suffix.textContent = `(1 ${code} = ? ₹)`;
        helpText.textContent = `Enter how many ₹ (INR) equal 1 ${code}. E.g. if 1 ${code} = ₹87.50, type 87.50. This is the ONLY rate used to convert this method's payments into ₹ for the wallet.`;
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🎁 BONUS TIER SYSTEM (per payment method) — Admin sets any number of
    // "Amount ≥ X → Y% Bonus" tiers. Fully independent per method, works in
    // its OWN currency, and works with BOTH Auto-Approve and Manual-Approval
    // methods. The highest tier that the entered amount qualifies for wins.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function togglePmBonusSection() {
      const enabled = document.getElementById('pmBonusEnabled').checked;
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pmBonusTiersWrap');
      if (wrap) wrap.style.display = enabled ? 'block' : 'none';
      // Always keep at least one row visible once enabled, for convenience
      if (enabled && document.getElementById('pmBonusTiersContainer').children.length === 0) {
        addBonusTierRow();
      }
    }

    function addBonusTierRow(minAmount, percent) {
      const container = document.getElementById('pmBonusTiersContainer');
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'bonus-tier-row';
      row.style.cssText = 'display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;';
      row.innerHTML = `
        <span style="font-size:12px; color: var(--text-gray); white-space:nowrap;">Amount ≥</span>
        <input type="number" class="form-input pm-bonus-min" placeholder="e.g. 500" min="0" step="0.01" value="${minAmount !== undefined ? minAmount : ''}" style="flex:1;">
        <span style="font-size:12px; color: var(--text-gray); white-space:nowrap;">→ Bonus %</span>
        <input type="number" class="form-input pm-bonus-pct" placeholder="e.g. 5" min="0" step="0.01" value="${percent !== undefined ? percent : ''}" style="flex:1;">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" style="padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px;" onclick="this.closest('.bonus-tier-row').remove()">🗑️</button>
      `;
      container.appendChild(row);
    }

    function renderBonusTierRows(tiers) {
      const container = document.getElementById('pmBonusTiersContainer');
      container.innerHTML = '';
      const sorted = [...(tiers || [])].sort((a, b) => (a.minAmount || 0) - (b.minAmount || 0));
      sorted.forEach(t => addBonusTierRow(t.minAmount, t.percent));
    }

    // Reads all bonus tier rows currently in the form, validates them, and
    // returns a clean array sorted ascending by minAmount (lowest first).
    function collectBonusTiers() {
      const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#pmBonusTiersContainer .bonus-tier-row');
      const tiers = [];
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const minAmount = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.pm-bonus-min').value);
        const percent = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.pm-bonus-pct').value);
        if (!isNaN(minAmount) && !isNaN(percent) && minAmount >= 0 && percent > 0) {
          tiers.push({ minAmount, percent });
        }
      });
      tiers.sort((a, b) => a.minAmount - b.minAmount);
      return tiers;
    }

    // Save (Add or Update) a payment method
    async function savePaymentMethod(event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const methodId = document.getElementById('pmMethodId').value;
      const currencyCode = document.getElementById('pmCurrencyCode').value.trim().toUpperCase();
      const isINR = currencyCode === 'INR';
      const exchangeRate = isINR ? 1 : (parseFloat(document.getElementById('pmExchangeRate').value) || 0);

      if (!isINR && exchangeRate <= 0) {
        return showToast(`Please enter a valid exchange rate for ${currencyCode}!`, 'error');
      }

      const bonusEnabled = document.getElementById('pmBonusEnabled').checked;
      const bonusTiers = bonusEnabled ? collectBonusTiers() : [];

      if (bonusEnabled && bonusTiers.length === 0) {
        return showToast('Please add at least one valid Bonus Tier (Amount + %) or disable Bonus Tiers!', 'error');
      }

      const data = {
        name: document.getElementById('pmName').value.trim(),
        icon: document.getElementById('pmIcon').value.trim(),
        qrUrl: document.getElementById('pmQrUrl').value.trim(),
        qrFile: document.getElementById('pmQrFile').value.trim(),
        qrConfigured: true,
        qrDisplaySize: Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, parseInt(document.getElementById('pmQrDisplaySize').value, 10) || 0)),
        qrBorderWidth: Math.max(0, Math.min(12, parseInt(document.getElementById('pmQrBorderWidth').value, 10) || 0)),
        currencyCode: currencyCode,
        currencySymbol: document.getElementById('pmCurrencySymbol').value.trim(),
        exchangeRateToINR: exchangeRate,
        minAmount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('pmMinAmount').value) || 0,
        instructions: document.getElementById('pmInstructions').value.trim(),
        txnLabel: document.getElementById('pmTxnLabel').value.trim(),
        txnMinLength: parseInt(document.getElementById('pmTxnMinLength').value) || 6,
        payId: document.getElementById('pmPayId').value.trim(),
        payIdLabel: document.getElementById('pmPayIdLabel').value.trim(),
        sortOrder: parseInt(document.getElementById('pmSortOrder').value) || 0,
        approvalMode: document.getElementById('pmApprovalMode').value === 'auto' ? 'auto' : 'manual',
        brand: (window.TSMX && TSMX.pmExtras) ? TSMX.pmExtras().brand : null,
        autoApproveDelaySec: (window.TSMX && TSMX.pmExtras) ? TSMX.pmExtras().autoApproveDelaySec : 0,
        enabled: document.getElementById('pmEnabled').checked,
        bonusEnabled: bonusEnabled,
        bonusTiers: bonusTiers,
        updatedAt: Date.now()
      };

      if (!data.icon) data.icon = '💳';
      if (!data.name || !data.currencyCode || !data.currencySymbol || !data.instructions || !data.txnLabel) {
        return showToast('Please fill all required fields!', 'error');
      }

      try {
        if (methodId) {
          await database.ref(`settings/paymentMethods/${methodId}`).update(data);
          showToast('💳 Payment method updated successfully!', 'success');
        } else {
          data.createdAt = Date.now();
          await database.ref('settings/paymentMethods').push(data);
          showToast('💳 Payment method added successfully! It will now appear on the user panel.', 'success');
        }
        closeModal('paymentMethodModal');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving payment method:', error);
        showToast('Failed to save payment method!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Enable / Disable a payment method (instantly hides/shows it on user panel)
    async function togglePaymentMethod(methodId, enable) {
      try {
        await database.ref(`settings/paymentMethods/${methodId}/enabled`).set(enable);
        showToast(`Payment method ${enable ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'} successfully!`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to update payment method status!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Delete a payment method permanently
    async function deletePaymentMethod(methodId, methodName) {
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete "${methodName}"? This action cannot be undone.`)) {
        return;
      }
      try {
        await database.ref(`settings/paymentMethods/${methodId}`).remove();
        showToast('Payment method deleted successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to delete payment method!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🎫 SUPPORT TICKET SYSTEM (Admin side)
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const TICKET_STATUS_LABELS_ADMIN = { open: '🟡 Open', answered: '🔵 Answered', closed: '🟢 Closed' };

    let ticketSubjectsCacheAdmin = [];
    let allSupportTicketsArray = [];
    let currentAdminTicketId = null;
    let adminTicketConvoListeners = { header: null, messages: null, ticketId: null };

    // Live-mirror of settings/ticketSubjects so Admin's table/conversation
    // views always show the current Admin-configured label for each subject
    // key — kept in sync automatically, no page reload needed.
    function loadTicketSubjectsCacheAdmin() {
      database.ref('settings/ticketSubjects').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        ticketSubjectsCacheAdmin = Object.values(data).sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));

        // Keep the "Subject" filter dropdown on the Support Tickets page
        // always in sync with Admin-configured subjects — preserves the
        // currently selected value if it still exists.
        const filterSelect = document.getElementById('ticketSubjectFilter');
        if (filterSelect) {
          const currentValue = filterSelect.value;
          filterSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All Subjects</option>' +
            ticketSubjectsCacheAdmin.map(s => `<option value="${s.key}">${s.label}</option>`).join('');
          if ([...filterSelect.options].some(o => o.value === currentValue)) {
            filterSelect.value = currentValue;
          }
        }

        // Re-render whichever ticket view is currently visible so labels
        // update live if Admin edits a subject while looking at tickets.
        if (document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage') && document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage').classList.contains('active')) {
          filterSupportTickets();
        }
      });
    }

    function getTicketSubjectLabelAdmin(key) {
      const found = ticketSubjectsCacheAdmin.find(s => s.key === key);
      return found ? found.label : key;
    }

    // Live-load ALL tickets (called once when the Support Tickets page opens,
    // but the listener stays attached for the whole session so the Dashboard's
    // "Open Tickets" stat + sidebar badge always stay accurate too).
    function loadSupportTicketsAdmin() {
      if (window._ticketsAdminListenerAttached) {
        displaySupportTicketsAdmin(allSupportTicketsArray);
        return;
      }
      window._ticketsAdminListenerAttached = true;

      database.ref('tickets').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        allSupportTicketsArray = Object.entries(data)
          .map(([id, t]) => ({ id, ...t }))
          .sort((a, b) => (b.lastMessageAt || 0) - (a.lastMessageAt || 0));

        // Keep Dashboard stat + sidebar badge live regardless of which page is open
        const openCount = allSupportTicketsArray.filter(t => t.status === 'open').length;
        const dashEl = document.getElementById('openTicketsCount');
        if (dashEl) dashEl.textContent = openCount;
        const badgeEl = document.getElementById('sidebarTicketBadge');
        if (badgeEl) {
          if (openCount > 0) { badgeEl.textContent = openCount; badgeEl.style.display = 'inline-block'; }
          else badgeEl.style.display = 'none';
        }

        if (document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage').classList.contains('active')) {
          filterSupportTickets();
        }

        // If admin currently has a ticket conversation open, keep header/thread fresh too
        // (handled by the dedicated per-ticket listeners in openAdminTicketConversation)
      });
    }

    function refreshSupportTickets() {
      displaySupportTicketsAdmin(allSupportTicketsArray);
      showToast('Tickets refreshed!', 'success');
    }

    function displaySupportTicketsAdmin(tickets) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('supportTicketsTableBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      if (tickets.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">🎫</div><div class="empty-text">No tickets found</div></div></td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      tbody.innerHTML = tickets.map(t => {
        const previewText = (t.lastMessagePreview || '').substring(0, 40) || '—';
        return `
          <tr style="${t.adminHasUnread ? 'background: rgba(239,68,68,0.05);' : ''}">
            <td class="cell-order-id">#${t.ticketNumber || t.id.substring(0,6).toUpperCase()} ${t.adminHasUnread ? '<span style="color:var(--error);">●</span>' : ''}</td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(t.userName || 'Unknown')}<br><span style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-gray);">${escapeHTML(t.userEmail || '')}</span></td>
            <td>
              ${getTicketSubjectLabelAdmin(t.subject)}
              ${t.orderIds && t.orderIds.length > 0 ? `<span class="status-badge" style="background:rgba(14,165,233,0.15); color:var(--primary-color); margin-left:4px;">${t.orderIds.length} order(s)</span>` : ''}
            </td>
            <td style="font-size:12px; color:var(--text-gray); max-width:200px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;">${previewText}</td>
            <td><span class="ticket-status-badge ticket-status-${t.status}">${TICKET_STATUS_LABELS_ADMIN[t.status] || t.status}</span></td>
            <td style="font-size:11px;">${new Date(t.updatedAt || t.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</td>
            <td>
              <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:8px 14px; font-size:12px;" onclick="openAdminTicketConversation('${t.id}')">💬 View</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function filterSupportTickets() {
      const searchTerm = (document.getElementById('searchTickets').value || '').toLowerCase();
      const statusFilter = document.getElementById('ticketStatusFilter').value;
      const subjectFilter = document.getElementById('ticketSubjectFilter').value;

      let filtered = allSupportTicketsArray;

      if (searchTerm) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(t =>
          (t.ticketNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (t.userName || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (t.userEmail || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
          (getTicketSubjectLabelAdmin(t.subject) || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        );
      }
      if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.status === statusFilter);
      }
      if (subjectFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.subject === subjectFilter);
      }

      displaySupportTicketsAdmin(filtered);
    }

    // ── Admin-side Ticket Conversation ──
    function openAdminTicketConversation(ticketId) {
      currentAdminTicketId = ticketId;
      navigatePage('adminTicketConvoPage');
      loadAdminTicketConversation(ticketId);
    }

    function detachAdminTicketConvoListeners() {
      if (adminTicketConvoListeners.header) {
        database.ref(`tickets/${adminTicketConvoListeners.ticketId}`).off('value', adminTicketConvoListeners.header);
      }
      if (adminTicketConvoListeners.messages) {
        database.ref(`tickets/${adminTicketConvoListeners.ticketId}/messages`).off('value', adminTicketConvoListeners.messages);
      }
      adminTicketConvoListeners = { header: null, messages: null, ticketId: null };
    }

    function loadAdminTicketConversation(ticketId) {
      detachAdminTicketConvoListeners();

      const headerListener = database.ref(`tickets/${ticketId}`).on('value', snap => {
        const ticket = snap.val();
        if (!ticket) return;
        renderAdminTicketConvoHeader({ id: ticketId, ...ticket });
        renderAdminTicketReplyArea({ id: ticketId, ...ticket });

        if (ticket.adminHasUnread) {
          database.ref(`tickets/${ticketId}/adminHasUnread`).set(false).catch(() => {});
        }
      });

      const messagesListener = database.ref(`tickets/${ticketId}/messages`).orderByChild('createdAt').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        const messages = Object.values(data).sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt);
        renderAdminTicketConvoThread(messages);
      });

      adminTicketConvoListeners = { header: headerListener, messages: messagesListener, ticketId: ticketId };
    }

    function renderAdminTicketConvoHeader(ticket) {
      const container = document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoHeader');
      if (!container) return;

      // Show whichever meta fields actually exist on this ticket record —
      // robust even if Admin later renames/deletes the Subject that was
      // originally selected (the data itself never changes).
      let metaLines = '';
      if (ticket.requestType || (ticket.orderIds && ticket.orderIds.length > 0)) {
        metaLines += `<div><strong>Request:</strong> ${escapeHTML(ticket.requestType || 'N/A')}</div><div><strong>Order ID(s):</strong> ${escapeHTML((ticket.orderIds || []).join(', ') || 'N/A')}</div>`;
      }
      if (ticket.paymentMethod) {
        metaLines += `<div><strong>Payment Method:</strong> ${escapeHTML(ticket.paymentMethod)}</div>`;
      }

      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ticket-convo-header-top">
          <div>
            <div class="ticket-convo-subject">${escapeHTML(getTicketSubjectLabelAdmin(ticket.subject))}</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--text-gray); margin-top:4px;">${escapeHTML(ticket.userName || 'Unknown')} • ${escapeHTML(ticket.userEmail || '')}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="text-align:right;">
            <div class="ticket-convo-id">#${escapeHTML(ticket.ticketNumber)}</div>
            <span class="ticket-status-badge ticket-status-${escapeAttr(ticket.status)}">${escapeHTML(TICKET_STATUS_LABELS_ADMIN[ticket.status]||ticket.status)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        ${metaLines ? `<div class="ticket-convo-meta-box">${metaLines}</div>` : ''}
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
          ${ticket.status !== 'closed' ? `<button class="btn btn-success" onclick="setAdminTicketStatus('${ticket.id}', 'closed')">✅ Close Ticket</button>` : `<button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="setAdminTicketStatus('${ticket.id}', 'open')">🔄 Reopen Ticket</button>`}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderAdminTicketConvoThread(messages) {
      const container = document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoThread');
      if (!container) return;

      container.innerHTML = messages.map(m => {
        const isUser = m.sender === 'user';
        const timeStr = new Date(m.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        return `
          <div class="ticket-msg-row ${isUser ? 'from-user' : 'from-admin'}">
            <div class="ticket-msg-avatar">${isUser ? '🙂' : '👨‍💼'}</div>
            <div class="ticket-msg-bubble-wrap">
              <div class="ticket-msg-sender">${isUser ? escapeHTML(m.senderName || 'User') : 'Support Team (You)'}</div>
              <div class="ticket-msg-bubble">${sanitizeTicketHTML(m.message)}</div>
              <div class="ticket-msg-time">${timeStr}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      setTimeout(() => container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' }), 100);
    }

    function renderAdminTicketReplyArea(ticket) {
      const container = document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoReplyArea');
      if (!container) return;

      if (ticket.status === 'closed') {
        container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; padding:16px; color:var(--text-gray);">🔒 This ticket is closed. Click "Reopen Ticket" above to continue the conversation.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">💬 Your Reply</label>
          <div class="rte-editor-wrap">
            <div class="rte-toolbar">
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('bold')" title="Bold"><b>B</b></button>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('italic')" title="Italic"><i>I</i></button>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('underline')" title="Underline"><u>U</u></button>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('strikeThrough')" title="Strikethrough"><s>S</s></button>
              <span class="rte-sep"></span>
              <select onchange="rteCmd('fontSize', this.value); this.selectedIndex=0;" title="Font Size">
                <option value="">Size</option>
                <option value="2">Small</option>
                <option value="3">Normal</option>
                <option value="5">Large</option>
                <option value="7">Huge</option>
              </select>
              <input type="color" onchange="rteCmd('foreColor', this.value)" title="Text Color" value="#0ea5e9">
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('formatBlock', 'PRE')" title="Monospace / Code Block">{ }</button>
              <span class="rte-sep"></span>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('insertUnorderedList')" title="Bullet List">☰</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('insertOrderedList')" title="Numbered List">☰¹</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="rteCmd('removeFormat')" title="Clear Formatting">⌫</button>
            </div>
            <div class="rte-editor-body" id="adminTicketReplyEditor" contenteditable="true" data-placeholder="Type your reply to the user..."></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-success" id="adminTicketReplySubmitBtn" onclick="submitAdminTicketReply('${ticket.id}')">💬 Send Reply</button>
      `;
    }

    // Shared rich-text-editor toolbar command executor — works for whichever
    // contenteditable box currently has focus (keeps focus before running
    // the command so execCommand always applies to the right editor).
    function rteCmd(cmd, value) {
      const editor = document.getElementById('adminTicketReplyEditor');
      if (editor) editor.focus();
      document.execCommand(cmd, false, value || null);
    }

    async function submitAdminTicketReply(ticketId) {
      const editor = document.getElementById('adminTicketReplyEditor');
      const messageHtml = sanitizeTicketHTML(editor ? editor.innerHTML : '');
      const messageText = editor ? editor.textContent.trim() : '';

      if (!messageText) {
        return showToast('Please type a reply!', 'error');
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById('adminTicketReplySubmitBtn');
      const originalHTML = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Sending...'; }

      try {
        const nowTs = Date.now();
        const msgRef = database.ref(`tickets/${ticketId}/messages`).push();

        await database.ref().update({
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/messages/${msgRef.key}`]: {
            sender: 'admin',
            senderName: 'Support Team',
            message: messageHtml,
            createdAt: nowTs
          },
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/status`]: 'answered',
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/updatedAt`]: nowTs,
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/lastMessageAt`]: nowTs,
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/lastMessageBy`]: 'admin',
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/lastMessagePreview`]: messageText.substring(0, 80),
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/userHasUnread`]: true,
          [`tickets/${ticketId}/adminHasUnread`]: false
        });

        if (editor) editor.innerHTML = '';

        showToast('✅ Reply sent to user!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error sending admin reply:', error);
        showToast('Failed to send reply. Try again!', 'error');
      } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = originalHTML; }
      }
    }

    async function setAdminTicketStatus(ticketId, status) {
      try {
        const updates = { status: status, updatedAt: Date.now() };
        if (status === 'open') updates.userHasUnread = true;
        await database.ref(`tickets/${ticketId}`).update(updates);
        showToast(`Ticket ${status === 'closed' ? 'closed' : 'reopened'}!`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to update ticket status!', 'error');
      }
    }

    async function saveTicketSubjectItem(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const id = document.getElementById('ticketSubjectKey').value;
      const label = document.getElementById('ticketSubjectLabel').value.trim();
      const behavior = document.getElementById('ticketSubjectBehavior').value;
      const sortOrder = parseInt(document.getElementById('ticketSubjectSortOrder').value) || 0;

      if (!label) return showToast('Please enter a label!', 'error');

      try {
        if (id) {
          await database.ref(`settings/ticketSubjects/${id}`).update({ label, behavior, sortOrder });
          showToast('Subject updated!', 'success');
        } else {
          // Generate a stable machine-friendly key from the label (lowercase, no emoji/spaces)
          const key = label.replace(/[^\w\s]/g, '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_') || ('subject_' + Date.now());
          await database.ref('settings/ticketSubjects').push({ key, label, behavior, sortOrder });
          showToast('Subject added!', 'success');
        }
        closeModal('ticketSubjectModal');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving ticket subject:', error);
        showToast('Failed to save subject!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ⚠️ IMPORTANT RULES MANAGEMENT (Admin side)

    function loadRulesManagementAdmin() {
      // Header (title / subtitle / footer note)
      database.ref('settings/importantRules/header').once('value', snap => {
        const header = snap.val() || {};
        document.getElementById('rulesHeaderTitleInput').value = header.title || 'Rules & User Guidelines';
        document.getElementById('rulesHeaderSubtitleInput').value = header.subtitle || '';
        document.getElementById('rulesFooterNoteInput').value = header.footerNote || '';
      });

      // Rule items list (live)
      database.ref('settings/importantRules/items').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        const items = Object.entries(data)
          .map(([id, r]) => ({ id, ...r }))
          .sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));

        const container = document.getElementById('rulesItemsAdminContainer');
        if (!container) return;

        if (items.length === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-text">No rules yet</div></div>';
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = items.map(item => `
          <div style="padding:12px 14px; background:var(--dark-bg); border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:8px;">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;">
              <strong style="flex:1;">${item.icon || '📌'} ${item.title}</strong>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0;">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px;" onclick='openEditRuleItemModal(${JSON.stringify(item).replace(/'/g, "&apos;")})'>✏️</button>
                <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px;" onclick="deleteRuleItem('${item.id}')">🗑️</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p style="font-size:12.5px; color:var(--text-gray); margin-top:6px;">${item.description.substring(0, 120)}${item.description.length > 120 ? '...' : ''}</p>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      });

      // User agreement stats — reuses the shared master 'users' subscription
      // (no duplicate download) to count who has rulesAgreedAt set.
      onUsersDataUpdate(users => {
        let agreedCount = 0;
        let notAgreedCount = 0;
        Object.values(users).forEach(u => {
          if (u.rulesAgreedAt) agreedCount++;
          else notAgreedCount++;
        });
        const agreedEl = document.getElementById('rulesAgreedCount');
        const notAgreedEl = document.getElementById('rulesNotAgreedCount');
        if (agreedEl) agreedEl.textContent = agreedCount;
        if (notAgreedEl) notAgreedEl.textContent = notAgreedCount;
      });
    }

    // 🗄️ FREE-PLAN MULTI-FIREBASE PROJECT MANAGER
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    let firebaseRegistryCache = null;
    function parseFirebaseWebConfig(raw) {
      raw = String(raw || '').trim();
      const first = raw.indexOf('{'), last = raw.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (first < 0 || last <= first) throw new Error('Could not find a Config object { ... } in the pasted text.');
      let body = raw.slice(first, last + 1)
        .replace(/([,{]\s*)([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(\s*:)/g, '$1"$2"$3')
        .replace(/'/g, '"').replace(/,\s*}/g, '}');
      const cfg = JSON.parse(body);
      for (const k of ['apiKey','authDomain','databaseURL','projectId','appId']) if (!cfg[k]) throw new Error(k + ' missing');
      if (!/^https:\/\//.test(cfg.databaseURL)) throw new Error('databaseURL must use https://');
      return cfg;
    }
    async function loadFirebaseProjectManager(force) {
      try {
        let snap = await controlDatabase.ref('system/firebaseRegistry').once('value');
        firebaseRegistryCache = snap.val() || window.TSMRuntime.registry;
        const active = firebaseRegistryCache.projects[firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId];
        document.getElementById('firebaseActiveSummary').innerHTML = `✅ Active: <strong>${active.label || active.id}</strong><br><small>${active.id} · Baseline orders: ${(active.baselineOrderCount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</small>`;
        const list = document.getElementById('firebaseProjectsList');
        list.innerHTML = Object.values(firebaseRegistryCache.projects).map(p => `
          <div style="padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;border:2px solid ${p.id===firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId?'#10b981':'#e2e8f0'};border-radius:12px;background:${p.id===firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId?'#ecfdf5':'#fff'};">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;"><div><strong>${p.label || p.id}</strong><br><small>${p.id}</small></div><span class="status-badge ${p.id===firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId?'status-approved':'status-processing'}">${p.id===firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId?'ACTIVE':'READ-ONLY ARCHIVE / STANDBY'}</span></div>
            <div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="estimateFirebaseUsage('${p.id}')">📊 Estimate</button>
              ${p.readOnly===true ? `<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="viewFirebaseArchive('${p.id}','orders_index')">📦 View Orders</button><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="viewFirebaseArchive('${p.id}','tickets')">🎫 Tickets</button><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="viewFirebaseArchive('${p.id}','panel_orders')">🖥️ Panels</button>`:''}
              ${p.id!==firebaseRegistryCache.activeProjectId && p.readOnly!==true ? `<button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="activateFirebaseProject('${p.id}')">🚀 Activate</button>`:''}
            </div>
          </div>`).join('');
      } catch (e) { showToast('Project registry load failed: '+e.message,'error'); }
    }
    async function addFirebaseDataProject() {
      const btn=document.getElementById('addFirebaseProjectBtn'), old=btn.innerHTML;
      try {
        btn.disabled=true;btn.innerHTML='⏳ Validating…';
        const config=parseFirebaseWebConfig(document.getElementById('newFirebaseConfigJson').value);
        if (config.projectId===window.TSMRuntime.controlConfig.projectId) throw new Error('The control project cannot be added as a data project.');
        const label=document.getElementById('newFirebaseLabel').value.trim()||config.projectId;
        await callSecureAdminFunction('registrySaveProject',{project:{id:config.projectId,label,config}});
        showToast('✅ New standby Firebase validated and saved globally.','success');
        document.getElementById('newFirebaseConfigJson').value='';
        await loadFirebaseProjectManager(true);
      } catch(e){showToast('❌ '+e.message,'error');} finally{btn.disabled=false;btn.innerHTML=old;}
    }
    async function estimateFirebaseUsage(projectId) {
      try {
        showToast('Estimating from shallow business-node counts…','warning');
        const r=await callSecureAdminFunction('registryEstimateUsage',{projectId});
        const pct=Number(r.estimatedPercent||0);
        document.getElementById('firebaseUsageResult').innerHTML=`<div style="padding:14px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid ${pct>=80?'#ef4444':'#10b981'};background:${pct>=80?'#fef2f2':'#ecfdf5'};"><strong>${r.projectId}</strong> estimated usage: <strong>${pct.toFixed(2)}%</strong> (~${(r.estimatedBytes/1048576).toFixed(1)} MB / 1024 MB) ${pct>=80?'🚨 ADD & ACTIVATE A NEW PROJECT NOW':''}<br><small>Estimate uses shallow record counts; Firebase Console remains the final exact source.</small></div>`;
      } catch(e){showToast('Estimate failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }
    function estimateActiveFirebaseUsage(){return estimateFirebaseUsage((firebaseRegistryCache||window.TSMRuntime.registry).activeProjectId);}
    async function viewFirebaseArchive(projectId,node) {
      try {
        const r=await callSecureAdminFunction('adminArchiveRecords',{projectId,node,limit:200});
        const rows=Object.entries(r.records||{}).map(([id,v])=>({id,...(v||{})})).reverse();
        const card=document.getElementById('archiveViewerCard'), box=document.getElementById('archiveViewerContent');
        card.style.display='block';document.getElementById('archiveViewerTitle').textContent=`📚 ${projectId} — ${node} (latest ${rows.length})`;
        box.innerHTML=rows.length?`<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>User</th><th>Details</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(x=>`<tr><td class="cell-order-id">${escapeHTML(x.orderNumber||x.ticketNumber||x.orderId||x.id)}</td><td>${escapeHTML(x.userName||x.userEmail||x.userId||'—')}</td><td>${escapeHTML(x.serviceName||x.subject||x.domainName||x.message||'—')}</td><td>${escapeHTML(x.status||'—')}</td><td>${new Date(x.createdAt||x.timestamp||x.updatedAt||0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`:'<div class="empty-state">No archived records.</div>';
        card.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
      }catch(e){showToast('Archive load failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }
    async function activateFirebaseProject(projectId) {
      const p=(firebaseRegistryCache.projects||{})[projectId];
      if(!p||!confirm(`Activate “${p.label||projectId}”?\n\nPortable settings/users/balance will be copied. Current project becomes read-only archive. All open user tabs reload automatically.`))return;
      try {
        showToast('⏳ Preparing new Firebase and preserving lifetime counters…','warning');
        const r=await callSecureAdminFunction('registryActivateProject',{projectId});
        showToast(`✅ Activated. Lifetime orders continue from ${Number(r.baselineOrderCount||0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}. Reloading…`,'success');
        setTimeout(()=>location.reload(),1200);
      } catch(e){showToast('Activation failed: '+e.message,'error');}
    }
