    // Load current API settings into the form
    function loadApiSettings() {
      database.ref('settings/apiSettings').on('value', snap => {
        const s = snap.val() || {};
        const enabledEl = document.getElementById('apiEnabled');
        const endpointEl = document.getElementById('apiEndpointUrl');
        const rateEl = document.getElementById('apiRateLimit');

        if (enabledEl) enabledEl.checked = s.enabled === true;
        if (endpointEl) endpointEl.value = s.endpointUrl || '';
        if (rateEl) rateEl.value = s.rateLimitPerMinute || 60;
      });

      loadApiServiceMap();
      // loadApiUsageOverview() is lazy — only runs when the API Settings page
      // is opened (it scans the whole users tree for source:'api' orders).
    }

    // Save API settings (enabled, endpoint URL, rate limit)
    async function saveApiSettings(event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const data = {
        enabled: document.getElementById('apiEnabled').checked,
        endpointUrl: document.getElementById('apiEndpointUrl').value.trim(),
        rateLimitPerMinute: parseInt(document.getElementById('apiRateLimit').value) || 60,
        updatedAt: Date.now()
      };

      try {
        await database.ref('settings/apiSettings').update(data);
        showToast('🔌 API settings saved! Changes apply instantly to every user.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving API settings:', error);
        showToast('Failed to save API settings!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ── API Service Catalog (maps a public numeric Service ID -> service+package) ──
    let apiServiceMapCache = [];

    function loadApiServiceMap() {
      database.ref('api_service_map').on('value', snap => {
        const data = snap.val() || {};
        apiServiceMapCache = Object.entries(data).map(([apiId, ref]) => ({ apiId, ...ref }));
        displayApiServiceMap(apiServiceMapCache);
      });
    }

    async function displayApiServiceMap(list) {
      const container = document.getElementById('apiServiceMapContainer');
      if (!container) return;

      if (list.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty-state">
            <div class="empty-icon">🔌</div>
            <div class="empty-text">No packages published to the API yet</div>
            <div style="font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-gray); margin-top: 8px;">Click "Publish a Package to API" to make your first service available to resellers</div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      // Resolve service/package names for display (small dataset, fine to await all)
      const rows = await Promise.all(list.sort((a, b) => a.apiId - b.apiId).map(async item => {
        const pkgSnap = await database.ref(`services/${item.serviceId}/packages/${item.packageId}`).once('value');
        const pkg = pkgSnap.val() || {};
        const svcSnap = await database.ref(`services/${item.serviceId}`).once('value');
        const svc = svcSnap.val() || {};
        return { ...item, packageName: pkg.name || 'Deleted Package', serviceName: svc.name || 'Deleted Service', price: pkg.pricePerK || 0 };
      }));

      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="table-wrapper">
          <table class="data-table">
            <thead><tr><th>API ID</th><th>Service</th><th>Package</th><th>Price/1K</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              ${rows.map(r => `
                <tr>
                  <td><code style="background: rgba(14,165,233,0.1); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--primary-color); font-weight: 700;">${r.apiId}</code></td>
                  <td>${escapeHTML(r.serviceName||'N/A')}</td>
                  <td>${escapeHTML(r.packageName||'N/A')}</td>
                  <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹${r.price}</td>
                  <td>
                    <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px;" onclick="removeApiServiceMap('${r.apiId}')">🗑️ Unpublish</button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              `).join('')}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    // Open the "Publish Package" modal and populate the Service dropdown
    async function openAddApiServiceMapModal() {
      document.getElementById('apiServiceMapForm').reset();

      // Suggest the next available API ID
      const usedIds = apiServiceMapCache.map(m => parseInt(m.apiId)).filter(n => !isNaN(n));
      const nextId = usedIds.length ? Math.max(...usedIds) + 1 : 1;
      document.getElementById('apiSvcMapId').value = nextId;

      // Fetch the current service list fresh (no shared cache needed for this modal)
      const servicesSnap = await database.ref('services').once('value');
      const services = servicesSnap.val() || {};
      const serviceList = Object.entries(services)
        .filter(([, s]) => s.enabled !== false)
        .map(([id, s]) => ({ id, name: s.name || 'Unnamed Service' }));

      const serviceSelect = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapServiceSelect');
      serviceSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose Service --</option>' +
        serviceList.map(s => `<option value="${s.id}">${s.name}</option>`).join('');

      document.getElementById('apiSvcMapPackageSelect').innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose Package --</option>';

      document.getElementById('apiServiceMapModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Populate packages dropdown when a service is picked in the modal
    async function loadApiSvcMapPackages() {
      const serviceId = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapServiceSelect').value;
      const packageSelect = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapPackageSelect');
      packageSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose Package --</option>';
      if (!serviceId) return;

      const snap = await database.ref(`services/${serviceId}/packages`).once('value');
      const packages = snap.val() || {};
      Object.entries(packages).forEach(([id, pkg]) => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = id;
        opt.textContent = `${pkg.name} (₹${pkg.pricePerK}/1K)`;
        packageSelect.appendChild(opt);
      });
    }

    // Save a new API Service ID -> service+package mapping
    async function saveApiServiceMap(event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const apiId = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapId').value.trim();
      const serviceId = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapServiceSelect').value;
      const packageId = document.getElementById('apiSvcMapPackageSelect').value;

      if (!apiId || !serviceId || !packageId) {
        return showToast('Please fill all fields!', 'error');
      }

      if (apiServiceMapCache.some(m => String(m.apiId) === String(apiId))) {
        return showToast(`API Service ID ${apiId} is already in use!`, 'error');
      }

      try {
        await database.ref(`api_service_map/${apiId}`).set({ serviceId, packageId, publishedAt: Date.now() });
        showToast(`✅ Published as API Service ID ${apiId}!`, 'success');
        closeModal('apiServiceMapModal');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error publishing API service:', error);
        showToast('Failed to publish package to API!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Remove a package from the public API catalog
    async function removeApiServiceMap(apiId) {
      if (!confirm(`Unpublish API Service ID ${apiId}? Resellers using this ID will no longer be able to order it.`)) {
        return;
      }
      try {
        await database.ref(`api_service_map/${apiId}`).remove();
        showToast('Package unpublished from API!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        showToast('Failed to unpublish!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ── Global API usage overview (orders placed with source:'api' across all users) ──
    function loadApiUsageOverview() {
      // ⚡ Uses the shared master 'users' subscription — no duplicate download.
      onUsersDataUpdate(users => {
        let totalOrders = 0;
        let totalRevenue = 0;
        let activeUsers = 0;

        Object.values(users).forEach(user => {
          if (user.apiKey) activeUsers++;
          const orders = user.orders || {};
          Object.values(orders).forEach(order => {
            if (order.source === 'api') {
              totalOrders++;
              totalRevenue += order.amount || 0;
            }
          });
        });

        const ordersEl = document.getElementById('apiTotalOrdersAdmin');
        const revenueEl = document.getElementById('apiTotalRevenueAdmin');
        const usersEl = document.getElementById('apiActiveUsersAdmin');
        if (ordersEl) ordersEl.textContent = totalOrders;
        if (revenueEl) revenueEl.textContent = `₹${totalRevenue.toFixed(2)}`;
        if (usersEl) usersEl.textContent = activeUsers;
      });
    }

    // Modal Functions
    function closeModal(modalId) {
      document.getElementById(modalId).classList.remove('active');

    // Mobile Menu Toggle
    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      const sidebar=document.getElementById('sidebar');
      if(sidebar)sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
    }

    // Desktop sidebar hide/show — local preference, instant and persistent.
    function updateAdminShellButtons(){
      const hidden=document.documentElement.classList.contains('admin-sidebar-hidden');
      const icon=document.getElementById('desktopSidebarToggleIcon'),text=document.getElementById('desktopSidebarToggleText'),btn=document.getElementById('desktopSidebarToggle');
      if(icon)icon.textContent=hidden?'☰':'◀';if(text)text.textContent=hidden?'Show Sidebar':'Hide Sidebar';
      if(btn){btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',hidden?'true':'false');btn.title=(hidden?'Show':'Hide')+' sidebar (Ctrl+B)';}
      const dark=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-admin-theme')==='dark',ti=document.getElementById('adminThemeIcon'),tt=document.getElementById('adminThemeText'),tb=document.getElementById('adminThemeToggle');
      if(ti)ti.textContent=dark?'☀️':'🌙';if(tt)tt.textContent=dark?'Light Theme':'Dark Theme';
      if(tb){tb.setAttribute('aria-pressed',dark?'true':'false');tb.title=dark?'Switch to light theme':'Switch to dark theme';}
    }
    function toggleDesktopSidebar(forceHidden){
      if(window.innerWidth<=768){toggleMobileMenu();return;}
      const root=document.documentElement,current=root.classList.contains('admin-sidebar-hidden'),hidden=typeof forceHidden==='boolean'?forceHidden:!current;
      root.classList.toggle('admin-sidebar-hidden',hidden);
      try{localStorage.setItem('topsmm_admin_sidebar_hidden',hidden?'1':'0');}catch(e){}
      updateAdminShellButtons();
    }
    function setAdminTheme(theme,persist=true){
      const next=theme==='dark'?'dark':'light';
      if(next==='dark')document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-admin-theme','dark');else document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-admin-theme');
      if(persist)try{localStorage.setItem('topsmm_admin_theme',next);}catch(e){}
      updateAdminShellButtons();
    }
    function toggleAdminTheme(){setAdminTheme(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-admin-theme')==='dark'?'light':'dark');}
    function filterAdminSidebar(value){
      const q=String(value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),clear=document.getElementById('sidebarSearchClear');let total=0;
      if(clear)clear.style.display=q?'block':'none';
      document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-section').forEach(section=>{let visible=0;section.querySelectorAll(':scope > .nav-item').forEach(item=>{const show=!q||item.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);item.classList.toggle('search-hidden',!show);if(show)visible++;});section.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-parent').forEach(parent=>{const parentMatch=!q||parent.querySelector('.sidebar-parent-toggle')?.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);let childVisible=0;parent.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-subitem').forEach(item=>{const show=parentMatch||!q||item.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);item.classList.toggle('search-hidden',!show);if(show)childVisible++;});parent.style.display=(childVisible||parentMatch)?'':'none';if(q&&(childVisible||parentMatch))parent.classList.add('open');if(childVisible||parentMatch)visible+=Math.max(childVisible,1);});section.classList.toggle('search-hidden',visible===0);total+=visible;});
      let empty=document.getElementById('sidebarNoResults');
      if(!total&&q){if(!empty){empty=document.createElement('div');empty.id='sidebarNoResults';empty.className='sidebar-no-results';empty.textContent='No admin page found';document.querySelector('.sidebar-nav')?.insertBefore(empty,document.querySelector('.sidebar-logout'));}}
      else empty?.remove();
    }
    function clearAdminSidebarSearch(){const input=document.getElementById('adminSidebarSearch');if(input){input.value='';filterAdminSidebar('');input.focus();}}
    function initializeAdminShell(){
      let theme='light';try{theme=localStorage.getItem('topsmm_admin_theme')==='dark'?'dark':'light';}catch(e){}
      setAdminTheme(theme,false);updateAdminShellButtons();restoreSidebarSubmenus();
      document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&String(e.key).toLowerCase()==='b'&&window.innerWidth>768){e.preventDefault();toggleDesktopSidebar();}});
    }

    // Toast Notification
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const existingToast = document.querySelector('.toast');
      if (existingToast) existingToast.remove();

      const toast = document.createElement('div');
      toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
      toast.textContent = message;
      document.body.appendChild(toast);

      setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 4000);
    }

    // Responsive check
    function checkResponsive() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn').style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open');
      }
      updateAdminShellButtons();
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', checkResponsive);
    checkResponsive();

    // Close modal on outside click
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal').forEach(modal => {
      modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === modal) {
          modal.classList.remove('active');
        }
      });
    });

    function adminMassEsc(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
    function massStatusCounts(items){const c={pending:0,processing:0,completed:0,rejected:0,cancelled:0};Object.values(items||{}).forEach(x=>{const s=x.status||'pending';c[s]=(c[s]||0)+1;});return c;}

    async function massItemAction(batchId,orderId,userId,action,noConfirm){if(!noConfirm&&!confirm(`Apply “${action}” to order ${orderId}?`))return;try{if(action==='reject'||action==='cancel')await callSecureAdminFunction('adminOrderRefundAction',{uid:userId,orderId,action});else if(action==='restore'){const item=massAdminBatches.find(x=>x.id===batchId)?.items?.[orderId],restored=await restoreRejectedOrder(userId,orderId,Number(item?.amount)||0,true,false,true);if(!restored){const e=new Error('Restore cancelled');e.code='restore-cancelled';throw e;}}else if(action==='delete')await callSecureAdminFunction('adminDeleteOrder',{uid:userId,orderId});else await callSecureAdminFunction('adminUpdateOrderStatus',{uid:userId,orderId,status:action});if(!noConfirm)showToast(`✅ Mass order updated: ${action}`,'success');}catch(e){showToast('Mass order action failed: '+e.message,'error');throw e;}}
    async function massRefillAction(batchId,orderId,userId,action){try{if(action==='approve')await approveRefillRequest(userId,orderId);else await denyRefillRequest(userId,orderId);}catch(e){showToast('Refill action failed: '+e.message,'error');}}
    async function massDenyCancel(batchId,orderId,userId){try{await database.ref().update({[`users/${userId}/orders/${orderId}/cancelRequested`]:false,[`orders_index/${orderId}/cancelRequested`]:false,[`adminPanel/massOrders/${batchId}/items/${orderId}/cancelRequested`]:false});showToast('Cancellation request denied.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Deny failed: '+e.message,'error');}}
    async function massBatchAction(batchId,action){
      const b=massAdminBatches.find(x=>x.id===batchId);if(!b)return;
      const all=Object.entries(b.items||{}),eligible=all.filter(([,o])=>action==='processing'?o.status==='pending':action==='completed'?['pending','processing'].includes(o.status):action==='reject'?['pending','processing'].includes(o.status):action==='restore'?o.status==='rejected':true);
      if(!eligible.length)return showToast(`No eligible orders for ${action}.`,'warning');
      const accountingNote=action==='restore'?'\n\nEvery applied refund will be re-debited from the corresponding user wallet and returned to Total Spent.':action==='reject'?'\n\nEach unresolved order will receive an exactly-once wallet refund.':'';if(!confirm(`${action.toUpperCase()} ${eligible.length} eligible order(s) in ${batchId}?${accountingNote}`))return;
      let done=0,failed=0;
      for(const [id] of eligible){try{await massItemAction(batchId,id,b.userId,action,true);done++;}catch(e){failed++;}}
      if(action==='delete'&&failed===0)await database.ref(`adminPanel/massOrders/${batchId}`).remove();
      showToast(`Batch action finished — ${done} updated${failed?`, ${failed} failed`:''}.`,failed?'warning':'success');
    }


    // ========== PANEL ORDERS MANAGEMENT ==========
    let allPanelOrders = [];

    // Load Panel Orders
    function loadPanelOrders() {
      database.ref('panel_orders').on('value', snapshot => {
        const orders = snapshot.val() || {};
        allPanelOrders = [];

        Object.entries(orders).forEach(([orderId, order]) => {
          allPanelOrders.push({
            id: orderId,
            ...order
          });
        });

        // Update stats
        document.getElementById('totalPanelOrders').textContent = allPanelOrders.length;
        document.getElementById('pendingPanelOrders').textContent = allPanelOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'pending').length;
        document.getElementById('processingPanelOrders').textContent = allPanelOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'processing').length;
        document.getElementById('completedPanelOrders').textContent = allPanelOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'completed').length;

        displayPanelOrders(allPanelOrders);
      });
    }

    // Display Panel Orders
    function displayPanelOrders(orders) {
      const container = document.getElementById('panelOrdersContainer');
      
      if (orders.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">🖥️</div><div class="empty-text">No panel orders yet</div></div>';
        return;
      }

      // Sort by date (newest first)
      orders.sort((a, b) => {
        const dateA = new Date(a.orderDate || 0);
        const dateB = new Date(b.orderDate || 0);
        return dateB - dateA;
      });

      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr>';
      html += '<th>Order ID</th><th>Domain</th><th>Plan</th><th>Price</th><th>Customer Email</th><th>WhatsApp</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th><th>Actions</th>';
      html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      orders.forEach(order => {
        const statusClass = 'status-' + (order.status || 'pending');
        const statusText = (order.status || 'pending').toUpperCase();
        
        html += `<tr>
          <td><code style="background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--primary-color);">${order.orderId || 'N/A'}</code></td>
          <td><strong>${escapeHTML(order.domainName||'N/A')}</strong></td>
          <td>${escapeHTML(order.planText||'N/A')}</td>
          <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹${order.price || '0'}</td>
          <td>${escapeHTML(order.adminEmail||'N/A')}</td>
          <td>${escapeHTML(order.whatsappNumber||'N/A')}</td>
          <td><span class="status-badge ${statusClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
          <td>${order.orderDate || 'N/A'}</td>
          <td>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px;" onclick='openEditPanelOrderModal(${JSON.stringify(order).replace(/'/g, "&apos;")})'>✏️ Edit</button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px;" onclick="deletePanelOrder('${order.id}')">🗑️</button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>`;
      });

      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Filter Panel Orders
    function filterPanelOrders() {
      const search = document.getElementById('searchPanelOrders').value.toLowerCase();
      const filtered = allPanelOrders.filter(order => {
        return (
          (order.orderId && order.orderId.toLowerCase().includes(search)) ||
          (order.domainName && order.domainName.toLowerCase().includes(search)) ||
          (order.adminEmail && order.adminEmail.toLowerCase().includes(search)) ||
          (order.whatsappNumber && order.whatsappNumber.includes(search)) ||
          (order.status && order.status.toLowerCase().includes(search))
        );
      });
      displayPanelOrders(filtered);
    }

    // Open Edit Panel Order Modal
    function openEditPanelOrderModal(order) {
      document.getElementById('editPanelOrderId').value = order.id;
      document.getElementById('editPanelDomain').value = order.domainName || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelPlan').value = order.planText || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelEmail').value = order.adminEmail || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelWhatsapp').value = order.whatsappNumber || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelPrice').value = '₹' + (order.price || '0');
      document.getElementById('editPanelStatus').value = order.status || 'pending';
      document.getElementById('editPanelUrl').value = order.panelUrl || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelAdminEmail').value = order.adminLoginEmail || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelAdminPassword').value = order.adminPassword || '';
      document.getElementById('editPanelAdminNote').value = order.adminNote || '';
      
      document.getElementById('editPanelOrderModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // Update Panel Order
    async function updatePanelOrder(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      
      const orderId = document.getElementById('editPanelOrderId').value;
      const updates = {
        status: document.getElementById('editPanelStatus').value,
        panelUrl: document.getElementById('editPanelUrl').value.trim(),
        adminLoginEmail: document.getElementById('editPanelAdminEmail').value.trim(),
        adminPassword: document.getElementById('editPanelAdminPassword').value.trim(),
        adminNote: document.getElementById('editPanelAdminNote').value.trim()
      };

      try {
        await database.ref(`panel_orders/${orderId}`).update(updates);
        showToast('Panel order updated successfully! 🎉', 'success');
        closeModal('editPanelOrderModal');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error updating panel order:', error);
        showToast('Failed to update panel order!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Delete Panel Order
    async function deletePanelOrder(orderId) {
      if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this panel order? This action cannot be undone.')) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        await database.ref(`panel_orders/${orderId}`).remove();
        showToast('Panel order deleted successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error deleting panel order:', error);
        showToast('Failed to delete panel order!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ========== PLAN MANAGEMENT ==========
    let allPlans = [];

    // Fixed default plans (the original hardcoded Monthly/Quarterly/Semi-Annual/Annual)
    // Seeded with FIXED keys so seeding is idempotent and safe from both admin.html/user.html.
    const DEFAULT_PANEL_PLANS = {
      plan_monthly: { name: 'Monthly [1 Month]', price: 169, description: '1 Subdomain, 7-Page Website', sortOrder: 0 },
      plan_quarterly: { name: 'Quarterly [3 Months]', price: 379, description: '1 Subdomain, 7-Page Website', sortOrder: 1 },
      plan_semiannual: { name: 'Semi-Annual [6 Months]', price: 699, description: '1 Main Domain, 15+ Page Website', sortOrder: 2 },
      plan_annual: { name: 'Annual [12 Months]', price: 1299, description: '1 Main Domain, 15+ Page Website', sortOrder: 3 }
    };

    async function seedDefaultPanelPlans() {
      try {
        const updates = {};
        Object.entries(DEFAULT_PANEL_PLANS).forEach(([id, plan]) => {
          updates[`panel_plans/${id}`] = { ...plan, createdAt: Date.now() };
        });
        await database.ref().update(updates);
        await database.ref('settings/panelPlansSeeded').set(true);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Default panel plans seeding skipped:', error.message);
      }
    }

    // Load Plans
    function loadPlans() {
      // Seed default plans exactly once on a fresh database (idempotent — mirrors the
      // payment-methods seeding pattern). If Admin deletes all plans afterwards, they
      // will NOT be recreated automatically.
      database.ref('settings/panelPlansSeeded').once('value').catch(e=>{console.warn('panelPlansSeeded read blocked:',e.message);return null;}).then(seededSnap => { if(!seededSnap) return;
        if (!seededSnap.exists()) {
          seedDefaultPanelPlans();
        }
      });

      database.ref('panel_plans').on('value', snapshot => {
        const plans = snapshot.val() || {};
        allPlans = [];

        Object.entries(plans).forEach(([planId, plan]) => {
          allPlans.push({
            id: planId,
            ...plan
          });
        });

        displayPlans(allPlans);
      });
    }

    // Display Plans
    function displayPlans(plans) {
      const container = document.getElementById('plansContainer');
      
      if (plans.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">📋</div><div class="empty-text">No plans added yet. Click "Add New Plan" to create one.</div></div>';
        return;
      }

      // Sort by admin-defined sort order (falls back to name if not set)
      plans.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.sortOrder !== undefined && b.sortOrder !== undefined) {
          return a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder;
        }
        return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '');
      });

      let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr>';
      html += '<th>Sort</th><th>Plan Name</th><th>Price</th><th>Description</th><th>Actions</th>';
      html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      plans.forEach(plan => {
        html += `<tr>
          <td style="color: var(--text-gray); font-size: 12px;">${plan.sortOrder !== undefined ? plan.sortOrder : '-'}</td>
          <td><strong style="color: var(--primary-color);">${plan.name || 'N/A'}</strong></td>
          <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: bold;">₹${plan.price || '0'}</td>
          <td>${plan.description || '-'}</td>
          <td>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px;" onclick='openEditPlanModal(${JSON.stringify(plan).replace(/'/g, "&apos;")})'>✏️ Edit</button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px;" onclick="deletePlan('${plan.id}')">🗑️</button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>`;
      });

      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Initialize EmailJS
    function initializeEmailJS() {
      if (emailConfig.publicKey && emailConfig.isActive) {
        emailjs.init(emailConfig.publicKey);
        console.log('✅ EmailJS initialized successfully');
      }
    }

    // Load Email Configuration from Firebase
    function loadEmailConfig() {
      database.ref('email_config').on('value', snapshot => {
        const config = snapshot.val();
        if (config) {
          emailConfig = {
            publicKey: config.publicKey || '',
            serviceId: config.serviceId || '',
            templateId: config.templateId || '',
            isActive: config.isActive || false
          };

          // Update UI
          if (document.getElementById('emailPublicKey')) {
            document.getElementById('emailPublicKey').value = emailConfig.publicKey;
            document.getElementById('emailServiceId').value = emailConfig.serviceId;
            document.getElementById('emailTemplateId').value = emailConfig.templateId;
          }

          // Update status badge
          const statusBadge = document.getElementById('emailConfigStatus');
          if (statusBadge) {
            if (emailConfig.isActive && emailConfig.publicKey && emailConfig.serviceId && emailConfig.templateId) {
              statusBadge.textContent = 'Active ✅';
              statusBadge.className = 'config-status active';
              initializeEmailJS();
            } else {
              statusBadge.textContent = 'Inactive ❌';
              statusBadge.className = 'config-status inactive';
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Save Email Configuration
    async function saveEmailConfig(event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      const publicKey = document.getElementById('emailPublicKey').value.trim();
      const serviceId = document.getElementById('emailServiceId').value.trim();
      const templateId = document.getElementById('emailTemplateId').value.trim();

      if (!publicKey || !serviceId || !templateId) {
        showToast('Please fill all fields!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      try {
        await database.ref('email_config').set({
          publicKey: publicKey,
          serviceId: serviceId,
          templateId: templateId,
          isActive: true,
          updatedAt: Date.now()
        });

        emailConfig = {
          publicKey: publicKey,
          serviceId: serviceId,
          templateId: templateId,
          isActive: true
        };

        initializeEmailJS();
        
        showToast('Email configuration saved successfully! 🎉', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving email config:', error);
        showToast('Failed to save configuration!', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Log Email Activity
    async function logEmail(email, status, message, userName = '') {
      try {
        await database.ref('email_logs').push({
          email: email,
          userName: userName,
          status: status,
          message: message,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          date: new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN', { 
            day: '2-digit', 
            month: 'short', 
            year: 'numeric', 
            hour: '2-digit', 
            minute: '2-digit',
            hour12: true 
          })
        });

        console.error('Error logging email:', error);
      }

    // Load Email Logs
    function loadEmailLogs() {
      database.ref('email_logs').limitToLast(50).on('value', snapshot => {
        const logs = snapshot.val();
        const container = document.getElementById('emailLogsContainer');

        if (!container) return;

        if (!logs) {
          container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-icon">📧</div><div class="empty-text">No emails sent yet</div></div>';
          return;
        }

        const logsArray = Object.entries(logs).map(([id, log]) => ({
          id,
          ...log
        }));

        // Sort by timestamp (newest first)
        logsArray.sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));

        // Calculate stats
        const totalEmails = logsArray.length;
        const successfulEmails = logsArray.filter(l => l.status === 'success').length;
        const failedEmails = logsArray.filter(l => l.status === 'failed').length;

        // Update stats
        if (document.getElementById('totalEmailsSent')) {
          document.getElementById('totalEmailsSent').textContent = totalEmails;
          document.getElementById('successfulEmails').textContent = successfulEmails;
          document.getElementById('failedEmails').textContent = failedEmails;
        }

        let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr>';
        html += '<th>User Email</th><th>User Name</th><th>Status</th><th>Message</th><th>Date & Time</th>';
        html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

        logsArray.forEach(log => {
          const statusClass = log.status === 'success' ? 'status-completed' : 'status-cancelled';
          const statusIcon = log.status === 'success' ? '✅' : '❌';
          const statusText = log.status === 'success' ? 'SENT' : 'FAILED';

          html += `<tr>
            <td><strong>${log.email || 'N/A'}</strong></td>
            <td>${escapeHTML(log.userName||'-')}</td>
            <td><span class="status-badge ${statusClass}">${statusIcon} ${statusText}</span></td>
            <td style="font-size: 12px;">${log.message || '-'}</td>
            <td style="font-size: 12px;">${log.date || 'N/A'}</td>
          </tr>`;
        });

        html += '</tbody></table></div>';
        container.innerHTML = html;
      });
    }

    // Monitor New Users and Send Welcome Emails
    // 📧 Welcome emails are no longer monitored/sent from this browser.
    // The included sendWelcomeEmailOnSignup Cloud Function runs even when
    // every Admin tab is closed and skips imported/legacy users.

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🗄️ ONE-TIME DATABASE MIGRATION — OLD Firebase project ➜ NEW project
    // Copies ONLY missing data (never overwrites newer NEW-db records),
    // skips users who already auto-migrated at login, and finally moves
    // the shared order counter forward from the old total. Idempotent —
    // safe to re-run any number of times.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 📊 LIVE monitor state + tiny DOM engine (throttled re-render)
    const MIG_UI = {
      steps: {}, order: [], startAt: 0,
      est: { users: 0, orders: 0 },
      timer: null, _paintT: null
    };
    function _migUiStep(name, state, counts) {
      counts = counts || {};
      if (!MIG_UI.steps[name]) { MIG_UI.order.push(name); }
      MIG_UI.steps[name] = {
        state: state,
        scanned: counts.scanned || 0,
        copied: counts.copied || 0,
        skipped: counts.skipped || 0
      };
      _migUiPaint();
    }
    function _migUiPaint() {
      clearTimeout(MIG_UI._paintT);
      MIG_UI._paintT = setTimeout(() => {
        const body = document.getElementById('migStepsBody');
        if (!body) return;
        let totalCopied = 0;
        const rows = MIG_UI.order.map(name => {
          const st = MIG_UI.steps[name];
          totalCopied += st.copied || 0;
          const ic = st.state === 'done' ? '✅' : st.state === 'warn' ? '⚠️' : '⏳';
          const col = st.state === 'done' ? '#15803d' : st.state === 'warn' ? '#b45309' : '#7c3aed';
          return '<tr style="border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;">'
            + '<td style="padding:6px 10px; font-family:monospace;">' + name + '</td>'
            + '<td style="padding:6px 10px;">' + (st.scanned || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN') + '</td>'
            + '<td style="padding:6px 10px; color:#15803d; font-weight:700;">' + (st.copied || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN') + '</td>'
            + '<td style="padding:6px 10px; color:#64748b;">' + (st.skipped || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN') + '</td>'
            + '<td style="padding:6px 10px; color:' + col + '; font-weight:700;">' + ic + ' ' + (st.state === 'run' ? 'running…' : st.state) + '</td>'
            + '</tr>';
        }).join('');
        body.innerHTML = rows;
        const cp = document.getElementById('migCopied');
        if (cp) cp.textContent = '📦 ' + totalCopied.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' copied';
      }, 120);
    }
    function _migUiBar(scanned) {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('migBarWrap');
      if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'block';
      const est = MIG_UI.est.orders || 0;
      const pct = est ? Math.min(99, Math.round(scanned / est * 100)) : 0;
      const bar = document.getElementById('migBar');
      if (bar) bar.style.width = pct + '%';
      const p = document.getElementById('migBarPct');
      if (p) p.textContent = est ? (pct + '%') : '';
      const t = document.getElementById('migBarText');
      if (t) t.textContent = scanned.toLocaleString('en-IN') + (est ? ' / ~' + est.toLocaleString('en-IN') : '') + ' scanned';
    }
    function _migUiTick() {
      if (!MIG_UI.startAt) return;
      const sec = Math.max(1, Math.round((Date.now() - MIG_UI.startAt) / 1000));
      const h = Math.floor(sec / 3600), m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60), ss = sec % 60;
      const elTxt = h ? (h + 'h ' + m + 'm') : (m ? (m + 'm ' + ss + 's') : (ss + 's'));
      const el = document.getElementById('migElapsed');
      if (el) el.textContent = '⏱️ ' + elTxt;
      let copied = 0;
      Object.keys(MIG_UI.steps).forEach(k => { copied += MIG_UI.steps[k].copied || 0; });
      const sp = document.getElementById('migSpeed');
      const perSec = copied / sec;
      if (sp) sp.textContent = '⚡ ' + (perSec >= 1 ? Math.round(perSec) + '/s' : (Math.round(perSec * 60) + '/min'));
      const eta = document.getElementById('migEta');
      const ord = MIG_UI.steps['orders_index'];
      if (eta) {
        if (ord && ord.state === 'run' && MIG_UI.est.orders && perSec > 0.5) {
          const left = Math.max(0, MIG_UI.est.orders - ord.scanned);
          const es = Math.round(left / perSec);
          eta.textContent = '🎯 ETA ~' + (es > 60 ? Math.round(es / 60) + ' min' : es + 's');
        } else if (ord && ord.state === 'done' && MIG_UI.est.orders) {
          eta.textContent = '🎯 orders done';
        } else {
          eta.textContent = '🎯 ETA —';
        }
      }
    }
    function _migUiTimer(on) {
      if (on && !MIG_UI.timer) MIG_UI.timer = setInterval(_migUiTick, 500);
      if (!on && MIG_UI.timer) { clearInterval(MIG_UI.timer); MIG_UI.timer = null; _migUiTick(); }
    }

    // 🕐 timestamped log line + quick filter colours
    function _migLog(msg, ok) {
      const el = document.getElementById('migrationLog');
      if (!el) return;
      el.style.display = 'block';
      const line = document.createElement('div');
      const d = new Date();
      const ts = '[' + String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0') + '] ';
      line.textContent = ts + (ok === false ? '❌ ' : '✅ ') + msg;
      if (ok === false) line.style.color = '#fca5a5';
      el.appendChild(line);
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    }

    // 🗓️ last-run meta under the button — always visible on the Settings page
    database.ref('_migration').on('value', sSnap => {
      const v = sSnap.val() || {};
      const meta = document.getElementById('migrationStatusMeta');
      if (!meta || window._migrationRunning) return;
      if (v.completedAt) {
        meta.textContent = '🗓️ Last completed: ' + new Date(v.completedAt).toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' · by ' + (v.by || 'admin') + ' — re-running is SAFE (copies only what is missing).';
        meta.style.color = '#15803d';
      } else {
        meta.textContent = '⚠️ Migration NOT completed yet — press 🚀 Start Migration once and let it finish (live monitor + log open below).';
        meta.style.color = '#b45309';
      }
    });

    // 🧱 CHUNKED MIGRATION ENGINE (v2)
    // The v1 engine snapshot the ENTIRE OLD root in one read — with very
    // large databases (100k+ orders_index rows) that read dies and NOTHING
    // got copied. This engine page-walks every node with orderByKey —
    // which needs NO ".indexOn" — copying only what NEW is missing, in
    // small batches, with live progress. Idempotent: run it any time.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const MIG_EXTRA_NODES = ['order_id_index', 'tickets', 'allTickets', 'panel_orders',
      'adminPanel', 'fundRequests', 'notifications', 'admin_notifications',
      'api_keys', 'apiKeys', 'api_key_index', 'api_service_map', 'api_svc_key_to_id',
      'api_providers', 'api_queue', 'api_logs', 'panel_plans', 'email_logs',
      'admin_settings', 'admin_activity_logs', 'buyPanelContent', 'fund_id_index'];

    // base64url encoding for email_index keys — shared with the USER panel
    // (LEGACY._emailKey there). Never contains . # $ [ ] or /
    function _migEmailKey(email) {
      let b = '';
      try { b = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(String(email).trim().toLowerCase()))); } catch (e) { return null; }
      return b ? b.replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '') : null;
    }

    // Generic missing-only, page-walked copy of one node OLD ➜ NEW.
    async function _migPagedCopy(name, opts, log) {
      opts = opts || {};
      const pageSize = opts.pageSize || 200;
      const skip = opts.skipKeys || null;
      const transform = opts.transform || null;
      const onRecord = opts.onRecord || null;
      let startKey = null, pages = 0, copied = 0, skipped = 0, scanned = 0;
      _migUiStep(name, 'run', { scanned: 0, copied: 0, skipped: 0 });

      for (;;) {
        let q = databaseOld.ref(name).orderByKey().limitToFirst(pageSize + 1);
        if (startKey) q = databaseOld.ref(name).orderByKey().startAt(startKey).limitToFirst(pageSize + 1);
        const snap = await q.once('value');
        const val = snap.val() || {};
        const keys = Object.keys(val).sort();
        if (!keys.length) break;

        const page = keys.slice(0, pageSize);
        // membership window on NEW must cover EXACTLY [startKey, lastOldKey]
        // — otherwise an already-copied OLD record beyond the cut would be
        // re-written (and could clobber admin-side edits on the mirror).
        const lastKey = page[page.length - 1];
        let nq = database.ref(name).orderByKey().endAt(lastKey);
        if (startKey) nq = database.ref(name).orderByKey().startAt(startKey).endAt(lastKey);
        const nsnap = await nq.once('value').catch(() => null);
        const nval = nsnap ? (nsnap.val() || {}) : {};

        const batch = {};
        page.forEach(k => {
          scanned++;
          if (name === 'orders_index' && val[k] && typeof val[k] === 'object') {
            const stt2 = val[k].status || 'pending';
            MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses[stt2] = (MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses[stt2] || 0) + 1;
            MIG_UI.orderStats.revenue += val[k].amount || 0;
          }
          if ((skip && skip.has(k)) || (k in nval)) { skipped++; return; }
          let rec = val[k];
          if (transform) rec = transform(rec, k);
          if (rec === undefined) return;
          batch[name + '/' + k] = rec;
          copied++;
          if (onRecord) onRecord(rec, k, batch);
        });
        if (Object.keys(batch).length) {
          try { await database.ref().update(batch); }
          catch (e) { log('⚠️ ' + name + ' batch write failed: ' + e.message, false); }
        }
        pages++;
        _migUiStep(name, 'run', { scanned: scanned, copied: copied, skipped: skipped });
        if (name === 'orders_index') {
          _migUiBar(scanned);
          if (pages % 10 === 0) log('…orders_index still loading: ' + scanned.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' scanned · ' + copied.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' copied · page #' + pages);
        }
        if (keys.length < pageSize + 1) break;
        startKey = keys[keys.length - 1];
      }
      _migUiStep(name, 'done', { scanned: scanned, copied: copied, skipped: skipped });
      log(name + ': ' + copied + ' copied · ' + skipped + ' already present/skipped (' + scanned + ' scanned)');
      return { copied: copied, skipped: skipped, scanned: scanned };
    }

    // Deep paged copy of OLD 'users' — per-field + per-nested-item merge
    // (never clobbers NEW-side work), tombstoned users only get a live-sync
    // merge. Also builds email_index for O(1) legacy login adoption.
    async function _migCopyUsers(tombs, log) {
      const pageSize = 15;
      let startKey = null, copied = 0, merged = 0, scanned = 0;
      _migUiStep('users', 'run', { scanned: 0, copied: 0, skipped: 0 });
      const emailBatch = {};
      const flushEmails = async () => {
        const ek = Object.keys(emailBatch);
        if (!ek.length) return 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < ek.length; i += 400) {
          const b = {};
          ek.slice(i, i + 400).forEach(x => { b[x] = emailBatch[x]; });
          try { await database.ref().update(b); } catch (e) {}
        }
        return ek.length;
      };
      let emailCount = 0;

      for (;;) {
        let q = databaseOld.ref('users').orderByKey().limitToFirst(pageSize + 1);
        if (startKey) q = databaseOld.ref('users').orderByKey().startAt(startKey).limitToFirst(pageSize + 1);
        const snap = await q.once('value');
        const val = snap.val() || {};
        const keys = Object.keys(val).sort();
        if (!keys.length) break;

        await Promise.all(keys.slice(0, pageSize).map(async k => {
          scanned++;
          const ov = val[k] || {};
          const em = (ov.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (em) {
            const ekey = _migEmailKey(em);
            if (ekey) emailBatch['email_index/' + ekey] = { uid: k, email: em };
          }
          if (tombs && tombs[k]) {
            merged++;
            try { await _lsSyncUser(k); } catch (e) {}
            return;
          }
          let nv = null;
          try { nv = (await database.ref('users/' + k).once('value')).val(); } catch (e) {}
          if (!nv) {
            try { await database.ref('users/' + k).set(ov); copied++; }
            catch (e) { log('⚠️ users/' + k + ' copy failed: ' + e.message, false); }
          } else {
            merged++;
            const upd = {};
            Object.keys(ov).forEach(f => {
              if (f === 'orders' || f === 'fundRequests' || f === 'transactions') return;
              if (!(f in nv)) upd['users/' + k + '/' + f] = ov[f];
            });
            ['orders', 'fundRequests', 'transactions'].forEach(sub => {
              const osub = ov[sub] || {}, nsub = nv[sub] || {};
              Object.keys(osub).forEach(ik => { if (!(ik in nsub)) upd['users/' + k + '/' + sub + '/' + ik] = osub[ik]; });
            });
            if (Object.keys(upd).length) { try { await database.ref().update(upd); } catch (e) {} }
          }
        }));

        _migUiStep('users', 'run', { scanned: scanned, copied: copied, skipped: merged });
        if (keys.length < pageSize + 1) break;
        startKey = keys[keys.length - 1];
      }

      emailCount = await flushEmails();
      _migUiStep('users', 'done', { scanned: scanned, copied: copied, skipped: merged });
      log('users: ' + copied + ' full copies · ' + merged + ' merged/tombstoned (' + scanned + ' total) · email_index: ' + emailCount + ' entries');
    }

    // Small flat node: whole-read both sides, copy missing keys.
    async function _migFlatNodeCopy(name, log) {
      _migUiStep(name, 'run', { scanned: 0, copied: 0, skipped: 0 });
      let ov = {}, nv = {};
      try { ov = (await databaseOld.ref(name).once('value')).val() || {}; }
      catch (e) { log('⚠️ ' + name + ': OLD read failed — ' + e.message, false); return; }
      try { nv = (await database.ref(name).once('value')).val() || {}; } catch (e) {}
      const batch = {};
      let c = 0, s = 0;
      Object.keys(ov).forEach(k => { if (!(k in nv)) { batch[name + '/' + k] = ov[k]; c++; } else s++; });
      if (c) { try { await database.ref().update(batch); } catch (e) { log('⚠️ ' + name + ' write failed: ' + e.message, false); } }
      _migUiStep(name, 'done', { scanned: c + s, copied: c, skipped: s });
      log(name + ': ' + c + ' copied · ' + s + ' already present');
    }

    async function _runLegacyMigrationFullCopyLegacy() {
      if (window._migrationRunning) return;
      window._migrationRunning = true;
      const btn = document.getElementById('migrationBtn');
      const st = document.getElementById('migrationStatus');
      const logEl = document.getElementById('migrationLog');
      if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Migrating…'; }
      if (st) { st.textContent = ''; }
      if (logEl) { logEl.innerHTML = ''; }
      const log = _migLog;
      try {
        // 📊 open the live monitor + estimate totals for the progress bar
        const dash = document.getElementById('migrationDash');
        if (dash) dash.style.display = 'block';
        const meta = document.getElementById('migrationStatusMeta');
        if (meta) { meta.textContent = '⏳ Estimating OLD database size…'; meta.style.color = '#7c3aed'; }
        MIG_UI.steps = {}; MIG_UI.order = []; MIG_UI.startAt = Date.now();
        MIG_UI.orderStats = { statuses: {}, revenue: 0 };
        MIG_UI.est = { users: 0, orders: 0 };
        _migUiPaint(); _migUiTimer(true);
        try {
          const [uR, oR] = await Promise.all([
            fetch(firebaseConfigLegacy.databaseURL + '/users.json?shallow=true').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
            fetch(firebaseConfigLegacy.databaseURL + '/orders_index.json?shallow=true').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null)
          ]);
          MIG_UI.est.users  = (uR && typeof uR === 'object') ? Object.keys(uR).length : 0;
          MIG_UI.est.orders = (oR && typeof oR === 'object') ? Object.keys(oR).length : 0;
          log('📊 OLD database estimate ⇒ users: ' + MIG_UI.est.users.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' · orders: ' + MIG_UI.est.orders.toLocaleString('en-IN'));
          try {
            const existing = await database.ref('orders_index').once('value');
            if (existing.exists()) Object.values(existing.val()).forEach(o => {
              o = o || {};
              const stt0 = o.status || 'pending';
              MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses[stt0] = (MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses[stt0] || 0) + 1;
              MIG_UI.orderStats.revenue += o.amount || 0;
            });
          } catch (e) {}
        } catch (e) { log('⚠️ size estimate failed (progress % may be off): ' + e.message, false); }

        log('📥 Reading migration flags + tombstones…');
        const migSnap = await database.ref('_migration').once('value').catch(() => null);
        const tombsSnap = await database.ref('_migrations').once('value').catch(() => null);
        const alreadyDone = !!(migSnap && migSnap.val() && migSnap.val().completedAt);
        const tombs = tombsSnap ? (tombsSnap.val() || {}) : {};

        // 1) USERS — deep paged merge (+ email_index byproduct)
        await _migCopyUsers(tombs, log);

        // 2) REGISTERED_USERS — flat profiles (skip login-migrated uids)
        await _migPagedCopy('registered_users', { pageSize: 60, skipKeys: new Set(Object.keys(tombs)) }, log);

        // 3) ORDERS_INDEX — THE GIANT. Paged key-walk; normalize createdAt
        //    (records without it would be invisible to date-ordered views);
        //    rebuild order_id_index along the way.
        await _migPagedCopy('orders_index', {
          pageSize: 450,
          transform: (rec) => {
            if (rec && typeof rec === 'object' && !rec.createdAt) rec = Object.assign({}, rec, { createdAt: Date.now() });
            return rec;
          },
          onRecord: (rec, k, batch) => {
            if (rec && rec.orderNumber) batch['order_id_index/' + rec.orderNumber] = { uid: rec.userId, orderKey: k };
          }
        }, log);

        // 4) Every other known top-level node — generic paged copy.
        for (const name of MIG_EXTRA_NODES) {
          try { await _migPagedCopy(name, {}, log); }
          catch (e) { log('⚠️ ' + name + ': skipped after error — ' + e.message, false); }
        }

        // 5) settings & services (small whole-reads) + deep payment methods
        await _migFlatNodeCopy('settings', log);
        await _migFlatNodeCopy('services', log);
        await _migFlatNodeCopy('settings/paymentMethods', log);

        // 6) Shared order counter: continue FROM the old total (only once)
        if (!alreadyDone) {
          try {
            const osnap = await databaseOld.ref('stats/totalOrders').once('value');
            const nsnap = await database.ref('stats/totalOrders').once('value');
            const os = osnap.val() || {}, ns = nsnap.val() || {};
            if (os.total || ns.total) {
              await database.ref('stats/totalOrders').update({
                total: (os.total || 0) + (ns.total || 0),
                pending: (ns.pending || 0)
              }).catch(() => {});
              log('stats/totalOrders ⇒ ' + ((os.total || 0) + (ns.total || 0)) + ' (old ' + (os.total || 0) + ' + new ' + (ns.total || 0) + ')');
            }
          } catch (e) { log('⚠️ stats merge skipped: ' + e.message, false); }
        } else {
          log('Order counter already merged before — left untouched (re-run safe).');
        }

        // 📊 Rebuild every live dashboard counter from EVERYTHING scanned
        try {
          await database.ref('stats/orderStatusCounts').set(MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses).catch(() => {});
          await database.ref('stats/revenueTotal').set(Math.round(MIG_UI.orderStats.revenue * 100) / 100).catch(() => {});
          const fr2 = await database.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').once('value').catch(() => null);
          let fa2 = 0;
          if (fr2 && fr2.val()) Object.values(fr2.val()).forEach(r => { if (r.status === 'approved') fa2 += r.amount || 0; });
          await database.ref('stats/fundsApproved').set(Math.round(fa2 * 100) / 100).catch(() => {});
          log('📊 live counters rebuilt ⇒ ' + JSON.stringify(MIG_UI.orderStats.statuses) + ' · revenue ₹' + Math.round(MIG_UI.orderStats.revenue).toLocaleString('en-IN'));
        } catch (e) { log('⚠️ counter rebuild skipped: ' + e.message, false); }

        await database.ref('_migration').update({
          completedAt: Date.now(),
          by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || 'admin'
        });
        _migUiTimer(false);
        const barEl = document.getElementById('migBar');
        if (barEl) barEl.style.width = '100%';
        const pctEl = document.getElementById('migBarPct');
        if (pctEl) pctEl.textContent = '100%';
        let totalCopied2 = 0;
        Object.keys(MIG_UI.steps).forEach(k => { totalCopied2 += MIG_UI.steps[k].copied || 0; });
        log('🎉 MIGRATION COMPLETE — ' + totalCopied2.toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' records copied. Old + new data are now LIVE together in the NEW database!');
        const meta2 = document.getElementById('migrationStatusMeta');
        if (meta2) { meta2.textContent = '🗓️ Last completed: ' + new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN') + ' · total copied this run: ' + totalCopied2.toLocaleString('en-IN'); meta2.style.color = '#15803d'; }
        try { refreshOrdersTotalCount(true); } catch (e) {}
        if (st) { st.textContent = '✅ Migration complete'; st.style.color = '#15803d'; }
        showToast('🎉 Migration complete! All old data is now in the new database.', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Migration failed:', err);
        log('Migration failed: ' + err.message, false);
        if (st) { st.textContent = '❌ Failed — see the log'; st.style.color = '#b91c1c'; }
        showToast('Migration failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      } finally {
        window._migrationRunning = false;
        _migUiTimer(false);
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '🚀 Start Migration'; }
      }
    }

    // Standalone guard: copying a complete archive into the active Spark
    // project is intentionally disabled. Keep one final public handler so
    // inline Admin buttons never overwrite a function declaration at runtime.
    async function runLegacyMigration() {
      showToast('📚 Standalone uses read-only archives — full database copy is disabled.', 'warning');
    }

    // ===== LOGIN SECURITY (Firebase Authentication) =====
    // 🔐 Only these emails may open the admin panel. Add/remove admins in
    // Firebase Console → Authentication → Users, then list the email here.
    const ADMIN_EMAILS = ['a@gmail.com'];

    async function doLogin() {
      const email = document.getElementById('loginId').value.trim();
      const pass = document.getElementById('loginPass').value;
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('loginError');
      const btn = document.querySelector('#loginOverlay .login-btn');
      if (!email || !pass) {
        errorEl.textContent = '⚠️ Enter the admin email & password!';
        errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }
      try {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Verifying Admin…'; }
        const timeout=new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>{const e=new Error('Login timed out. Check your connection.');e.code='auth/timeout';reject(e);},20000));
        const login = await Promise.race([window.TSMRuntime.signInOrAdoptEmail(email.toLowerCase(), pass),timeout]);
        const user=login.credential.user;
        let allowed=ADMIN_EMAILS.indexOf((user.email||'').toLowerCase())>=0,record=null;
        if(window.TSMX&&typeof TSMX.resolveAdmin==='function'){record=await TSMX.resolveAdmin(user);allowed=!!(record&&!record.__denied);}
        if(!allowed){await auth.signOut();throw Object.assign(new Error('This account is not registered as an enabled admin.'),{code:'auth/not-admin'});}
        if (login.adopted) console.log('✅ Admin Auth adopted from archive project:', login.sourceProjectId);
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';
      } catch (err) {
        errorEl.textContent = err.code === 'auth/too-many-requests' ? '⏳ Too many attempts — try again in a minute!'
          : err.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' ? '❌ Incorrect admin email or password.'
          : err.code === 'auth/not-admin' ? '⛔ This account is not an enabled Admin.'
          : err.code === 'auth/timeout' ? 'Connection timed out. Please try again.'
          : '❌ ' + (err.message || 'Admin login failed');
        errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('loginPass').value = '';
      } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '🔐 Sign In Securely'; }
      }
    }

    function adminLogout() {
      auth.signOut().then(() => window.location.reload());
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🔄 LEGACY LIVE SYNC — the OLD Firebase database is watched in real
    // time. EVERYTHING new that appears there (users, orders, fund
    // requests, tickets, panel orders, user-subtree changes…) is copied
    // into the NEW database within seconds — automatically, forever.
    // Runs hand-in-hand with the one-time Database Migration below.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    let _liveSyncStarted = false;
    let _liveSyncTombs = null;
    function _lsTombstoned(oldUid) { return !!(_liveSyncTombs && _liveSyncTombs[oldUid]); }

    async function _lsPutMissing(path, value) {
      try {
        const s = await database.ref(path).once('value');
        if (!s.exists()) {
          await database.ref(path).set(value);
          console.log('🔄 live-sync ⇒ ' + path);
          return true;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return false;
    }

    // Copy whatever is missing from ONE user's OLD subtree into NEW
    // (profile fields + nested orders / fundRequests / transactions)
    async function _lsSyncUser(oldUid) {
      if (!oldUid || _lsTombstoned(oldUid)) return;
      try {
        const results = await Promise.all([
          database.ref('users/' + oldUid).once('value'),
          databaseOld.ref('users/' + oldUid).once('value')
        ]);
        const nv = results[0].val() || {}, ov = results[1].val();
        if (!ov) return;
        const upd = {};
        Object.keys(ov).forEach(k => {
          if (k === 'orders' || k === 'fundRequests' || k === 'transactions') return;
          if (!(k in nv)) upd['users/' + oldUid + '/' + k] = ov[k];
        });
        ['orders', 'fundRequests', 'transactions'].forEach(sub => {
          const osub = ov[sub] || {}, nsub = nv[sub] || {};
          Object.keys(osub).forEach(k => { if (!(k in nsub)) upd['users/' + oldUid + '/' + sub + '/' + k] = osub[k]; });
        });
        if (Object.keys(upd).length) {
          await database.ref().update(upd);
          console.log('🔄 live-sync user ' + oldUid + ': ' + Object.keys(upd).length + ' fields');
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function startLegacyLiveSync() {
      if (_liveSyncStarted) return;
      _liveSyncStarted = true;
      database.ref('_migrations').on('value', s => { _liveSyncTombs = s.val() || {}; });

      // ── A) FIRST RUN: one silent full copy so OLD users/orders show up
      // in every admin list immediately (same safe engine as the button) ──
      try {
        const bs = await database.ref('_liveSync/bootstrapDone').once('value');
        if (!bs.exists()) {
          console.log('🔄 live-sync: first-time bulk copy running in background…');
          await runLegacyMigration();           // idempotent copy-missing + stats
          await database.ref('_liveSync/bootstrapDone').set(Date.now());
        }
      } catch (e) { console.log('live-sync bootstrap:', e.message); }

      // ── B) LIVE TAILS. Push-key nodes use orderByKey().startAt("now")
      // (minted locally) → fires ONLY for items created from now on,
      // never flooding with the whole old node on every login. ──
      const marker = databaseOld.ref().push().key; // locally-minted "now" push id
      const liveTail = (node, cb) => {
        databaseOld.ref(node).orderByKey().startAt(marker).on('child_added', s => cb(s.key, s.val()));
      };

      // B1) NEW ORDERS created in the old system
      liveTail('orders_index', (k, v) => {
        _lsPutMissing('orders_index/' + k, v);
        if (v && v.orderNumber) _lsPutMissing('order_id_index/' + v.orderNumber, { uid: v.userId, orderKey: k });
        if (v && v.userId) _lsSyncUser(v.userId); // pulls the real nested order too
      });

      // B1b) CHANGES on already-copied old orders — refill requests and
      // cancel requests coming from the old system update just those flag
      // fields in NEW (never clobbering Admin's NEW-side status work)
      databaseOld.ref('orders_index').on('child_changed', s => {
        try {
          const k = s.key, v = s.val() || {};
          database.ref('orders_index/' + k).once('value').then(ns => {
            if (!ns.exists()) { _lsPutMissing('orders_index/' + k, v); if (v.userId) _lsSyncUser(v.userId); return; }
            const upd = {};
            ['refillStatus', 'refillRequestedAt', 'cancelRequested', 'cancelRequestedAt'].forEach(f => {
              if (v[f] !== undefined) upd['orders_index/' + k + '/' + f] = v[f];
            });
            if (Object.keys(upd).length) database.ref().update(upd).catch(() => {});
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      });

      // B2) NEW tickets — plus old-ticket replies merged into NEW
      liveTail('tickets', (k, v) => _lsPutMissing('tickets/' + k, v));
      databaseOld.ref('tickets').on('child_changed', s => {
        try {
          const k = s.key, v = s.val() || {};
          database.ref('tickets/' + k).once('value').then(ns => {
            if (!ns.exists()) { _lsPutMissing('tickets/' + k, v); return; }
            const nv = ns.val() || {}, upd = {};
            Object.keys(v).forEach(f => {
              if (f === 'messages') {
                const om = v.messages || {}, nm = nv.messages || {};
                Object.keys(om).forEach(mk => { if (!(mk in nm)) upd['tickets/' + k + '/messages/' + mk] = om[mk]; });
              } else if (!(f in nv)) {
                upd['tickets/' + k + '/' + f] = v[f];
              }
            });
            if (Object.keys(upd).length) database.ref().update(upd).catch(() => {});
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      });

      // B3) NEW fund requests in the old system
      liveTail('adminPanel/fundRequests', (k, v) => {
        _lsPutMissing('adminPanel/fundRequests/' + k, v);
        if (v && v.userId) _lsSyncUser(v.userId); // pulls the user-side twin too
      });

      // B4) NEW child-panel orders in the old system
      liveTail('panel_orders', (k, v) => _lsPutMissing('panel_orders/' + k, v));

      // B5) NEW signups in the old system (UID keys are not time-ordered,
      // so tail by createdAt — catches recent + all future signups only)
      databaseOld.ref('users').orderByChild('createdAt').startAt(Date.now() - 2 * 86400000)
        .on('child_added', s => {
          if (_lsTombstoned(s.key)) return;
          _lsPutMissing('users/' + s.key, s.val());
          _lsPutMissing('registered_users/' + s.key, s.val());
        }, err => {
          // 🛡️ OLD rules have no createdAt index → periodic chunked re-sync
          _firebaseIndexHint('OLD users/createdAt');
          console.warn('live-sync: OLD users createdAt tail rejected — periodic chunked re-sync armed', err && (err.message || err));
          if (!window._lsResyncTimer) {
            window._lsResyncTimer = setInterval(() => { try { runLegacyMigration(); } catch (e) {} }, 30 * 60000);
          }
        });

      // B6) ANY old-side change inside a user subtree (balance, order
      // updates, twin fund requests…) → copy whatever is missing
      databaseOld.ref('users').on('child_changed', s => _lsSyncUser(s.key));

      console.log('🔄 legacy live-sync: ON (old ➜ new, real-time)');
    }

    // 🗄️ Silent auto-sync (runs once per browser session, right after an
    // authorized admin signs in): any 'settings' / 'services' keys still
    // missing in the NEW database are copied over from the OLD one.
    // Never overwrites newer NEW-db values; the full Database Migration
    // tool (Settings page) handles all remaining nodes (users/orders/…).
    let _autoSyncRan = false;
    function adminLegacyAutoSync() {
      if (_autoSyncRan) return; _autoSyncRan = true;
      const syncNode = (node) => {
        database.ref('_legacySync/' + node).once('value').then(flagSnap => {
          if (flagSnap && flagSnap.val()) return;
          return Promise.all([database.ref(node).once('value'), databaseOld.ref(node).once('value')])
            .then(results => {
              const nv = results[0].val() || {}, ov = results[1].val() || {};
              const upd = {}; let c = 0;
              Object.keys(ov).forEach(k => { if (!(k in nv)) { upd[node + '/' + k] = ov[k]; c++; } });
              upd['_legacySync/' + node] = Date.now();
              return database.ref().update(upd).then(() => { if (c) console.log('🗄️ auto-synced ' + node + ': ' + c + ' keys'); }).catch(() => {});
            });
        }).catch(() => {});
      };
      syncNode('settings');
      syncNode('services');
      deepSyncPaymentMethods(); // 💳 every OLD payment method ➜ NEW
    }

    // 💳 DEEP merge of settings/paymentMethods — EACH payment method
    // saved in the OLD project is copied into the NEW one individually,
    // even when NEW already has some methods of its own (e.g. seeded
    // defaults). One-time, missing methods only; methods you delete
    // later in NEW are never resurrected.
    function deepSyncPaymentMethods() {
      database.ref('_legacySync/paymentMethodsDeep').once('value').then(flagSnap => {
        if (flagSnap && flagSnap.val()) return;
        return Promise.all([
          database.ref('settings/paymentMethods').once('value'),
          databaseOld.ref('settings/paymentMethods').once('value')
        ]).then(results => {
          const nv = results[0].val() || {}, ov = results[1].val() || {};
          const upd = {}; let c = 0;
          Object.keys(ov).forEach(k => { if (!(k in nv)) { upd['settings/paymentMethods/' + k] = ov[k]; c++; } });
          upd['_legacySync/paymentMethodsDeep'] = Date.now();
          return database.ref().update(upd).then(() => {
            if (c) console.log('🗄️ payment methods synced OLD ➜ NEW:', c);
          }).catch(() => {});
        });
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Hard gate: panel stays locked until Firebase confirms a signed-in,
    // allow-listed admin. Sessions persist across reloads automatically.
    auth.onAuthStateChanged(async user => {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('loginOverlay');
      if (!user) { overlay.style.display='flex'; return; }
      let allowed=ADMIN_EMAILS.indexOf((user.email||'').toLowerCase())>=0,rec=null;
      // Give the UID-role module time to finish loading on a restored session.
      if(!window.TSMX||typeof TSMX.resolveAdmin!=='function')await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));
      if(window.TSMX&&typeof TSMX.resolveAdmin==='function'){
        try{rec=await TSMX.resolveAdmin(user);allowed=!!(rec&&!rec.__denied);}catch(e){console.warn('Admin gate:',e.message);}
      }
      if(allowed){overlay.style.display='none';runV14ServerMigrations();if(window.startAdminHydration)window.startAdminHydration();return;}
      overlay.style.display='flex';const errEl=document.getElementById('loginError');
      if(errEl){errEl.textContent='⛔ This account is not an enabled Admin.';errEl.style.display='block';}
      await auth.signOut().catch(()=>{});
    });
    // ===== END LOGIN SECURITY =====


    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // v19 — PROFESSIONAL USER PANEL COLOUR + TEXT CONTROL CENTER
    // Standalone / No-Deploy: Firebase Realtime Database only.
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS=[{"group":"Brand Palette","key":"primaryColor","label":"Primary Brand","default":"#0ea5e9"},{"group":"Brand Palette","key":"primaryDark","label":"Primary     const COLOR_ADJUST_DEFAULTS=Object.fromEntries(COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.map(x=>[x.key,x.default]));
    let colorAdjustLoaded=false,colorAdjustSaveTimer=null,colorAdjustSaving=false,colorAdjustSaveAgain=false,colorAdjustState={...COLOR_ADJUST_DEFAULTS,enabled:true};
    function caEsc(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
    function caValid(v,fallback){v=String(v||'').trim();if(/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}$/.test(v))v='#'+v.slice(1).split('').map(c=>c+c).join('');return /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v)?v.toLowerCase():fallback;}
    function loadColorAdjustAdmin(){
      if(!colorAdjustLoaded){colorAdjustLoaded=true;renderColorPresetGrid();renderColorControlGroups();}
      database.ref('settings/colorAdjust').once('value').then(s=>{colorAdjustState={...COLOR_ADJUST_DEFAULTS,...(s.val()||{})};document.getElementById('colorAdjustEnabled').checked=colorAdjustState.enabled!==false;syncColorAdminInputs();updateColorPreview();}).catch(e=>setColorStatus('Load failed: '+e.message,'error'));
    }
    function renderColorPresetGrid(){const box=document.getElementById('colorPresetGrid');if(!box)return;box.innerHTML=COLOR_ADJUST_PRESETS.map(p=>`<button type="button" class="colour-preset" data-preset="${p.id}" onclick="applyColorPreset('${p.id}')"><b>${p.emoji} ${p.name}</b><div class="preset-swatches"><i style="background:${p.primaryColor}"></i><i style="background:${p.pageBackground}"></i><i style="background:${p.cardBackground}"></i><i style="background:${p.primaryText}"></i></div></button>`).join('');}
    function renderColorControlGroups(){const box=document.getElementById('colorControlGroups');if(!box)return;const groups=[...new Set(COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.map(x=>x.group))];box.innerHTML=groups.map(g=>`<section class="colour-control-group" data-group="${caEsc(g.toLowerCase())}"><h4 class="colour-group-title">${caEsc(g)}</h4><div class="colour-fields-grid">${COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.filter(x=>x.group===g).map(x=>`<div class="colour-field" data-search="${caEsc((x.group+' '+x.label+' '+x.key).toLowerCase())}"><label>${caEsc(x.label)}</label><input type="color" class="colour-picker" data-color-key="${x.key}" value="${x.default}"><input class="form-input colour-hex" data-hex-key="${x.key}" value="${x.default}" maxlength="7"><button type="button" class="colour-reset" onclick="resetOneColor('${x.key}')" title="Reset">↺</button></div>`).join('')}</div></section>`).join('');box.querySelectorAll('[data-color-key]').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener('input',()=>{const k=e.dataset.colorKey;document.querySelector(`[data-hex-key="${k}"]`).value=e.value;colorAdjustState[k]=e.value;updateColorPreview();scheduleColorAutoSave();}));box.querySelectorAll('[data-hex-key]').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener('input',()=>{const k=e.dataset.hexKey,v=caValid(e.value,null);if(v){document.querySelector(`[data-color-key="${k}"]`).value=v;colorAdjustState[k]=v;updateColorPreview();scheduleColorAutoSave();}}));}
    function syncColorAdminInputs(){COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.forEach(f=>{const v=caValid(colorAdjustState[f.key],f.default),p=document.querySelector(`[data-color-key="${f.key}"]`),h=document.querySelector(`[data-hex-key="${f.key}"]`);if(p)p.value=v;if(h)h.value=v;});}
    function collectColorAdjust(){const out={enabled:document.getElementById('colorAdjustEnabled')?.checked!==false};COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.forEach(f=>{const e=document.querySelector(`[data-hex-key="${f.key}"]`);out[f.key]=caValid(e?.value,f.default);});return out;}
    function setColorStatus(t,type){const e=document.getElementById('colorLiveStatus');if(!e)return;e.textContent=t;e.className='control-live-pill'+(type?' '+type:'');}
    function scheduleColorAutoSave(){clearTimeout(colorAdjustSaveTimer);setColorStatus('● Unsaved colour change…','saving');colorAdjustSaveTimer=setTimeout(()=>saveColorAdjust(null,true),700);}
    async function saveColorAdjust(event,auto){if(event?.preventDefault)event.preventDefault();clearTimeout(colorAdjustSaveTimer);if(colorAdjustSaving){colorAdjustSaveAgain=true;return;}colorAdjustSaving=true;setColorStatus('● Publishing live…','saving');try{const payload=collectColorAdjust(),revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);Object.assign(payload,{revision,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'});const up={'settings/colorAdjust':payload,'settings/headerColor':payload.enabled?payload.headerBackground:'','settings/headerTextColor':payload.enabled?payload.headerText:'','settings/footerColor':payload.enabled?payload.bottomNavBackground:'','settings/footerTextColor':payload.enabled?payload.bottomNavText:''};await database.ref().update(up);const v=(await database.ref('settings/colorAdjust/revision').once('value')).val();if(v!==revision)throw new Error('Live verification failed');colorAdjustState={...payload};setColorStatus('● Live on User Panel','');if(!auto)showToast('✅ All user-panel colours published live.','success');}catch(e){setColorStatus('● Save failed','error');showToast('Colour Adjust failed: '+e.message,'error');}finally{colorAdjustSaving=false;if(colorAdjustSaveAgain){colorAdjustSaveAgain=false;scheduleColorAutoSave();}}}
    function resetOneColor(key){const f=COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.find(x=>x.key===key);if(!f)return;document.querySelector(`[data-color-key="${key}"]`).value=f.default;document.querySelector(`[data-hex-key="${key}"]`).value=f.default;colorAdjustState[key]=f.default;updateColorPreview();scheduleColorAutoSave();}
    function resetColorAdjustDefaults(){if(!confirm('Reset every colour to the professional default palette?'))return;colorAdjustState={...COLOR_ADJUST_DEFAULTS,enabled:true};document.getElementById('colorAdjustEnabled').checked=true;syncColorAdminInputs();updateColorPreview();saveColorAdjust(null,false);}
    function applyColorPreset(id){const p=COLOR_ADJUST_PRESETS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;const merged={...COLOR_ADJUST_DEFAULTS,...p,enabled:true};const pageKeys=COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.filter(f=>/PageBackground$/.test(f.key)).map(f=>f.key),cardKeys=COLOR_ADJUST_FIELDS.filter(f=>/(CardBackground|SectionBackground)$/.test(f.key)).map(f=>f.key);pageKeys.forEach(k=>merged[k]=p.pageBackground);cardKeys.forEach(k=>merged[k]=p.cardBackground);merged.inputBackground=p.cardBackground;merged.inputText=p.primaryText;merged.inputBorder=p.cardBorder;merged.buttonText=['graphite','midnight','forest','cyber'].includes(id)?'#020617':'#ffffff';merged.headerText=['graphite','midnight','forest','cyber','crimson','royal'].includes(id)?'#ffffff':p.primaryText;merged.bottomNavText=p.secondaryText;merged.bottomNavActiveBackground=p.primaryColor;merged.bottomNavActiveText=merged.buttonText;merged.modalBackground=p.cardBackground;merged.modalOverlay='#0f172a';merged.landingHeaderBackground=p.headerBackground;colorAdjustState=merged;document.getElementById('colorAdjustEnabled').checked=true;syncColorAdminInputs();document.querySelectorAll('.colour-preset').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.preset===id));updateColorPreview();scheduleColorAutoSave();showToast(`${p.emoji} ${p.name} selected — publishing live…`,'success');}
    function filterColorControls(){const q=(document.getElementById('colorControlSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase(),locked=window._activeColorAdjustGroup||null;document.querySelectorAll('.colour-control-group').forEach(g=>{const title=g.querySelector('.colour-group-title')?.textContent.trim()||'';if(locked&&title!==locked){g.style.display='none';return;}let n=0;g.querySelectorAll('.colour-field').forEach(f=>{const on=!q||f.dataset.search.includes(q);f.style.display=on?'grid':'none';if(on)n++;});g.style.display=n?'block':'none';});}
    function updateColorPreview(){const p=document.getElementById('colorAdjustPreview');if(!p)return;let c;try{c=collectColorAdjust();}catch(e){c=colorAdjustState;}p.style.background=c.pageBackground;p.style.color=c.primaryText;p.innerHTML=`<div class="preview-mini-header" style="background:${c.headerBackground};color:${c.headerText}"><span>Top SMM</span><span>🔔</span></div><div class="preview-mini-body"><div class="preview-mini-card" style="background:${c.welcomeCardBackground};border-color:${c.cardBorder}"><b>Dashboard</b><p style="color:${c.mutedText}">Welcome card preview</p></div><div class="preview-mini-card" style="background:${c.newOrderCardBackground};border-color:${c.cardBorder}"><b>New Order</b><div class="preview-mini-input" style="background:${c.inputBackground};color:${c.inputText};border-color:${c.inputBorder}">Package link</div><button class="preview-mini-button" style="background:${c.buttonBackground};color:${c.buttonText}">Place Order</button></div><div class="preview-mini-card" style="background:${c.massOrderCardBackground};border-color:${c.cardBorder}"><b style="color:${c.primaryColor}">Mass Order</b><p style="color:${c.secondaryText}">Live colour preview</p></div></div>`;}
