    let textAdjustLoaded=false,textAdjustValues={},textSaveTimer=null,textSavePending=new Map(),textSaveBusy=false,textSaveAgain=false;
    function taEsc(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
    function loadTextAdjustAdmin(){
      if(!textAdjustLoaded){textAdjustLoaded=true;renderTextAdjustFields();}
      Promise.all([database.ref('settings/textAdjust/values').once('value'),database.ref('settings').once('value')]).then(([v,s])=>{textAdjustValues=v.val()||{};document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>e.value=textAdjustValues[e.dataset.key]||'');const st=s.val()||{};document.getElementById('taPanelName').value=st.panelName||'';document.getElementById('taTopBanner').value=st.topBanner||'';document.getElementById('taLatestNews').value=st.latestNews||'';refreshTextAdjustSummary();filterTextAdjustFields();}).catch(e=>setTextStatus('Load failed: '+e.message,'error'));
    }
    function renderTextAdjustFields(){const box=document.getElementById('textAdjustGroups'),sel=document.getElementById('textAdjustSectionFilter');if(!box||!sel)return;const sections=[...new Set(USER_TEXT_ADJUST_CATALOG.map(x=>x.section))];sel.innerHTML='<option value="all">All Pages / Sections</option>'+sections.map(s=>`<option value="${taEsc(s)}">${taEsc(s)}</option>`).join('');box.innerHTML=sections.map(s=>`<section class="text-adjust-group" data-section="${taEsc(s)}"><h4 class="text-group-title"><span>${taEsc(s)} <small>(${USER_TEXT_ADJUST_CATALOG.filter(x=>x.section===s).length})</small></span><button class="text-section-reset" onclick="resetTextSection('${taEsc(s).replace(/'/g,'&#39;')}')">Reset Section</button></h4><div class="text-adjust-fields">${USER_TEXT_ADJUST_CATALOG.filter(x=>x.section===s).map(d=>{const area=d.default.length>85?'textarea':'input';return `<div class="text-adjust-field" data-section="${taEsc(s.toLowerCase())}" data-search="${taEsc((s+' '+d.label+' '+d.default).toLowerCase())}"><div class="text-adjust-label">${taEsc(d.label)}</div>${area==='textarea'?`<textarea class="form-textarea text-adjust-input" data-key="${d.key}" rows="2" placeholder="${taEsc(d.default)}"></textarea>`:`<input class="form-input text-adjust-input" data-key="${d.key}" placeholder="${taEsc(d.default)}">`}<div class="text-adjust-meta"><span>${d.key} · ${d.mode==='attr'?'Placeholder':'Visible text'}</span><button class="text-reset-one" onclick="resetOneText('${d.key}')">Reset</button></div></div>`;}).join('')}</div></section>`).join('');box.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>e.addEventListener('input',()=>queueTextAdjustSave(e.dataset.key,e.value)));document.getElementById('textControlTotal').textContent=USER_TEXT_ADJUST_CATALOG.length;refreshTextAdjustSummary();}
    function setTextStatus(t,type){const e=document.getElementById('textLiveStatus');if(!e)return;e.textContent=t;e.className='control-live-pill'+(type?' '+type:'');}
    function queueTextAdjustSave(key,value){textAdjustValues[key]=value;textSavePending.set(key,value);const input=document.querySelector(`.text-adjust-input[data-key="${key}"]`);input?.closest('.text-adjust-field')?.classList.toggle('changed',!!String(value||'').trim());const changed=Object.values(textAdjustValues).filter(v=>String(v||'').trim()).length,e=document.getElementById('textControlChanged');if(e)e.textContent=changed;if(document.getElementById('textOnlyChanged')?.checked)filterTextAdjustFields();clearTimeout(textSaveTimer);setTextStatus('● Unsaved text change…','saving');textSaveTimer=setTimeout(flushTextAdjustSaves,700);}
    async function flushTextAdjustSaves(){if(textSaveBusy){textSaveAgain=true;return;}if(!textSavePending.size)return;textSaveBusy=true;const items=[...textSavePending.entries()];textSavePending.clear();const revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),up={};items.forEach(([k,v])=>up[`settings/textAdjust/values/${k}`]=String(v||'').trim()?v:null);up['settings/textAdjust/revision']=revision;up['settings/textAdjust/updatedAt']=firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP;up['settings/textAdjust/updatedBy']=auth.currentUser?.email||'admin';setTextStatus('● Publishing text live…','saving');try{await database.ref().update(up);if((await database.ref('settings/textAdjust/revision').once('value')).val()!==revision)throw new Error('Verification failed');setTextStatus(`● ${Object.values(textAdjustValues).filter(v=>String(v||'').trim()).length} live overrides`,'');}catch(e){items.forEach(([k,v])=>textSavePending.set(k,v));setTextStatus('● Save failed','error');showToast('Text live update failed: '+e.message,'error');}finally{textSaveBusy=false;if(textSaveAgain||textSavePending.size){textSaveAgain=false;clearTimeout(textSaveTimer);textSaveTimer=setTimeout(flushTextAdjustSaves,600);}}}
    async function saveAllTextAdjust(){clearTimeout(textSaveTimer);const values={};document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>{if(e.value.trim())values[e.dataset.key]=e.value;});const revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);setTextStatus('● Publishing all text…','saving');try{await database.ref('settings/textAdjust').set({values,revision,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'});if((await database.ref('settings/textAdjust/revision').once('value')).val()!==revision)throw new Error('Verification failed');textAdjustValues=values;textSavePending.clear();refreshTextAdjustSummary();setTextStatus(`● ${Object.keys(values).length} live overrides`,'');showToast(`✅ ${Object.keys(values).length} text override(s) published live.`,'success');}catch(e){setTextStatus('● Save failed','error');showToast('Save All Text failed: '+e.message,'error');}}
    function resetOneText(key){const e=document.querySelector(`.text-adjust-input[data-key="${key}"]`);if(!e)return;e.value='';queueTextAdjustSave(key,'');}
    function resetTextSection(section){if(!confirm(`Reset every Text Adjust override in “${section}”?`))return;document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-group').forEach(g=>{if(g.dataset.section===section)g.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>{e.value='';textAdjustValues[e.dataset.key]='';textSavePending.set(e.dataset.key,'');});});refreshTextAdjustSummary();filterTextAdjustFields();clearTimeout(textSaveTimer);textSaveTimer=setTimeout(flushTextAdjustSaves,100);}
    function resetAllTextAdjust(){if(!confirm('Delete ALL Text Adjust overrides? Original and dedicated-control text will return instantly.'))return;document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>e.value='');textAdjustValues={};textSavePending.clear();const revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);database.ref('settings/textAdjust').set({values:{},revision,updatedAt:firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,updatedBy:auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'}).then(()=>{refreshTextAdjustSummary();filterTextAdjustFields();setTextStatus('● 0 live overrides','');showToast('✅ All Text Adjust overrides reset.','success');}).catch(e=>showToast('Reset failed: '+e.message,'error'));}
    function refreshTextAdjustSummary(){let changed=0;document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-input').forEach(e=>{const on=!!e.value.trim();e.closest('.text-adjust-field')?.classList.toggle('changed',on);if(on)changed++;});const a=document.getElementById('textControlChanged');if(a)a.textContent=changed;const s=document.getElementById('textLiveStatus');if(s&&!s.classList.contains('saving')&&!s.classList.contains('error'))s.textContent=`● ${changed} live overrides`;}
    function filterTextAdjustFields(){const q=(document.getElementById('textAdjustSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase(),section=document.getElementById('textAdjustSectionFilter')?.value||'all',only=document.getElementById('textOnlyChanged')?.checked;let visible=0;document.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-group').forEach(g=>{let n=0;g.querySelectorAll('.text-adjust-field').forEach(f=>{const input=f.querySelector('.text-adjust-input'),on=(!q||f.dataset.search.includes(q)||(input?.value||'').toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(section==='all'||g.dataset.section===section)&&(!only||!!input?.value.trim());f.classList.toggle('hidden-control',!on);if(on){n++;visible++;}});g.style.display=n?'block':'none';});const e=document.getElementById('textControlVisible');if(e)e.textContent=visible;}
    async function saveConnectedTextSettings(){const panelName=document.getElementById('taPanelName').value.trim(),topBanner=document.getElementById('taTopBanner').value,latestNews=document.getElementById('taLatestNews').value,revision=Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);try{await database.ref().update({'settings/panelName':panelName||'Top SMM','settings/topBanner':topBanner,'settings/latestNews':latestNews,'settings/textAdjust/connectedRevision':revision,'settings/textAdjust/updatedAt':firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP,'settings/textAdjust/updatedBy':auth.currentUser?.email||'admin'});showToast('✅ Connected brand/banner/news content updated live.','success');}catch(e){showToast('Connected content failed: '+e.message,'error');}}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOP SMM — v26 ADMIN UPGRADE LAYER · PART 1 : CORE
   Namespace: window.TSMX
   Adds: page registry, sidebar injection, SVG charts, CSV export,
         modal engine, ledger writer, audit logger, resilience helpers.
   Does NOT modify any existing function — only wraps/extends.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.TSMX) return;

  const TSMX = window.TSMX = {
    version: '30.0.0',
    ready: false,
    pages: {},
    role: null,
    roleData: null,
    _bootQueue: []
  };

  /* ─────────────── LEXICAL GLOBAL BRIDGE (critical) ───────────────
     The panel declares its globals with const/let at script top level, so they
     live in the global LEXICAL scope and are NOT properties of window.        */
  const LEXGET = (function () { try { return new Function('n', 'try{return eval(n);}catch(e){return undefined;}'); } catch (e) { return function () { }; } })();
  const LEXSET = (function () { try { return new Function('n', 'v', 'try{eval(n+"=v");return true;}catch(e){return false;}'); } catch (e) { return function () { return false; }; } })();
  TSMX.G = function (n) { var v; try { v = LEXGET(n); } catch (e) { } return v !== undefined ? v : window[n]; };
  TSMX.S = function (n, v) { if (!LEXSET(n, v)) window[n] = v; return v; };
  TSMX.authUser = () => { const a = TSMX.G('auth') || (window.firebase && firebase.auth()); return a && a.currentUser; };
  TSMX.adminEmail = () => { const u = TSMX.authUser(); return (u && u.email) || 'admin'; };
  const DB = () => TSMX.G('database') || (window.firebase && firebase.database());
  const AUTH = () => TSMX.G('auth') || (window.firebase && firebase.auth());
  TSMX.db = DB; TSMX.authObj = AUTH;

  /* ─────────────── tiny utils ─────────────── */
  const esc = TSMX.esc = v => String(v ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
  TSMX.num = (v, d = 0) => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d; };
  TSMX.money = v => '₹' + TSMX.num(v).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  TSMX.money0 = v => '₹' + Math.round(TSMX.num(v)).toLocaleString('en-IN');
  TSMX.int = v => Math.round(TSMX.num(v)).toLocaleString('en-IN');
  TSMX.pct = (a, b) => (!b ? '0%' : (Math.round((a / b) * 1000) / 10) + '%');
  TSMX.dt = ts => { if (!ts) return '—'; const d = new Date(Number(ts)); return isNaN(d) ? '—' : d.toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); };
  TSMX.dateOnly = ts => { const d = new Date(Number(ts)); return isNaN(d) ? '—' : d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); };
  TSMX.dayKey = ts => { const d = new Date(Number(ts)); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); };
  TSMX.uid = () => 'x' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  TSMX.toast = (m, t) => { try { window.showToast ? showToast(m, t) : console.log('[TSMX]', t || 'info', m); } catch (e) { console.log('[TSMX]', m); } };
  TSMX.debounce = (fn, ms) => { let t; return function () { clearTimeout(t); const a = arguments, s = this; t = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(s, a), ms || 300); }; };

  /* ─────────────── canonical field readers (v27 — this panel's REAL schema) ───────────────
     order   : amount / createdAt
     package : basePricePerK (= cost) + marginType/marginValue  → pricePerK (= sale price)
     fund    : amount / createdAt / method                                                  */
  TSMX.orderAmount = o => TSMX.num(o && (o.amount != null ? o.amount : (o.charge != null ? o.charge : (o.cost != null ? o.cost : o.price))));
  TSMX.orderTime   = o => TSMX.num(o && (o.createdAt != null ? o.createdAt : (o.timestamp != null ? o.timestamp : o.at)));
  TSMX.fundAmount  = f => TSMX.num(f && (f.amount != null ? f.amount : (f.amountINR != null ? f.amountINR : f.baseAmount)));
  TSMX.fundTime    = f => TSMX.num(f && (f.createdAt != null ? f.createdAt : (f.timestamp != null ? f.timestamp : f.at)));
  TSMX.fundMethod  = f => (f && (f.method || f.paymentMethod || f.methodId)) || 'Unknown';
  TSMX.packageCostPerK = function (p) {
    if (!p) return NaN;
    const base = TSMX.num(p.basePricePerK, NaN);
    if (Number.isFinite(base) && base > 0) return base;
    const alts = ['costPerK', 'costPrice', 'providerPrice', 'cost'];
    for (let i = 0; i < alts.length; i++) { const v = TSMX.num(p[alts[i]], NaN); if (Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) return v; }
    const price = TSMX.num(p.pricePerK, NaN);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return NaN;
    const mv = TSMX.num(p.marginValue, NaN);
    if (p.marginType === 'percent' && Number.isFinite(mv) && mv > 0) return price / (1 + mv / 100);
    if (p.marginType === 'fixed' && Number.isFinite(mv) && mv > 0 && mv < price) return price - mv;
    const mp = TSMX.num(p.marginPercent, NaN);
    if (Number.isFinite(mp) && mp > 0 && mp < 100) return price * (1 - mp / 100);
    return NaN;
  };

  };

  /* ─────────────── page registry + sidebar ─────────────── */
  TSMX.registerPage = function (cfg) {
    // cfg = {id, title, html, onEnter, group, icon, label, badgeId}
    TSMX.pages[cfg.id] = cfg;
    const host = document.querySelector('.main-content');
    if (host && !document.getElementById(cfg.id)) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'page-content'; d.id = cfg.id;
      d.innerHTML = cfg.html || '';
      host.appendChild(d);
    }
    if (cfg.group) TSMX.addNav(cfg.group, cfg.id, cfg.icon || '•', cfg.label || cfg.title, cfg.badgeId, cfg.after);
    // register the human title so navigatePage's title map fallback works
    TSMX._titles[cfg.id] = cfg.title || cfg.label || cfg.id;
  };

  TSMX.addNav = function (groupKey, pageId, icon, label, badgeId, afterSelector) {
    const sec = document.querySelector('.sidebar-section[data-sidebar-group="' + groupKey + '"]');
    if (!sec || sec.querySelector('.nav-item[onclick*="\'' + pageId + '\'"]')) return;
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'nav-item'; el.setAttribute('onclick', "navigatePage('" + pageId + "')");
    el.style.position = 'relative';
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="nav-icon">' + icon + '</span><span>' + esc(label) + '</span>' +
      (badgeId ? '<span class="nav-badge" id="' + badgeId + '" style="display:none;">0</span>' : '');
    sec.appendChild(el);
  };

  TSMX.addNavSection = function (key, icon, title, beforeKey) {
    const bar = document.querySelector('.sidebar-nav') || document.querySelector('.sidebar');
    if (!bar || document.querySelector('.sidebar-section[data-sidebar-group="' + key + '"]')) return;
    const sec = document.createElement('section');
    sec.className = 'sidebar-section'; sec.setAttribute('data-sidebar-group', key);
    sec.innerHTML = '<div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>' + icon + '</span><span>' + esc(title) + '</span></div>';
    const before = beforeKey ? document.querySelector('.sidebar-section[data-sidebar-group="' + beforeKey + '"]') : null;
    if (before) before.parentNode.insertBefore(sec, before); else {
      const logout = bar.querySelector('.sidebar-logout');
      logout ? logout.parentNode.insertBefore(sec, logout) : bar.appendChild(sec);
    }
  };

  /* ─────────────── SVG charts (no CDN, sandbox-safe) ─────────────── */
  const C = TSMX.chart = {};

  C.line = function (series, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const W = 760, H = opts.height || 230, PL = 56, PR = 16, PT = 16, PB = 30;
    const iw = W - PL - PR, ih = H - PT - PB;
    const labels = opts.labels || [];
    const all = series.reduce((a, s) => a.concat(s.data), []);
    let max = Math.max.apply(null, all.concat([1]));
    max = max <= 0 ? 1 : max * 1.12;
    const n = Math.max(1, labels.length - 1);
    const X = i => PL + (n === 0 ? iw / 2 : (i / n) * iw);
    const Y = v => PT + ih - (TSMX.num(v) / max) * ih;
    let g = '';
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const y = PT + (ih / 4) * i, val = max - (max / 4) * i;
      g += '<line x1="' + PL + '" y1="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (W - PR) + '" y2="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity=".12"/>' +
        '<text x="' + (PL - 8) + '" y="' + (y + 4).toFixed(1) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".55">' + (opts.money ? TSMX.short(val) : TSMX.short(val)) + '</text>';
    }
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(labels.length / 8));
    labels.forEach((l, i) => { if (i % step === 0 || i === labels.length - 1) g += '<text x="' + X(i).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (H - 9) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".55">' + esc(l) + '</text>'; });
    series.forEach((s, si) => {
      const pts = s.data.map((v, i) => X(i).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(v).toFixed(1));
      if (!pts.length) return;
      if (s.fill !== false) g += '<polygon points="' + PL + ',' + (PT + ih) + ' ' + pts.join(' ') + ' ' + X(s.data.length - 1).toFixed(1) + ',' + (PT + ih) + '" fill="' + s.color + '" fill-opacity=".11"/>';
      g += '<polyline points="' + pts.join(' ') + '" fill="none" stroke="' + s.color + '" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
      if (s.data.length <= 40) s.data.forEach((v, i) => { g += '<circle cx="' + X(i).toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + Y(v).toFixed(1) + '" r="2.8" fill="' + s.color + '"><title>' + esc(labels[i] || '') + ': ' + (opts.money ? TSMX.money0(v) : TSMX.int(v)) + '</title></circle>'; });
    });
    const legend = series.map(s => '<span><i style="background:' + s.color + '"></i>' + esc(s.name) + '</span>').join('');
    return '<svg class="tsmx-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="color:var(--text-primary,#0f172a)">' + g + '</svg><div class="tsmx-legend">' + legend + '</div>';
  };

  C.bars = function (items, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const max = Math.max.apply(null, items.map(i => TSMX.num(i.value)).concat([1]));
    if (!items.length) return '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">📊</span>No data in this range</div>';
    return items.map(i =>
      '<div class="tsmx-bar"><div class="bn" title="' + esc(i.name) + '">' + esc(i.name) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="bt"><div class="bf" style="width:' + Math.max(2, (TSMX.num(i.value) / max) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' + (i.color ? ';background:' + i.color : '') + '"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="bv">' + (opts.money ? TSMX.money0(i.value) : TSMX.int(i.value)) + (i.sub ? ' <small style="opacity:.65">' + esc(i.sub) + '</small>' : '') + '</div></div>').join('');
  };

  C.donut = function (items, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const total = items.reduce((a, b) => a + TSMX.num(b.value), 0);
    if (!total) return '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">🍩</span>No data in this range</div>';
    const R = 68, r = 42, cx = 90, cy = 90; let a0 = -Math.PI / 2, g = '';
    items.forEach(it => {
      const frac = TSMX.num(it.value) / total, a1 = a0 + frac * Math.PI * 2, big = frac > .5 ? 1 : 0;
      const p = (rad, a) => [cx + rad * Math.cos(a), cy + rad * Math.sin(a)];
      const [x0, y0] = p(R, a0), [x1, y1] = p(R, a1), [x2, y2] = p(r, a1), [x3, y3] = p(r, a0);
      if (frac > 0.9999) {
        g += '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + ((R + r) / 2) + '" fill="none" stroke="' + it.color + '" stroke-width="' + (R - r) + '"/>';
      } else {
        g += '<path d="M' + x0.toFixed(2) + ',' + y0.toFixed(2) + ' A' + R + ',' + R + ' 0 ' + big + ' 1 ' + x1.toFixed(2) + ',' + y1.toFixed(2) +
          ' L' + x2.toFixed(2) + ',' + y2.toFixed(2) + ' A' + r + ',' + r + ' 0 ' + big + ' 0 ' + x3.toFixed(2) + ',' + y3.toFixed(2) + ' Z" fill="' + it.color + '"><title>' +
          esc(it.name) + ': ' + TSMX.int(it.value) + ' (' + Math.round(frac * 100) + '%)</title></path>';
      }
      a0 = a1;
    });
    g += '<text x="' + cx + '" y="' + (cy - 3) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="currentColor">' + TSMX.short(total) + '</text>' +
      '<text x="' + cx + '" y="' + (cy + 15) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".6">' + esc(opts.centerLabel || 'TOTAL') + '</text>';
    const legend = items.map(i => '<span><i style="background:' + i.color + '"></i>' + esc(i.name) + ' <b>' + TSMX.int(i.value) + '</b> <small style="opacity:.6">' + Math.round(TSMX.num(i.value) / total * 100) + '%</small></span>').join('');
    return '<div style="display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><svg viewBox="0 0 180 180" width="180" height="180" style="flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--text-primary,#0f172a)">' + g + '</svg>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-legend" style="flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;margin:0">' + legend + '</div></div>';
  };

  TSMX.short = v => { v = TSMX.num(v); const a = Math.abs(v); if (a >= 1e7) return (v / 1e7).toFixed(1) + 'Cr'; if (a >= 1e5) return (v / 1e5).toFixed(1) + 'L'; if (a >= 1e3) return (v / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'k'; return (Math.round(v * 100) / 100).toString(); };

  /* ─────────────── CSV export ─────────────── */
  TSMX.csv = function (filename, rows) {
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return TSMX.toast('Nothing to export', 'error');
    const q = v => { v = v == null ? '' : String(v); return /[",\n\r]/.test(v) ? '"' + v.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : v; };
    const body = rows.map(r => r.map(q).join(',')).join('\r\n');
    const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + body], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = filename.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '_');
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
    setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1200);
    TSMX.toast('✅ Exported ' + (rows.length - 1) + ' row(s)', 'success');
  };

  /* ─────────────── loading / error / retry states ─────────────── */
  TSMX.loading = (el, msg) => { const e = typeof el === 'string' ? document.getElementById(el) : el; if (e) e.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-load"><div class="tsmx-spin"></div>' + esc(msg || 'Loading…') + '</div>'; };
  TSMX.empty = (el, icon, msg) => { const e = typeof el === 'string' ? document.getElementById(el) : el; if (e) e.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">' + (icon || '📭') + '</span>' + esc(msg || 'Nothing here yet') + '</div>'; };
  TSMX.fail = function (el, err, retryFnName) {
    const e = typeof el === 'string' ? document.getElementById(el) : el; if (!e) return;
    const msg = (err && (err.message || err.code)) || String(err || 'Unknown error');
    const hint = /permission|denied/i.test(msg) ? 'Firebase Rules are blocking this read. Check your database rules.' :
      /index|orderBy/i.test(msg) ? 'A Firebase index is missing for this query — see the browser console for the exact rule.' :
        /network|offline|unavailable/i.test(msg) ? 'Network problem — check your internet connection.' : '';
    e.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-err"><span class="ei">⚠️</span><div class="et">Could not load this data</div>' +
      '<div class="em">' + esc(msg) + (hint ? '<br><b>' + esc(hint) + '</b>' : '') + '</div>' +
      (retryFnName ? '<button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="' + esc(retryFnName) + '">🔄 Retry</button>' : '') + '</div>';
  };
  TSMX.guard = function (containerId, retryFnName, fn) {
    return Promise.resolve().then(fn).catch(err => { console.error('[TSMX]', retryFnName, err); TSMX.fail(containerId, err, retryFnName); });
  };

  TSMX.ledger = {
    write: function (uid, entry) {
      if (!uid || !entry || !entry.type) return Promise.resolve();
      const db = DB(); if (!db) return Promise.resolve();
      const row = {
        type: entry.type,
        amount: Math.round(TSMX.num(entry.amount) * 10000) / 10000,
        balanceAfter: entry.balanceAfter == null ? null : Math.round(TSMX.num(entry.balanceAfter) * 10000) / 10000,
        balanceBefore: entry.balanceBefore == null ? null : Math.round(TSMX.num(entry.balanceBefore) * 10000) / 10000,
        note: String(entry.note || '').slice(0, 240),
        ref: entry.ref ? String(entry.ref).slice(0, 80) : null,
        at: Date.now(),
        by: entry.by || 'system'
      };
      try { return Promise.resolve(db.ref('users/' + uid + '/ledger').push(row)).catch(e => console.warn('[TSMX ledger]', e && e.message)); }
      catch (e) { console.warn('[TSMX ledger]', e && e.message); return Promise.resolve(); }
    },
    /** Balance change + ledger in one atomic-ish operation. delta may be +/-. */
    apply: function (uid, delta, entry) {
      const db = DB(); if (!db || !uid) return Promise.reject(new Error('No uid'));
      let before = 0, after = 0;
      return db.ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').transaction(b => {
        before = TSMX.num(b);
        after = Math.round((before + TSMX.num(delta)) * 10000) / 10000;
        if (entry && entry.noNegative && after < 0) return; // abort
        return after;
      }).then(res => {
        if (!res.committed) throw new Error('Balance update aborted (insufficient funds)');
        after = TSMX.num(res.snapshot.val());
        try { if (window.mirrorUserWallet) mirrorUserWallet(uid); } catch (e) { }
        return TSMX.ledger.write(uid, Object.assign({}, entry, {
          amount: Math.abs(TSMX.num(delta)), balanceBefore: before, balanceAfter: after
        })).then(() => after);
      });
    }
  };

  /* ─────────────── AUDIT LOG ─────────────── */
  TSMX.audit = function (action, detail, target) {
    const db = DB(), a = AUTH();
    if (!db) return Promise.resolve();
    try { return Promise.resolve(db.ref('admin_audit').push({
      action: String(action || '').slice(0, 60),
      detail: String(detail || '').slice(0, 400),
      target: target ? String(target).slice(0, 120) : null,
      by: (a && a.currentUser && a.currentUser.email) || 'unknown',
      byUid: (a && a.currentUser && a.currentUser.uid) || null,
      role: TSMX.role || 'unknown',
      at: Date.now(),
      ua: navigator.userAgent.slice(0, 120)
    })).catch(e => console.warn('[TSMX audit]', e && e.message)); }
    catch (e) { console.warn('[TSMX audit]', e && e.message); return Promise.resolve(); }
  };

  /* ─────────────── date-range helper ─────────────── */
  TSMX.range = function (preset) {
    const now = new Date(), end = now.getTime();
    const d0 = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime();
    switch (preset) {
      case 'today': return { from: d0, to: end, label: 'Today', days: 1 };
      case '7d': return { from: d0 - 6 * 864e5, to: end, label: 'Last 7 days', days: 7 };
      case '30d': return { from: d0 - 29 * 864e5, to: end, label: 'Last 30 days', days: 30 };
      case '90d': return { from: d0 - 89 * 864e5, to: end, label: 'Last 90 days', days: 90 };
      case 'mtd': return { from: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).getTime(), to: end, label: 'This month', days: now.getDate() };
      case 'prevm': { const s = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1).getTime(), e = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).getTime() - 1; return { from: s, to: e, label: 'Last month', days: Math.ceil((e - s) / 864e5) }; }
      case 'ytd': return { from: new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1).getTime(), to: end, label: 'This year', days: Math.ceil((end - new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1).getTime()) / 864e5) };
      case 'all': return { from: 0, to: end, label: 'All time', days: 3650 };
      default: return { from: d0 - 29 * 864e5, to: end, label: 'Last 30 days', days: 30 };
    }
  };
  TSMX.buckets = function (from, to) {
    const out = [], span = to - from, DAY = 864e5;
    const stepDays = span > 200 * DAY ? 30 : span > 70 * DAY ? 7 : 1;
    let cur = new Date(from); cur.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    while (cur.getTime() <= to) {
      const s = cur.getTime(); const e = s + stepDays * DAY - 1;
      out.push({ from: s, to: Math.min(e, to), label: stepDays >= 30 ? cur.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', year: '2-digit' }) : cur.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }) });
      cur = new Date(s + stepDays * DAY);
      if (out.length > 400) break;
    }
    return out;
  };

  /* ─────────────── connection / offline watchdog ─────────────── */
  const off = document.createElement('div');
  off.className = 'tsmx-off'; off.id = 'tsmxOffline';
  const attachOff = () => { if (document.body && !document.getElementById('tsmxOffline')) document.body.appendChild(off); };
  attachOff(); document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attachOff);
  let wasDown = false;
  function setConn(state, text) {
    off.className = 'tsmx-off' + (state ? ' on ' + state : '');
    off.textContent = text || '';
  }
  window.addEventListener('offline', () => { wasDown = true; setConn('', '📴 You are offline — changes will not save until the connection returns.'); off.classList.add('on'); });
  window.addEventListener('online', () => { setConn('back', '✅ Back online'); setTimeout(() => off.classList.remove('on'), 2600); });
  TSMX.watchConnection = function () {
    const db = DB(); if (!db) return;
    try {
      db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', s => {
        const up = s.val() === true;
        if (!up) { wasDown = true; setConn('recon', '⏳ Reconnecting to the database…'); off.classList.add('on'); }
        else if (wasDown) { wasDown = false; setConn('back', '✅ Database reconnected'); setTimeout(() => off.classList.remove('on'), 2400); }
      });
    } catch (e) { }
  };

  /* ─────────────── global error boundary ─────────────── */
  TSMX.errors = [];
  function record(kind, msg, src) {
    TSMX.errors.unshift({ kind: kind, msg: String(msg).slice(0, 300), src: String(src || '').slice(0, 160), at: Date.now() });
    if (TSMX.errors.length > 60) TSMX.errors.length = 60;
  }
  window.addEventListener('error', e => {
    record('error', e.message, (e.filename || '') + ':' + (e.lineno || ''));
    if (/Loading chunk|ResizeObserver/.test(e.message || '')) return;
    console.warn('[TSMX caught]', e.message);
  });
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => {
    const r = e.reason || {};
    record('promise', r.message || r.code || String(r), '');
    if (/permission_denied|PERMISSION_DENIED/i.test(r.message || r.code || '')) {
      TSMX.toast('⛔ Permission denied by Firebase Rules — action blocked.', 'error');
    }
  });

  /* ─────────────── boot ─────────────── */
  TSMX.onReady = fn => { TSMX.ready ? fn() : TSMX._bootQueue.push(fn); };
  TSMX.boot = function () {
    if (TSMX.ready) return;
    TSMX.ready = true;
    TSMX.watchConnection();
    TSMX._bootQueue.splice(0).forEach(f => { try { f(); } catch (e) { console.error('[TSMX boot]', e); } });
  };

  console.log('%c TSMX v' + TSMX.version + ' core loaded ', 'background:#0ea5e9;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 02-security.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 2 — GAP #2 : REAL ADMIN SECURITY (roles + audit)
   • Database-backed admin list at  admins/{uid}
   • 4 roles with granular permissions
   • Full audit trail at  admin_audit/*
   • Auto-bootstrap: the legacy ADMIN_EMAILS owner becomes 'super' once.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const AUTH = () => TSMX.authObj();

  /* ---------- role matrix ---------- */
  const ROLES = TSMX.ROLES = {
    super: {
      label: '👑 Super Admin', color: '#7c3aed',
      desc: 'Full control including admin management, database migration and destructive actions.',
      perms: ['*']
    },
    manager: {
      label: '🛡️ Manager', color: '#0ea5e9',
      desc: 'Everything except managing admins, migration tools and Firebase project switching.',
      perms: ['orders', 'funds', 'refills', 'tickets', 'users', 'users.balance', 'users.status', 'services', 'settings', 'design', 'campaigns', 'coupons', 'broadcast', 'analytics', 'referral', 'panel']
    },
    finance: {
      label: '💰 Finance', color: '#10b981',
      desc: 'Money side only — fund requests, balances, coupons, referral settings and analytics.',
      perms: ['funds', 'users', 'users.balance', 'analytics', 'coupons', 'referral', 'orders.view']
    },
    support: {
      label: '🎧 Support', color: '#f59e0b',
      desc: 'Day-to-day desk — orders, refills, tickets and read-only users. Cannot touch money or settings.',
      perms: ['orders', 'refills', 'tickets', 'users.view', 'orders.view']
    }
  };

  TSMX.can = function (perm) {
    if (!TSMX.role) return false;
    const r = ROLES[TSMX.role]; if (!r) return false;
    if (r.perms.indexOf('*') >= 0) return true;
    if (r.perms.indexOf(perm) >= 0) return true;
    const base = perm.split('.')[0];
    return r.perms.indexOf(base) >= 0;
  };
  TSMX.require = function (perm, silent) {
    if (TSMX.can(perm)) return true;
    if (!silent) TSMX.toast('⛔ Your role (' + (ROLES[TSMX.role] ? ROLES[TSMX.role].label : TSMX.role) + ') cannot perform this action.', 'error');
    return false;
  };

  /* hide sidebar entries a role cannot use */
  const NAV_PERM = {
    ordersPage: 'orders.view', massOrdersPage: 'orders', fundRequestsPage: 'funds',
    refillRequestsPage: 'refills', supportTicketsPage: 'tickets', panelOrdersPage: 'panel',
    usersPage: 'users.view', allSignupUsersPage: 'users.view', servicesPage: 'services',
    planManagementPage: 'panel', newOrderControlPage: 'settings', massControlPage: 'settings',
    paymentMethodsPage: 'funds', currencySettingsPage: 'settings', apiSettingsPage: 'settings',
    rulesManagementPage: 'design', ticketSettingsPage: 'tickets', analyticsPage: 'analytics',
    emailSettingsPage: 'settings', maintenancePage: 'settings',
    tsmxReferralPage: 'referral', tsmxCouponsPage: 'coupons', tsmxBroadcastPage: 'broadcast',
    tsmxAdminsPage: 'admins', tsmxAuditPage: 'admins', tsmxAnalyticsPage: 'analytics',
    tsmxDripPage: 'orders', tsmxHealthPage: 'settings', tsmxPricingPage: 'users.balance',
    tsmxServiceToolkitPage: 'services', tsmxOrderRulesPage: 'settings',
    tsmxOrderSearchPage: 'orders.view', tsmxUsersPage: 'users.view', tsmxBridgePage: 'settings',
    tsmxPlatformsPage: 'services', tsmxWishlistPage: 'users.view',
    tsmxPanelControlsPage: 'settings', tsmxFeedbackPage: 'tickets'
  };
  function applyRoleVisibility() {
    if (!TSMX.role || TSMX.role === 'super') return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar .nav-item[onclick*="navigatePage("]').forEach(el => {
      const m = /navigatePage\('([^']+)'/.exec(el.getAttribute('onclick') || '');
      if (!m) return;
      const need = NAV_PERM[m[1]];
      if (need && !TSMX.can(need)) el.style.display = 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-parent').forEach(p2 => {
      const kids = p2.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-submenu .nav-item');
      const vis = Array.prototype.filter.call(kids, k => k.style.display !== 'none').length;
      if (kids.length && !vis) p2.style.display = 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-section').forEach(sec => {
      const kids = sec.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .sidebar-parent');
      const vis = Array.prototype.filter.call(kids, k => k.style.display !== 'none').length;
      if (kids.length && !vis) sec.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }
  TSMX.applyRoleVisibility = applyRoleVisibility;

  function paintRoleBadge() {
    const bar = document.querySelector('.top-bar-right .admin-info');
    if (!bar || !TSMX.role) return;
    let b = document.getElementById('tsmxRoleBadge');
    if (!b) {
      b = document.createElement('span'); b.id = 'tsmxRoleBadge';
      b.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;margin-right:9px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.3px;color:#fff';
      bar.parentNode.insertBefore(b, bar);
    }
    const r = ROLES[TSMX.role] || { label: TSMX.role, color: '#64748b' };
    b.style.background = r.color; b.textContent = r.label; b.title = r.desc || '';
  }

  /* ---------- resolve current admin ----------
     FAIL-SAFE BY DESIGN. We only ever DENY when the database explicitly says
     enabled:false. If the admins node is missing or unreadable we fall back to
     the panel's own ADMIN_EMAILS allow-list, exactly like the original code.
     ADMIN_EMAILS is a top-level const, so it is NOT on window - read it
     through the lexical bridge.                                              */
  function ownerEmails() {
    const list = TSMX.G('ADMIN_EMAILS') || window.ADMIN_EMAILS || [];
    return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).map(e => String(e || '').trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
  }
  TSMX.ownerEmails = ownerEmails;
  TSMX.isOwnerEmail = em => ownerEmails().indexOf(String(em || '').trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0;

  function grant(role, rec) {
    TSMX.role = role;
    TSMX.roleData = rec || { role: role };
    paintRoleBadge();
    applyRoleVisibility();
    return TSMX.roleData;
  }

  TSMX.resolveAdmin = function (user) {
    const db = DB();
    if (!user) { TSMX.role = null; TSMX.roleData = null; return Promise.resolve(null); }
    const email = String(user.email || '').toLowerCase();
    const legacyOwner = TSMX.isOwnerEmail(email);

    if (!db) return Promise.resolve(legacyOwner ? grant('super', { email: email, role: 'super', enabled: true, offline: true }) : null);

    return db.ref('admins/' + user.uid).once('value')
      .then(snap => (snap && snap.exists()) ? snap.val() : null)
      .catch(err => { console.warn('[TSMX] admins read blocked:', err && err.message); return undefined; })
      .then(rec => {
        // 1. explicit record
        if (rec && typeof rec === 'object') {
          if (rec.enabled === false) { TSMX.role = null; TSMX.roleData = null; return { __denied: true, reason: 'Your admin access has been disabled by a Super Admin.' }; }
          db.ref('admins/' + user.uid + '/lastLoginAt').set(Date.now()).catch(() => { });
          TSMX.audit('login', 'Admin signed in', email);
          return grant(rec.role || 'support', rec);
        }
        // 2. no record (or unreadable) -> trust the panel's own allow-list
        if (legacyOwner) {
          const seedRec = { email: email, name: 'Owner', role: 'super', enabled: true, createdAt: Date.now(), bootstrapped: true };
          grant('super', seedRec);                       // access granted immediately
          if (rec === null) {                            // readable but empty -> create it
            db.ref('admins/' + user.uid).set(seedRec)
              .then(() => db.ref('admins_index/' + email.replace(/[.#$\[\]]/g, '_')).set(user.uid).catch(() => { }))
              .then(() => console.log('%c TSMX: owner bootstrapped into admins/' + user.uid, 'color:#10b981'))
              .catch(e => console.warn('[TSMX] could not create the admins record (check your Firebase rules):', e.message));
          }
          TSMX.audit('login', 'Owner signed in (allow-list)', email);
          return TSMX.roleData;
        }
        TSMX.role = null; TSMX.roleData = null;
        return null;
      });
  };

  /* ---------- hard gate: replace the email-only auth observer ---------- */
  TSMX.installAuthGate = function () {
    const auth = AUTH(); if (!auth || TSMX._gateInstalled) return;
    TSMX._gateInstalled = true;
    auth.onAuthStateChanged(function (user) {
      if (!user) return;
      TSMX.resolveAdmin(user).then(rec => {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('loginOverlay');
        if (rec && rec.__denied) {                       // an explicit, deliberate denial
          const e2 = document.getElementById('loginError');
          if (e2) { e2.textContent = '\u26D4 ' + rec.reason; e2.style.display = 'block'; }
          if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'flex';
          try { AUTH().signOut(); } catch (e) { }
          return;
        }
        if (rec) { if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none'; TSMX.boot(); return; }
        // Not recognised. NEVER sign out someone the panel's own list accepts -
        // leave that decision to the original observer so behaviour is identical.
        if (TSMX.isOwnerEmail(user.email)) { if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none'; TSMX.boot(); return; }
        const errEl = document.getElementById('loginError');
        if (errEl) {
          errEl.innerHTML = '&#9940; This account is not registered as an admin.<br>' +
            '<small style="font-weight:500;opacity:.85">Ask a Super Admin to add your UID under <b>Security &amp; Access &rarr; Admin Accounts</b>.<br>Your UID: <code>' +
            esc(user.uid) + '</code></small>';
          errEl.style.display = 'block';
        }
        if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'flex';
      }).catch(e => { console.warn('[TSMX] auth gate error, allowing the original gate to decide:', e && e.message); TSMX.boot(); });
    });
  };

  /* ══════════ PAGE: Admin Accounts ══════════ */
  const adminsHTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🔐 Admin Accounts & Roles</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-warn">
      <b>Important:</b> this list is the real gate — a person can only open the admin panel if their Firebase UID
      exists here with <b>enabled = true</b>. Pair it with these Realtime Database rules so it cannot be bypassed:<br>
      <code style="display:block;margin-top:7px;padding:9px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;white-space:pre-wrap">".write": "root.child('admins').child(auth.uid).child('enabled').val() === true"</code>
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="tsmxAdminSearch" placeholder="Email, name or UID…" oninput="TSMX.renderAdmins()"></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.openAdminModal()">➕ Add Admin</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.loadAdmins()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.exportAdmins()">📥 CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="tsmxAdminsList"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🎭 Role Permissions Reference</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2" id="tsmxRoleCards"></div>
  </div>`;

  const auditHTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">📜 Admin Activity Log</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">Every sensitive admin action is written to <code>admin_audit</code> with who did it, when, and from which device.</div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Action</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxAuditAction" onchange="TSMX.renderAudit()"><option value="">All actions</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Admin</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxAuditWho" onchange="TSMX.renderAudit()"><option value="">All admins</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="tsmxAuditSearch" placeholder="Detail or target…" oninput="TSMX.renderAudit()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Show</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxAuditLimit" onchange="TSMX.loadAudit()"><option value="200">Last 200</option><option value="500">Last 500</option><option value="1000">Last 1000</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.loadAudit()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.exportAudit()">📥 CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="tsmxAuditList"></div>
  </div>`;

  let ADMINS = [], AUDIT = [];

  TSMX.loadAdmins = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxAdminsList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading admin accounts…');
    TSMX.guard('tsmxAdminsList', 'TSMX.loadAdmins()', () =>
      DB().ref('admins').once('value').then(s => {
        ADMINS = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([uid, v]) => Object.assign({ uid: uid }, v));
        ADMINS.sort((a, b) => (a.role === 'super' ? -1 : 1) - (b.role === 'super' ? -1 : 1) || String(a.email || '').localeCompare(String(b.email || '')));
        TSMX.renderAdmins();
      })
    );
  };

  TSMX.renderAdmins = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxAdminsList'); if (!box) return;
    const q = (document.getElementById('tsmxAdminSearch') || {}).value || '';
    const list = ADMINS.filter(a => !q || (a.email + ' ' + (a.name || '') + ' ' + a.uid).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🔐', 'No admin accounts match.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Admin</th><th>Role</th><th>Status</th><th>Last Login</th><th>Added</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.map(a => {
        const r = ROLES[a.role] || { label: a.role, color: '#64748b' };
        const me = (TSMX.authUser() && TSMX.authUser().uid) === a.uid;
        return '<tr><td><b>' + esc(a.name || a.email || '—') + '</b>' + (me ? ' <span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">YOU</span>' : '') +
          '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(a.email || '') + '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-light,#94a3b8);font-family:monospace">' + esc(a.uid) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td><span class="tsmx-pill" style="background:' + r.color + '22;color:' + r.color + '">' + esc(r.label) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td>' + (a.enabled === false ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">Disabled</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">Active</span>') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px">' + TSMX.dt(a.lastLoginAt) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px">' + TSMX.dateOnly(a.createdAt) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.openAdminModal(\'' + esc(a.uid) + '\')">✏️ Edit</button> ' +
          (me ? '' : '<button class="tsmx-btn sm ' + (a.enabled === false ? 'ok' : 'warn') + '" onclick="TSMX.toggleAdmin(\'' + esc(a.uid) + '\')">' + (a.enabled === false ? '✅ Enable' : '⏸ Disable') + '</button> ' +
            '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.deleteAdmin(\'' + esc(a.uid) + '\')">🗑</button>') +
          '</td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  };

  TSMX.openAdminModal = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('admins')) return;
    const a = ADMINS.find(x => x.uid === uid) || { role: 'support', enabled: true };
    TSMX.modal({
      title: uid ? '✏️ Edit Admin' : '➕ Add Admin Account',
      body:
        (uid ? '' : '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">The person must <b>already have a normal account</b> on this panel (or an Auth user). Copy their <b>Firebase UID</b> from Users page → it is shown under their name.</div>') +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Firebase UID *</label><input id="tsmxAdUid" value="' + esc(a.uid || '') + '" ' + (uid ? 'readonly style="opacity:.65"' : 'placeholder="e.g. K3jf9dLm2..."') + '></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Email</label><input id="tsmxAdEmail" value="' + esc(a.email || '') + '" placeholder="admin@example.com"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Display Name</label><input id="tsmxAdName" value="' + esc(a.name || '') + '" placeholder="e.g. Rahul (Support)"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Role *</label><select id="tsmxAdRole">' +
        Object.keys(ROLES).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '"' + (a.role === k ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + ROLES[k].label + '</option>').join('') +
        '</select><div class="hint" id="tsmxAdRoleHint"></div></div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="tsmxAdEnabled"' + (a.enabled !== false ? ' checked' : '') + '><span><span class="sw-t">Account enabled</span><span class="sw-h">Turn off to instantly block this person from the admin panel.</span></span></label>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.saveAdmin(' + (uid ? "'" + uid + "'" : 'null') + ')">💾 Save</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        const sel = document.getElementById('tsmxAdRole'), h = document.getElementById('tsmxAdRoleHint');
        const paint = () => { h.textContent = (ROLES[sel.value] || {}).desc || ''; };
        sel.onchange = paint; paint();
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.saveAdmin = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('admins')) return;
    const u = (document.getElementById('tsmxAdUid').value || '').trim();
    if (!u) return TSMX.toast('Firebase UID is required', 'error');
    const rec = {
      email: (document.getElementById('tsmxAdEmail').value || '').trim().toLowerCase(),
      name: (document.getElementById('tsmxAdName').value || '').trim(),
      role: document.getElementById('tsmxAdRole').value,
      enabled: document.getElementById('tsmxAdEnabled').checked,
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    if (!uid) rec.createdAt = Date.now();
    DB().ref('admins/' + u).update(rec).then(() => {
      if (rec.email) DB().ref('admins_index/' + rec.email.replace(/[.#$\[\]]/g, '_')).set(u).catch(() => { });
      TSMX.audit(uid ? 'admin.update' : 'admin.create', rec.role + ' · ' + rec.email, u);
      TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('✅ Admin saved', 'success'); TSMX.loadAdmins();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.toggleAdmin = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('admins')) return;
    const a = ADMINS.find(x => x.uid === uid); if (!a) return;
    const next = a.enabled === false;
    DB().ref('admins/' + uid + '/enabled').set(next).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('admin.' + (next ? 'enable' : 'disable'), a.email || uid, uid);
      TSMX.toast(next ? '✅ Admin enabled' : '⏸ Admin disabled', 'success'); TSMX.loadAdmins();
    });
  };

  TSMX.deleteAdmin = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('admins')) return;
    const a = ADMINS.find(x => x.uid === uid) || {};
    TSMX.confirm('Remove admin access?', 'This removes <b>' + esc(a.email || uid) + '</b> from the admin list. Their normal user account is not touched.', () => {
      DB().ref('admins/' + uid).remove().then(() => {
        TSMX.audit('admin.delete', a.email || uid, uid);
        TSMX.toast('🗑 Admin removed', 'success'); TSMX.loadAdmins();
      });
    }, true);
  };

  TSMX.exportAdmins = () => TSMX.csv('admins_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['UID', 'Email', 'Name', 'Role', 'Enabled', 'Last Login', 'Created']].concat(
      ADMINS.map(a => [a.uid, a.email || '', a.name || '', a.role, a.enabled !== false, TSMX.dt(a.lastLoginAt), TSMX.dt(a.createdAt)])));

  /* ---------- audit page ---------- */
  TSMX.loadAudit = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxAuditList'); if (!box) return;
    const lim = Number((document.getElementById('tsmxAuditLimit') || {}).value || 200);
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading activity log…');
    TSMX.guard('tsmxAuditList', 'TSMX.loadAudit()', () =>
      DB().ref('admin_audit').orderByChild('at').limitToLast(lim).once('value').then(s => {
        AUDIT = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
        const acts = [...new Set(AUDIT.map(a => a.action))].sort();
        const whos = [...new Set(AUDIT.map(a => a.by))].sort();
        const sa = document.getElementById('tsmxAuditAction'), sw = document.getElementById('tsmxAuditWho');
        const keepA = sa.value, keepW = sw.value;
        sa.innerHTML = '<option value="">All actions</option>' + acts.map(a => '<option>' + esc(a) + '</option>').join('');
        sw.innerHTML = '<option value="">All admins</option>' + whos.map(a => '<option>' + esc(a) + '</option>').join('');
        sa.value = keepA; sw.value = keepW;
        TSMX.renderAudit();
      })
    );
  };

  TSMX.renderAudit = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxAuditList'); if (!box) return;
    const fa = (document.getElementById('tsmxAuditAction') || {}).value || '';
    const fw = (document.getElementById('tsmxAuditWho') || {}).value || '';
    const q = ((document.getElementById('tsmxAuditSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const list = AUDIT.filter(a => (!fa || a.action === fa) && (!fw || a.by === fw) &&
      (!q || ((a.detail || '') + ' ' + (a.target || '')).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '📜', 'No matching activity.');
    const tone = a => /delete|remove|reject|ban|disable/i.test(a.action) ? 'p-red' : /create|add|approve|enable|credit/i.test(a.action) ? 'p-green' : /update|edit|save/i.test(a.action) ? 'p-blue' : 'p-gray';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Admin</th><th>Action</th><th>Detail</th><th>Target</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      list.map(a => '<tr><td style="font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(a.at) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(a.by || '—') + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(a.role || '') + '</div></td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + tone(a) + '">' + esc(a.action) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(a.detail || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(a.target || '—') + '</td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div><div style="margin-top:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing ' + list.length + ' of ' + AUDIT.length + ' entries</div>';
  };

  TSMX.exportAudit = () => TSMX.csv('admin_audit_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['When', 'Admin', 'Role', 'Action', 'Detail', 'Target']].concat(
      AUDIT.map(a => [TSMX.dt(a.at), a.by || '', a.role || '', a.action, a.detail || '', a.target || ''])));

  /* ---------- register ---------- */
  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.addNavSection('security', '🔐', 'Security & Access', 'system');
    TSMX.registerPage({ id: 'tsmxAdminsPage', title: 'Admin Accounts & Roles', html: adminsHTML, group: 'security', icon: '🔐', label: 'Admin Accounts', onEnter: () => { TSMX.loadAdmins(); paintRoles(); } });
    TSMX.registerPage({ id: 'tsmxAuditPage', title: 'Admin Activity Log', html: auditHTML, group: 'security', icon: '📜', label: 'Activity Log', onEnter: TSMX.loadAudit });
    applyRoleVisibility();
  });

  function paintRoles() {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxRoleCards'); if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = Object.keys(ROLES).map(k => {
      const r = ROLES[k];
      return '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + r.color + '"><div class="k-l" style="color:' + r.color + '">' + esc(r.label) + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-top:7px;line-height:1.55">' + esc(r.desc) + '</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:9px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px">' +
        (r.perms.indexOf('*') >= 0 ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">EVERYTHING</span>' :
          r.perms.map(p => '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">' + esc(p) + '</span>').join('')) + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
  }
})();


/* ---------- 03-referral.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 3 — GAP #1 : REFERRAL CONTROL CENTER
   ⚠️ BY DESIGN: referral commission is NEVER withdrawable.
      It is credited straight into the referrer's WALLET BALANCE and can
      only be spent on orders inside the panel. No withdrawal system.
   Writes to: admin_settings/referral   (the node the user panel reads)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const PATH = 'admin_settings/referral';

  const DEFAULTS = {
    enabled: true,
    commission_percent: 5,
    credit_on_status: 'completed',
    min_order_amount: 0,
    max_commission_per_order: 0,       // 0 = unlimited
    signup_bonus_referrer: 0,
    signup_bonus_referee: 0,
    lifetime: true,                     // commission on every order, not just first
    first_order_only: false,
    self_referral_block: true,
    reverse_on_refund: true,
    code_length: 8,
    banner_text: 'Invite friends and earn commission straight into your wallet balance!',
    terms_text: 'Commission is added to your wallet balance automatically when your referred user\'s order is completed. Wallet balance can be used for placing orders on this panel. It is not withdrawable as cash.'
  };

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🎁 Referral Program Control</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-ok">
      <b>💡 How this program works:</b> when a referred user's order reaches the chosen status, the commission is
      <b>added directly to the referrer's wallet balance</b> and they can immediately spend it on orders.
      <b>There is no withdrawal / payout system</b> — it is panel credit only. Every credit is written to the
      user's Wallet Statement so it is fully traceable.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-warn" id="tsmxRefWireStatus">Checking live connection to the user panel…</div>

    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3" style="margin-bottom:18px" id="tsmxRefKpis"></div>

    <div class="tsmx-tabs">
      <button class="tsmx-tab on" data-rt="core" onclick="TSMX.refTab('core')">⚙️ Core Rules</button>
      <button class="tsmx-tab" data-rt="bonus" onclick="TSMX.refTab('bonus')">🎉 Signup Bonus</button>
      <button class="tsmx-tab" data-rt="text" onclick="TSMX.refTab('text')">✍️ Page Text</button>
      <button class="tsmx-tab" data-rt="log" onclick="TSMX.refTab('log')">📊 Commission Log</button>
    </div>

    <div data-rp="core">
      <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rfEnabled"><span><span class="sw-t">Referral program enabled</span><span class="sw-h">Turn off to hide earning and stop all new commission credits. Existing wallet balance is never touched.</span></span></label>
      <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Commission percentage (%) *</label>
          <input type="number" id="rfPercent" min="0" max="100" step="0.1">
          <div class="hint">Percent of the referred user's order amount credited to the referrer's wallet. This is the exact value the user panel shows on the Referral page.</div></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Credit commission when order becomes</label>
          <select id="rfCreditOn">
            <option value="completed">✅ Completed (safest — recommended)</option>
            <option value="processing">⚙️ Processing</option>
            <option value="pending">⏳ Pending (instant, highest risk)</option>
          </select>
          <div class="hint">Later statuses protect you from paying commission on orders that get cancelled or refunded.</div></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Minimum order amount (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" id="rfMinOrder" min="0" step="1">
          <div class="hint">Orders below this value earn no commission. 0 = no minimum.</div></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum commission per order (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" id="rfMaxComm" min="0" step="1">
          <div class="hint">Caps a single commission credit. 0 = unlimited.</div></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Referral code length</label>
          <input type="number" id="rfCodeLen" min="4" max="16" step="1">
          <div class="hint">Length of newly generated codes. Existing codes keep working.</div></div>
      </div>
      <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rfLifetime"><span><span class="sw-t">Lifetime commission</span><span class="sw-h">Earn on <b>every</b> order the referred user ever places (not just the first one).</span></span></label>
      <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rfFirstOnly"><span><span class="sw-t">First order only</span><span class="sw-h">Pay commission only on the referred user's very first completed order. Overrides lifetime.</span></span></label>
      <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rfSelfBlock"><span><span class="sw-t">Block self-referral</span><span class="sw-h">Stop users applying their own code or creating loops between two accounts.</span></span></label>
      <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rfReverse"><span><span class="sw-t">Reverse commission on refund / cancel</span><span class="sw-h">If a paid order is later moved out of the credit status, the commission is pulled back out of the wallet automatically.</span></span></label>
    </div>

    <div data-rp="bonus" style="display:none">
      <div class="tsmx-note n-info">One-time wallet credits given the moment a referral code is successfully applied at signup. Set 0 to disable.</div>
      <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Bonus to the REFERRER (₹)</label><input type="number" id="rfBonusReferrer" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">Instantly added to the inviter's wallet balance.</div></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Bonus to the NEW USER (₹)</label><input type="number" id="rfBonusReferee" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">Welcome credit for the person who used the code — great for first-order conversion.</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div data-rp="text" style="display:none">
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Referral page banner text</label><textarea id="rfBanner" rows="2"></textarea><div class="hint">Shown at the top of the user's Referral & Earn page.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Program terms text</label><textarea id="rfTerms" rows="4"></textarea><div class="hint">Explain clearly that commission goes to wallet balance and is not withdrawable.</div></div>
    </div>

    <div data-rp="log" style="display:none">
      <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
        <div class="fld"><label>Status</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="rfLogStatus" onchange="TSMX.renderRefLog()"><option value="">All</option><option value="completed">Credited</option><option value="reversed">Reversed</option></select></div>
        <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="rfLogSearch" placeholder="Order ID or UID…" oninput="TSMX.renderRefLog()"></div>
        <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.loadRefLog()">🔄 Refresh</button>
        <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.exportRefLog()">📥 CSV</button>
      </div>
      <div id="rfLogBox"></div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color)">
      <button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.saveReferral()">💾 Save & Publish Live</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.loadReferral()">↺ Reload</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.resetReferral()">⚙️ Restore Defaults</button>
      <span id="rfStatus" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  let LOG = [];

  TSMX.refTab = function (t) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-rt]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.rt === t));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-rp]').forEach(p => p.style.display = p.dataset.rp === t ? '' : 'none');
    if (t === 'log' && !LOG.length) TSMX.loadRefLog();
  };

  TSMX.loadReferral = function () {
    if (!document.getElementById('rfPercent')) return;
    DB().ref(PATH).once('value').then(s => {
      const v = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, s.val() || {});
      const set = (id, val, chk) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (!e) return; if (chk) e.checked = val !== false; else e.value = val; };
      set('rfEnabled', v.enabled, 1); set('rfPercent', TSMX.num(v.commission_percent, 5));
      document.getElementById('rfCreditOn').value = v.credit_on_status || 'completed';
      set('rfMinOrder', TSMX.num(v.min_order_amount)); set('rfMaxComm', TSMX.num(v.max_commission_per_order));
      set('rfCodeLen', TSMX.num(v.code_length, 8));
      set('rfLifetime', v.lifetime, 1); document.getElementById('rfFirstOnly').checked = v.first_order_only === true;
      set('rfSelfBlock', v.self_referral_block, 1); set('rfReverse', v.reverse_on_refund, 1);
      set('rfBonusReferrer', TSMX.num(v.signup_bonus_referrer)); set('rfBonusReferee', TSMX.num(v.signup_bonus_referee));
      set('rfBanner', v.banner_text || ''); set('rfTerms', v.terms_text || '');
      const w = document.getElementById('tsmxRefWireStatus');
      if (w) {
        w.className = 'tsmx-note n-ok';
        w.innerHTML = '✅ <b>Live link verified.</b> The user panel reads <code>' + PATH + '</code> — saving here changes the referral page instantly for every user. Current live rate: <b>' + TSMX.num(v.commission_percent, 5) + '%</b>.';
      }
      paintKpis();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Referral load failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.saveReferral = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('referral')) return;
    const pct = TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfPercent').value);
    if (pct < 0 || pct > 100) return TSMX.toast('Commission must be between 0 and 100%', 'error');
    const payload = {
      enabled: document.getElementById('rfEnabled').checked,
      commission_percent: pct,
      credit_on_status: document.getElementById('rfCreditOn').value,
      min_order_amount: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfMinOrder').value)),
      max_commission_per_order: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfMaxComm').value)),
      code_length: Math.min(16, Math.max(4, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfCodeLen').value, 8))),
      lifetime: document.getElementById('rfLifetime').checked,
      first_order_only: document.getElementById('rfFirstOnly').checked,
      self_referral_block: document.getElementById('rfSelfBlock').checked,
      reverse_on_refund: document.getElementById('rfReverse').checked,
      signup_bonus_referrer: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfBonusReferrer').value)),
      signup_bonus_referee: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfBonusReferee').value)),
      banner_text: document.getElementById('rfBanner').value.trim(),
      terms_text: document.getElementById('rfTerms').value.trim(),
      withdrawal_enabled: false,          // hard-locked: wallet credit only
      payout_mode: 'wallet_balance_only',
      revision: Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
    const s = document.getElementById('rfStatus'); if (s) s.textContent = '● Publishing…';
    DB().ref(PATH).update(payload).then(() => DB().ref(PATH + '/revision').once('value')).then(r => {
      if (r.val() !== payload.revision) throw new Error('Verification failed — value did not persist');
      if (s) s.textContent = '● Live · saved ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN');
      TSMX.audit('referral.settings', pct + '% · credit on ' + payload.credit_on_status + ' · lifetime=' + payload.lifetime, PATH);
      TSMX.toast('✅ Referral settings are now live for every user.', 'success');
      paintKpis();
    }).catch(e => { if (s) s.textContent = '● Save failed'; TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); });
  };

  TSMX.resetReferral = function () {
    TSMX.confirm('Restore referral defaults?', 'Every referral rule goes back to the built-in default (5% on completed orders, wallet credit only). Already-credited wallet balance is <b>not</b> touched.', () => {
      DB().ref(PATH).update(Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, { revision: Date.now().toString(36), updatedAt: Date.now() }))
        .then(() => { TSMX.loadReferral(); TSMX.audit('referral.reset', 'Restored defaults', PATH); TSMX.toast('✅ Defaults restored', 'success'); });
    });
  };

  function paintKpis() {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxRefKpis'); if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:#7c3aed"><div class="k-l">Total Commission Credited</div><div class="k-v" id="rfKpiTotal">…</div><div class="k-s">Added to wallet balances</div></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:#10b981"><div class="k-l">Successful Referrals</div><div class="k-v" id="rfKpiCount">…</div><div class="k-s">Commission events</div></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:#f59e0b"><div class="k-l">Reversed</div><div class="k-v" id="rfKpiRev">…</div><div class="k-s">Refunded / cancelled back-outs</div></div>';
    DB().ref('referral_commissions').once('value').then(s => {
      let total = 0, n = 0, rev = 0;
      s.forEach(c => { const v = c.val() || {}; if (v.status === 'reversed') rev++; else { total += TSMX.num(v.commission_amount); n++; } });
      const set = (i, t) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.textContent = t; };
      set('rfKpiTotal', TSMX.money0(total)); set('rfKpiCount', TSMX.int(n)); set('rfKpiRev', TSMX.int(rev));
    }).catch(() => { });
  }

  TSMX.loadRefLog = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('rfLogBox'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading commission history…');
    TSMX.guard('rfLogBox', 'TSMX.loadRefLog()', () =>
      DB().ref('referral_commissions').limitToLast(800).once('value').then(s => {
        LOG = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => (b.created_at || 0) - (a.created_at || 0));
        TSMX.renderRefLog();
      }));
  };

  TSMX.renderRefLog = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('rfLogBox'); if (!box) return;
    const st = (document.getElementById('rfLogStatus') || {}).value || '';
    const q = ((document.getElementById('rfLogSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const list = LOG.filter(r => (!st || r.status === st) && (!q || ((r.order_id || '') + ' ' + (r.referrer_user_id || '') + ' ' + (r.referee_user_id || '')).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🤝', 'No commission records yet.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Order</th><th>Referrer (paid to wallet)</th><th>Referred User</th><th style="text-align:right">Commission</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      list.slice(0, 400).map(r => '<tr><td style="font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(r.created_at) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + esc(r.order_id || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px">' + esc(String(r.referrer_user_id || '—').slice(0, 16)) + '…</td>' +
        '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px">' + esc(String(r.referee_user_id || '—').slice(0, 16)) + '…</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:#10b981">' + TSMX.money(r.commission_amount) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + (r.status === 'reversed' ? 'p-red' : 'p-green') + '">' + esc(r.status === 'reversed' ? 'Reversed' : 'Credited to wallet') + '</span></td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>' + (list.length > 400 ? '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing first 400 of ' + list.length + ' — use CSV export for the full list.</div>' : '');
  };

  TSMX.exportRefLog = () => TSMX.csv('referral_commissions_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['Date', 'Order ID', 'Referrer UID', 'Referee UID', 'Commission (INR)', 'Status', 'Payout Mode']].concat(
      LOG.map(r => [TSMX.dt(r.created_at), r.order_id || '', r.referrer_user_id || '', r.referee_user_id || '', TSMX.num(r.commission_amount), r.status || '', 'wallet_balance_only'])));

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxReferralPage', title: 'Referral Program Control', html: HTML,
      group: 'order-control', icon: '🎁', label: 'Referral Program',
      onEnter: () => { TSMX.loadReferral(); }
    });
    // make sure the node exists so the user panel never falls back silently
    DB().ref(PATH + '/commission_percent').once('value').then(s => {
      if (s.val() == null) DB().ref(PATH).update(Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, { createdAt: Date.now(), seeded: true })).catch(() => { });
    }).catch(() => { });
  });
})();


/* ---------- 04-analytics.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 4 — GAP #3 + #4 : PRO ANALYTICS & PROFIT INTELLIGENCE
   Pure inline SVG charts (no CDN → works inside sandboxed previews).
   Reads orders_index → orders, fund requests, signups, services.
   Profit = revenue − cost, using the package cost/margin fields.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">📊 Business Intelligence</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Period</label>
        <select class="tsmx-sel" id="anRange" onchange="TSMX.anRangeChange()">
          <option value="today">Today</option><option value="7d">Last 7 days</option>
          <option value="30d" selected>Last 30 days</option><option value="90d">Last 90 days</option>
          <option value="mtd">This month</option><option value="prevm">Last month</option>
          <option value="ytd">This year</option><option value="all">All time</option>
          <option value="custom">Custom range…</option>
        </select></div>
      <div class="fld" id="anCustomFrom" style="display:none"><label>From</label><input type="date" class="tsmx-in" id="anFrom"></div>
      <div class="fld" id="anCustomTo" style="display:none"><label>To</label><input type="date" class="tsmx-in" id="anTo"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Max rows scanned</label>
        <select class="tsmx-sel" id="anCap"><option value="3000">3,000 (fast)</option><option value="8000" selected>8,000</option><option value="20000">20,000 (slow)</option><option value="60000">60,000 (very slow)</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.runAnalytics()">📈 Run Report</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.exportAnalytics()">📥 Export CSV</button>
      <span id="anStatus" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
    </div>
    <div id="anKpis" class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">💵 Revenue · Cost · Profit</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info" id="anProfitNote">Profit uses each package's <b>base price</b> (<code>basePricePerK</code>) — the value you type in “Price” before the margin is added on the Services page. Packages with no base price fall back to the panel-wide margin below.</div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Fallback margin % (packages with no cost)</label><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" id="anFallbackMargin" value="30" min="0" max="99" step="1" onchange="TSMX.runAnalytics()"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="anProfitKpis" class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
    <div id="anProfitChart"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
    <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">📈 Orders & Revenue Trend</h3><div id="anTrend"></div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">👥 New Signups</h3><div id="anSignups"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
    <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🥧 Order Status Split</h3><div id="anStatusPie"></div></div>
    <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">💰 Deposits by Payment Method</h3><div id="anPayMix"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🏆 Top Services by Revenue</h3><div id="anTopServices"></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">📦 Top Packages by Orders</h3><div id="anTopPackages"></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">👑 Top Customers</h3><div id="anTopUsers"></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🕐 Busiest Hours (order volume)</h3><div id="anHours"></div></div>`;

  let RESULT = null;

  TSMX.anRangeChange = function () {
    const c = document.getElementById('anRange').value === 'custom';
    document.getElementById('anCustomFrom').style.display = c ? '' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('anCustomTo').style.display = c ? '' : 'none';
    if (!c) TSMX.runAnalytics();
  };

  function getRange() {
    const p = document.getElementById('anRange').value;
    if (p !== 'custom') return TSMX.range(p);
    const f = document.getElementById('anFrom').value, t = document.getElementById('anTo').value;
    const from = f ? new Date(f + 'T00:00:00').getTime() : Date.now() - 30 * 864e5;
    const to = t ? new Date(t + 'T23:59:59').getTime() : Date.now();
    return { from: from, to: to, label: 'Custom', days: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((to - from) / 864e5)) };
  }

  /* ---------- data collection ---------- */
  function collect(range, cap) {
    const db = DB();
    const st = document.getElementById('anStatus');
    const say = t => { if (st) st.textContent = t; };
    say('⏳ Reading services…');

    return db.ref('services').once('value').then(svcSnap => {
      const services = {}, packages = {};
      svcSnap.forEach(s => {
        const sv = s.val() || {};
        services[s.key] = { name: sv.name || s.key, packages: {} };
        Object.entries(sv.packages || {}).forEach(([pid, p]) => {
          const price = TSMX.num(p.pricePerK);
          const cost = TSMX.packageCostPerK(p);
          packages[s.key + '|' + pid] = { name: p.name || pid, service: services[s.key].name, serviceId: s.key, price: price, cost: cost, unit: TSMX.num(p.quantity, 1000) };
        });
      });
      say('⏳ Reading users & orders…');
      return db.ref('users').once('value').then(uSnap => ({ services: services, packages: packages, uSnap: uSnap }));
    }).then(ctx => {
      const orders = [], funds = [], users = [];
      let scanned = 0;
      ctx.uSnap.forEach(u => {
        const uv = u.val() || {};
        users.push({ uid: u.key, email: uv.email || '', name: uv.name || '', balance: TSMX.num(uv.balance), spent: TSMX.num(uv.spent), createdAt: TSMX.num(uv.createdAt || uv.joinedAt || uv.signupAt), status: uv.status || 'active' });
        Object.entries(uv.orders || {}).forEach(([oid, o]) => {
          if (scanned >= cap) return;
          scanned++;
          const at = TSMX.orderTime(o);
          if (at < range.from || at > range.to) return;
          orders.push({
            id: oid, uid: u.key, email: uv.email || '', at: at,
            status: String(o.status || 'pending').toLowerCase(),
            amount: TSMX.orderAmount(o),
            qty: TSMX.num(o.quantity), serviceId: o.serviceId || '', packageId: o.packageId || '',
