            serviceName: o.serviceName || '', packageName: o.packageName || '',
            costSnapshot: TSMX.num(o.costSnapshot, NaN)
          });
        });
        Object.entries(uv.fundRequests || {}).forEach(([fid, f]) => {
          const at = TSMX.fundTime(f);
          if (at < range.from || at > range.to) return;
          funds.push({ id: fid, uid: u.key, at: at, amount: TSMX.fundAmount(f), status: String(f.status || 'pending').toLowerCase(), method: TSMX.fundMethod(f) });
        });
      });
      say('⏳ Crunching numbers…');
      return Object.assign(ctx, { orders: orders, funds: funds, users: users, scanned: scanned, range: range });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- compute ---------- */
  function compute(ctx) {
    const fb = Math.min(99, Math.max(0, TSMX.num((document.getElementById('anFallbackMargin') || {}).value, 30)));
    const done = ctx.orders.filter(o => o.status === 'completed');
    const live = ctx.orders.filter(o => ['pending', 'processing', 'in progress', 'partial'].includes(o.status));
    const bad = ctx.orders.filter(o => ['cancelled', 'canceled', 'rejected', 'refunded'].includes(o.status));

    let revenue = 0, cost = 0, costKnown = 0, costGuessed = 0;
    done.forEach(o => {
      revenue += o.amount;
      let c = Number.isFinite(o.costSnapshot) ? o.costSnapshot : NaN;
      if (!Number.isFinite(c)) {
        const pk = ctx.packages[o.serviceId + '|' + o.packageId];
        if (pk && Number.isFinite(pk.cost) && pk.price > 0) { c = o.amount * (pk.cost / pk.price); costKnown++; }
      } else costKnown++;
      if (!Number.isFinite(c)) { c = o.amount * (1 - fb / 100); costGuessed++; }
      o._cost = c; cost += c;
    });
    const profit = revenue - cost;

    const approvedFunds = ctx.funds.filter(f => f.status === 'approved' || f.status === 'completed');
    const depositTotal = approvedFunds.reduce((a, b) => a + b.amount, 0);

    // buckets
    const buckets = TSMX.buckets(ctx.range.from, ctx.range.to);
    const bIdx = t => { for (let i = buckets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (t >= buckets[i].from) return i; return 0; };
    const bOrders = buckets.map(() => 0), bRev = buckets.map(() => 0), bProf = buckets.map(() => 0), bCost = buckets.map(() => 0), bSign = buckets.map(() => 0), bDep = buckets.map(() => 0);
    ctx.orders.forEach(o => { const i = bIdx(o.at); if (i >= 0 && i < buckets.length) bOrders[i]++; });
    done.forEach(o => { const i = bIdx(o.at); if (i >= 0 && i < buckets.length) { bRev[i] += o.amount; bCost[i] += o._cost; bProf[i] += o.amount - o._cost; } });
    approvedFunds.forEach(f => { const i = bIdx(f.at); if (i >= 0 && i < buckets.length) bDep[i] += f.amount; });
    ctx.users.forEach(u => { if (u.createdAt >= ctx.range.from && u.createdAt <= ctx.range.to) { const i = bIdx(u.createdAt); if (i >= 0 && i < buckets.length) bSign[i]++; } });

    // groupings
    const bySvc = {}, byPkg = {}, byUser = {}, byMethod = {}, byHour = new Array(24).fill(0);
    ctx.orders.forEach(o => { byHour[new Date(o.at).getHours()]++; });
    done.forEach(o => {
      const pk = ctx.packages[o.serviceId + '|' + o.packageId];
      const sn = o.serviceName || (pk && pk.service) || (ctx.services[o.serviceId] || {}).name || 'Unknown';
      const pn = (o.packageName || (pk && pk.name) || o.packageId || 'Unknown');
      bySvc[sn] = bySvc[sn] || { rev: 0, cost: 0, n: 0 }; bySvc[sn].rev += o.amount; bySvc[sn].cost += o._cost; bySvc[sn].n++;
      const pkey = sn + ' → ' + pn;
      byPkg[pkey] = byPkg[pkey] || { rev: 0, n: 0 }; byPkg[pkey].rev += o.amount; byPkg[pkey].n++;
      const uk = o.email || o.uid;
      byUser[uk] = byUser[uk] || { rev: 0, n: 0, uid: o.uid }; byUser[uk].rev += o.amount; byUser[uk].n++;
    });
    approvedFunds.forEach(f => { byMethod[f.method] = (byMethod[f.method] || 0) + f.amount; });

    const statusCount = {};
    ctx.orders.forEach(o => { statusCount[o.status] = (statusCount[o.status] || 0) + 1; });

    const newUsers = ctx.users.filter(u => u.createdAt >= ctx.range.from && u.createdAt <= ctx.range.to).length;
    const activeUsers = Object.keys(byUser).length;

    return {
      ctx: ctx, buckets: buckets, bOrders: bOrders, bRev: bRev, bProf: bProf, bCost: bCost, bSign: bSign, bDep: bDep,
      revenue: revenue, cost: cost, profit: profit, margin: revenue ? (profit / revenue) * 100 : 0,
      done: done, live: live, bad: bad, depositTotal: depositTotal, approvedFunds: approvedFunds,
      bySvc: bySvc, byPkg: byPkg, byUser: byUser, byMethod: byMethod, byHour: byHour,
      statusCount: statusCount, newUsers: newUsers, activeUsers: activeUsers,
      costKnown: costKnown, costGuessed: costGuessed, fallback: fb,
      aov: done.length ? revenue / done.length : 0,
      arpu: activeUsers ? revenue / activeUsers : 0,
      successRate: ctx.orders.length ? (done.length / ctx.orders.length) * 100 : 0
    };
  }

  /* ---------- render ---------- */
  function render(R) {
    const set = (id, h) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.innerHTML = h; };
    const prev = R.prev;
    const delta = (cur, old) => {
      if (!old || !Number.isFinite(old)) return '';
      const d = ((cur - old) / Math.abs(old)) * 100;
      return ' <span class="' + (d >= 0 ? 'k-up' : 'k-dn') + '">' + (d >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼') + ' ' + Math.abs(Math.round(d)) + '%</span>';
    };

    set('anKpis',
      kpi('#0ea5e9', 'Revenue (completed)', TSMX.money0(R.revenue), R.done.length + ' completed orders' + (prev ? delta(R.revenue, prev.revenue) : '')) +
      kpi('#7c3aed', 'Total Orders', TSMX.int(R.ctx.orders.length), R.live.length + ' live · ' + R.bad.length + ' failed' + (prev ? delta(R.ctx.orders.length, prev.orders) : '')) +
      kpi('#10b981', 'Deposits Approved', TSMX.money0(R.depositTotal), R.approvedFunds.length + ' payments' + (prev ? delta(R.depositTotal, prev.deposits) : '')) +
      kpi('#f59e0b', 'New Signups', TSMX.int(R.newUsers), 'in this period' + (prev ? delta(R.newUsers, prev.signups) : '')) +
      kpi('#06b6d4', 'Avg Order Value', TSMX.money(R.aov), 'per completed order') +
      kpi('#db2777', 'Buying Customers', TSMX.int(R.activeUsers), TSMX.money(R.arpu) + ' avg per customer') +
      kpi('#22c55e', 'Success Rate', Math.round(R.successRate) + '%', R.done.length + ' of ' + R.ctx.orders.length + ' orders') +
      kpi('#64748b', 'Wallet Float', TSMX.money0(R.ctx.users.reduce((a, u) => a + u.balance, 0)), 'unspent user balance (all time)')
    );

    set('anProfitKpis',
      kpi('#0ea5e9', 'Revenue', TSMX.money0(R.revenue), 'money collected from completed orders') +
      kpi('#ef4444', 'Service Cost', TSMX.money0(R.cost), R.costKnown + ' exact · ' + R.costGuessed + ' estimated @' + R.fallback + '%') +
      kpi(R.profit >= 0 ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444', 'Net Profit', TSMX.money0(R.profit), 'revenue − cost') +
      kpi('#7c3aed', 'Profit Margin', (Math.round(R.margin * 10) / 10) + '%', R.done.length ? TSMX.money(R.profit / R.done.length) + ' profit per order' : '—')
    );

    const note = document.getElementById('anProfitNote');
    if (note) {
      note.className = 'tsmx-note ' + (R.costGuessed > R.costKnown ? 'n-warn' : 'n-ok');
      note.innerHTML = R.costGuessed
        ? '⚠️ <b>' + R.costGuessed + ' of ' + (R.costGuessed + R.costKnown) + '</b> completed orders had no cost data, so a <b>' + R.fallback + '%</b> fallback margin was used. Fix: open <b>Services → Edit Package</b> and fill the <b>Price (base)</b> field plus a Margin Type/Value — the panel stores that as <code>basePricePerK</code>, which is your real cost. From now on every new order also stores a <b>cost snapshot</b>, so reports keep getting more accurate.'
        : '✅ Every completed order in this period had a real cost price — this profit figure is exact.';
    }

    set('anProfitChart', TSMX.chart.line([
      { name: 'Revenue', data: R.bRev, color: '#0ea5e9' },
      { name: 'Cost', data: R.bCost, color: '#ef4444', fill: false },
      { name: 'Profit', data: R.bProf, color: '#10b981' }
    ], { labels: R.buckets.map(b => b.label), money: true, height: 250 }));

    set('anTrend', TSMX.chart.line([
      { name: 'Orders', data: R.bOrders, color: '#7c3aed' },
      { name: 'Revenue ₹', data: R.bRev, color: '#0ea5e9', fill: false }
    ], { labels: R.buckets.map(b => b.label), height: 210 }));

    set('anSignups', TSMX.chart.line([
      { name: 'New users', data: R.bSign, color: '#f59e0b' },
      { name: 'Deposits ₹', data: R.bDep, color: '#10b981', fill: false }
    ], { labels: R.buckets.map(b => b.label), height: 210 }));

    const SC = { completed: '#10b981', pending: '#f59e0b', processing: '#0ea5e9', 'in progress': '#06b6d4', partial: '#8b5cf6', cancelled: '#94a3b8', canceled: '#94a3b8', rejected: '#ef4444', refunded: '#db2777' };
    set('anStatusPie', TSMX.chart.donut(Object.entries(R.statusCount).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .map(([k, v]) => ({ name: k.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + k.slice(1), value: v, color: SC[k] || '#64748b' })), { centerLabel: 'ORDERS' }));

    const PM = ['#0ea5e9', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#7c3aed', '#ef4444', '#06b6d4', '#db2777', '#84cc16'];
    set('anPayMix', TSMX.chart.donut(Object.entries(R.byMethod).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8)
      .map(([k, v], i) => ({ name: k, value: Math.round(v), color: PM[i % PM.length] })), { centerLabel: '₹ TOTAL' }));

    set('anTopServices', TSMX.chart.bars(Object.entries(R.bySvc).sort((a, b) => b[1].rev - a[1].rev).slice(0, 12)
      .map(([k, v]) => ({ name: k, value: v.rev, sub: '· ' + v.n + ' ord · ' + TSMX.money0(v.rev - v.cost) + ' profit' })), { money: true }));

    set('anTopPackages', TSMX.chart.bars(Object.entries(R.byPkg).sort((a, b) => b[1].n - a[1].n).slice(0, 12)
      .map(([k, v]) => ({ name: k, value: v.n, sub: '· ' + TSMX.money0(v.rev), color: '#7c3aed' }))));

    const tu = Object.entries(R.byUser).sort((a, b) => b[1].rev - a[1].rev).slice(0, 15);
    set('anTopUsers', tu.length ? '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Customer</th><th style="text-align:right">Orders</th><th style="text-align:right">Spent</th><th style="text-align:right">Avg</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      tu.map(([k, v], i) => '<tr><td><b>' + (i + 1) + '</b></td><td style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(k) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.int(v.n) + '</td><td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:#0ea5e9">' + TSMX.money0(v.rev) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-size:12px">' + TSMX.money(v.rev / v.n) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right"><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.openUser360(\'' + esc(v.uid) + '\')">👁 View</button></td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>' : '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">👑</span>No customers in this period</div>');

    set('anHours', TSMX.chart.bars(R.byHour.map((v, h) => ({ name: String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':00 – ' + String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':59', value: v, color: '#06b6d4' })).filter(x => x.value > 0).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 12)));

    const st = document.getElementById('anStatus');
    if (st) st.textContent = '✅ ' + R.ctx.range.label + ' · ' + R.ctx.orders.length + ' orders · scanned ' + TSMX.int(R.ctx.scanned) + ' records';
  }

  function kpi(color, label, value, sub) {
    return '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + color + '"><div class="k-l">' + esc(label) + '</div><div class="k-v">' + value + '</div><div class="k-s">' + sub + '</div></div>';
  }

  TSMX.runAnalytics = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('analytics')) return;
    const st = document.getElementById('anStatus'); if (st) st.textContent = '⏳ Running…';
    const range = getRange(), cap = Number(document.getElementById('anCap').value || 8000);
    ['anKpis', 'anProfitKpis', 'anTrend', 'anSignups', 'anProfitChart', 'anStatusPie', 'anPayMix', 'anTopServices', 'anTopPackages', 'anTopUsers', 'anHours']
      .forEach(id => TSMX.loading(id, 'Crunching…'));

    collect(range, cap).then(ctx => {
      const R = compute(ctx);
      // comparison window of equal length, immediately before
      const span = range.to - range.from;
      const prevRange = { from: range.from - span, to: range.from - 1, label: 'previous', days: range.days };
      return collect(prevRange, Math.min(cap, 8000)).then(pctx => {
        const P = compute(Object.assign({}, pctx, { range: prevRange }));
        R.prev = { revenue: P.revenue, orders: P.ctx.orders.length, deposits: P.depositTotal, signups: P.newUsers, profit: P.profit };
        RESULT = R; render(R);
      }).catch(() => { RESULT = R; render(R); });
    }).catch(e => {
      console.error(e);
      TSMX.fail('anKpis', e, 'TSMX.runAnalytics()');
      const st2 = document.getElementById('anStatus'); if (st2) st2.textContent = '❌ Failed';
    });
  };

  TSMX.exportAnalytics = function () {
    if (!RESULT) return TSMX.toast('Run the report first', 'error');
    const R = RESULT, rows = [];
    rows.push(['TOP SMM — Analytics Export']);
    rows.push(['Period', R.ctx.range.label, TSMX.dt(R.ctx.range.from), '→', TSMX.dt(R.ctx.range.to)]);
    rows.push([]);
    rows.push(['SUMMARY']);
    rows.push(['Revenue (completed)', R.revenue]); rows.push(['Service cost', Math.round(R.cost * 100) / 100]);
    rows.push(['Net profit', Math.round(R.profit * 100) / 100]); rows.push(['Margin %', Math.round(R.margin * 10) / 10]);
    rows.push(['Total orders', R.ctx.orders.length]); rows.push(['Completed', R.done.length]);
    rows.push(['Failed/cancelled', R.bad.length]); rows.push(['Deposits approved', R.depositTotal]);
    rows.push(['New signups', R.newUsers]); rows.push(['Buying customers', R.activeUsers]);
    rows.push(['Average order value', Math.round(R.aov * 100) / 100]);
    rows.push([]);
    rows.push(['DAILY BREAKDOWN']);
    rows.push(['Bucket', 'Orders', 'Revenue', 'Cost', 'Profit', 'Signups', 'Deposits']);
    R.buckets.forEach((b, i) => rows.push([b.label, R.bOrders[i], Math.round(R.bRev[i] * 100) / 100, Math.round(R.bCost[i] * 100) / 100, Math.round(R.bProf[i] * 100) / 100, R.bSign[i], Math.round(R.bDep[i] * 100) / 100]));
    rows.push([]);
    rows.push(['SERVICE PERFORMANCE']);
    rows.push(['Service', 'Orders', 'Revenue', 'Cost', 'Profit', 'Margin %']);
    Object.entries(R.bySvc).sort((a, b) => b[1].rev - a[1].rev).forEach(([k, v]) =>
      rows.push([k, v.n, Math.round(v.rev * 100) / 100, Math.round(v.cost * 100) / 100, Math.round((v.rev - v.cost) * 100) / 100, v.rev ? Math.round(((v.rev - v.cost) / v.rev) * 1000) / 10 : 0]));
    rows.push([]);
    rows.push(['TOP CUSTOMERS']);
    rows.push(['Customer', 'Orders', 'Spent']);
    Object.entries(R.byUser).sort((a, b) => b[1].rev - a[1].rev).slice(0, 100).forEach(([k, v]) => rows.push([k, v.n, Math.round(v.rev * 100) / 100]));
    TSMX.csv('analytics_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv', rows);
    TSMX.audit('analytics.export', R.ctx.range.label + ' · ' + R.ctx.orders.length + ' orders');
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxAnalyticsPage', title: 'Business Intelligence', html: HTML,
      group: 'system', icon: '📈', label: 'Analytics Pro',
      onEnter: () => { if (!RESULT) TSMX.runAnalytics(); }
    });
    // Add a shortcut on the legacy analytics page
    const legacy = document.getElementById('analyticsPage');
    if (legacy && !document.getElementById('tsmxAnaShortcut')) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'card'; d.id = 'tsmxAnaShortcut';
      d.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note n-ok" style="margin:0"><b>📈 Analytics Pro is available.</b> Charts, profit reporting, top services, customer ranking and CSV export. ' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="margin-left:8px" onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxAnalyticsPage\')">Open Analytics Pro →</button></div>';
      legacy.insertBefore(d, legacy.firstChild);
    }
  });
})();


/* ---------- 05-users-ledger.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 5 — GAP #5 + #6
   #5  Wallet Ledger  : every balance change is recorded & viewable
   #6  User Command Centre : status (active/suspended/banned), multi-select,
       bulk balance, bulk status, CSV export, full 360° user profile.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  const STATUS = TSMX.USER_STATUS = {
    active: { label: 'Active', pill: 'p-green', icon: '✅', desc: 'Full access to everything.' },
    suspended: { label: 'Suspended', pill: 'p-amber', icon: '⏸️', desc: 'Can log in and see history, but cannot place orders or add funds.' },
    banned: { label: 'Banned', pill: 'p-red', icon: '⛔', desc: 'Blocked completely — signed out and cannot use the panel at all.' }
  };

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">👥 User Command Centre</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="ucKpis" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="ucSearch" placeholder="Email, name, UID, phone…" oninput="TSMX.ucRender()" style="min-width:210px"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Status</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="ucStatus" onchange="TSMX.ucRender()">
        <option value="">All statuses</option><option value="active">✅ Active</option><option value="suspended">⏸️ Suspended</option><option value="banned">⛔ Banned</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Balance</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="ucBal" onchange="TSMX.ucRender()">
        <option value="">Any balance</option><option value="pos">Has balance &gt; 0</option><option value="zero">Zero balance</option><option value="neg">Negative (bug)</option><option value="rich">₹1,000+</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Activity</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="ucAct" onchange="TSMX.ucRender()">
        <option value="">Everyone</option><option value="buyer">Has ordered</option><option value="never">Never ordered</option><option value="new7">Joined last 7 days</option><option value="new30">Joined last 30 days</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Sort</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="ucSort" onchange="TSMX.ucRender()">
        <option value="spent">Top spenders</option><option value="balance">Highest balance</option><option value="new">Newest first</option><option value="old">Oldest first</option><option value="orders">Most orders</option><option value="az">A → Z</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.ucLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.ucExport()">📥 Export CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="ucList"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-bulk" id="ucBulk">
      <span class="bc"><span id="ucSelCount">0</span> selected</span>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.ucBulkBalance()">💰 Adjust Balance</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.ucBulkStatus()">🚦 Change Status</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.ucBulkNotify()">🔔 Send Notification</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.ucExport(true)">📥 Export Selected</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.ucClearSel()">✖ Clear</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  let USERS = [], SEL = new Set(), VIEW = [];

  TSMX.ucLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ucList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading users…');
    TSMX.guard('ucList', 'TSMX.ucLoad()', () =>
      Promise.all([DB().ref('users').once('value'), DB().ref('registered_users').once('value')]).then(([u, r]) => {
        const reg = r.val() || {};
        USERS = [];
        u.forEach(c => {
          const v = c.val() || {}, rr = reg[c.key] || {};
          const orders = v.orders || {};
          const oKeys = Object.keys(orders);
          let last = 0, completed = 0;
          oKeys.forEach(k => { const o = orders[k] || {}; const t = TSMX.orderTime(o); if (t > last) last = t; if (String(o.status).toLowerCase() === 'completed') completed++; });
          USERS.push({
            uid: c.key,
            email: v.email || rr.email || '',
            name: v.name || rr.name || '',
            phone: v.phone || rr.phone || '',
            balance: TSMX.num(v.balance),
            spent: TSMX.num(v.spent),
            orders: oKeys.length,
            completed: completed,
            lastOrderAt: last,
            createdAt: TSMX.num(v.createdAt || v.joinedAt || rr.createdAt || rr.signupAt),
            status: v.status || 'active',
            statusReason: v.statusReason || '',
            referrer: v.referrer_user_id || '',
            currency: v.preferredCurrency || 'INR',
            funds: Object.keys(v.fundRequests || {}).length
          });
        });
        SEL.clear(); paintKpis(); TSMX.ucRender();
      }));
  };

  function paintKpis() {
    const box = document.getElementById('ucKpis'); if (!box) return;
    const total = USERS.length;
    const active = USERS.filter(u => (u.status || 'active') === 'active').length;
    const blocked = USERS.filter(u => u.status === 'banned' || u.status === 'suspended').length;
    const buyers = USERS.filter(u => u.orders > 0).length;
    const float = USERS.reduce((a, u) => a + u.balance, 0);
    const lifetime = USERS.reduce((a, u) => a + u.spent, 0);
    const k = (c, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    box.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Total Users', TSMX.int(total), active + ' active · ' + blocked + ' blocked') +
      k('#10b981', 'Buying Customers', TSMX.int(buyers), TSMX.pct(buyers, total) + ' conversion') +
      k('#f59e0b', 'Wallet Float', TSMX.money0(float), 'unspent balance held') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Lifetime Spend', TSMX.money0(lifetime), 'all users combined');
  }

  TSMX.ucRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ucList'); if (!box) return;
    const q = ((document.getElementById('ucSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const fs = (document.getElementById('ucStatus') || {}).value || '';
    const fb = (document.getElementById('ucBal') || {}).value || '';
    const fa = (document.getElementById('ucAct') || {}).value || '';
    const sort = (document.getElementById('ucSort') || {}).value || 'spent';
    const now = Date.now();

    VIEW = USERS.filter(u => {
      if (q && !((u.email + ' ' + u.name + ' ' + u.uid + ' ' + u.phone).toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
      if (fs && (u.status || 'active') !== fs) return false;
      if (fb === 'pos' && !(u.balance > 0)) return false;
      if (fb === 'zero' && u.balance !== 0) return false;
      if (fb === 'neg' && !(u.balance < 0)) return false;
      if (fb === 'rich' && u.balance < 1000) return false;
      if (fa === 'buyer' && !u.orders) return false;
      if (fa === 'never' && u.orders) return false;
      if (fa === 'new7' && !(u.createdAt && now - u.createdAt < 7 * 864e5)) return false;
      if (fa === 'new30' && !(u.createdAt && now - u.createdAt < 30 * 864e5)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    const S = { spent: (a, b) => b.spent - a.spent, balance: (a, b) => b.balance - a.balance, new: (a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt, old: (a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt, orders: (a, b) => b.orders - a.orders, az: (a, b) => (a.email || '').localeCompare(b.email || '') };
    VIEW.sort(S[sort] || S.spent);

    if (!VIEW.length) { TSMX.empty(box, '👥', 'No users match these filters.'); updBulk(); return; }
    const show = VIEW.slice(0, 400);
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th style="width:34px"><input type="checkbox" class="tsmx-chk" id="ucAll" onchange="TSMX.ucToggleAll(this.checked)"></th>' +
      '<th>User</th><th>Status</th><th style="text-align:right">Balance</th><th style="text-align:right">Spent</th>' +
      '<th style="text-align:right">Orders</th><th>Joined</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      show.map(u => {
        const s = STATUS[u.status] || STATUS.active;
        return '<tr class="' + (SEL.has(u.uid) ? 'sel' : '') + '" id="ucr_' + esc(u.uid) + '">' +
          '<td><input type="checkbox" class="tsmx-chk" ' + (SEL.has(u.uid) ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="TSMX.ucToggle(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\',this.checked)"></td>' +
          '<td><b style="font-size:13px">' + esc(u.name || u.email || 'Unknown') + '</b>' +
          '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(u.email || '—') + '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-light,#94a3b8);font-family:monospace">' + esc(u.uid) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + s.pill + '">' + s.icon + ' ' + s.label + '</span>' + (u.statusReason ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray);margin-top:3px">' + esc(u.statusReason.slice(0, 40)) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:' + (u.balance > 0 ? '#10b981' : u.balance < 0 ? '#ef4444' : 'inherit') + '">' + TSMX.money(u.balance) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-size:12.5px">' + TSMX.money0(u.spent) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-size:12.5px">' + TSMX.int(u.orders) + (u.completed ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:#10b981">' + u.completed + ' done</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dateOnly(u.createdAt) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.openUser360(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">👁 360°</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" onclick="TSMX.ucAdjust(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">💰</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm warn" onclick="TSMX.ucStatusOne(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">🚦</button>' +
          '</td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing ' + show.length + ' of ' + VIEW.length + ' matching users (' + USERS.length + ' total)' +
      (VIEW.length > 400 ? ' — refine filters or use CSV export for the rest.' : '') + '</div>';
    updBulk();
  };

  TSMX.ucToggle = function (uid, on) { on ? SEL.add(uid) : SEL.delete(uid); const r = document.getElementById('ucr_' + uid); if (r) r.classList.toggle('sel', on); updBulk(); };
  TSMX.ucToggleAll = function (on) { VIEW.slice(0, 400).forEach(u => on ? SEL.add(u.uid) : SEL.delete(u.uid)); TSMX.ucRender(); };
  TSMX.ucClearSel = function () { SEL.clear(); TSMX.ucRender(); };
  function updBulk() {
    const b = document.getElementById('ucBulk'), c = document.getElementById('ucSelCount');
    if (!b) return; b.classList.toggle('on', SEL.size > 0); if (c) c.textContent = SEL.size;
  }

  /* ---------- balance adjust (single + bulk) ---------- */
  function balanceForm(count, label) {
    return '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn">This writes a full <b>Wallet Statement</b> entry for every user so the change is permanently traceable.</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Operation</label><select id="ucOp">' +
      '<option value="add">➕ Add to balance</option><option value="sub">➖ Subtract from balance</option><option value="set">🎯 Set exact balance</option></select></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Amount (₹)</label><input type="number" id="ucAmt" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00"></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Reason / note (shown to the user)</label><input id="ucNote" placeholder="e.g. Festival bonus, Manual top-up, Correction"></div>' +
      '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="ucNotify" checked><span><span class="sw-t">Notify the user</span><span class="sw-h">Send an in-app notification about this balance change.</span></span></label>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">Applying to <b>' + count + '</b> ' + label + '.</div>';
  }

  function applyBalance(uids) {
    const op = document.getElementById('ucOp').value;
    const amt = TSMX.num(document.getElementById('ucAmt').value);
    const note = (document.getElementById('ucNote').value || '').trim() || 'Admin adjustment';
    const notify = document.getElementById('ucNotify').checked;
    if (!(amt >= 0) || (op !== 'set' && amt <= 0)) return TSMX.toast('Enter a valid amount', 'error');
    TSMX.closeModal();
    TSMX.toast('⏳ Updating ' + uids.length + ' wallet(s)…');
    let ok = 0, fail = 0;
    const run = uids.reduce((chain, uid) => chain.then(() => {
      const u = USERS.find(x => x.uid === uid) || {};
      let delta = op === 'add' ? amt : op === 'sub' ? -amt : (amt - u.balance);
      const type = delta >= 0 ? 'admin_add' : 'admin_sub';
      return TSMX.ledger.apply(uid, delta, { type: type, note: note, by: TSMX.adminEmail() })
        .then(after => {
          ok++;
          if (notify) DB().ref('notifications').push({
            user_id: uid, type: delta >= 0 ? 'fund_approved' : 'info',
            title: delta >= 0 ? '💰 Balance Added' : '➖ Balance Adjusted',
            message: (delta >= 0 ? 'Your wallet was credited with ' : 'Your wallet was debited by ') + TSMX.money(Math.abs(delta)) + '. ' + note + ' · New balance: ' + TSMX.money(after),
            read: false, timestamp: Date.now()
          }).catch(() => { });
        }).catch(() => { fail++; });
    }), Promise.resolve());

    run.then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('user.balance.bulk', op + ' ' + TSMX.money(amt) + ' × ' + uids.length + ' users · ' + note, uids.slice(0, 5).join(','));
      TSMX.toast('✅ ' + ok + ' wallet(s) updated' + (fail ? ' · ' + fail + ' failed' : ''), fail ? 'error' : 'success');
      TSMX.ucLoad();
    });
  }

  TSMX.ucAdjust = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.balance')) return;
    const u = USERS.find(x => x.uid === uid) || {};
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '💰 Adjust Balance — ' + (u.email || uid),
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">Current balance: <b>' + TSMX.money(u.balance) + '</b> · Lifetime spend: <b>' + TSMX.money0(u.spent) + '</b></div>' + balanceForm(1, 'user'),
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" id="ucGo">💾 Apply</button>',
      onOpen: () => { document.getElementById('ucGo').onclick = () => applyBalance([uid]); }
    });
  };

  TSMX.ucBulkBalance = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.balance')) return;
    if (!SEL.size) return;
    const uids = [...SEL];
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '💰 Bulk Balance Adjustment',
      body: balanceForm(uids.length, 'selected users'),
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" id="ucGo">💾 Apply to ' + uids.length + ' users</button>',
      onOpen: () => { document.getElementById('ucGo').onclick = () => applyBalance(uids); }
    });
  };

  /* ---------- status (ban / suspend) ---------- */
  function statusForm(count) {
    return '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>New status</label><select id="ucNewStatus">' +
      Object.keys(STATUS).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '">' + STATUS[k].icon + ' ' + STATUS[k].label + ' — ' + STATUS[k].desc + '</option>').join('') + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Reason (the user sees this)</label><input id="ucReason" placeholder="e.g. Payment fraud, Abuse of refill system"></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn"><b>Suspended</b> = can log in and view history, but ordering, funding, refills and tickets are blocked.<br><b>Banned</b> = fully locked out and signed out immediately on their device.</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">Applying to <b>' + count + '</b> user(s).</div>';
  }
  function applyStatus(uids) {
    const s = document.getElementById('ucNewStatus').value;
    const reason = (document.getElementById('ucReason').value || '').trim();
    TSMX.closeModal();
    const by = TSMX.adminEmail();
    const up = {};
    uids.forEach(uid => {
      up['users/' + uid + '/status'] = s;
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusReason'] = reason || null;
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusAt'] = Date.now();
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusBy'] = by;
      // 🔒 the user panel's own login gate reads blocked_users/{uid} — keep both in sync
      up['blocked_users/' + uid] = (s === 'banned') ? { at: Date.now(), by: by, reason: reason || null } : null;
    });
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
      uids.forEach(uid => DB().ref('notifications').push({
        user_id: uid, type: s === 'active' ? 'info' : 'warning',
        title: s === 'active' ? '✅ Account Restored' : s === 'suspended' ? '⏸️ Account Suspended' : '⛔ Account Banned',
        message: s === 'active' ? 'Your account is active again. Welcome back!' : (STATUS[s].desc + (reason ? ' Reason: ' + reason : '')),
        read: false, timestamp: Date.now()
      }).catch(() => { }));
      TSMX.audit('user.status', s + ' × ' + uids.length + (reason ? ' · ' + reason : ''), uids.slice(0, 5).join(','));
      TSMX.toast('✅ Status updated for ' + uids.length + ' user(s)', 'success');
      TSMX.ucLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  }
  TSMX.ucStatusOne = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.status')) return;
    const u = USERS.find(x => x.uid === uid) || {};
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '🚦 Change Status — ' + (u.email || uid),
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">Current: <b>' + (STATUS[u.status] || STATUS.active).label + '</b></div>' + statusForm(1),
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn warn" id="ucGo">🚦 Apply</button>',
      onOpen: () => { document.getElementById('ucNewStatus').value = u.status || 'active'; document.getElementById('ucGo').onclick = () => applyStatus([uid]); }
    });
  };
  TSMX.ucBulkStatus = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.status') || !SEL.size) return;
    const uids = [...SEL];
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '🚦 Bulk Status Change', body: statusForm(uids.length),
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn warn" id="ucGo">Apply to ' + uids.length + '</button>',
      onOpen: () => { document.getElementById('ucGo').onclick = () => applyStatus(uids); }
    });
  };

  TSMX.ucBulkNotify = function () {
    if (!SEL.size) return;
    const uids = [...SEL];
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '🔔 Notify ' + uids.length + ' user(s)',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Title</label><input id="ucNTitle" placeholder="e.g. Special offer for you"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Message</label><textarea id="ucNMsg" rows="4" placeholder="Write your message…"></textarea></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Type</label><select id="ucNType"><option value="info">ℹ️ Info</option><option value="success">✅ Success</option><option value="warning">⚠️ Warning</option><option value="offer">🎁 Offer</option></select></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn" id="ucGo">🔔 Send</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        document.getElementById('ucGo').onclick = () => {
          const t = document.getElementById('ucNTitle').value.trim(), m = document.getElementById('ucNMsg').value.trim(), ty = document.getElementById('ucNType').value;
          if (!t || !m) return TSMX.toast('Title and message are required', 'error');
          TSMX.closeModal();
          const up = {};
          uids.forEach(uid => { up['notifications/' + DB().ref('notifications').push().key] = { user_id: uid, type: ty, title: t, message: m, read: false, timestamp: Date.now() }; });
          DB().ref().update(up).then(() => { TSMX.audit('user.notify', t + ' → ' + uids.length + ' users'); TSMX.toast('✅ Sent to ' + uids.length + ' user(s)', 'success'); });
        };
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.ucExport = function (onlySelected) {
    const list = onlySelected ? USERS.filter(u => SEL.has(u.uid)) : VIEW;
    TSMX.csv('users_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
      [['UID', 'Email', 'Name', 'Phone', 'Status', 'Reason', 'Balance (INR)', 'Lifetime Spend', 'Orders', 'Completed', 'Fund Requests', 'Currency', 'Joined', 'Last Order']].concat(
        list.map(u => [u.uid, u.email, u.name, u.phone, u.status || 'active', u.statusReason, u.balance, u.spent, u.orders, u.completed, u.funds, u.currency, TSMX.dt(u.createdAt), u.lastOrderAt ? TSMX.dt(u.lastOrderAt) : ''])));
    TSMX.audit('user.export', list.length + ' users exported');
  };

  /* ══════════ 360° USER PROFILE + WALLET LEDGER ══════════ */
  TSMX.openUser360 = function (uid) {
    TSMX.modal({
      wide: true, title: '👁 User 360° View',
      body: '<div id="u360"><div class="tsmx-load"><div class="tsmx-spin"></div>Loading complete profile…</div></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Close</button>'
    });
    Promise.all([
      DB().ref('users/' + uid).once('value'),
      DB().ref('registered_users/' + uid).once('value'),
      DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/ledger').orderByChild('at').limitToLast(300).once('value')
    ]).then(([us, rs, ls]) => {
      const u = us.val() || {}, r = rs.val() || {};
      const ledger = Object.entries(ls.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
      const orders = Object.entries(u.orders || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => TSMX.orderTime(b) - TSMX.orderTime(a));
      const funds = Object.entries(u.fundRequests || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => TSMX.fundTime(b) - TSMX.fundTime(a));
      const s = STATUS[u.status || 'active'] || STATUS.active;
      const el = document.getElementById('u360'); if (!el) return;

      const k = (c, l, v, sub) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + (sub || '') + '</div></div>';
      const doneN = orders.filter(o => String(o.status).toLowerCase() === 'completed').length;

      el.innerHTML =
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:15px">' +
        '<div style="flex:1;min-width:220px"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800">' + esc(u.name || r.name || u.email || uid) + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(u.email || r.email || '—') + (u.phone ? ' · ' + esc(u.phone) : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:10.5px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--text-light,#94a3b8);margin-top:3px">' + esc(uid) + '</div></div>' +
        '<span class="tsmx-pill ' + s.pill + '" style="font-size:12px;padding:6px 13px">' + s.icon + ' ' + s.label + '</span></div>' +

        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" style="margin-bottom:16px">' +
        k('#10b981', 'Wallet Balance', TSMX.money(u.balance), 'spendable now') +
        k('#0ea5e9', 'Lifetime Spend', TSMX.money0(u.spent), doneN + ' completed orders') +
        k('#7c3aed', 'Total Orders', TSMX.int(orders.length), funds.length + ' fund requests') +
        k('#f59e0b', 'Joined', TSMX.dateOnly(u.createdAt || r.createdAt), u.preferredCurrency || 'INR') +
        '</div>' +

        '<div class="tsmx-tabs">' +
        '<button class="tsmx-tab on" data-ut="led" onclick="TSMX.u360Tab(\'led\')">💳 Wallet Statement (' + ledger.length + ')</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-tab" data-ut="ord" onclick="TSMX.u360Tab(\'ord\')">📋 Orders (' + orders.length + ')</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-tab" data-ut="fun" onclick="TSMX.u360Tab(\'fun\')">💰 Funds (' + funds.length + ')</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-tab" data-ut="raw" onclick="TSMX.u360Tab(\'raw\')">🔎 Account</button></div>' +

        '<div data-up="led">' + renderLedger(ledger, u) + '</div>' +
        '<div data-up="ord" style="display:none">' + renderOrders(orders) + '</div>' +
        '<div data-up="fun" style="display:none">' + renderFunds(funds) + '</div>' +
        '<div data-up="raw" style="display:none">' + renderRaw(u, r) + '</div>' +

        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color)">' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" onclick="TSMX.closeModal();TSMX.ucAdjust(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">💰 Adjust Balance</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm warn" onclick="TSMX.closeModal();TSMX.ucStatusOne(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">🚦 Change Status</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.exportLedger(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">📥 Export Statement</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.rebuildLedger(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">🧮 Rebuild Statement</button></div>';
      TSMX._u360 = { uid: uid, ledger: ledger, orders: orders, funds: funds, user: u };
    }).catch(e => { const el = document.getElementById('u360'); if (el) TSMX.fail(el, e, "TSMX.openUser360('" + uid + "')"); });
  };

  TSMX.u360Tab = function (t) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ut]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.ut === t));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-up]').forEach(p => p.style.display = p.dataset.up === t ? '' : 'none');
  };

  function renderLedger(ledger, u) {
    if (!ledger.length) return '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">No wallet statement entries yet. Entries are created automatically from now on — every order, deposit, refund, referral commission and admin adjustment. Use <b>Rebuild Statement</b> to reconstruct the history from existing orders and fund requests.</div>';
    return '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Type</th><th>Note</th><th style="text-align:right">Amount</th><th style="text-align:right">Balance After</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      ledger.map(l => {
        const t = TSMX.LEDGER_TYPES[l.type] || { label: l.type, icon: '•', sign: 0 };
        const sign = t.sign < 0 ? '−' : t.sign > 0 ? '+' : '';
        const col = t.sign < 0 ? '#ef4444' : t.sign > 0 ? '#10b981' : 'inherit';
        return '<tr><td style="font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(l.at) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap">' + t.icon + ' ' + esc(t.label) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(l.note || '—') + (l.ref ? '<div style="font-size:10px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(l.ref) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:' + col + '">' + sign + TSMX.money(l.amount) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-size:12px">' + (l.balanceAfter == null ? '—' : TSMX.money(l.balanceAfter)) + '</td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  function renderOrders(orders) {
    if (!orders.length) return '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">📋</span>No orders yet</div>';
    return '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Service</th><th style="text-align:right">Qty</th><th style="text-align:right">Charge</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      orders.slice(0, 120).map(o => '<tr><td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px">' + esc(o.orderId || o.shortId || o.id) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(o.serviceName || '') + '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(o.packageName || '') + '</div></td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.int(o.quantity) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.money(TSMX.orderAmount(o)) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + statusPill(o.status) + '">' + esc(o.status || '—') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(TSMX.orderTime(o)) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  function renderFunds(funds) {
    if (!funds.length) return '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">💰</span>No fund requests yet</div>';
    return '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Method</th><th style="text-align:right">Amount</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      funds.slice(0, 120).map(f => '<tr><td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px">' + esc(f.requestId || f.id) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(TSMX.fundMethod(f)) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.money(TSMX.fundAmount(f)) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + statusPill(f.status) + '">' + esc(f.status || '—') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(TSMX.fundTime(f)) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  function renderRaw(u, r) {
    const rows = [['Wallet balance', TSMX.money(u.balance)], ['Lifetime spend', TSMX.money(u.spent)],
    ['Status', (u.status || 'active') + (u.statusReason ? ' — ' + u.statusReason : '')],
    ['Status changed', u.statusAt ? TSMX.dt(u.statusAt) + ' by ' + (u.statusBy || '—') : '—'],
    ['Preferred currency', u.preferredCurrency || 'INR'],
    ['Referral code', u.referral_code || u.referralCode || '—'],
    ['Referred by (UID)', u.referrer_user_id || '—'],
    ['API key', u.apiKey ? String(u.apiKey).slice(0, 10) + '…' + String(u.apiKey).slice(-4) : 'not generated'],
    ['Terms agreed', u.termsAgreedAt ? TSMX.dt(u.termsAgreedAt) : 'no'],
    ['Rules agreed', u.rulesAgreedAt ? TSMX.dt(u.rulesAgreedAt) : 'no'],
    ['Signup email', r.email || u.email || '—'],
    ['Welcome email sent', r.welcomeEmailSentAt ? TSMX.dt(r.welcomeEmailSentAt) : 'no']];
    return '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl" style="min-width:0"><tbody>' +
      rows.map(x => '<tr><td style="font-weight:700;width:42%;font-size:12.5px">' + esc(x[0]) + '</td><td style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(x[1]) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  function statusPill(s) {
    s = String(s || '').toLowerCase();
    return s === 'completed' || s === 'approved' ? 'p-green' : s === 'pending' ? 'p-amber' :
      s === 'processing' || s === 'in progress' ? 'p-blue' : s === 'partial' ? 'p-violet' :
        (s === 'rejected' || s === 'cancelled' || s === 'canceled') ? 'p-red' : 'p-gray';
  }

  TSMX.exportLedger = function (uid) {
    const d = TSMX._u360; if (!d || d.uid !== uid) return;
    TSMX.csv('wallet_statement_' + uid.slice(0, 8) + '.csv',
      [['When', 'Type', 'Note', 'Reference', 'Amount (INR)', 'Direction', 'Balance After']].concat(
        d.ledger.map(l => { const t = TSMX.LEDGER_TYPES[l.type] || { label: l.type, sign: 0 }; return [TSMX.dt(l.at), t.label, l.note || '', l.ref || '', l.amount, t.sign < 0 ? 'debit' : t.sign > 0 ? 'credit' : 'adjust', l.balanceAfter]; })));
  };

  /** Reconstruct a statement from existing orders + approved funds (best-effort, chronological). */
  TSMX.rebuildLedger = function (uid) {
    TSMX.confirm('Rebuild wallet statement?',
      'This reconstructs the statement from all existing <b>orders</b> and <b>approved fund requests</b>, in chronological order. ' +
      'Existing statement entries for this user are replaced. Balances themselves are <b>not</b> changed.', () => {
        const d = TSMX._u360; if (!d) return;
        const evts = [];
        d.orders.forEach(o => {
          const at = TSMX.orderTime(o); if (!at) return;
          const amt = TSMX.orderAmount(o);
          const st = String(o.status || '').toLowerCase();
          evts.push({ at: at, type: 'order', amount: amt, note: (o.serviceName || '') + ' · ' + (o.packageName || ''), ref: o.orderId || o.id, delta: -amt });
          if (st === 'rejected' || st === 'cancelled' || st === 'canceled' || st === 'refunded')
            evts.push({ at: at + 1, type: 'order_refund', amount: amt, note: 'Order ' + st, ref: o.orderId || o.id, delta: amt });
        });
        d.funds.forEach(f => {
          const at = TSMX.fundTime(f); if (!at) return;
          const st = String(f.status || '').toLowerCase();
          if (st === 'approved' || st === 'completed')
            evts.push({ at: at, type: 'fund', amount: TSMX.fundAmount(f), note: TSMX.fundMethod(f) + ' approved', ref: f.requestNumber || f.requestId || f.id, delta: TSMX.fundAmount(f) });
        });
        evts.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
        let run = 0; const up = {};
        evts.forEach(e => { const before = run; run = Math.round((run + e.delta) * 10000) / 10000; up[DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/ledger').push().key] = { type: e.type, amount: Math.abs(e.amount), balanceBefore: before, balanceAfter: run, note: e.note, ref: e.ref, at: e.at, by: 'rebuild' }; });
        DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/ledger').set(up).then(() => {
          TSMX.audit('ledger.rebuild', evts.length + ' entries rebuilt', uid);
          TSMX.toast('✅ Statement rebuilt with ' + evts.length + ' entries', 'success');
          TSMX.openUser360(uid);
        }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Rebuild failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
      });
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({ id: 'tsmxUsersPage', title: 'User Command Centre', html: HTML, group: 'business', icon: '🧑‍💼', label: 'User Command Centre', onEnter: TSMX.ucLoad });
    const legacy = document.getElementById('usersPage');
    if (legacy && !document.getElementById('tsmxUsersShortcut')) {
      const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'card'; d.id = 'tsmxUsersShortcut';
      d.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note n-ok" style="margin:0"><b>🧑‍💼 User Command Centre</b> — multi-select, bulk balance & status, ban/suspend, CSV export and 360° profiles with wallet statements. ' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="margin-left:8px" onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxUsersPage\')">Open →</button></div>';
      legacy.insertBefore(d, legacy.firstChild);
    }
  });
})();


/* ---------- 06-coupons.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 6 — GAP #7 : COUPON / PROMO CODE ENGINE
   Node: coupons/{CODE}   ·   Redemptions: coupon_redemptions/{CODE}/{uid}/{id}
   Works on New Order (discount) and Add Funds (bonus credit).
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🏷️ Coupons & Promo Codes</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      Coupons work in two places: <b>Order discount</b> (reduces the charge at checkout) and
      <b>Deposit bonus</b> (extra wallet credit when a fund request is approved).
      Every redemption is logged and shows up in the user's Wallet Statement.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="cpKpis" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="cpSearch" placeholder="Code or description…" oninput="TSMX.cpRender()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Status</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="cpFilter" onchange="TSMX.cpRender()">
        <option value="">All</option><option value="live">🟢 Live now</option><option value="scheduled">🕒 Scheduled</option>
        <option value="expired">⌛ Expired</option><option value="exhausted">🚫 Used up</option><option value="off">⏸️ Disabled</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Applies to</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="cpApplies" onchange="TSMX.cpRender()">
        <option value="">Any</option><option value="order">🛒 Orders</option><option value="fund">💰 Deposits</option><option value="both">Both</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.cpOpen()">➕ Create Coupon</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.cpLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.cpExport()">📥 CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="cpList"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">📊 Recent Redemptions</h3><div id="cpRedeem"></div></div>`;

  let COUPONS = [], REDEEM = [], SERVICES = [];

  function state(c) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (c.enabled === false) return { k: 'off', label: '⏸️ Disabled', pill: 'p-gray' };
    if (c.totalUses > 0 && TSMX.num(c.usedCount) >= c.totalUses) return { k: 'exhausted', label: '🚫 Used up', pill: 'p-red' };
    if (c.startAt && now < c.startAt) return { k: 'scheduled', label: '🕒 Scheduled', pill: 'p-blue' };
    if (c.endAt && now > c.endAt) return { k: 'expired', label: '⌛ Expired', pill: 'p-amber' };
    return { k: 'live', label: '🟢 Live', pill: 'p-green' };
  }

  TSMX.cpLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('cpList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading coupons…');
    TSMX.guard('cpList', 'TSMX.cpLoad()', () =>
      Promise.all([DB().ref('coupons').once('value'), DB().ref('services').once('value'), DB().ref('coupon_redemptions').limitToLast(50).once('value')])
        .then(([c, s, r]) => {
          COUPONS = Object.entries(c.val() || {}).map(([code, v]) => Object.assign({ code: code }, v)).sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
          SERVICES = []; s.forEach(x => SERVICES.push({ id: x.key, name: (x.val() || {}).name || x.key }));
          REDEEM = [];
          Object.entries(r.val() || {}).forEach(([code, users]) => Object.entries(users || {}).forEach(([uid, rows]) =>
            Object.entries(rows || {}).forEach(([id, v]) => REDEEM.push(Object.assign({ code: code, uid: uid, id: id }, v)))));
          REDEEM.sort((a, b) => (b.at || 0) - (a.at || 0));
          paintKpis(); TSMX.cpRender(); renderRedeem();
        }));
  };

  function paintKpis() {
    const box = document.getElementById('cpKpis'); if (!box) return;
    const live = COUPONS.filter(c => state(c).k === 'live').length;
    const uses = COUPONS.reduce((a, c) => a + TSMX.num(c.usedCount), 0);
    const given = COUPONS.reduce((a, c) => a + TSMX.num(c.totalDiscountGiven), 0);
    const k = (col, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + col + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    box.innerHTML = k('#10b981', 'Live Coupons', TSMX.int(live), COUPONS.length + ' total created') +
      k('#0ea5e9', 'Total Redemptions', TSMX.int(uses), 'all coupons') +
      k('#f59e0b', 'Discount Given', TSMX.money0(given), 'value handed out') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Avg Discount', uses ? TSMX.money(given / uses) : '₹0.00', 'per redemption');
  }

  TSMX.cpRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('cpList'); if (!box) return;
    const q = ((document.getElementById('cpSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const f = (document.getElementById('cpFilter') || {}).value || '';
    const ap = (document.getElementById('cpApplies') || {}).value || '';
    const list = COUPONS.filter(c => (!q || (c.code + ' ' + (c.description || '')).toLowerCase().includes(q)) &&
      (!f || state(c).k === f) && (!ap || c.appliesTo === ap));
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🏷️', 'No coupons match. Click “Create Coupon” to add one.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Code</th><th>Discount</th><th>Applies To</th><th>Usage</th><th>Window</th><th>Status</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      list.map(c => {
        const s = state(c);
        const disc = c.type === 'percent' ? TSMX.num(c.value) + '% off' + (c.maxDiscount > 0 ? ' (max ' + TSMX.money0(c.maxDiscount) + ')' : '') : TSMX.money0(c.value) + ' off';
        const usage = TSMX.num(c.usedCount) + (c.totalUses > 0 ? ' / ' + c.totalUses : ' / ∞') + (c.perUserLimit > 0 ? ' · ' + c.perUserLimit + '/user' : '');
        const win = (c.startAt ? TSMX.dateOnly(c.startAt) : 'now') + ' → ' + (c.endAt ? TSMX.dateOnly(c.endAt) : 'never');
        return '<tr><td><b style="font-family:monospace;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.6px">' + esc(c.code) + '</b>' +
          (c.description ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(c.description) + '</div>' : '') +
          (c.firstOrderOnly ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet" style="margin-top:3px">First order only</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-weight:700;color:#10b981">' + disc + (c.minAmount > 0 ? '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray);font-weight:500">min ' + TSMX.money0(c.minAmount) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + (c.appliesTo === 'fund' ? 'p-amber' : c.appliesTo === 'both' ? 'p-violet' : 'p-blue') + '">' + (c.appliesTo === 'fund' ? '💰 Deposits' : c.appliesTo === 'both' ? '🔀 Both' : '🛒 Orders') + '</span>' +
          (c.serviceIds && c.serviceIds.length ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray);margin-top:3px">' + c.serviceIds.length + ' service(s) only</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px">' + usage + '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#0ea5e9">' + TSMX.money0(c.totalDiscountGiven) + ' given</div></td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + win + '</td>' +
          '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + s.pill + '">' + s.label + '</span></td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.cpOpen(\'' + esc(c.code) + '\')">✏️</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm ' + (c.enabled === false ? 'ok' : 'warn') + '" onclick="TSMX.cpToggle(\'' + esc(c.code) + '\')">' + (c.enabled === false ? '▶' : '⏸') + '</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.cpCopy(\'' + esc(c.code) + '\')">📋</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.cpDelete(\'' + esc(c.code) + '\')">🗑</button></td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  };

  function renderRedeem() {
    const box = document.getElementById('cpRedeem'); if (!box) return;
    if (!REDEEM.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '📊', 'No coupon has been redeemed yet.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Code</th><th>User</th><th>Context</th><th style="text-align:right">Order/Deposit</th><th style="text-align:right">Discount</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      REDEEM.slice(0, 120).map(r => '<tr><td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(r.at) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:700">' + esc(r.code) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + esc(r.email || String(r.uid).slice(0, 14) + '…') + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + (r.context === 'fund' ? 'p-amber' : 'p-blue') + '">' + esc(r.context || 'order') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.money(r.baseAmount) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:#10b981">−' + TSMX.money(r.discount) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }

  TSMX.cpOpen = function (code) {
    if (!TSMX.require('coupons')) return;
    const c = COUPONS.find(x => x.code === code) || { type: 'percent', appliesTo: 'order', enabled: true, perUserLimit: 1 };
    const dtv = ts => { if (!ts) return ''; const d = new Date(ts); const p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()) + 'T' + p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes()); };
    TSMX.modal({
      wide: true, title: code ? '✏️ Edit Coupon — ' + code : '➕ Create Coupon',
      body:
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Coupon code *</label><input id="cpCode" value="' + esc(c.code || '') + '" ' + (code ? 'readonly style="opacity:.6"' : '') + ' placeholder="e.g. FEST50" style="font-family:monospace;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px"><div class="hint">Users type this exactly. Letters and numbers only.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Internal description</label><input id="cpDesc" value="' + esc(c.description || '') + '" placeholder="Diwali campaign 2026"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Discount type *</label><select id="cpType"><option value="percent"' + (c.type === 'percent' ? ' selected' : '') + '>％ Percentage off</option><option value="flat"' + (c.type === 'flat' ? ' selected' : '') + '>₹ Flat amount off</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Value *</label><input type="number" id="cpValue" value="' + TSMX.num(c.value) + '" min="0" step="0.01"><div class="hint" id="cpValHint"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum discount cap (₹)</label><input type="number" id="cpMax" value="' + TSMX.num(c.maxDiscount) + '" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">Only for percentage coupons. 0 = no cap.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Minimum amount to qualify (₹)</label><input type="number" id="cpMin" value="' + TSMX.num(c.minAmount) + '" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">Order/deposit must be at least this much.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Applies to *</label><select id="cpAppliesTo">' +
        '<option value="order"' + (c.appliesTo === 'order' ? ' selected' : '') + '>🛒 New orders (checkout discount)</option>' +
        '<option value="fund"' + (c.appliesTo === 'fund' ? ' selected' : '') + '>💰 Deposits (extra wallet credit)</option>' +
        '<option value="both"' + (c.appliesTo === 'both' ? ' selected' : '') + '>🔀 Both</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Total uses allowed</label><input type="number" id="cpTotal" value="' + TSMX.num(c.totalUses) + '" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">0 = unlimited.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Uses per user</label><input type="number" id="cpPerUser" value="' + TSMX.num(c.perUserLimit, 1) + '" min="0" step="1"><div class="hint">0 = unlimited per user.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Starts at</label><input type="datetime-local" id="cpStart" value="' + dtv(c.startAt) + '"><div class="hint">Leave blank to start immediately.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Expires at</label><input type="datetime-local" id="cpEnd" value="' + dtv(c.endAt) + '"><div class="hint">Leave blank for no expiry.</div></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Limit to specific services (optional)</label><select id="cpServices" multiple size="5" style="height:auto">' +
        SERVICES.map(s => '<option value="' + esc(s.id) + '"' + ((c.serviceIds || []).indexOf(s.id) >= 0 ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(s.name) + '</option>').join('') +
        '</select><div class="hint">Ctrl/Cmd-click to pick several. Leave nothing selected to allow every service.</div></div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="cpFirst"' + (c.firstOrderOnly ? ' checked' : '') + '><span><span class="sw-t">First order only</span><span class="sw-h">Only valid for users who have never completed an order — perfect for new-customer acquisition.</span></span></label>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="cpEnabled"' + (c.enabled !== false ? ' checked' : '') + '><span><span class="sw-t">Coupon active</span><span class="sw-h">Turn off to instantly stop it being accepted, without deleting it.</span></span></label>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.cpSave(' + (code ? "'" + code + "'" : 'null') + ')">💾 Save Coupon</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        const t = document.getElementById('cpType'), h = document.getElementById('cpValHint');
        const paint = () => h.textContent = t.value === 'percent' ? 'Enter 10 for “10% off”. Max 100.' : 'Enter 50 for “₹50 off”.';
        t.onchange = paint; paint();
        const cc = document.getElementById('cpCode');
        if (!code) cc.oninput = () => { cc.value = cc.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ''); };
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.cpSave = function (existing) {
    if (!TSMX.require('coupons')) return;
    const code = (document.getElementById('cpCode').value || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
    if (code.length < 3) return TSMX.toast('Code must be at least 3 characters (A–Z, 0–9)', 'error');
    const type = document.getElementById('cpType').value;
    const value = TSMX.num(document.getElementById('cpValue').value);
    if (value <= 0) return TSMX.toast('Discount value must be greater than 0', 'error');
    if (type === 'percent' && value > 100) return TSMX.toast('Percentage cannot exceed 100', 'error');
    const dtn = id => { const v = document.getElementById(id).value; return v ? new Date(v).getTime() : null; };
    const svc = Array.from(document.getElementById('cpServices').selectedOptions).map(o => o.value);
    const old = COUPONS.find(x => x.code === code) || {};
    const rec = {
      code: code,
      description: document.getElementById('cpDesc').value.trim(),
      type: type, value: value,
      maxDiscount: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('cpMax').value)),
      minAmount: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('cpMin').value)),
      appliesTo: document.getElementById('cpAppliesTo').value,
      totalUses: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('cpTotal').value)),
      perUserLimit: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('cpPerUser').value)),
      startAt: dtn('cpStart'), endAt: dtn('cpEnd'),
      serviceIds: svc.length ? svc : null,
      firstOrderOnly: document.getElementById('cpFirst').checked,
      enabled: document.getElementById('cpEnabled').checked,
      usedCount: TSMX.num(old.usedCount),
      totalDiscountGiven: TSMX.num(old.totalDiscountGiven),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
    if (rec.endAt && rec.startAt && rec.endAt <= rec.startAt) return TSMX.toast('Expiry must be after the start time', 'error');
    if (!existing) rec.createdAt = Date.now();
    DB().ref('coupons/' + code).update(rec).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit(existing ? 'coupon.update' : 'coupon.create', code + ' · ' + (type === 'percent' ? value + '%' : '₹' + value) + ' · ' + rec.appliesTo, code);
      TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('✅ Coupon ' + code + ' saved', 'success'); TSMX.cpLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.cpToggle = function (code) {
    const c = COUPONS.find(x => x.code === code); if (!c) return;
    DB().ref('coupons/' + code + '/enabled').set(c.enabled === false).then(() => { TSMX.audit('coupon.toggle', code, code); TSMX.cpLoad(); });
  };
  TSMX.cpCopy = function (code) {
    const t = document.createElement('textarea'); t.value = code; document.body.appendChild(t); t.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); TSMX.toast('📋 Copied “' + code + '”', 'success'); } catch (e) { } t.remove();
  };
  TSMX.cpDelete = function (code) {
    if (!TSMX.require('coupons')) return;
    TSMX.confirm('Delete coupon ' + code + '?', 'It will stop working immediately. Redemption history is kept for your records.', () => {
      DB().ref('coupons/' + code).remove().then(() => { TSMX.audit('coupon.delete', code, code); TSMX.toast('🗑 Deleted', 'success'); TSMX.cpLoad(); });
    }, true);
  };
  TSMX.cpExport = () => TSMX.csv('coupons_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['Code', 'Description', 'Type', 'Value', 'Max Discount', 'Min Amount', 'Applies To', 'Total Uses', 'Used', 'Per User', 'First Order Only', 'Start', 'End', 'Enabled', 'Discount Given']].concat(
      COUPONS.map(c => [c.code, c.description || '', c.type, c.value, c.maxDiscount || 0, c.minAmount || 0, c.appliesTo, c.totalUses || 0, c.usedCount || 0, c.perUserLimit || 0, !!c.firstOrderOnly, c.startAt ? TSMX.dt(c.startAt) : '', c.endAt ? TSMX.dt(c.endAt) : '', c.enabled !== false, c.totalDiscountGiven || 0])));

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({ id: 'tsmxCouponsPage', title: 'Coupons & Promo Codes', html: HTML, group: 'order-control', icon: '🏷️', label: 'Coupons & Promos', onEnter: TSMX.cpLoad });
  });
})();


/* ---------- 07-broadcast.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 7 — GAP #8 : BROADCAST CENTRE  (fixes the no-op push)
   Real, working announcements delivered through the database:
     broadcasts/{id}  → every matching user's panel shows a banner
                        + a permanent notification, live, no server needed.
   Optional OneSignal REST relay if the owner supplies a proxy URL.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">📢 Broadcast Centre</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-ok">
      <b>This actually works without any server.</b> A broadcast is written to <code>broadcasts/</code>; every user
      panel listens live and instantly shows an in-app banner plus a permanent notification.
      Browser push (OneSignal) additionally needs a REST relay — configure it at the bottom if you have one.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
      <div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Title *</label><input id="bcTitle" placeholder="e.g. 🎉 Diwali Sale — 20% extra on every deposit" maxlength="90"></div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Message *</label><textarea id="bcMsg" rows="4" placeholder="Write the announcement…" maxlength="600"></textarea></div>
        <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Style</label><select id="bcType">
            <option value="info">ℹ️ Info (blue)</option><option value="offer">🎁 Offer (violet)</option>
            <option value="success">✅ Good news (green)</option><option value="warning">⚠️ Warning (amber)</option>
            <option value="critical">🚨 Critical (red)</option></select></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Audience</label><select id="bcAudience" onchange="TSMX.bcAudChange()">
            <option value="all">👥 Every user</option><option value="buyers">🛒 Users who have ordered</option>
            <option value="never">🆕 Users who never ordered</option><option value="balance">💰 Users with balance &gt; 0</option>
            <option value="zero">🪙 Users with zero balance</option><option value="specific">🎯 Specific users…</option></select></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tsmx-f" id="bcSpecificWrap" style="display:none"><label>Emails or UIDs (one per line)</label><textarea id="bcSpecific" rows="4" placeholder="user1@mail.com&#10;user2@mail.com"></textarea></div>
        <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Banner shows until</label><input type="datetime-local" id="bcExpires"><div class="hint">After this the banner disappears; the notification stays in history. Blank = 7 days.</div></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Action button link (optional)</label><input id="bcLink" placeholder="e.g. addFundPage or https://…"><div class="hint">A panel page id (addFundPage, referralPage…) or a full URL.</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Action button text (optional)</label><input id="bcLinkText" placeholder="e.g. Add Funds Now"></div>
        <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="bcNotif" checked><span><span class="sw-t">Also save as a notification</span><span class="sw-h">Adds it to each user's notification list so they see it later too.</span></span></label>
        <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="bcSticky"><span><span class="sw-t">Sticky banner</span><span class="sw-h">User cannot dismiss it until it expires. Use only for critical notices.</span></span></label>
        <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="bcPush"><span><span class="sw-t">Also send browser push</span><span class="sw-h">Requires the OneSignal relay below to be configured.</span></span></label>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px">
          <button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.bcSend()">📢 Send Broadcast</button>
          <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.bcPreview()">👁 Preview</button>
          <span id="bcStatus" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-bottom:9px">Live Preview</div>
        <div id="bcPreviewBox" style="border:2px dashed var(--border-color);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;min-height:150px;background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc)">
          <div style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-gray);font-size:12.5px;padding:30px 0">Start typing to see how it looks on the user's phone…</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tsmx-note n-info" style="margin-top:14px"><b>Estimated reach:</b> <span id="bcReach">calculating…</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">📜 Sent Broadcasts</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar"><button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.bcLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button></div>
    <div id="bcList"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🔔 Browser Push Relay (optional)</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-warn">
      OneSignal's REST API needs a secret key that must never sit in a public HTML file. If you host a tiny relay
      (Cloudflare Worker / Vercel function) that forwards <code>{title, message, audience}</code> to OneSignal,
      paste its URL here and “Also send browser push” will start working. Leave blank and in-app broadcasts still work perfectly.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Relay endpoint URL</label><input id="bcRelay" placeholder="https://your-worker.workers.dev/push"></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Shared secret header (optional)</label><input id="bcRelayKey" placeholder="X-Relay-Token value"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.bcSaveRelay()">💾 Save Relay Settings</button>
    <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.bcTestRelay()">🧪 Test Relay</button>
  </div>`;

  let SENT = [], USERCACHE = null;

  TSMX.bcAudChange = function () {
    document.getElementById('bcSpecificWrap').style.display = document.getElementById('bcAudience').value === 'specific' ? '' : 'none';
    estimate();
  };

  const TONE = { info: ['#3b82f6', 'ℹ️'], offer: ['#8b5cf6', '🎁'], success: ['#10b981', '✅'], warning: ['#f59e0b', '⚠️'], critical: ['#ef4444', '🚨'] };

  TSMX.bcPreview = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('bcPreviewBox'); if (!box) return;
    const t = document.getElementById('bcTitle').value.trim();
    const m = document.getElementById('bcMsg').value.trim();
    const ty = document.getElementById('bcType').value;
    const lt = document.getElementById('bcLinkText').value.trim();
    const [col, ic] = TONE[ty] || TONE.info;
    if (!t && !m) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-gray);font-size:12.5px;padding:30px 0">Start typing to see how it looks on the user\'s phone…</div>'; return; }
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.13);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #e2e8f0">' +
      '<div style="background:' + col + ';padding:11px 14px;color:#fff;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center">' +
      '<span style="font-size:19px">' + ic + '</span><b style="font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.3">' + esc(t || 'Title') + '</b></div>' +
      '<div style="padding:13px 14px;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.62;color:#334155;white-space:pre-wrap">' + esc(m || 'Your message appears here…') + '</div>' +
      (lt ? '<div style="padding:0 14px 14px"><button style="width:100%;padding:9px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:' + col + ';color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px">' + esc(lt) + '</button></div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
  };

  function estimate() {
    const el = document.getElementById('bcReach'); if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = 'calculating…';
    const aud = document.getElementById('bcAudience').value;
    if (aud === 'specific') {
      const n = (document.getElementById('bcSpecific').value || '').split('\n').filter(x => x.trim()).length;
      el.textContent = n + ' specified user(s)'; return;
    }
    const go = users => {
      let n = 0;
      users.forEach(u => {
        if (u.status === 'banned') return;
        if (aud === 'all') n++;
        else if (aud === 'buyers' && u.orders > 0) n++;
        else if (aud === 'never' && !u.orders) n++;
        else if (aud === 'balance' && u.balance > 0) n++;
        else if (aud === 'zero' && u.balance <= 0) n++;
      });
      el.innerHTML = '<b>' + TSMX.int(n) + '</b> user(s) will receive this out of ' + TSMX.int(users.length) + ' total.';
    };
    if (USERCACHE) return go(USERCACHE);
    DB().ref('users').once('value').then(s => {
      USERCACHE = [];
      s.forEach(c => { const v = c.val() || {}; USERCACHE.push({ uid: c.key, email: (v.email || '').toLowerCase(), balance: TSMX.num(v.balance), orders: Object.keys(v.orders || {}).length, status: v.status || 'active' }); });
      go(USERCACHE);
    }).catch(() => { el.textContent = 'could not calculate'; });
  }

  function targets(aud, specificRaw) {
    if (!USERCACHE) return [];
    if (aud === 'specific') {
      const wanted = specificRaw.split('\n').map(x => x.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
      return USERCACHE.filter(u => wanted.indexOf(u.email) >= 0 || wanted.indexOf(u.uid.toLowerCase()) >= 0);
    }
    return USERCACHE.filter(u => u.status !== 'banned' && (
      aud === 'all' || (aud === 'buyers' && u.orders > 0) || (aud === 'never' && !u.orders) ||
      (aud === 'balance' && u.balance > 0) || (aud === 'zero' && u.balance <= 0)));
  }

  TSMX.bcSend = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('broadcast')) return;
    const title = document.getElementById('bcTitle').value.trim();
    const message = document.getElementById('bcMsg').value.trim();
    if (!title || !message) return TSMX.toast('Title and message are both required', 'error');
    const aud = document.getElementById('bcAudience').value;
    const spec = document.getElementById('bcSpecific').value || '';
    const expIn = document.getElementById('bcExpires').value;
    const expiresAt = expIn ? new Date(expIn).getTime() : Date.now() + 7 * 864e5;
    const rec = {
      title: title, message: message, type: document.getElementById('bcType').value,
      audience: aud, sticky: document.getElementById('bcSticky').checked,
      link: document.getElementById('bcLink').value.trim() || null,
      linkText: document.getElementById('bcLinkText').value.trim() || null,
      createdAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: expiresAt, enabled: true,
      by: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
    const st = document.getElementById('bcStatus'); st.textContent = '⏳ Resolving audience…';

    const proceed = () => {
      const list = targets(aud, spec);
      if (!list.length) { st.textContent = ''; return TSMX.toast('No users match this audience', 'error'); }
      if (aud === 'specific') rec.uids = list.map(u => u.uid);
      rec.reach = list.length;
      st.textContent = '⏳ Publishing to ' + list.length + ' user(s)…';

      const bref = DB().ref('broadcasts').push();
      bref.set(rec).then(() => {
        if (!document.getElementById('bcNotif').checked) return;
        // write notifications in chunks so huge panels don't stall
        const CH = 400; let i = 0;
        const next = () => {
