          if (i >= list.length) return Promise.resolve();
          const slice = list.slice(i, i + CH); i += CH;
          const up = {};
          slice.forEach(u => { up['notifications/' + DB().ref('notifications').push().key] = { user_id: u.uid, type: rec.type, title: title, message: message, is_read: false, read: false, created_at: Date.now(), timestamp: Date.now(), broadcastId: bref.key }; });
          st.textContent = '⏳ Notifications ' + Math.min(i, list.length) + ' / ' + list.length + '…';
          return DB().ref().update(up).then(next);
        };
        return next();
      }).then(() => {
        if (document.getElementById('bcPush').checked) return relayPush(rec, list.length).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Push relay: ' + e.message, 'error'));
      }).then(() => {
        st.textContent = '✅ Delivered to ' + list.length + ' user(s) at ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN');
        TSMX.audit('broadcast.send', title + ' → ' + aud + ' (' + list.length + ')', bref.key);
        TSMX.toast('📢 Broadcast delivered to ' + list.length + ' user(s)', 'success');
        document.getElementById('bcTitle').value = ''; document.getElementById('bcMsg').value = '';
        TSMX.bcPreview(); TSMX.bcLoad();
      }).catch(e => { st.textContent = '❌ Failed'; TSMX.toast('Broadcast failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); });
    };

    if (USERCACHE) proceed();
    else DB().ref('users').once('value').then(s => {
      USERCACHE = []; s.forEach(c => { const v = c.val() || {}; USERCACHE.push({ uid: c.key, email: (v.email || '').toLowerCase(), balance: TSMX.num(v.balance), orders: Object.keys(v.orders || {}).length, status: v.status || 'active' }); });
      proceed();
    }).catch(e => { st.textContent = '❌ ' + e.message; });
  };

  function relayPush(rec, reach) {
    return DB().ref('settings/pushRelay').once('value').then(s => {
      const cfg = s.val() || {};
      if (!cfg.url) throw new Error('No relay URL configured');
      return fetch(cfg.url, {
        method: 'POST', headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, cfg.key ? { 'X-Relay-Token': cfg.key } : {}),
        body: JSON.stringify({ title: rec.title, message: rec.message, audience: rec.audience, url: rec.link, reach: reach })
      }).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Relay HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json().catch(() => ({})); });
    });
  }

  TSMX.bcSaveRelay = function () {
    DB().ref('settings/pushRelay').set({
      url: document.getElementById('bcRelay').value.trim() || null,
      key: document.getElementById('bcRelayKey').value.trim() || null,
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    }).then(() => { TSMX.audit('broadcast.relay', 'Relay settings saved'); TSMX.toast('✅ Relay settings saved', 'success'); });
  };
  TSMX.bcTestRelay = function () {
    relayPush({ title: '🧪 Test push from Admin Panel', message: 'If you see this, your relay works!', audience: 'all', link: null }, 1)
      .then(() => TSMX.toast('✅ Relay responded OK', 'success'))
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.bcLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('bcList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading broadcast history…');
    TSMX.guard('bcList', 'TSMX.bcLoad()', () =>
      DB().ref('broadcasts').orderByChild('createdAt').limitToLast(60).once('value').then(s => {
        SENT = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
        if (!SENT.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '📢', 'No broadcasts sent yet.');
        const now = Date.now();
        box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Sent</th><th>Title</th><th>Audience</th><th>Reach</th><th>Banner</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
          SENT.map(b => '<tr><td style="font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(b.createdAt) + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(b.by || '') + '</div></td>' +
            '<td><b style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(b.title) + '</b><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray);max-width:340px">' + esc(String(b.message || '').slice(0, 110)) + (String(b.message || '').length > 110 ? '…' : '') + '</div></td>' +
            '<td><span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">' + esc(b.audience) + '</span></td>' +
            '<td style="font-weight:700">' + TSMX.int(b.reach) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + (b.enabled === false ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">Stopped</span>' : (b.expiresAt && b.expiresAt < now) ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">Expired</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">Showing</span>') + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
            (b.enabled === false ? '' : '<button class="tsmx-btn sm warn" onclick="TSMX.bcStop(\'' + esc(b.id) + '\')">⏹ Stop</button> ') +
            '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.bcReuse(\'' + esc(b.id) + '\')">♻️ Reuse</button> ' +
            '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.bcDelete(\'' + esc(b.id) + '\')">🗑</button></td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
      }));
  };
  TSMX.bcStop = id => DB().ref('broadcasts/' + id + '/enabled').set(false).then(() => { TSMX.audit('broadcast.stop', id, id); TSMX.toast('⏹ Banner stopped', 'success'); TSMX.bcLoad(); });
  TSMX.bcDelete = id => TSMX.confirm('Delete broadcast?', 'The banner disappears for everyone. Notifications already delivered are kept.', () =>
    DB().ref('broadcasts/' + id).remove().then(() => { TSMX.audit('broadcast.delete', id, id); TSMX.bcLoad(); }), true);
  TSMX.bcReuse = function (id) {
    const b = SENT.find(x => x.id === id); if (!b) return;
    document.getElementById('bcTitle').value = b.title || '';
    document.getElementById('bcMsg').value = b.message || '';
    document.getElementById('bcType').value = b.type || 'info';
    document.getElementById('bcAudience').value = b.audience || 'all';
    document.getElementById('bcLink').value = b.link || '';
    document.getElementById('bcLinkText').value = b.linkText || '';
    TSMX.bcAudChange(); TSMX.bcPreview();
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    TSMX.toast('♻️ Loaded into the composer — edit and send again', 'success');
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxBroadcastPage', title: 'Broadcast Centre', html: HTML, group: 'design', icon: '📢', label: 'Broadcast Centre',
      onEnter: () => {
        TSMX.bcLoad(); estimate();
        ['bcTitle', 'bcMsg', 'bcType', 'bcLinkText'].forEach(id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e && !e._bcWired) { e._bcWired = 1; e.addEventListener('input', TSMX.bcPreview); e.addEventListener('change', TSMX.bcPreview); } });
        const sp = document.getElementById('bcSpecific'); if (sp && !sp._w) { sp._w = 1; sp.addEventListener('input', TSMX.debounce(estimate, 400)); }
        DB().ref('settings/pushRelay').once('value').then(s => { const c = s.val() || {}; const a = document.getElementById('bcRelay'), b = document.getElementById('bcRelayKey'); if (a) a.value = c.url || ''; if (b) b.value = c.key || ''; }).catch(() => { });
      }
    });
  });
})();


/* ---------- 08-search-drip-health.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 8 — GAP #9 (deep order search) + #10 (drip-feed)
                        + #11/#12 (performance, resilience, health)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  /* ═══════════ GAP #9 — DEEP ORDER SEARCH ═══════════ */
  const SEARCH_HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🔎 Deep Order Search</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      The main Orders page can only look up a short Order ID or a status. This searches <b>everything</b> —
      customer email, target link, service, package, amount range, quantity and date range — then lets you
      act on the results or export them.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Free text</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="osQ" placeholder="Order ID, email, link, service…" style="min-width:230px"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Field</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="osField">
        <option value="any">Any field</option><option value="id">Order ID</option><option value="email">Customer email</option>
        <option value="link">Target link</option><option value="service">Service / package</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Status</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="osStatus">
        <option value="">All</option><option value="pending">Pending</option><option value="processing">Processing</option>
        <option value="completed">Completed</option><option value="partial">Partial</option>
        <option value="cancelled">Cancelled</option><option value="rejected">Rejected</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>From</label><input type="date" class="tsmx-in" id="osFrom"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>To</label><input type="date" class="tsmx-in" id="osTo"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Min ₹</label><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" id="osMin" style="min-width:90px"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Max ₹</label><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" id="osMax" style="min-width:90px"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Scan limit</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="osCap"><option value="5000">5,000</option><option value="15000" selected>15,000</option><option value="40000">40,000</option><option value="100000">All (slow)</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.osRun()">🔎 Search</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.osReset()">✖ Clear</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.osExport()">📥 Export</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="osKpis" style="margin-bottom:14px"></div>
    <div id="osList"></div>
  </div>`;

  let FOUND = [];

  TSMX.osReset = function () {
    ['osQ', 'osFrom', 'osTo', 'osMin', 'osMax'].forEach(i => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.value = ''; });
    document.getElementById('osStatus').value = ''; document.getElementById('osField').value = 'any';
    document.getElementById('osList').innerHTML = ''; document.getElementById('osKpis').innerHTML = '';
    FOUND = [];
  };

  TSMX.osRun = function () {
    const q = (document.getElementById('osQ').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const field = document.getElementById('osField').value;
    const stf = document.getElementById('osStatus').value;
    const from = document.getElementById('osFrom').value ? new Date(document.getElementById('osFrom').value + 'T00:00:00').getTime() : 0;
    const to = document.getElementById('osTo').value ? new Date(document.getElementById('osTo').value + 'T23:59:59').getTime() : Infinity;
    const min = document.getElementById('osMin').value === '' ? -Infinity : TSMX.num(document.getElementById('osMin').value);
    const max = document.getElementById('osMax').value === '' ? Infinity : TSMX.num(document.getElementById('osMax').value);
    const cap = Number(document.getElementById('osCap').value);
    if (!q && !stf && !from && to === Infinity && min === -Infinity && max === Infinity)
      return TSMX.toast('Enter at least one filter', 'error');

    TSMX.loading('osList', 'Scanning orders…');
    TSMX.guard('osList', 'TSMX.osRun()', () => DB().ref('users').once('value').then(snap => {
      FOUND = []; let scanned = 0;
      snap.forEach(u => {
        const uv = u.val() || {}, email = String(uv.email || '').toLowerCase();
        const orders = uv.orders || {};
        for (const oid in orders) {
          if (scanned >= cap) break;
          scanned++;
          const o = orders[oid] || {};
          const at = TSMX.orderTime(o);
          if (at < from || at > to) continue;
          const amt = TSMX.orderAmount(o);
          if (amt < min || amt > max) continue;
          const st = String(o.status || '').toLowerCase();
          if (stf && st !== stf) continue;
          if (q) {
            const idS = String(o.orderId || o.shortId || oid).toLowerCase();
            const link = String(o.link || '').toLowerCase();
            const svc = (String(o.serviceName || '') + ' ' + String(o.packageName || '')).toLowerCase();
            let hit = false;
            if (field === 'id') hit = idS.includes(q);
            else if (field === 'email') hit = email.includes(q);
            else if (field === 'link') hit = link.includes(q);
            else if (field === 'service') hit = svc.includes(q);
            else hit = idS.includes(q) || email.includes(q) || link.includes(q) || svc.includes(q) || u.key.toLowerCase().includes(q);
            if (!hit) continue;
          }
          FOUND.push({
            key: oid, uid: u.key, email: uv.email || '', orderId: o.orderId || o.shortId || oid,
            link: o.link || '', service: o.serviceName || '', pkg: o.packageName || '',
            qty: TSMX.num(o.quantity), amount: amt, status: st || 'pending', at: at,
            startCount: o.startCount, remains: o.remains
          });
        }
      });
      FOUND.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
      renderFound(scanned);
    }));
  };

  function renderFound(scanned) {
    const box = document.getElementById('osList');
    const kp = document.getElementById('osKpis');
    const total = FOUND.reduce((a, o) => a + o.amount, 0);
    const done = FOUND.filter(o => o.status === 'completed');
    const users = new Set(FOUND.map(o => o.uid)).size;
    const k = (c, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    kp.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Matches', TSMX.int(FOUND.length), 'scanned ' + TSMX.int(scanned) + ' orders') +
      k('#10b981', 'Total Value', TSMX.money0(total), TSMX.money0(done.reduce((a, o) => a + o.amount, 0)) + ' completed') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Unique Customers', TSMX.int(users), '') +
      k('#f59e0b', 'Avg Order', FOUND.length ? TSMX.money(total / FOUND.length) : '₹0', '');
    if (!FOUND.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🔎', 'No orders match these filters.');
    const pill = s => s === 'completed' ? 'p-green' : s === 'pending' ? 'p-amber' : s === 'processing' ? 'p-blue' : s === 'partial' ? 'p-violet' : (s === 'rejected' || s === 'cancelled') ? 'p-red' : 'p-gray';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Order ID</th><th>Customer</th><th>Service</th><th>Link</th><th style="text-align:right">Qty</th><th style="text-align:right">Charge</th><th>Status</th><th>Date</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      FOUND.slice(0, 500).map(o => '<tr><td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700">' + esc(o.orderId) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + esc(o.email || o.uid.slice(0, 12)) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + esc(o.service) + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(o.pkg) + '</div></td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11px;max-width:190px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis"><a href="' + esc(o.link) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:#0ea5e9">' + esc(String(o.link).slice(0, 46)) + '</a></td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.int(o.qty) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.money(o.amount) + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + pill(o.status) + '">' + esc(o.status) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(o.at) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right"><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.openUser360(\'' + esc(o.uid) + '\')">👁</button></td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>' + (FOUND.length > 500 ? '<div style="margin-top:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing first 500 of ' + FOUND.length + ' — export for the full list.</div>' : '');
  }

  TSMX.osExport = () => {
    if (!FOUND.length) return TSMX.toast('Run a search first', 'error');
    TSMX.csv('order_search_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
      [['Order ID', 'UID', 'Email', 'Service', 'Package', 'Link', 'Quantity', 'Charge (INR)', 'Status', 'Date']].concat(
        FOUND.map(o => [o.orderId, o.uid, o.email, o.service, o.pkg, o.link, o.qty, o.amount, o.status, TSMX.dt(o.at)])));
    TSMX.audit('orders.search.export', FOUND.length + ' rows');
  };

  /* ═══════════ GAP #10 — DRIP-FEED / SCHEDULED ORDERS ═══════════ */
  const DRIP_HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">💧 Drip-Feed & Scheduled Orders</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-ok">
      <b>Drip-feed</b> splits one big order into small timed runs (e.g. 10,000 followers as 20 × 500 every hour) so the
      target account looks natural and stays safe. <b>Scheduled</b> orders simply start later.
      Enable it here and the option appears on the user's New Order form automatically.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
      <div>
        <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="dfEnabled"><span><span class="sw-t">Enable Drip-Feed for users</span><span class="sw-h">Shows the drip-feed panel on the New Order form.</span></span></label>
        <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="dfSchedEnabled"><span><span class="sw-t">Enable Scheduled Orders</span><span class="sw-h">Lets users pick a future start date & time.</span></span></label>
        <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Minimum runs</label><input type="number" id="dfMinRuns" min="2" value="2"><div class="hint">Fewest splits allowed.</div></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum runs</label><input type="number" id="dfMaxRuns" min="2" value="100"><div class="hint">Most splits allowed.</div></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Minimum interval (minutes)</label><input type="number" id="dfMinInt" min="5" value="30"></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum interval (minutes)</label><input type="number" id="dfMaxInt" min="5" value="1440"></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Extra fee (%)</label><input type="number" id="dfFee" min="0" max="50" step="0.5" value="0"><div class="hint">Optional surcharge added to drip-feed orders.</div></div>
          <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Max schedule ahead (days)</label><input type="number" id="dfMaxAhead" min="1" max="90" value="30"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Helper text shown to users</label><textarea id="dfHelp" rows="2" placeholder="Split your order into smaller batches for a natural, safe delivery."></textarea></div>
        <button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.dfSave()">💾 Save Drip-Feed Settings</button>
        <span id="dfStatus" style="margin-left:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-gray);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:9px">Example</div>
        <div class="tsmx-note n-info" id="dfExample"></div>
        <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3" id="dfKpis"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">⚙️ Drip Runner</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-warn">
      Drip runs are executed by this browser tab while the admin panel is open (the same pattern the panel already
      uses for Auto-Complete and Pending→Processing). Keep this tab open, or press <b>Process Due Runs</b> when you check in.
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px">
      <button class="tsmx-btn" id="dfLoopBtn" onclick="TSMX.dfToggleLoop()">▶️ Start Auto Runner</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.dfProcess()">⚡ Process Due Runs Now</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.dfLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <span id="dfLoopStatus" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
    </div>
    <div id="dfList"></div>
  </div>`;

  let DRIPS = [], loopTimer = null;

  TSMX.dfLoadSettings = function () {
    DB().ref('settings/dripFeed').once('value').then(s => {
      const v = s.val() || {};
      const set = (i, val) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.value = val; };
      const chk = (i, val) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.checked = !!val; };
      chk('dfEnabled', v.enabled); chk('dfSchedEnabled', v.scheduleEnabled);
      set('dfMinRuns', TSMX.num(v.minRuns, 2)); set('dfMaxRuns', TSMX.num(v.maxRuns, 100));
      set('dfMinInt', TSMX.num(v.minInterval, 30)); set('dfMaxInt', TSMX.num(v.maxInterval, 1440));
      set('dfFee', TSMX.num(v.feePercent, 0)); set('dfMaxAhead', TSMX.num(v.maxAheadDays, 30));
      set('dfHelp', v.helpText || 'Split your order into smaller batches for a natural, safe delivery.');
      paintExample();
    }).catch(() => { });
  };
  function paintExample() {
    const runs = TSMX.num((document.getElementById('dfMinRuns') || {}).value, 2) * 5;
    const iv = TSMX.num((document.getElementById('dfMinInt') || {}).value, 30);
    const e = document.getElementById('dfExample'); if (!e) return;
    const total = 10000, per = Math.floor(total / runs);
    e.innerHTML = '<b>10,000 quantity split into ' + runs + ' runs, every ' + iv + ' minutes:</b><br>' +
      '→ ' + TSMX.int(per) + ' delivered per run<br>→ finishes in about <b>' + (Math.round(runs * iv / 60 * 10) / 10) + ' hours</b><br>' +
      '→ the user is charged once, up front, exactly like a normal order.';
  }
  TSMX.dfSave = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('settings')) return;
    const p = {
      enabled: document.getElementById('dfEnabled').checked,
      scheduleEnabled: document.getElementById('dfSchedEnabled').checked,
      minRuns: Math.max(2, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfMinRuns').value, 2)),
      maxRuns: Math.max(2, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfMaxRuns').value, 100)),
      minInterval: Math.max(5, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfMinInt').value, 30)),
      maxInterval: Math.max(5, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfMaxInt').value, 1440)),
      feePercent: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfFee').value, 0)),
      maxAheadDays: Math.max(1, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('dfMaxAhead').value, 30)),
      helpText: document.getElementById('dfHelp').value.trim(),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/dripFeed').update(p).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('dripfeed.settings', 'enabled=' + p.enabled + ' runs ' + p.minRuns + '-' + p.maxRuns);
      const s = document.getElementById('dfStatus'); if (s) s.textContent = '✅ Saved & live';
      TSMX.toast('✅ Drip-feed settings live', 'success'); paintExample();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.dfLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('dfList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading drip & scheduled orders…');
    TSMX.guard('dfList', 'TSMX.dfLoad()', () => DB().ref('drip_orders').limitToLast(300).once('value').then(s => {
      DRIPS = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)).sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
      const now = Date.now();
      const kp = document.getElementById('dfKpis');
      if (kp) {
        const act = DRIPS.filter(d => d.status === 'running' || d.status === 'scheduled').length;
        const due = DRIPS.filter(d => (d.status === 'running' || d.status === 'scheduled') && TSMX.num(d.nextRunAt) <= now).length;
        const k = (c, l, v) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div></div>';
        kp.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Active', TSMX.int(act)) + k('#f59e0b', 'Due Now', TSMX.int(due)) + k('#10b981', 'Finished', TSMX.int(DRIPS.filter(d => d.status === 'completed').length));
      }
      if (!DRIPS.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '💧', 'No drip-feed or scheduled orders yet.');
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Customer</th><th>Plan</th><th>Progress</th><th>Next Run</th><th>Status</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        DRIPS.map(d => {
          const pctv = d.runs ? Math.round((TSMX.num(d.completedRuns) / d.runs) * 100) : 0;
          const overdue = (d.status === 'running' || d.status === 'scheduled') && TSMX.num(d.nextRunAt) <= now;
          return '<tr><td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + esc(d.orderId || d.id) + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(d.serviceName || '') + '</div></td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + esc(d.email || String(d.uid || '').slice(0, 12)) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.int(d.totalQuantity) + ' in ' + TSMX.int(d.runs) + ' runs<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + TSMX.int(d.perRun) + ' every ' + TSMX.int(d.intervalMinutes) + ' min</div></td>' +
            '<td style="min-width:130px"><div class="bt" style="height:14px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--border-light,#f1f5f9);overflow:hidden"><div style="height:100%;width:' + pctv + '%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0ea5e9,#38bdf8)"></div></div>' +
            '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray);margin-top:3px">' + TSMX.int(d.completedRuns) + '/' + TSMX.int(d.runs) + ' runs · ' + TSMX.int(d.delivered) + ' delivered</div></td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:11px' + (overdue ? ';color:#ef4444;font-weight:700' : '') + '">' + (d.nextRunAt ? TSMX.dt(d.nextRunAt) + (overdue ? ' ⚠ due' : '') : '—') + '</td>' +
            '<td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + (d.status === 'completed' ? 'p-green' : d.status === 'paused' ? 'p-amber' : d.status === 'cancelled' ? 'p-red' : d.status === 'scheduled' ? 'p-blue' : 'p-violet') + '">' + esc(d.status) + '</span></td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
            (d.status === 'running' || d.status === 'scheduled' ? '<button class="tsmx-btn sm warn" onclick="TSMX.dfPause(\'' + esc(d.id) + '\')">⏸</button> ' : '') +
            (d.status === 'paused' ? '<button class="tsmx-btn sm ok" onclick="TSMX.dfResume(\'' + esc(d.id) + '\')">▶</button> ' : '') +
            (d.status !== 'completed' && d.status !== 'cancelled' ? '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.dfCancel(\'' + esc(d.id) + '\')">✖</button>' : '') +
            '</td></tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }));
  };

  TSMX.dfPause = id => DB().ref('drip_orders/' + id + '/status').set('paused').then(() => { TSMX.audit('drip.pause', id, id); TSMX.dfLoad(); });
  TSMX.dfResume = id => DB().ref('drip_orders/' + id).update({ status: 'running', nextRunAt: Date.now() }).then(() => { TSMX.audit('drip.resume', id, id); TSMX.dfLoad(); });
  TSMX.dfCancel = id => TSMX.confirm('Cancel this drip order?', 'Remaining runs will not be delivered. Refund the customer manually if needed.', () =>
    DB().ref('drip_orders/' + id).update({ status: 'cancelled', cancelledAt: Date.now() }).then(() => { TSMX.audit('drip.cancel', id, id); TSMX.dfLoad(); }), true);

  TSMX.dfProcess = function () {
    const now = Date.now();
    const due = DRIPS.filter(d => (d.status === 'running' || d.status === 'scheduled') && TSMX.num(d.nextRunAt) <= now);
    if (!due.length) { const s = document.getElementById('dfLoopStatus'); if (s) s.textContent = '✓ Nothing due · checked ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN'); return Promise.resolve(0); }
    let n = 0;
    return due.reduce((ch, d) => ch.then(() => {
      const runsDone = TSMX.num(d.completedRuns) + 1;
      const finished = runsDone >= TSMX.num(d.runs);
      const delivered = Math.min(TSMX.num(d.totalQuantity), TSMX.num(d.delivered) + TSMX.num(d.perRun));
      const up = {
        status: finished ? 'completed' : 'running',
        completedRuns: runsDone, delivered: delivered,
        lastRunAt: Date.now(),
        nextRunAt: finished ? null : Date.now() + TSMX.num(d.intervalMinutes, 60) * 60000
      };
      return DB().ref('drip_orders/' + d.id).update(up).then(() => {
        n++;
        const p = {};
        if (d.uid && d.orderKey) {
          p['users/' + d.uid + '/orders/' + d.orderKey + '/dripDelivered'] = delivered;
          p['users/' + d.uid + '/orders/' + d.orderKey + '/dripRunsDone'] = runsDone;
          if (finished) p['users/' + d.uid + '/orders/' + d.orderKey + '/status'] = 'completed';
          else p['users/' + d.uid + '/orders/' + d.orderKey + '/status'] = 'processing';
        }
        return Object.keys(p).length ? DB().ref().update(p) : null;
      }).then(() => DB().ref('drip_orders/' + d.id + '/log').push({ at: Date.now(), run: runsDone, qty: TSMX.num(d.perRun) }).catch(() => { }));
    }), Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
      const s = document.getElementById('dfLoopStatus'); if (s) s.textContent = '⚡ Processed ' + n + ' run(s) at ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN');
      if (n) TSMX.audit('drip.process', n + ' runs delivered');
      TSMX.dfLoad(); return n;
    });
  };

  TSMX.dfToggleLoop = function () {
    const btn = document.getElementById('dfLoopBtn');
    if (loopTimer) { clearInterval(loopTimer); loopTimer = null; btn.textContent = '▶️ Start Auto Runner'; btn.className = 'tsmx-btn'; TSMX.toast('⏹ Auto runner stopped'); return; }
    loopTimer = setInterval(() => { DB().ref('drip_orders').limitToLast(300).once('value').then(s => { DRIPS = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v)); TSMX.dfProcess(); }); }, 60000);
    btn.textContent = '⏹ Stop Auto Runner'; btn.className = 'tsmx-btn dgr';
    TSMX.toast('▶️ Auto runner started — checks every 60 seconds while this tab is open', 'success');
    TSMX.dfProcess();
  };

  </div>`;

  TSMX.hlRun = function () {
    const out = document.getElementById('hlOut'); TSMX.loading(out, 'Running diagnostics…');
    const checks = [];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    Promise.all([
      DB().ref('.info/connected').once('value').then(s => checks.push(['Database connection', s.val() === true, s.val() === true ? 'Connected' : 'Disconnected'])).catch(e => checks.push(['Database connection', false, e.message])),
      DB().ref('admins').once('value').then(s => { const n = Object.keys(s.val() || {}).length; checks.push(['Admin accounts configured', n > 0, n + ' admin(s) registered']); }).catch(e => checks.push(['Admin accounts configured', false, e.message])),
      DB().ref('admin_settings/referral/commission_percent').once('value').then(s => checks.push(['Referral commission set', s.val() != null, s.val() != null ? s.val() + '% (live)' : 'Missing — user panel falls back to 5%'])).catch(() => { }),
      DB().ref('settings/maintenance').once('value').then(s => { const v = s.val() || {}; checks.push(['Maintenance mode', v.enabled !== true, v.enabled ? '⚠️ MAINTENANCE IS ON — users are blocked' : 'Off (normal operation)']); }).catch(() => { }),
      DB().ref('settings/paymentMethods').once('value').then(s => { const n = Object.values(s.val() || {}).filter(m => m && m.enabled !== false).length; checks.push(['Active payment methods', n > 0, n + ' method(s) enabled']); }).catch(() => { }),
      DB().ref('services').once('value').then(s => {
        let sv = 0, pk = 0, noCost = 0;
        s.forEach(x => { sv++; const p = (x.val() || {}).packages || {}; Object.values(p).forEach(q => { pk++; if (q.costPerK == null && q.costPrice == null && q.marginPercent == null) noCost++; }); });
        checks.push(['Services & packages', sv > 0 && pk > 0, sv + ' services · ' + pk + ' packages']);
        checks.push(['Packages with cost price', noCost === 0, noCost ? noCost + ' package(s) have no cost — profit reporting will estimate' : 'All packages have cost data']);
      }).catch(() => { }),
      DB().ref('settings/apiSettings').once('value').then(s => { const v = s.val() || {}; checks.push(['Reseller API', true, v.enabled ? 'Enabled · ' + (v.endpointUrl || 'default endpoint') : 'Disabled']); }).catch(() => { }),
      DB().ref('email_config').once('value').then(s => { const v = s.val() || {}; checks.push(['Email (EmailJS)', !!v.isActive, v.isActive ? 'Configured & active' : 'Not configured — welcome emails will not send']); }).catch(() => { })
    ]).then(() => {
      const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
      const ok = checks.filter(c => c[1]).length;
      document.getElementById('hlKpis').innerHTML =
        '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:#10b981"><div class="k-l">Checks Passed</div><div class="k-v">' + ok + ' / ' + checks.length + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:#0ea5e9"><div class="k-l">Round Trip</div><div class="k-v">' + ms + ' ms</div><div class="k-s">database latency</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + (TSMX.errors.length ? '#ef4444' : '#64748b') + '"><div class="k-l">Caught JS Errors</div><div class="k-v">' + TSMX.errors.length + '</div><div class="k-s">this session</div></div>';
      out.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th style="width:70px">Result</th><th>Check</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        checks.map(c => '<tr><td><span class="tsmx-pill ' + (c[1] ? 'p-green' : 'p-amber') + '">' + (c[1] ? '✅ OK' : '⚠️ Look') + '</span></td>' +
          '<td style="font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px">' + esc(c[0]) + '</td><td style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(c[2]) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    });
  };

  TSMX.hlErrors = function () {

        '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(e.msg) + '</td><td style="font-size:10.5px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(e.src) + '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  };

    TSMX.modal({

  TSMX.onReady(function () {

    TSMX.registerPage({ id: 'tsmxHealthPage', title: 'System Health', html: HEALTH_HTML, group: 'security', icon: '🩺', label: 'System Health', onEnter: TSMX.hlRun });
    ['dfMinRuns', 'dfMinInt'].forEach(i => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.addEventListener('input', paintExample); });
  });

/* ---------- 09-hooks.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v26 ADMIN · PART 9 — HOOKS & BOOT
   Wraps the panel's existing functions (without editing them) so that:
     • new pages get their onEnter callback from navigatePage
     • every balance movement writes a Wallet Statement entry
     • referral commission obeys the new admin rules (wallet credit only)
     • lazy rendering keeps the shell fast
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const wrap = (name, factory) => { const o = window[name]; if (typeof o !== 'function') return false; window[name] = factory(o); return true; };

  /* ---------- 1. navigatePage → run onEnter, set title, gate by role ---------- */
  function tsmxNav(pageId, orig) {
    const page = TSMX.pages[pageId];
    if (page) {
      const t = document.getElementById('pageTitle');
      document.querySelectorAll('.page-content').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      const el = document.getElementById(pageId);
      if (el) el.classList.add('active');
      if (t) t.textContent = page.title || pageId;
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
      const nav = document.querySelector('.sidebar .nav-item[onclick*="\'' + pageId + '\'"]');
      if (nav) { nav.classList.add('active'); try { expandSidebarParentForItem(nav); } catch (e) { } }
      try { if (window.innerWidth <= 992 && window.toggleMobileMenu) document.querySelector('.sidebar').classList.remove('active'); } catch (e) { }
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      if (page.onEnter) { try { page.onEnter(); } catch (e) { console.error('[TSMX onEnter]', pageId, e); } }
      return true;
    }
    if (orig) return orig.apply(window, [pageId]);
    console.warn('[TSMX] unknown page:', pageId);
    return false;
  }
  if (!wrap('navigatePage', orig => function (pageId) { return tsmxNav(pageId, orig); })) {
    window.navigatePage = function (pageId) { return tsmxNav(pageId, null); };
  }

  /* ---------- 2. Wallet statement on every admin balance change ---------- */
  wrap('updateUserBalance', orig => async function () {
    const uid = window.currentEditUserId || window.editingUserId || null;
    let before = null;
    if (uid) { try { before = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val()); } catch (e) { } }
    const out = await orig.apply(this, arguments);
    if (uid && before !== null) {
      try {
        const after = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val());
        const d = Math.round((after - before) * 10000) / 10000;
        if (d !== 0) TSMX.ledger.write(uid, {
          type: d > 0 ? 'admin_add' : 'admin_sub', amount: Math.abs(d),
          balanceBefore: before, balanceAfter: after,
          note: 'Manual balance edit from admin panel',
          by: TSMX.adminEmail()
        });
        TSMX.audit('user.balance', (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + TSMX.money(d) + ' (' + TSMX.money(before) + ' → ' + TSMX.money(after) + ')', uid);
      } catch (e) { }
    }
    return out;
  });

  /* ---------- 3. Fund approve / reject → statement ---------- */
  function fundHook(fnName, type, note) {
    wrap(fnName, orig => async function (requestId, userId, amount) {
      const out = await orig.apply(this, arguments);
      try {
        const uid = userId || arguments[1];
        const amt = TSMX.num(amount != null ? amount : arguments[2]);
        if (uid && amt) {
          const after = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val());
          TSMX.ledger.write(uid, { type: type, amount: Math.abs(amt), balanceAfter: after, note: note, ref: requestId, by: TSMX.adminEmail() });
          TSMX.audit('fund.' + (type === 'fund' ? 'approve' : 'reverse'), TSMX.money(amt), uid);
        }
      } catch (e) { }
      return out;
    });
  }
  fundHook('approveFundRequest', 'fund', 'Deposit approved by admin');
  fundHook('revertFundRequestToPending', 'fund_reverse', 'Approved deposit reverted to pending');

  /* ---------- 4. Order refund / reject → statement ---------- */
  wrap('rejectOrder', orig => async function (orderId, userId) {
    const uid = userId || arguments[1];
    let before = null;
    if (uid) { try { before = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val()); } catch (e) { } }
    const out = await orig.apply(this, arguments);
    if (uid && before !== null) {
      try {
        const after = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val());
        const d = Math.round((after - before) * 10000) / 10000;
        if (d > 0) TSMX.ledger.write(uid, { type: 'order_refund', amount: d, balanceBefore: before, balanceAfter: after, note: 'Order rejected — amount refunded', ref: orderId, by: TSMX.adminEmail() });
        TSMX.audit('order.reject', 'refund ' + TSMX.money(d), orderId);
      } catch (e) { }
    }
    return out;
  });

  wrap('approveCancelRequest', orig => async function (orderId, userId) {
    const uid = userId || arguments[1];
    let before = null;
    if (uid) { try { before = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val()); } catch (e) { } }
    const out = await orig.apply(this, arguments);
    if (uid && before !== null) {
      try {
        const after = TSMX.num((await DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/balance').once('value')).val());
        const d = Math.round((after - before) * 10000) / 10000;
        if (d > 0) TSMX.ledger.write(uid, { type: 'order_refund', amount: d, balanceBefore: before, balanceAfter: after, note: 'Cancellation approved — amount refunded', ref: orderId, by: 'admin' });
        TSMX.audit('order.cancel.approve', TSMX.money(d), orderId);
      } catch (e) { }
    }
    return out;
  });

  /* ---------- 5. Referral commission → obey admin rules + statement ---------- */
  wrap('standaloneReferral', orig => async function (uid, orderId, order, status) {
    let cfg = {};
    try { cfg = (await DB().ref('admin_settings/referral').once('value')).val() || {}; } catch (e) { }
    if (cfg.enabled === false) return;

    const creditOn = cfg.credit_on_status || 'completed';
    const stateRef = DB().ref('referral_commission_state/' + orderId);
    const state = (await stateRef.once('value')).val();

    if (status === creditOn && (!state || state.status !== 'credited')) {
      const profile = (await DB().ref('users/' + uid).once('value')).val() || {};
      const rid = profile.referrer_user_id;
      if (!rid) return;
      if (cfg.self_referral_block !== false && rid === uid) return;

      const amountBase = TSMX.num(order && order.amount);
      if (TSMX.num(cfg.min_order_amount) > 0 && amountBase < TSMX.num(cfg.min_order_amount)) return;

      if (cfg.first_order_only === true) {
        const prev = (await DB().ref('referral_commissions').orderByChild('referee_user_id').equalTo(uid).limitToFirst(1).once('value')).val();
        if (prev && Object.keys(prev).length) return;
      }

      const pct = TSMX.num(cfg.commission_percent, 5);
      let amount = Math.round(amountBase * pct) / 100;
      const cap = TSMX.num(cfg.max_commission_per_order);
      if (cap > 0 && amount > cap) amount = cap;
      if (!(amount > 0)) return;

      let won = false;
      const c = await stateRef.transaction(v => { if (v && v.status === 'credited') return; won = true; return { status: 'processing', at: Date.now() }; });
      if (!(c.committed && won)) return;

      // credit straight into WALLET BALANCE — never withdrawable
      const after = await TSMX.ledger.apply(rid, amount, {
        type: 'referral', note: 'Referral commission ' + pct + '% — added to your wallet balance (usable for orders)',
        ref: orderId, by: 'system'
      });
      await stateRef.set({ status: 'credited', referrerUid: rid, amount: amount, creditedAt: Date.now(), percent: pct, payout: 'wallet_balance_only' });
      await DB().ref('referral_commissions/' + orderId).set({
        referrer_user_id: rid, referee_user_id: uid, order_id: orderId,
        commission_amount: amount, commission_percent: pct, status: 'completed',
        payout_mode: 'wallet_balance_only', created_at: Date.now()
      });
      DB().ref('notifications').push({
        user_id: rid, type: 'success', title: '🤝 Referral Commission Earned',
        message: TSMX.money(amount) + ' has been added to your wallet balance from a referral order. Your new balance is ' + TSMX.money(after) + ' — use it to place orders right away.',
        read: false, timestamp: Date.now()
      }).catch(() => { });
      return;
    }

    // reversal
    if (cfg.reverse_on_refund !== false && order && order.status === creditOn && status !== creditOn && state && state.status === 'credited') {
      await TSMX.ledger.apply(state.referrerUid, -TSMX.num(state.amount), {
        type: 'referral_reverse', note: 'Referral commission reversed — the referred order was cancelled or refunded', ref: orderId, by: 'system'
      }).catch(() => { });
      await stateRef.update({ status: 'reversed', reversedAt: Date.now() });
      await DB().ref('referral_commissions/' + orderId).update({ status: 'reversed', reversed_at: Date.now() });
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 6. audit trail on the remaining destructive actions ---------- */
  [['deleteUser', 'user.delete'], ['deleteOrder', 'order.delete'], ['deleteFundRequest', 'fund.delete'],
  ['deleteService', 'service.delete'], ['deletePackage', 'package.delete'], ['deletePlan', 'plan.delete'],
  ['deletePaymentMethod', 'payment.delete'], ['deletePanelOrder', 'panelorder.delete'],
  ['saveMaintenanceSettings', 'maintenance.save'], ['savePaymentMethod', 'payment.save'],
  ['saveCurrencyRates', 'currency.save'], ['saveApiSettings', 'api.save'],
  ['updateOrderStatus', 'order.status'], ['runLegacyMigration', 'migration.run'],
  ['activateFirebaseProject', 'firebase.activate']
  ].forEach(([fn, action]) => wrap(fn, orig => function () {
    try { TSMX.audit(action, Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 0, 3).map(x => String(x).slice(0, 40)).join(' · ')); } catch (e) { }
    return orig.apply(this, arguments);
  }));

  /* ---------- 7. keep the legacy email allow-list working as a super-admin seed ---------- */
  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    // sidebar search should also find the new pages
    try { if (window.filterAdminSidebar) filterAdminSidebar(''); } catch (e) { }
    TSMX.applyRoleVisibility();
  });

  /* ---------- 8. boot ---------- */
  let tries = 0;
  function start() {
    const ready = (function () { try { return !!(TSMX.db() && TSMX.authObj()); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
    if (!ready) { if (++tries < 150) return setTimeout(start, 120); console.warn('[TSMX] booting without a database handle'); }
    TSMX.installAuthGate();
    // if the original observer already let someone in, resolve their role too
    const cu = TSMX.authUser(); if (cu) TSMX.resolveAdmin(cu).then(() => TSMX.boot());
    // boot the UI layer even before login so pages exist
    setTimeout(() => TSMX.boot(), 800);

    // 11 — performance: defer the heaviest legacy renderers until their page is opened
    ['loadColorAdjustAdmin', 'loadTextAdjustAdmin'].forEach(fn => wrap(fn, orig => function () {
      const el = document.getElementById(fn === 'loadColorAdjustAdmin' ? 'colorAdjustPage' : 'textAdjustPage');
      if (el && !el.classList.contains('active') && !window._tsmxForceHeavy) return;
      return orig.apply(this, arguments);
    }));
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();

  console.log('%c TSMX admin hooks installed ', 'background:#10b981;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 10-live-bridge.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v27 ADMIN · PART 10 — LIVE BRIDGE & AUDIT FIXES
   Fixes found by the admin↔user cross-audit:
     • admin_contact   — user panel read it LIVE but admin had NO editor
     • blocked_users   — user panel hard-blocks login on it, admin had no UI
     • refill wait     — was hard-coded 24h in the user panel
     • service icon    — admin field existed but user panel ignored it
     • package order   — admin drag&drop was ignored by the New Order dropdown
     • FILTER TABS on Users + All Signup Users (live)
     • Live Link Checker — verifies every admin→user binding at runtime
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  /* ══════════════ 1. FILTER TABS — Users & All Signup Users ══════════════ */
  const TAB_CSS = `
  .tsmx-ftabs{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 14px;padding-bottom:2px}
  .tsmx-ftab{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:2px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);background:var(--card-bg,#fff);
    font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-secondary,#475569);transition:.15s;font-family:inherit;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .tsmx-ftab:hover{border-color:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9)}
  .tsmx-ftab.on{background:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9);color:#fff;border-color:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9)}
  .tsmx-ftab .cnt{background:rgba(0,0,0,.09);padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
  .tsmx-ftab.on .cnt{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
  .tsmx-fbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:13px;padding:12px;background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc);border:1px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:13px}
  .tsmx-fbar .fld{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .tsmx-fbar label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b)}
  .tsmx-live-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#10b981;margin-right:5px;animation:tsmxPulse 1.7s infinite}
  @keyframes tsmxPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
  body.admin-theme-dark .tsmx-fbar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
  `;
  const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = TAB_CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);

  /** shared predicate engine used by both user pages */
  const NOW = () => Date.now();
  const FILTERS = {
    all: { label: '👥 All', fn: () => true },
    active: { label: '✅ Active', fn: u => (u.status || 'active') === 'active' },
    suspended: { label: '⏸️ Suspended', fn: u => u.status === 'suspended' },
    banned: { label: '⛔ Banned', fn: u => u.status === 'banned' || u.blocked === true },
    buyers: { label: '🛒 Has Ordered', fn: u => TSMX.num(u.totalOrders || u.orders) > 0 },
    never: { label: '🆕 Never Ordered', fn: u => !TSMX.num(u.totalOrders || u.orders) },
    balance: { label: '💰 Has Balance', fn: u => TSMX.num(u.balance) > 0 },
    zero: { label: '🪙 Zero Balance', fn: u => TSMX.num(u.balance) <= 0 },
    spender: { label: '👑 Spent ₹1000+', fn: u => TSMX.num(u.spent) >= 1000 },
    today: { label: '📅 Joined Today', fn: u => { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); return TSMX.num(u.createdAt) >= d.getTime(); } },
    week: { label: '🗓️ Last 7 Days', fn: u => NOW() - TSMX.num(u.createdAt) < 7 * 864e5 && TSMX.num(u.createdAt) > 0 },
    month: { label: '📆 Last 30 Days', fn: u => NOW() - TSMX.num(u.createdAt) < 30 * 864e5 && TSMX.num(u.createdAt) > 0 },
    google: { label: '🔵 Google Login', fn: u => /google/i.test(u.loginMethod || u.provider || '') },
    email: { label: '✉️ Email Login', fn: u => !/google/i.test(u.loginMethod || u.provider || '') },
    nomail: { label: '⚠️ No Email', fn: u => !u.email }
  };
  const TAB_SETS = {
    usersPage: ['all', 'active', 'suspended', 'banned', 'buyers', 'never', 'balance', 'zero', 'spender', 'week', 'month'],
    allSignupUsersPage: ['all', 'active', 'suspended', 'banned', 'today', 'week', 'month', 'buyers', 'never', 'balance', 'google', 'email', 'nomail']
  };

  const state = { usersPage: { tab: 'all', sort: 'new', min: '', max: '' }, allSignupUsersPage: { tab: 'all', sort: 'new', min: '', max: '' } };
  const statusMap = {};      // uid -> {status, blocked}
  let statusWatching = false;

  function watchStatuses() {
    if (statusWatching) return; statusWatching = true;
    DB().ref('users').on('value', s => {
      s.forEach(c => { const v = c.val() || {}; statusMap[c.key] = { status: v.status || 'active', balance: TSMX.num(v.balance), spent: TSMX.num(v.spent), orders: Object.keys(v.orders || {}).length }; });
      reapply('usersPage'); reapply('allSignupUsersPage');
    }, e => console.warn('[TSMX status watch]', e.message));
    DB().ref('blocked_users').on('value', s => {
      const b = s.val() || {};
      Object.keys(statusMap).forEach(k => { statusMap[k] = statusMap[k] || {}; statusMap[k].blocked = !!b[k]; });
      Object.keys(b).forEach(k => { statusMap[k] = statusMap[k] || {}; statusMap[k].blocked = true; });
      reapply('usersPage'); reapply('allSignupUsersPage');
    }, () => { });
  }

  function enrich(u) {
    const s = statusMap[u.uid] || {};
    return Object.assign({}, u, {
      status: s.status || u.status || 'active',
      blocked: !!s.blocked,
      balance: u.balance != null ? u.balance : s.balance,
      spent: u.spent != null ? u.spent : s.spent,
      totalOrders: u.totalOrders != null ? u.totalOrders : (u.orders != null ? u.orders : s.orders)
    });
  }

  function buildBar(pageId, onChange) {
    const page = document.getElementById(pageId); if (!page) return null;
    if (document.getElementById('tsmxFB_' + pageId)) return document.getElementById('tsmxFB_' + pageId);
    const host = page.querySelector('.card'); if (!host) return null;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'tsmxFB_' + pageId;
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="tsmx-fbar">' +
      '<div class="fld"><label><span class="tsmx-live-dot"></span>Live Filters</label>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-ftabs" id="tsmxTabs_' + pageId + '"></div></div></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-fbar">' +
      '<div class="fld"><label>Sort by</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxSort_' + pageId + '">' +
      '<option value="new">🆕 Newest first</option><option value="old">📜 Oldest first</option>' +
      '<option value="balance">💰 Highest balance</option><option value="spent">👑 Top spender</option>' +
      '<option value="orders">📋 Most orders</option><option value="az">🔤 Name A→Z</option></select></div>' +
      '<div class="fld"><label>Balance min ₹</label><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" id="tsmxMin_' + pageId + '" style="width:110px" placeholder="any"></div>' +
      '<div class="fld"><label>Balance max ₹</label><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" id="tsmxMax_' + pageId + '" style="width:110px" placeholder="any"></div>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" id="tsmxClr_' + pageId + '">✖ Clear</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" id="tsmxExp_' + pageId + '">📥 Export Filtered</button>' +
      '<div style="flex:1"></div>' +
      '<div style="align-self:center;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary)" id="tsmxCount_' + pageId + '"></div>' +
      '</div>';
    // insert right after the page's title / existing filter-bar
    const anchor = host.querySelector('.filter-bar') || host.querySelector('.stats-grid') || host.querySelector('.card-title');
    if (anchor && anchor.parentNode === host) host.insertBefore(box, anchor.nextSibling);
    else host.insertBefore(box, host.firstChild);

    const tabs = box.querySelector('#tsmxTabs_' + pageId);
    TAB_SETS[pageId].forEach(k => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'tsmx-ftab' + (state[pageId].tab === k ? ' on' : '');
      b.dataset.k = k;
      b.innerHTML = FILTERS[k].label + ' <span class="cnt" data-c="' + k + '">0</span>';
      b.onclick = () => { state[pageId].tab = k; tabs.querySelectorAll('.tsmx-ftab').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.k === k)); onChange(); };
      tabs.appendChild(b);
    });
    box.querySelector('#tsmxSort_' + pageId).onchange = e => { state[pageId].sort = e.target.value; onChange(); };
    box.querySelector('#tsmxMin_' + pageId).oninput = TSMX.debounce(e => { state[pageId].min = e.target.value; onChange(); }, 320);
    box.querySelector('#tsmxMax_' + pageId).oninput = TSMX.debounce(e => { state[pageId].max = e.target.value; onChange(); }, 320);
    box.querySelector('#tsmxClr_' + pageId).onclick = () => {
      state[pageId] = { tab: 'all', sort: 'new', min: '', max: '' };
      box.querySelector('#tsmxSort_' + pageId).value = 'new';
      box.querySelector('#tsmxMin_' + pageId).value = ''; box.querySelector('#tsmxMax_' + pageId).value = '';
      tabs.querySelectorAll('.tsmx-ftab').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.k === 'all'));
      const sb = document.getElementById(pageId === 'usersPage' ? 'searchUsers' : 'searchAllSignupUsers');
      if (sb) { sb.value = ''; try { pageId === 'usersPage' ? filterUsers() : filterAllSignupUsers(); } catch (e) { } }
      onChange();
    };
    box.querySelector('#tsmxExp_' + pageId).onclick = () => exportFiltered(pageId);
    return box;
  }

  function apply(pageId, list) {
    const s = state[pageId];
    const rows = (list || []).map(enrich);
    // live counts on every tab
    TAB_SETS[pageId].forEach(k => {
      const el = document.querySelector('#tsmxTabs_' + pageId + ' [data-c="' + k + '"]');
      if (el) el.textContent = TSMX.int(rows.filter(FILTERS[k].fn).length);
    });
    let out = rows.filter(FILTERS[s.tab].fn);
    if (s.min !== '') out = out.filter(u => TSMX.num(u.balance) >= TSMX.num(s.min));
    if (s.max !== '') out = out.filter(u => TSMX.num(u.balance) <= TSMX.num(s.max));
    const S = {
      new: (a, b) => TSMX.num(b.createdAt) - TSMX.num(a.createdAt),
      old: (a, b) => TSMX.num(a.createdAt) - TSMX.num(b.createdAt),
      balance: (a, b) => TSMX.num(b.balance) - TSMX.num(a.balance),
      spent: (a, b) => TSMX.num(b.spent) - TSMX.num(a.spent),
      orders: (a, b) => TSMX.num(b.totalOrders) - TSMX.num(a.totalOrders),
      az: (a, b) => String(a.name || a.email || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || b.email || ''))
    };
    out.sort(S[s.sort] || S.new);
    const c = document.getElementById('tsmxCount_' + pageId);
    if (c) c.innerHTML = 'Showing <b>' + TSMX.int(out.length) + '</b> of ' + TSMX.int(rows.length) + ' · <span style="color:#10b981">live</span>';
    TSMX['_filtered_' + pageId] = out;
    return out;
  }

  function exportFiltered(pageId) {
    const list = TSMX['_filtered_' + pageId] || [];
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.toast('Nothing to export', 'error');
    TSMX.csv((pageId === 'usersPage' ? 'users' : 'signup_users') + '_' + state[pageId].tab + '_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
      [['UID', 'Name', 'Email', 'Phone', 'Status', 'Blocked', 'Balance', 'Spent', 'Orders', 'Login Method', 'Joined']].concat(
        list.map(u => [u.uid, u.name || '', u.email || '', u.phone || '', u.status, u.blocked ? 'YES' : '', TSMX.num(u.balance), TSMX.num(u.spent), TSMX.num(u.totalOrders), u.loginMethod || '', TSMX.dt(u.createdAt)])));
    TSMX.audit('users.export.filtered', pageId + ' · ' + state[pageId].tab + ' · ' + list.length + ' rows');
  }

  function reapply(pageId) {
    const el = document.getElementById(pageId);
    if (!el || !el.classList.contains('active')) return;
    try { pageId === 'usersPage' ? window.refreshUsers && refreshUsers() : window.filterAllSignupUsers && filterAllSignupUsers(); } catch (e) { }
  }

  /* wrap the two renderers so our filter runs on the live data every time */
  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };

  wrap('displayUsers', orig => function (users) {
    buildBar('usersPage', () => { try { displayUsers(window._tsmxLastUsers || users); } catch (e) { } });
    window._tsmxLastUsers = users;
    watchStatuses();
    const filtered = apply('usersPage', users || []);
    const out = orig.call(this, filtered);
    paintStatusColumn('usersTableBody', filtered);
    return out;
  });

  wrap('displayAllSignupUsers', orig => function () {
    buildBar('allSignupUsersPage', () => { try { displayAllSignupUsers(); } catch (e) { } });
    watchStatuses();
    const src = window._tsmxSignupSource || TSMX.G('filteredSignupUsers') || [];
    if (!window._tsmxSignupSource) window._tsmxSignupSource = (TSMX.G('filteredSignupUsers') || []).slice();
    const filtered = apply('allSignupUsersPage', window._tsmxSignupSource);
    TSMX.S('filteredSignupUsers', filtered);
    let out;
    try { out = orig.apply(this, arguments); } finally { /* keep filtered so pagination matches */ }
    paintStatusColumn('allSignupUsersContainer', filtered);
    return out;
  });

  // whenever the panel's own search recalculates filteredSignupUsers, refresh our source
  wrap('filterAllSignupUsers', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    window._tsmxSignupSource = (TSMX.G('filteredSignupUsers') || []).slice();
    try { displayAllSignupUsers(); } catch (e) { }
    return r;
  });
  wrap('rebuildAllSignupUsers', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => { window._tsmxSignupSource = (TSMX.G('filteredSignupUsers') || []).slice(); }, 60);
    return r;
  });

  /** add a small live status chip into the first cell of each rendered row */
  function paintStatusColumn(containerId, list) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const host = document.getElementById(containerId); if (!host) return;
      const rows = host.querySelectorAll('tr');
      let i = 0;
      rows.forEach(tr => {
        if (!tr.querySelector('td')) return;
        const u = list[i++]; if (!u) return;
        if (tr.querySelector('.tsmx-ustatus')) return;
        const s = u.blocked ? { t: '⛔ BLOCKED', c: 'p-red' } :
          u.status === 'banned' ? { t: '⛔ Banned', c: 'p-red' } :
            u.status === 'suspended' ? { t: '⏸️ Suspended', c: 'p-amber' } : null;
        if (!s) return;
        const cell = tr.querySelector('td');
        const sp = document.createElement('div');
        sp.className = 'tsmx-pill ' + s.c + ' tsmx-ustatus';
        sp.style.marginTop = '4px'; sp.textContent = s.t;
        cell.appendChild(sp);
      });
    }, 40);
  }

  /* defensive: build the bar the moment either page is opened, even if the
     panel's renderer has not run yet (e.g. first visit before data loads)  */
  const _origNav = window.navigatePage;
  function ensureBars(pageId) {
    if (pageId === 'usersPage') { buildBar('usersPage', () => { try { displayUsers(window._tsmxLastUsers || TSMX.G('allUsers') || []); } catch (e) { } }); watchStatuses(); }
    if (pageId === 'allSignupUsersPage') { buildBar('allSignupUsersPage', () => { try { displayAllSignupUsers(); } catch (e) { } }); watchStatuses(); }
  }
  if (typeof _origNav === 'function') {
    window.navigatePage = function (pageId) { const r = _origNav.apply(this, arguments); try { ensureBars(pageId); } catch (e) { } return r; };
  }
  TSMX.ensureUserFilterBars = ensureBars;

  /* ══════════════ 2. BAN must also write blocked_users (hard login block) ══════════════ */
  const origStatusApply = TSMX._applyStatusHook;
  TSMX.syncBlockedUsers = function (uids, status) {
    const up = {};
    uids.forEach(uid => { up['blocked_users/' + uid] = (status === 'banned') ? { at: Date.now(), by: TSMX.adminEmail() } : null; });
    return DB().ref().update(up);
  };

  /* ══════════════ 3. LIVE BRIDGE PAGE ══════════════ */
  const BRIDGE_HTML = `
  <div class="card">

    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      These controls existed in the <b>user panel</b> but had <b>no admin editor</b> — so they always showed

Until now the user panel ignored it and only showed the logo badge. Turn this on to display it next to the service name in the New Order dropdown and the Services catalog.</span></span></label>

    <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.runLinkCheck()">🔎 Check All Links</button>
    <div id="lcOut" style="margin-top:14px"></div>
