  TSMX.loadBridge = function () {
    Promise.all([
      DB().ref('admin_contact').once('value'),
      DB().ref('settings/refill').once('value'),
      DB().ref('settings/serviceDisplay').once('value')
    ]).then(([c, r, s]) => {
      const cv = c.val() || {}, rv = r.val() || {}, sv = s.val() || {};
      const set = (i, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.value = v == null ? '' : v; };
      set('acEmail', cv.email || ''); set('acWhats', cv.whatsapp || ''); set('acTg', cv.telegram || '');
      set('rfWait', TSMX.num(rv.waitHours, 24)); set('rfWindow', TSMX.num(rv.windowDays, 0)); set('rfMax', TSMX.num(rv.maxPerOrder, 0));
      const a = document.getElementById('svShowIcon'); if (a) a.checked = sv.showIcon === true;
      const b = document.getElementById('svLivePkg'); if (b) b.checked = sv.livePackages !== false;
      const g = document.getElementById('svGuard'); if (g) g.checked = sv.guardDisabled !== false;
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Load failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.saveContact = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('settings')) return;
    const p = {
      email: document.getElementById('acEmail').value.trim(),
      whatsapp: document.getElementById('acWhats').value.trim(),
      telegram: document.getElementById('acTg').value.trim(),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('admin_contact').update(p).then(() => {
      document.getElementById('acStatus').textContent = '✅ Live on the user panel';
      TSMX.audit('contact.save', p.email + ' · ' + p.whatsapp);
      TSMX.toast('✅ Contact details are now live', 'success');
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.saveRefillRules = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('settings')) return;
    const p = {
      waitHours: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfWait').value, 24)),
      windowDays: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfWindow').value, 0)),
      maxPerOrder: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rfMax').value, 0)),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/refill').update(p).then(() => {
      document.getElementById('rfrStatus').textContent = '✅ Live — user Refill buttons updated';
      TSMX.audit('refill.rules', p.waitHours + 'h wait · window ' + p.windowDays + 'd · max ' + p.maxPerOrder);
      TSMX.toast('✅ Refill rules are now live', 'success');
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.saveServiceDisplay = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('services')) return;
    const p = {
      showIcon: document.getElementById('svShowIcon').checked,
      livePackages: document.getElementById('svLivePkg').checked,
      guardDisabled: document.getElementById('svGuard').checked,
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/serviceDisplay').update(p).then(() => {
      document.getElementById('svStatus').textContent = '✅ Live';
      TSMX.audit('service.display', JSON.stringify(p));
      TSMX.toast('✅ Service display settings are live', 'success');
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  /* ---------- Live Link Checker ---------- */
  const LINKS = [
    ['Panel name / logo / brand sizes', 'settings/panelName', 'Header, landing, footer'],
    ['Top scrolling banner (text/speed/colour/on)', 'settings/topBanner', 'Top banner'],
    ['Latest news', 'settings/latestNews', 'Dashboard news card'],
    ['Header & footer colours', 'settings/headerColor', 'Header + bottom nav'],
    ['Tutorial / fund / password videos', 'settings/tutorialVideo', 'Video thumbnails'],
    ['Maintenance switches (16)', 'settings/maintenance', 'Every gated feature'],
    ['New Order control', 'settings/newOrderControl', 'New Order form labels'],
    ['Mass Order control', 'settings/massOrder', 'Mass Order tab'],
    ['Order Success popup', 'settings/orderSuccessPopup', 'After placing an order'],
    ['Order count boost', 'settings/orderBoost', 'Dashboard order counter'],
    ['Pending→Processing automation', 'settings/autoOrderProcessing', 'Order status'],
    ['Payment methods + bonus tiers', 'settings/paymentMethods', 'Add Funds page'],
    ['Currency rates', 'settings/currency/rates', 'All prices'],
    ['Terms & Conditions', 'settings/termsAndConditions', 'Terms page'],
    ['Important Rules', 'settings/importantRules', 'Rules page'],
    ['Ticket subjects / types / FAQ / on-off', 'settings/ticketSubjects', 'Support page'],
    ['Reseller API settings', 'settings/apiSettings', 'API page'],
    ['Colour Adjust (66 fields)', 'settings/colorAdjust', 'Every page colour'],
    ['Text Adjust (529 strings)', 'settings/textAdjust/values', 'Every visible label'],
    ['Festival campaigns ×3', 'settings/festival', 'Festival FX + popups'],
    ['Services & packages', 'services', 'New Order + catalog'],
    ['Buy Panel content', 'buyPanelContent', 'Buy Own Panel page'],
    ['Panel plans', 'panel_plans', 'Buy Panel plan list'],
    ['Referral program rules', 'admin_settings/referral', 'Referral page', 'v26'],
    ['Coupons', 'coupons', 'Order + Add Funds coupon box', 'v26'],
    ['Broadcasts', 'broadcasts', 'In-app announcement banner', 'v26'],
    ['Drip-feed settings', 'settings/dripFeed', 'New Order drip panel', 'v26'],
    ['Contact details', 'admin_contact', 'Buy Panel contact block', 'v27'],
    ['Refill rules', 'settings/refill', 'Refill buttons', 'v27'],
    ['Service display options', 'settings/serviceDisplay', 'Service dropdown / catalog', 'v27'],
    ['Blocked users (hard login block)', 'blocked_users', 'Login gate', 'v27'],
    ['User account status', 'users/*/status', 'Suspended bar / ban lock', 'v26']
  ];

  TSMX.runLinkCheck = function () {
    const out = document.getElementById('lcOut');
    TSMX.loading(out, 'Checking every admin → user binding…');
    const jobs = LINKS.map(l => {
      const p = l[1].replace('/*/', '/'); // sample path
      const path = l[1].indexOf('*') >= 0 ? l[1].split('/*')[0] : l[1];
      return DB().ref(path).limitToFirst ? DB().ref(path).once('value').then(s => ({ l: l, exists: s.exists(), n: s.exists() && typeof s.val() === 'object' ? Object.keys(s.val()).length : (s.exists() ? 1 : 0) })).catch(e => ({ l: l, err: e.message }))
        : Promise.resolve({ l: l, exists: false });
    });
    Promise.all(jobs).then(res => {
      const ok = res.filter(r => r.exists).length;
      out.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note ' + (ok === res.length ? 'n-ok' : 'n-warn') + '"><b>' + ok + ' of ' + res.length + '</b> admin controls have live data in the database and are being read by the user panel.' +
        (ok < res.length ? ' The greyed rows simply have no value saved yet — save that section once and it goes live.' : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Admin Control</th><th>Database Node</th><th>Shows In User Panel</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        res.map(r => '<tr><td style="font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px">' + esc(r.l[0]) + (r.l[3] ? ' <span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">' + r.l[3] + '</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(r.l[1]) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(r.l[2]) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (r.err ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">⚠ ' + esc(r.err.slice(0, 30)) + '</span>' :
            r.exists ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">🟢 LIVE' + (r.n > 1 ? ' · ' + r.n : '') + '</span>' :
              '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">◌ not set yet</span>') + '</td></tr>').join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div>';
    });
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxBridgePage', title: 'User Panel Live Links', html: BRIDGE_HTML,
      group: 'security', icon: '🔗', label: 'Live Links & Contact',
      onEnter: () => { TSMX.loadBridge(); TSMX.runLinkCheck(); }
    });
    // seed the nodes so nothing is "dead" on day one
    DB().ref('admin_contact').once('value').then(s => {
      if (!s.exists()) DB().ref('admin_contact').set({ email: '', whatsapp: '', telegram: '', seeded: true, updatedAt: Date.now() }).catch(() => { });
    }).catch(() => { });
    DB().ref('settings/refill').once('value').then(s => {
      if (!s.exists()) DB().ref('settings/refill').set({ waitHours: 24, windowDays: 0, maxPerOrder: 0, seeded: true }).catch(() => { });
    }).catch(() => { });
    DB().ref('settings/serviceDisplay').once('value').then(s => {
      if (!s.exists()) DB().ref('settings/serviceDisplay').set({ showIcon: false, livePackages: true, guardDisabled: true, seeded: true }).catch(() => { });
    }).catch(() => { });
  });
})();


/* ---------- 11-audit-fixes.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v27 ADMIN · PART 11 — AUDIT CORRECTIONS
   Fixes real field-name mismatches found by the cross-audit:
     • order amount is stored as `amount` (not charge/cost) → money showed ₹0
     • package cost is `basePricePerK` + marginType/marginValue
       (NOT costPerK) → profit report was estimating instead of exact
     • fund request uses `method` + `createdAt`
     • ban now also writes blocked_users/{uid} (hard login block)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  /* ---------- ban → blocked_users hard gate (shared helper) ---------- */
  TSMX.applyUserStatus = function (uids, status, reason) {
    const by = TSMX.adminEmail();
    const up = {};
    uids.forEach(uid => {
      up['users/' + uid + '/status'] = status;
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusReason'] = reason || null;
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusAt'] = Date.now();
      up['users/' + uid + '/statusBy'] = by;
      // the user panel's own login gate checks this node — keep both in sync
      up['blocked_users/' + uid] = (status === 'banned') ? { at: Date.now(), by: by, reason: reason || null } : null;
    });
    return DB().ref().update(up);
  };

  console.log('%c TSMX v27 audit corrections loaded ', 'background:#f59e0b;color:#000;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 12-pricing-control.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v28 ADMIN · PART 12 — PRICING CONTROL
   • FREE packages (rate 0.0000) fully supported + clearly flagged
   • 4-decimal rate everywhere
   • Per-package USAGE LIMIT  (N orders per account, lifetime/daily/weekly/monthly)
   • Per-user RESELLER DISCOUNT (global / per-service / per-package, tiers, expiry)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const R4 = v => Math.round((Number(v) || 0) * 10000) / 10000;
  /* CSS.escape is missing in older browsers - our keys are safe id characters,
     so a simple quote/backslash escape is all an attribute selector needs. */
  const q = v => String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/(["\\])/g, '\\$1');
  TSMX.r4 = R4;
  TSMX.rate4 = v => '₹' + R4(v).toFixed(4);

  /* ══════════ 1. EXTRA FIELDS INSIDE THE PACKAGE MODALS ══════════ */
  const PERIODS = [['life', 'Lifetime (one time per account)'], ['daily', 'Per day'], ['weekly', 'Per week'], ['monthly', 'Per month']];

  function extraFieldsHTML(prefix) {
    return '<div id="' + prefix + 'ExtrasBlock" style="grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:6px;padding:13px;border:2px dashed var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(124,58,237,.045)">' +
      '<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;color:#7c3aed;margin-bottom:10px">🎯 Usage Limit &amp; Free Service</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:11px">' +
      '<div><label class="form-label">Max orders per account</label>' +
      '<input type="number" class="form-input" id="' + prefix + 'UsageLimit" min="0" step="1" placeholder="0 = unlimited" oninput="TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview(\'' + prefix + '\')">' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">How many times ONE user account may order this package. Leave 0 or empty for unlimited.</div></div>' +
      '<div><label class="form-label">Limit resets</label>' +
      '<select class="form-input" id="' + prefix + 'LimitPeriod" onchange="TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview(\'' + prefix + '\')">' +
      PERIODS.map(p => '<option value="' + p[0] + '">' + p[1] + '</option>').join('') + '</select>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">Lifetime never resets — perfect for one-time free trials.</div></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="' + prefix + 'ExtrasPreview" style="margin-top:11px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6"></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function mountExtras() {
    [['newPackage', 'addPackageModal'], ['editPackage', 'editPackageModal']].forEach(([prefix, modalId]) => {
      if (document.getElementById(prefix + 'ExtrasBlock')) return;
      const priceInput = document.getElementById(prefix + 'Price');
      if (!priceInput) return;
      const form = priceInput.closest('form') || document.getElementById(modalId);
      if (!form) return;
      const holder = document.createElement('div');
      holder.style.gridColumn = '1/-1';
      holder.innerHTML = extraFieldsHTML(prefix);
      const submit = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], .btn-primary');
      const grid = priceInput.closest('.form-grid') || priceInput.parentNode.parentNode;
      if (grid && grid.appendChild) grid.appendChild(holder.firstChild);
      else if (submit && submit.parentNode) submit.parentNode.insertBefore(holder.firstChild, submit);
      else form.appendChild(holder.firstChild);
      priceInput.addEventListener('input', () => TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview(prefix));
      const mv = document.getElementById(prefix + 'MarginValue');
      if (mv) mv.addEventListener('input', () => TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview(prefix));
      TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview(prefix);
    });
  }

  TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview = function (prefix) {
    const box = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ExtrasPreview'); if (!box) return;
    const base = TSMX.num((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Price') || {}).value, NaN);
    const type = (document.getElementById(prefix + 'MarginType') || {}).value || 'none';
    const val = TSMX.num((document.getElementById(prefix + 'MarginValue') || {}).value);
    const finalP = type === 'percent' ? R4(base * (1 + val / 100)) : type === 'fixed' ? R4(base + val) : R4(base);
    const lim = TSMX.num((document.getElementById(prefix + 'UsageLimit') || {}).value);
    const per = (document.getElementById(prefix + 'LimitPeriod') || {}).value || 'life';
    const perTxt = { life: 'in total (lifetime)', daily: 'per day', weekly: 'per week', monthly: 'per month' }[per];
    let html = '', bg = 'rgba(59,130,246,.08)', col = 'var(--text-secondary,#475569)';

    if (Number.isFinite(base) && finalP <= 0) {
      bg = 'rgba(16,185,129,.13)'; col = '#065f46';
      html += '🎁 <b>This package will be completely FREE.</b> Users are charged ₹0.0000 and no balance is deducted.';
      html += lim > 0
        ? '<br>✅ Protected: each account may order it only <b>' + lim + ' time' + (lim > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ' + perTxt + '</b>.'
        : '<br>⚠️ <b>No usage limit set.</b> A free package with unlimited use can be ordered endlessly by every user. Set a limit above.';
    } else if (Number.isFinite(base)) {
      html += 'Final rate charged to users: <b>' + TSMX.rate4(finalP) + '</b> per unit block';
      if (base > 0) html += ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; your cost <b>' + TSMX.rate4(base) + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; profit <b>' + TSMX.rate4(finalP - base) + '</b>';
      html += lim > 0
        ? '<br>🎯 Usage limit: <b>' + lim + ' order' + (lim > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ' + perTxt + '</b> per account.'
        : '<br>♾️ Usage limit: <b>unlimited</b> orders per account.';
    } else {
      html = 'Enter a price. Use <b>0.0000</b> to make this package completely FREE.';
    }
    box.style.background = bg; box.style.color = col;
    box.innerHTML = html;
  };

  /** Read by the source-patched addNewPackage / updatePackage. */
  TSMX.collectPkgExtras = function (prefix) {
    const lim = Math.max(0, TSMX.num((document.getElementById(prefix + 'UsageLimit') || {}).value));
    return {
      usageLimit: lim,
      limitPeriod: lim > 0 ? ((document.getElementById(prefix + 'LimitPeriod') || {}).value || 'life') : 'life'
    };
  };

  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };

  wrap('openAddPackageModal', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      mountExtras();
      const a = document.getElementById('newPackageUsageLimit'); if (a) a.value = '';
      const b = document.getElementById('newPackageLimitPeriod'); if (b) b.value = 'life';
      TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview('newPackage');
    }, 60);
    return r;
  });
  wrap('openEditPackageModal', orig => function (serviceId, pkg) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      mountExtras();
      const a = document.getElementById('editPackageUsageLimit'); if (a) a.value = TSMX.num(pkg && pkg.usageLimit) || '';
      const b = document.getElementById('editPackageLimitPeriod'); if (b) b.value = (pkg && pkg.limitPeriod) || 'life';
      TSMX.pkgExtrasPreview('editPackage');
    }, 60);
    return r;
  });

  /* FREE + LIMIT badges inside the admin services table */
  wrap('displayServices', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-package-row]').forEach(() => { });
      const svc = TSMX.G('_adminServicesById') || {};
      Object.entries(svc).forEach(([sid, s]) => {
        Object.entries((s && s.packages) || {}).forEach(([pid, p]) => {
          const host = document.querySelector('[data-pkg-id="' + pid + '"]') ||
            document.querySelector('[onclick*="' + pid + '"]');
          if (!host || host.querySelector('.tsmx-pkgtag')) return;
          const bits = [];
          if (TSMX.num(p.pricePerK) <= 0) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-green tsmx-pkgtag">🎁 FREE</span>');
          if (TSMX.num(p.usageLimit) > 0) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet tsmx-pkgtag">🎯 ' + p.usageLimit + '/' +
            ({ life: 'life', daily: 'day', weekly: 'week', monthly: 'month' }[p.limitPeriod || 'life']) + '</span>');
          if (bits.length) { const d = document.createElement('span'); d.innerHTML = ' ' + bits.join(' '); host.appendChild(d); }
        });
      });
    }, 120);
    return r;
  });

  /* ══════════ 2. RESELLER PRICING & DISCOUNTS PAGE ══════════ */
  const TIERS = [
    { id: 'bronze', name: '🥉 Bronze Reseller', value: 5, color: '#b45309' },
    { id: 'silver', name: '🥈 Silver Reseller', value: 10, color: '#64748b' },
    { id: 'gold', name: '🥇 Gold Reseller', value: 15, color: '#d97706' },
    { id: 'platinum', name: '💎 Platinum Reseller', value: 20, color: '#0ea5e9' },
    { id: 'partner', name: '🤝 Partner', value: 25, color: '#7c3aed' }
  ];

  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">💎 Reseller Pricing &amp; Discounts</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      Give any user their own pricing. A discount can be set <b>on everything</b>, <b>per service</b>, or
      <b>per single package</b> — the most specific rule always wins. The user instantly sees the new rate
      everywhere (New Order, Services catalog, search, order total) and is charged the discounted price.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="rpKpis" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Find user</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="rpSearch" placeholder="Email, name or UID…" style="min-width:230px" oninput="TSMX.rpRender()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Show</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="rpFilter" onchange="TSMX.rpRender()">
        <option value="">Everyone</option><option value="on">💎 Has a discount</option><option value="off">Standard price</option>
        <option value="exp">⌛ Expired discount</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.rpLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.rpExport()">📥 CSV</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.rpBulk()">⚡ Bulk Apply Tier</button>
    </div>
    <div id="rpList"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🎯 Service Usage Limits</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-warn">
      Any package can be capped so one account may only order it a set number of times — essential for
      <b>free services</b>. Set it on the Services page (Add / Edit Package → “Usage Limit &amp; Free Service”).
      Everything you have configured is listed below, with live usage.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.ulLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <div class="fld"><label>Show</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="ulFilter" onchange="TSMX.ulRender()">
        <option value="limited">Only limited packages</option><option value="free">Only FREE packages</option><option value="all">All packages</option></select></div>
    </div>
    <div id="ulList"></div>
  </div>`;

  let USERS = [], SERVICES = [], PKGS = [];

  TSMX.rpLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('rpList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading users and services…');
    TSMX.guard('rpList', 'TSMX.rpLoad()', () =>
      Promise.all([DB().ref('users').once('value'), DB().ref('services').once('value')]).then(([u, s]) => {
        USERS = []; SERVICES = []; PKGS = [];
        u.forEach(c => {
          const v = c.val() || {};
          USERS.push({
            uid: c.key, email: v.email || '', name: v.name || '',
            balance: TSMX.num(v.balance), spent: TSMX.num(v.spent),
            orders: Object.keys(v.orders || {}).length,
            discount: v.discount || null
          });
        });
        s.forEach(x => {
          const v = x.val() || {};
          SERVICES.push({ id: x.key, name: v.name || x.key });
          Object.entries(v.packages || {}).forEach(([pid, p]) => PKGS.push({
            sid: x.key, sname: v.name || x.key, pid: pid, name: p.name || pid,
            price: TSMX.num(p.pricePerK), base: TSMX.num(p.basePricePerK),
            qty: TSMX.num(p.quantity, 1000), enabled: p.enabled !== false,
            usageLimit: TSMX.num(p.usageLimit), limitPeriod: p.limitPeriod || 'life'
          }));
        });
        USERS.sort((a, b) => b.spent - a.spent);
        paintKpis(); TSMX.rpRender();
      }));
  };

  function activeDisc(d) { return d && d.enabled && !(d.expiresAt && Date.now() > d.expiresAt); }
  function discSummary(d) {
    if (!d || !d.enabled) return '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">Standard price</span>';
    if (d.expiresAt && Date.now() > d.expiresAt) return '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">⌛ Expired ' + TSMX.dateOnly(d.expiresAt) + '</span>';
    const bits = [];
    if (TSMX.num(d.value) > 0) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">' + (d.type === 'flat' ? '₹' + TSMX.num(d.value) + ' off/1K' : TSMX.num(d.value) + '% off all') + '</span>');
    const ns = d.services ? Object.keys(d.services).length : 0, np = d.packages ? Object.keys(d.packages).length : 0;
    if (ns) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">' + ns + ' service rule' + (ns > 1 ? 's' : '') + '</span>');
    if (np) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">' + np + ' package rule' + (np > 1 ? 's' : '') + '</span>');
    if (!bits.length) bits.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">No rule set</span>');
    if (d.tier) bits.unshift('<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">' + esc(d.tier) + '</span>');
    return bits.join(' ');
  }

  function paintKpis() {
    const box = document.getElementById('rpKpis'); if (!box) return;
    const on = USERS.filter(u => activeDisc(u.discount)).length;
    const exp = USERS.filter(u => u.discount && u.discount.enabled && u.discount.expiresAt && Date.now() > u.discount.expiresAt).length;
    const freePk = PKGS.filter(p => p.price <= 0).length;
    const limPk = PKGS.filter(p => p.usageLimit > 0).length;
    const k = (c, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    box.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Resellers with a discount', TSMX.int(on), USERS.length + ' users total') +
      k('#f59e0b', 'Expired discounts', TSMX.int(exp), 'need review') +
      k('#10b981', 'FREE packages', TSMX.int(freePk), PKGS.length + ' packages total') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Usage-limited packages', TSMX.int(limPk), 'protected from abuse');
  }

  TSMX.rpRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('rpList'); if (!box) return;
    const q = ((document.getElementById('rpSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const f = (document.getElementById('rpFilter') || {}).value || '';
    let list = USERS.filter(u => !q || (u.email + ' ' + u.name + ' ' + u.uid).toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if (f === 'on') list = list.filter(u => activeDisc(u.discount));
    if (f === 'off') list = list.filter(u => !activeDisc(u.discount));
    if (f === 'exp') list = list.filter(u => u.discount && u.discount.enabled && u.discount.expiresAt && Date.now() > u.discount.expiresAt);
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '💎', 'No users match.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>User</th><th>Current Pricing</th><th style="text-align:right">Spent</th><th style="text-align:right">Orders</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.slice(0, 300).map(u =>
        '<tr><td><b style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(u.name || u.email || 'Unknown') + '</b>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(u.email || '—') + '</div></td>' +
        '<td>' + discSummary(u.discount) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.money0(u.spent) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.int(u.orders) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" onclick="TSMX.rpOpen(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">💎 Set Pricing</button> ' +
        (activeDisc(u.discount) ? '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.rpClear(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">✖</button>' : '') +
        '</td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      (list.length > 300 ? '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing first 300 of ' + list.length + '.</div>' : '');
  };

  TSMX.rpOpen = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.balance')) return;
    const u = USERS.find(x => x.uid === uid); if (!u) return;
    const d = u.discount || { enabled: true, type: 'percent', value: 0, services: {}, packages: {} };
    const dtv = ts => { if (!ts) return ''; const x = new Date(ts), p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); return x.getFullYear() + '-' + p(x.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(x.getDate()) + 'T' + p(x.getHours()) + ':' + p(x.getMinutes()); };

    TSMX.modal({
      wide: true, title: '💎 Reseller Pricing — ' + (u.email || uid),
      body:
        '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">The most specific rule wins: <b>package rule → service rule → global rule</b>. ' +
        'Set a global 10% and then give one service 25% — that service uses 25%, everything else uses 10%.</div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="rpEnabled"' + (d.enabled !== false ? ' checked' : '') + '>' +
        '<span><span class="sw-t">Special pricing enabled</span><span class="sw-h">Turn off to instantly put this user back on standard prices. Nothing is deleted.</span></span></label>' +

        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Reseller tier (optional label shown to the user)</label>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px">' +
        TIERS.map(t => '<button type="button" class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.rpTier(\'' + t.id + '\')">' + t.name + ' · ' + t.value + '%</button>').join('') +
        '</div><input id="rpTierName" value="' + esc(d.tier || '') + '" placeholder="e.g. Gold Reseller"></div>' +

        '<h4 style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;margin:16px 0 9px">1️⃣ Global discount (applies to every service)</h4>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Type</label><select id="rpType">' +
        '<option value="percent"' + (d.type !== 'flat' ? ' selected' : '') + '>％ Percentage off</option>' +
        '<option value="flat"' + (d.type === 'flat' ? ' selected' : '') + '>₹ Flat amount off per 1K</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Value</label><input type="number" id="rpValue" step="0.0001" min="0" value="' + TSMX.num(d.value) + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Never price below (₹ per 1K)</label><input type="number" id="rpMinRate" step="0.0001" min="0" value="' + TSMX.num(d.minRate) + '"><div class="hint">Safety floor. 0 = no floor.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Expires at (optional)</label><input type="datetime-local" id="rpExpires" value="' + dtv(d.expiresAt) + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Internal note</label><input id="rpNote" value="' + esc(d.note || '') + '" placeholder="Why this user gets a discount"></div>' +
        '</div>' +

        '<h4 style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;margin:18px 0 9px">2️⃣ Per-service discount <span style="font-weight:500;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">(overrides global)</span></h4>' +
        '<div id="rpSvcRows" class="tsmx-tblwrap" style="max-height:230px;overflow-y:auto"></div>' +

        '<h4 style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;margin:18px 0 9px">3️⃣ Per-package discount <span style="font-weight:500;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">(overrides everything)</span></h4>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-toolbar" style="margin-bottom:9px"><div class="fld" style="flex:1"><label>Filter packages</label>' +
        '<input class="tsmx-in" id="rpPkgSearch" placeholder="Type to filter…" oninput="TSMX.rpPkgFilter()"></div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw" style="margin:0;padding:8px 11px"><input type="checkbox" id="rpOnlySet" onchange="TSMX.rpPkgFilter()"><span><span class="sw-t" style="font-size:12px">Only rules I set</span></span></label></div>' +
        '<div id="rpPkgRows" class="tsmx-tblwrap" style="max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto"></div>' +

        '<div id="rpPreview" class="tsmx-note n-ok" style="margin-top:16px"></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.rpPreviewCalc()">🔍 Preview Rates</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.rpSave(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">💾 Save Pricing</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        const sv = d.services || {}, pk = d.packages || {};
        document.getElementById('rpSvcRows').innerHTML =
          '<table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Service</th><th style="width:130px">Type</th><th style="width:110px">Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
          SERVICES.map(s => {
            const r = sv[s.id] || {};
            return '<tr><td style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600">' + esc(s.name) + '</td>' +
              '<td><select class="tsmx-sel" data-svc-type="' + esc(s.id) + '" style="min-width:0;width:100%"><option value="">— none —</option>' +
              '<option value="percent"' + (r.type === 'percent' ? ' selected' : '') + '>％</option>' +
              '<option value="flat"' + (r.type === 'flat' ? ' selected' : '') + '>₹</option></select></td>' +
              '<td><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" data-svc-val="' + esc(s.id) + '" step="0.0001" min="0" value="' + (r.value != null ? TSMX.num(r.value) : '') + '" style="min-width:0;width:100%"></td></tr>';
          }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';

        document.getElementById('rpPkgRows').innerHTML =
          '<table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Package</th><th style="width:120px">List Rate</th><th style="width:110px">Type</th><th style="width:100px">Value</th><th style="width:120px">They Pay</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
          PKGS.map(p => {
            const key = p.sid + '__' + p.pid, r = pk[key] || {};
            return '<tr data-pkgrow="' + esc(key) + '" data-search="' + esc((p.sname + ' ' + p.name).toLowerCase()) + '" data-set="' + (r.type ? '1' : '0') + '">' +
              '<td style="font-size:12px"><b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b><div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(p.sname) + (p.price <= 0 ? ' · <span style="color:#10b981;font-weight:700">FREE</span>' : '') + (p.usageLimit > 0 ? ' · 🎯 ' + p.usageLimit : '') + '</div></td>' +
              '<td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.rate4(p.price) + '</td>' +
              '<td><select class="tsmx-sel" data-pkg-type="' + esc(key) + '" style="min-width:0;width:100%" onchange="TSMX.rpPreviewCalc()"><option value="">—</option>' +
              '<option value="percent"' + (r.type === 'percent' ? ' selected' : '') + '>％</option>' +
              '<option value="flat"' + (r.type === 'flat' ? ' selected' : '') + '>₹</option></select></td>' +
              '<td><input type="number" class="tsmx-in" data-pkg-val="' + esc(key) + '" step="0.0001" min="0" value="' + (r.value != null ? TSMX.num(r.value) : '') + '" style="min-width:0;width:100%" oninput="TSMX.rpPreviewCalc()"></td>' +
              '<td data-pkg-eff="' + esc(key) + '" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#10b981"></td></tr>';
          }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
        TSMX.rpPreviewCalc();
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.rpTier = function (id) {
    const t = TIERS.find(x => x.id === id); if (!t) return;
    document.getElementById('rpTierName').value = t.name.replace(/^\S+\s/, '');
    document.getElementById('rpType').value = 'percent';
    document.getElementById('rpValue').value = t.value;
    document.getElementById('rpEnabled').checked = true;
    TSMX.rpPreviewCalc();
  };

  TSMX.rpPkgFilter = function () {
    const q = ((document.getElementById('rpPkgSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const only = (document.getElementById('rpOnlySet') || {}).checked;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkgrow]').forEach(tr => {
      const key = tr.dataset.pkgrow;
      const hasRule = !!(document.querySelector('[data-pkg-type="' + q(key) + '"]') || {}).value;
      const on = (!q || tr.dataset.search.includes(q)) && (!only || hasRule);
      tr.style.display = on ? '' : 'none';
    });
  };

  function collectDiscount() {
    const services = {}, packages = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-svc-type]').forEach(sel => {
      const id = sel.dataset.svcType, v = TSMX.num((document.querySelector('[data-svc-val="' + q(id) + '"]') || {}).value);
      if (sel.value && v > 0) services[id] = { type: sel.value, value: v };
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pkg-type]').forEach(sel => {
      const id = sel.dataset.pkgType, v = TSMX.num((document.querySelector('[data-pkg-val="' + q(id) + '"]') || {}).value);
      if (sel.value && v > 0) packages[id] = { type: sel.value, value: v };
    });
    const exp = (document.getElementById('rpExpires') || {}).value;
    return {
      enabled: document.getElementById('rpEnabled').checked,
      tier: document.getElementById('rpTierName').value.trim() || null,
      type: document.getElementById('rpType').value,
      value: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rpValue').value)),
      minRate: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(document.getElementById('rpMinRate').value)),
      expiresAt: exp ? new Date(exp).getTime() : null,
      note: document.getElementById('rpNote').value.trim() || null,
      services: Object.keys(services).length ? services : null,
      packages: Object.keys(packages).length ? packages : null,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
  }

  function effRate(price, d, sid, pid) {
    if (price <= 0) return 0;
    if (!d.enabled) return price;
    const rule = (d.packages && d.packages[sid + '__' + pid]) || (d.services && d.services[sid]) || (d.value > 0 ? { type: d.type, value: d.value } : null);
    if (!rule) return price;
    let r = rule.type === 'flat' ? price - rule.value : price * (1 - rule.value / 100);
    if (d.minRate > 0 && r < d.minRate) r = d.minRate;
    return R4(Math.max(0, r));
  }

  TSMX.rpPreviewCalc = function () {
    const d = collectDiscount();
    let changed = 0, totalSave = 0;
    PKGS.forEach(p => {
      const eff = effRate(p.price, d, p.sid, p.pid);
      const cell = document.querySelector('[data-pkg-eff="' + q(p.sid + '__' + p.pid) + '"]');
      if (cell) cell.textContent = eff <= 0 ? 'FREE' : TSMX.rate4(eff);
      if (eff < p.price - 0.00001) { changed++; totalSave += (p.price - eff); }
    });
    const box = document.getElementById('rpPreview');
    if (box) box.innerHTML = changed
      ? '✅ <b>' + changed + ' of ' + PKGS.length + '</b> packages will be cheaper for this user. Average saving <b>' +
      TSMX.rate4(totalSave / changed) + '</b> per 1K. ' + (d.expiresAt ? 'Valid until <b>' + TSMX.dt(d.expiresAt) + '</b>.' : 'No expiry set.')
      : 'ℹ️ No discount is currently configured — this user will pay standard prices.';
  };

  TSMX.rpSave = function (uid) {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.balance')) return;
    const d = collectDiscount();
    DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/discount').set(d).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('discount.set', (d.tier || '') + ' ' + d.type + ' ' + d.value +
        ' · svc:' + (d.services ? Object.keys(d.services).length : 0) + ' pkg:' + (d.packages ? Object.keys(d.packages).length : 0), uid);
      DB().ref('notifications').push({
        user_id: uid, type: 'success', title: '💎 Special Pricing Activated',
        message: (d.tier ? d.tier + ' pricing is now active on your account. ' : 'Special reseller pricing is now active on your account. ') +
          'Your new rates are already visible on the New Order page.',
        read: false, timestamp: Date.now()
      }).catch(() => { });
      TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('✅ Reseller pricing saved and live', 'success'); TSMX.rpLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.rpClear = function (uid) {
    TSMX.confirm('Remove special pricing?', 'This user goes back to standard prices immediately.', () => {
      DB().ref('users/' + uid + '/discount').remove().then(() => {
        TSMX.audit('discount.clear', 'removed', uid);
        TSMX.toast('✅ Back to standard pricing', 'success'); TSMX.rpLoad();
      });
    }, true);
  };

  TSMX.rpBulk = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('users.balance')) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '⚡ Bulk Apply a Reseller Tier',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn">This overwrites the <b>global</b> discount of every matching user. Per-service and per-package rules are kept.</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Apply to</label><select id="rpBulkWho">' +
        '<option value="spent1000">Users who spent ₹1,000+</option><option value="spent5000">Users who spent ₹5,000+</option>' +
        '<option value="orders10">Users with 10+ orders</option><option value="all">Everyone</option>' +
        '<option value="existing">Only users who already have a discount</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Tier</label><select id="rpBulkTier">' +
        TIERS.map(t => '<option value="' + t.id + '">' + t.name + ' · ' + t.value + '% off</option>').join('') +
        '<option value="none">❌ Remove global discount</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Expires at (optional)</label><input type="datetime-local" id="rpBulkExp"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-note n-info" id="rpBulkCount">…</div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.rpBulkGo()">⚡ Apply</button>',
      onOpen: () => { document.getElementById('rpBulkWho').onchange = bulkCount; bulkCount(); }
    });
  };
  function bulkTargets() {
    const who = (document.getElementById('rpBulkWho') || {}).value;
    return USERS.filter(u => who === 'all' || (who === 'spent1000' && u.spent >= 1000) || (who === 'spent5000' && u.spent >= 5000) ||
      (who === 'orders10' && u.orders >= 10) || (who === 'existing' && u.discount && u.discount.enabled));
  }
  function bulkCount() { const e = document.getElementById('rpBulkCount'); if (e) e.innerHTML = 'This will update <b>' + bulkTargets().length + '</b> user(s).'; }
  TSMX.rpBulkGo = function () {
    const list = bulkTargets(), tierId = document.getElementById('rpBulkTier').value;
    const exp = document.getElementById('rpBulkExp').value;
    const t = TIERS.find(x => x.id === tierId);
    TSMX.closeModal();
    const up = {};
    list.forEach(u => {
      const cur = u.discount || {};
      if (tierId === 'none') { up['users/' + u.uid + '/discount/value'] = 0; up['users/' + u.uid + '/discount/tier'] = null; return; }
      up['users/' + u.uid + '/discount'] = Object.assign({}, cur, {
        enabled: true, tier: t.name.replace(/^\S+\s/, ''), type: 'percent', value: t.value,
        expiresAt: exp ? new Date(exp).getTime() : (cur.expiresAt || null),
        updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
      });
    });
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('discount.bulk', tierId + ' → ' + list.length + ' users');
      TSMX.toast('✅ Applied to ' + list.length + ' user(s)', 'success'); TSMX.rpLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.rpExport = () => TSMX.csv('reseller_pricing_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['UID', 'Email', 'Name', 'Tier', 'Enabled', 'Global Type', 'Global Value', 'Min Rate', 'Service Rules', 'Package Rules', 'Expires', 'Note', 'Spent']].concat(
      USERS.map(u => { const d = u.discount || {}; return [u.uid, u.email, u.name, d.tier || '', !!d.enabled, d.type || '', TSMX.num(d.value), TSMX.num(d.minRate), d.services ? Object.keys(d.services).length : 0, d.packages ? Object.keys(d.packages).length : 0, d.expiresAt ? TSMX.dt(d.expiresAt) : '', d.note || '', u.spent]; })));

  /* ══════════ 3. USAGE LIMIT OVERVIEW ══════════ */
  TSMX.ulLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ulList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Scanning packages and usage…');
    TSMX.guard('ulList', 'TSMX.ulLoad()', () =>
      Promise.all([DB().ref('services').once('value'), DB().ref('users').once('value')]).then(([s, u]) => {
        PKGS = [];
        s.forEach(x => {
          const v = x.val() || {};
          Object.entries(v.packages || {}).forEach(([pid, p]) => PKGS.push({
            sid: x.key, sname: v.name || x.key, pid: pid, name: p.name || pid,
            price: TSMX.num(p.pricePerK), qty: TSMX.num(p.quantity, 1000),
            usageLimit: TSMX.num(p.usageLimit), limitPeriod: p.limitPeriod || 'life', enabled: p.enabled !== false
          }));
        });
        const usage = {};
        u.forEach(c => {
          const su = (c.val() || {}).serviceUsage || {};
          Object.entries(su).forEach(([k, periods]) => {
            usage[k] = usage[k] || { users: 0, total: 0, maxed: 0 };
            const n = Object.values(periods || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + TSMX.num(b), 0);
            if (n > 0) { usage[k].users++; usage[k].total += n; }
          });
        });
        TSMX._usage = usage; TSMX.ulRender();
      }));
  };

  TSMX.ulRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ulList'); if (!box) return;
    const f = (document.getElementById('ulFilter') || {}).value || 'limited';
    const usage = TSMX._usage || {};
    let list = PKGS;
    if (f === 'limited') list = PKGS.filter(p => p.usageLimit > 0);
    if (f === 'free') list = PKGS.filter(p => p.price <= 0);
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🎯', f === 'limited'
      ? 'No package has a usage limit yet. Open Services → Edit Package → “Usage Limit & Free Service”.'
      : 'No FREE packages yet. Set a package price to 0.0000 to make it free.');
    const per = { life: 'lifetime', daily: 'per day', weekly: 'per week', monthly: 'per month' };
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Package</th><th>Rate</th><th>Limit</th><th style="text-align:right">Users who ordered</th><th style="text-align:right">Total orders</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.map(p => {
        const u = usage[p.sid + '__' + p.pid] || { users: 0, total: 0 };
        const risky = p.price <= 0 && !(p.usageLimit > 0);
        return '<tr' + (risky ? ' style="background:rgba(239,68,68,.05)"' : '') + '>' +
          '<td><b style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(p.name) + '</b><div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(p.sname) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td>' + (p.price <= 0 ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">🎁 FREE</span>' : '<span style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.rate4(p.price) + '</span>') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (p.usageLimit > 0
            ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">🎯 ' + p.usageLimit + ' ' + per[p.limitPeriod] + '</span>'
            : (risky ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">⚠️ UNLIMITED FREE</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">♾️ unlimited</span>')) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.int(u.users) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right">' + TSMX.int(u.total) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right"><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.ulReset(\'' + esc(p.sid) + '\',\'' + esc(p.pid) + '\',\'' + esc(p.name) + '\')">♻️ Reset usage</button></td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      (list.some(p => p.price <= 0 && !(p.usageLimit > 0))
        ? '<div class="tsmx-note n-dgr" style="margin-top:12px">⚠️ The rows highlighted in red are <b>FREE packages with no usage limit</b> — any user can order them endlessly. Set a limit on the Services page.</div>' : '');
  };

  TSMX.ulReset = function (sid, pid, name) {
    TSMX.confirm('Reset usage for “' + esc(name) + '”?',
      'The usage counter for <b>every user</b> on this package is cleared, so everyone can order it again from zero.', () => {
        DB().ref('users').once('value').then(s => {
          const up = {};
          s.forEach(c => { const su = (c.val() || {}).serviceUsage || {}; if (su[sid + '__' + pid]) up['users/' + c.key + '/serviceUsage/' + sid + '__' + pid] = null; });
          const n = Object.keys(up).length;
          if (!n) { TSMX.toast('No usage recorded yet', 'success'); return; }
          return DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
            TSMX.audit('usage.reset', name + ' · ' + n + ' users', sid + '/' + pid);
            TSMX.toast('✅ Usage reset for ' + n + ' user(s)', 'success'); TSMX.ulLoad();
          });
        }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Reset failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
      }, true);
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxPricingPage', title: 'Reseller Pricing & Limits', html: HTML,
      group: 'order-control', icon: '💎', label: 'Reseller Pricing',
      onEnter: () => { TSMX.rpLoad(); TSMX.ulLoad(); }
    });
    setTimeout(mountExtras, 900);
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v28 pricing control loaded ', 'background:#7c3aed;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();
