/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v29 ADMIN · PART 13 — SERVICE MANAGEMENT PRO
   • Min = Max allowed (fixed-quantity packages) + live validator in the modal
   • Quantity STEP (order quantity must be a multiple of N)
   • Package CLONE / duplicate (same or another service)
   • BULK PACKAGE EDITOR (price ±%, ±flat, min/max/step/limit/enable, many at once)
   • CSV IMPORT / EXPORT of the whole catalogue
   • Service & package BADGES (HOT / NEW / OFFER / custom)
   • Price change history
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const R4 = v => Math.round((Number(v) || 0) * 10000) / 10000;
  const N = v => { const r = String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/[,\s_]/g, ''); return r === '' ? NaN : Number(r); };
  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };

  const BADGES = [
    { id: '', label: 'None', color: '' },
    { id: 'hot', label: '🔥 HOT', color: '#ef4444' },
    { id: 'new', label: '✨ NEW', color: '#0ea5e9' },
    { id: 'offer', label: '🎁 OFFER', color: '#8b5cf6' },
    { id: 'sale', label: '💸 SALE', color: '#f59e0b' },
    { id: 'best', label: '⭐ BEST SELLER', color: '#10b981' },
    { id: 'fast', label: '⚡ INSTANT', color: '#06b6d4' },
    { id: 'limited', label: '⏳ LIMITED', color: '#db2777' }
  ];
  TSMX.BADGES = BADGES;

  /* ══════════ 1. EXTRA FIELDS IN THE PACKAGE MODAL (step + badge) ══════════ */
  function extraHTML(prefix) {
    return '<div id="' + prefix + 'ProBlock" style="grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:6px;padding:13px;border:2px dashed var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(14,165,233,.05)">' +
      '<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;color:#0369a1;margin-bottom:10px">📐 Quantity Rules &amp; Badge</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:11px">' +
      '<div><label class="form-label">Quantity step / multiple</label>' +
      '<input type="number" class="form-input" id="' + prefix + 'Step" min="0" step="1" placeholder="0 = any number" oninput="TSMX.qtyPreview(\'' + prefix + '\')">' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">Force orders to be a multiple of this (e.g. 100 → 100, 200, 300…). 0 = any quantity allowed.</div></div>' +
      '<div><label class="form-label">Badge</label><select class="form-input" id="' + prefix + 'Badge" onchange="TSMX.qtyPreview(\'' + prefix + '\')">' +
      BADGES.map(b => '<option value="' + b.id + '">' + b.label + '</option>').join('') + '</select>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">Shown next to the package name in the user panel.</div></div>' +
      '<div><label class="form-label">Custom badge text</label>' +
      '<input type="text" class="form-input" id="' + prefix + 'BadgeText" maxlength="18" placeholder="e.g. -30% TODAY" oninput="TSMX.qtyPreview(\'' + prefix + '\')">' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">Overrides the preset above. Leave blank to use the preset.</div></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="' + prefix + 'QtyPreview" style="margin-top:11px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.65"></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function mountPro() {
    [['newPackage', 'addPackageModal'], ['editPackage', 'editPackageModal']].forEach(([prefix]) => {
      if (document.getElementById(prefix + 'ProBlock')) return;
      const anchor = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ExtrasBlock') || document.getElementById(prefix + 'Price');
      if (!anchor) return;
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.innerHTML = extraHTML(prefix);
      const node = div.firstChild;
      if (anchor.id.indexOf('ExtrasBlock') > 0) anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(node, anchor);
      else (anchor.closest('.form-grid') || anchor.parentNode.parentNode).appendChild(node);
      ['Min', 'Max', 'Quantity'].forEach(k => {
        const el = document.getElementById(prefix + k);
        if (el && !el._proWired) { el._proWired = 1; el.addEventListener('input', () => TSMX.qtyPreview(prefix)); }
      });
      TSMX.qtyPreview(prefix);
    });
  }

  TSMX.qtyPreview = function (prefix) {
    const box = document.getElementById(prefix + 'QtyPreview'); if (!box) return;
    const min = N((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Min') || {}).value);
    const max = N((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Max') || {}).value);
    const step = N((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Step') || {}).value) || 0;
    const unit = N((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Quantity') || {}).value) || 1000;
    let msgs = [], bg = 'rgba(59,130,246,.08)', col = 'var(--text-secondary,#475569)';

    if (!Number.isFinite(min) || !Number.isFinite(max)) msgs.push('Enter a minimum and maximum quantity.');
    else if (min > max) { bg = 'rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; col = '#991b1b'; msgs.push('❌ Minimum (' + min + ') cannot be greater than maximum (' + max + ').'); }
    else if (min === max) { bg = 'rgba(139,92,246,.12)'; col = '#5b21b6'; msgs.push('📌 <b>Fixed quantity package</b> — every order will be exactly <b>' + TSMX.int(min) + '</b>. This is allowed.'); }
    else msgs.push('✅ Users may order between <b>' + TSMX.int(min) + '</b> and <b>' + TSMX.int(max) + '</b>.');

    if (step > 0 && Number.isFinite(min) && Number.isFinite(max)) {
      if (min % step !== 0) msgs.push('⚠️ Minimum ' + min + ' is not a multiple of the step ' + step + ' — the first valid quantity will be ' + (Math.ceil(min / step) * step) + '.');
      const examples = [];
      let v = Math.max(step, Math.ceil(min / step) * step);
      while (examples.length < 4 && v <= max) { examples.push(TSMX.int(v)); v += step; }
      msgs.push('🔢 Allowed quantities: <b>' + examples.join(', ') + (v <= max ? ', …' : '') + '</b>');
    }
    if (Number.isFinite(min) && unit) msgs.push('💰 Price is per <b>' + TSMX.int(unit) + '</b> units.');
    const bt = (document.getElementById(prefix + 'BadgeText') || {}).value;
    const bid = (document.getElementById(prefix + 'Badge') || {}).value;
    if (bt || bid) {
      const b = BADGES.find(x => x.id === bid) || BADGES[1];
      msgs.push('🏷️ Badge shown: <span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:99px;background:' + (b.color || '#64748b') + ';color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800">' + esc(bt || b.label) + '</span>');
    }
    box.style.background = bg; box.style.color = col;
    box.innerHTML = msgs.join('<br>');
  };

  /* extend the extras collector from part 12 */
  const prevCollect = TSMX.collectPkgExtras;
  TSMX.collectPkgExtras = function (prefix) {
    const base = prevCollect ? prevCollect(prefix) : {};
    const step = Math.max(0, Math.round(N((document.getElementById(prefix + 'Step') || {}).value) || 0));
    const badge = (document.getElementById(prefix + 'Badge') || {}).value || '';
    const badgeText = ((document.getElementById(prefix + 'BadgeText') || {}).value || '').trim();
    return Object.assign(base, { qtyStep: step, badge: badge || null, badgeText: badgeText || null });
  };

  wrap('openAddPackageModal', o => function () {
    const r = o.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      mountPro();
      ['Step', 'BadgeText'].forEach(k => { const e = document.getElementById('newPackage' + k); if (e) e.value = ''; });
      const b = document.getElementById('newPackageBadge'); if (b) b.value = '';
      TSMX.qtyPreview('newPackage');
    }, 90);
    return r;
  });
  wrap('openEditPackageModal', o => function (sid, pkg) {
    const r = o.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      mountPro();
      const s = document.getElementById('editPackageStep'); if (s) s.value = TSMX.num(pkg && pkg.qtyStep) || '';
      const b = document.getElementById('editPackageBadge'); if (b) b.value = (pkg && pkg.badge) || '';
      const t = document.getElementById('editPackageBadgeText'); if (t) t.value = (pkg && pkg.badgeText) || '';
      TSMX.qtyPreview('editPackage');
    }, 90);
    return r;
  });

  /* ══════════ 2. SERVICE MANAGEMENT PRO PAGE ══════════ */
  const HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🧰 Service Toolkit</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      Bulk tools for a large catalogue. Everything here writes straight to <code>services/</code>, so the user panel updates live.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="stKpis" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar">
      <div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="stSearch" placeholder="Service or package…" style="min-width:210px" oninput="TSMX.stRender()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Service</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="stService" onchange="TSMX.stRender()"><option value="">All services</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Show</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="stFilter" onchange="TSMX.stRender()">
        <option value="">All packages</option><option value="on">Enabled only</option><option value="off">Disabled only</option>
        <option value="free">FREE only</option><option value="limited">Usage-limited</option><option value="fixed">Fixed quantity (min = max)</option>
        <option value="nocost">Missing base price</option><option value="badge">Has a badge</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Sort</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="stSort" onchange="TSMX.stRender()">
        <option value="order">Catalogue order</option><option value="pricehi">Price high → low</option><option value="pricelo">Price low → high</option>
        <option value="profit">Profit high → low</option><option value="name">Name A → Z</option></select></div>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.stLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.stExport()">📥 Export CSV</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.stImportOpen()">📤 Import CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="stList"></div>
    <div class="tsmx-bulk" id="stBulk">
      <span class="bc"><span id="stSelCount">0</span> package(s) selected</span>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stBulkEdit()">✏️ Bulk Edit</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stBulkToggle(true)">✅ Enable</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stBulkToggle(false)">⏸ Disable</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stClone()">📋 Clone</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stBulkDelete()">🗑 Delete</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sm" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)" onclick="TSMX.stClearSel()">✖ Clear</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">🕓 Price Change History</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-toolbar"><button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.phLoad()">🔄 Refresh</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.phExport()">📥 CSV</button></div>
    <div id="phList"></div>
  </div>`;

  let PKGS = [], SVCS = [], SEL = new Set(), VIEW = [], HIST = [];

  TSMX.stLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('stList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading catalogue…');
    TSMX.guard('stList', 'TSMX.stLoad()', () => DB().ref('services').once('value').then(s => {
      PKGS = []; SVCS = [];
      s.forEach(x => {
        const v = x.val() || {};
        SVCS.push({ id: x.key, name: v.name || x.key, enabled: v.enabled !== false, order: TSMX.num(v.order, 999999), icon: v.icon || '', logo: v.logo || 'none', badge: v.badge || '', badgeText: v.badgeText || '' });
        Object.entries(v.packages || {}).forEach(([pid, p]) => PKGS.push({
          sid: x.key, sname: v.name || x.key, pid: pid,
          name: p.name || pid, order: TSMX.num(p.order, 999999),
          price: TSMX.num(p.pricePerK), base: TSMX.num(p.basePricePerK, NaN),
          marginType: p.marginType || 'none', marginValue: TSMX.num(p.marginValue),
          qty: TSMX.num(p.quantity, 1000), min: TSMX.num(p.min), max: TSMX.num(p.max),
          step: TSMX.num(p.qtyStep), usageLimit: TSMX.num(p.usageLimit), limitPeriod: p.limitPeriod || 'life',
          enabled: p.enabled !== false, cancelable: !!p.cancelable, refillable: !!p.refillable,
          avgTime: p.avgTime || '', description: p.description || '',
          badge: p.badge || '', badgeText: p.badgeText || ''
        }));
      });
      SVCS.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
      const sel = document.getElementById('stService');
      const keep = sel.value;
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All services</option>' + SVCS.map(s2 => '<option value="' + esc(s2.id) + '">' + esc(s2.name) + '</option>').join('');
      sel.value = keep;
      SEL.clear(); paintKpis(); TSMX.stRender();
    }));
  };

  function paintKpis() {
    const box = document.getElementById('stKpis'); if (!box) return;
    const free = PKGS.filter(p => p.price <= 0).length;
    const noBase = PKGS.filter(p => !Number.isFinite(p.base) || p.base <= 0).length;
    const profit = PKGS.filter(p => Number.isFinite(p.base) && p.base > 0)
      .reduce((a, p) => a + (p.price - p.base), 0);
    const k = (c, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    box.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Services', TSMX.int(SVCS.length), SVCS.filter(s => s.enabled).length + ' enabled') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Packages', TSMX.int(PKGS.length), PKGS.filter(p => p.enabled).length + ' enabled · ' + free + ' free') +
      k('#10b981', 'Avg margin per 1K', PKGS.length ? TSMX.rate4(profit / Math.max(1, PKGS.length - noBase)) : '₹0.0000', 'across priced packages') +
      k(noBase ? '#f59e0b' : '#64748b', 'Missing base price', TSMX.int(noBase), noBase ? 'profit is estimated for these' : 'profit reporting is exact');
  }

  TSMX.stRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('stList'); if (!box) return;
    const q = ((document.getElementById('stSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase();
    const sv = (document.getElementById('stService') || {}).value || '';
    const f = (document.getElementById('stFilter') || {}).value || '';
    const sort = (document.getElementById('stSort') || {}).value || 'order';
    VIEW = PKGS.filter(p => {
      if (sv && p.sid !== sv) return false;
      if (q && !((p.sname + ' ' + p.name).toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
      if (f === 'on' && !p.enabled) return false;
      if (f === 'off' && p.enabled) return false;
      if (f === 'free' && p.price > 0) return false;
      if (f === 'limited' && !(p.usageLimit > 0)) return false;
      if (f === 'fixed' && p.min !== p.max) return false;
      if (f === 'nocost' && Number.isFinite(p.base) && p.base > 0) return false;
      if (f === 'badge' && !(p.badge || p.badgeText)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    const S = {
      order: (a, b) => a.sname.localeCompare(b.sname) || a.order - b.order,
      pricehi: (a, b) => b.price - a.price, pricelo: (a, b) => a.price - b.price,
      profit: (a, b) => ((b.price - (b.base || 0)) - (a.price - (a.base || 0))),
      name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
    };
    VIEW.sort(S[sort] || S.order);
    if (!VIEW.length) { TSMX.empty(box, '📦', 'No packages match these filters.'); updBulk(); return; }
    const per = { life: 'life', daily: 'day', weekly: 'week', monthly: 'month' };
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th style="width:34px"><input type="checkbox" class="tsmx-chk" onchange="TSMX.stToggleAll(this.checked)"></th>' +
      '<th>Package</th><th style="text-align:right">Rate / unit</th><th style="text-align:right">Base</th><th style="text-align:right">Profit</th>' +
      '<th>Quantity rules</th><th>Flags</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      VIEW.slice(0, 400).map(p => {
        const key = p.sid + '__' + p.pid;
        const prof = Number.isFinite(p.base) && p.base > 0 ? p.price - p.base : NaN;
        const b = BADGES.find(x => x.id === p.badge);
        const flags = [];
        if (!p.enabled) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">⏸ off</span>');
        if (p.price <= 0) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">🎁 FREE</span>');
        if (p.usageLimit > 0) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">🎯 ' + p.usageLimit + '/' + per[p.limitPeriod] + '</span>');
        if (p.min === p.max) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">📌 fixed</span>');
        if (p.step > 0) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">🔢 ×' + p.step + '</span>');
        if (p.refillable) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">🔄</span>');
        if (p.cancelable) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">🚫</span>');
        if (p.badgeText || b) flags.push('<span class="tsmx-pill" style="background:' + ((b && b.color) || '#64748b') + '22;color:' + ((b && b.color) || '#64748b') + '">' + esc(p.badgeText || (b && b.label) || '') + '</span>');
        return '<tr class="' + (SEL.has(key) ? 'sel' : '') + '" id="strow_' + esc(key) + '">' +
          '<td><input type="checkbox" class="tsmx-chk" ' + (SEL.has(key) ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="TSMX.stToggle(\'' + esc(key) + '\',this.checked)"></td>' +
          '<td><b style="font-size:12.5px">' + esc(p.name) + '</b><div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(p.sname) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700">' + (p.price <= 0 ? 'FREE' : TSMX.rate4(p.price)) + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray);font-weight:400">per ' + TSMX.int(p.qty) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + (Number.isFinite(p.base) ? TSMX.rate4(p.base) : '<span style="color:#f59e0b">—</span>') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;color:' + (prof > 0 ? '#10b981' : '#94a3b8') + '">' + (Number.isFinite(prof) ? TSMX.rate4(prof) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.int(p.min) + ' – ' + TSMX.int(p.max) + (p.step > 0 ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-gray)">step ' + TSMX.int(p.step) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="max-width:190px">' + (flags.join(' ') || '<span style="color:var(--text-light)">—</span>') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;white-space:nowrap">' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.stEdit(\'' + esc(p.sid) + '\',\'' + esc(p.pid) + '\')">✏️</button> ' +
          '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.stCloneOne(\'' + esc(key) + '\')">📋</button></td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">Showing ' + Math.min(400, VIEW.length) + ' of ' + VIEW.length + ' packages (' + PKGS.length + ' total)</div>';
    updBulk();
  };

  TSMX.stToggle = (k, on) => { on ? SEL.add(k) : SEL.delete(k); const r = document.getElementById('strow_' + k); if (r) r.classList.toggle('sel', on); updBulk(); };
  TSMX.stToggleAll = on => { VIEW.slice(0, 400).forEach(p => on ? SEL.add(p.sid + '__' + p.pid) : SEL.delete(p.sid + '__' + p.pid)); TSMX.stRender(); };
  TSMX.stClearSel = () => { SEL.clear(); TSMX.stRender(); };
  function updBulk() { const b = document.getElementById('stBulk'), c = document.getElementById('stSelCount'); if (b) b.classList.toggle('on', SEL.size > 0); if (c) c.textContent = SEL.size; }
  function selected() { return PKGS.filter(p => SEL.has(p.sid + '__' + p.pid)); }

  TSMX.stEdit = function (sid, pid) {
    const p = PKGS.find(x => x.sid === sid && x.pid === pid); if (!p) return;
    try { openEditPackageModal(sid, { id: pid, name: p.name, pricePerK: p.price, basePricePerK: p.base, marginType: p.marginType, marginValue: p.marginValue, quantity: p.qty, min: p.min, max: p.max, avgTime: p.avgTime, description: p.description, cancelable: p.cancelable, refillable: p.refillable, order: p.order, usageLimit: p.usageLimit, limitPeriod: p.limitPeriod, qtyStep: p.step, badge: p.badge, badgeText: p.badgeText }); }
    catch (e) { TSMX.toast('Open the Services page to edit this package.', 'error'); }
  };

  /* ---------- BULK EDIT ---------- */
  TSMX.stBulkEdit = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('services') || !SEL.size) return;
    const list = selected();
    TSMX.modal({
      wide: true, title: '✏️ Bulk Edit ' + list.length + ' package(s)',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn">Leave a field blank to keep it unchanged. Changes go live immediately.</div>' +
        '<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin:14px 0 9px">💰 Pricing</h4>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Price action</label><select id="beMode">' +
        '<option value="">— no change —</option><option value="pct">Increase / decrease by %</option>' +
        '<option value="flat">Add / subtract a fixed amount</option><option value="set">Set exact rate</option>' +
        '<option value="margin">Recalculate from base + margin</option><option value="free">Make FREE (0.0000)</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Value</label><input type="number" id="beVal" step="0.0001" placeholder="e.g. 10 or -5"><div class="hint">Negative values reduce the price.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Round to</label><select id="beRound"><option value="4">4 decimals</option><option value="2">2 decimals</option><option value="0">Whole number</option></select></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin:16px 0 9px">📐 Quantity rules</h4>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4">' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Min</label><input type="number" id="beMin" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Max</label><input type="number" id="beMax" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Step</label><input type="number" id="beStep" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Price per (unit)</label><input type="number" id="beUnit" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin:16px 0 9px">🎯 Limits &amp; flags</h4>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4">' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Usage limit</label><input type="number" id="beLimit" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Limit period</label><select id="bePeriod"><option value="">keep</option><option value="life">Lifetime</option><option value="daily">Per day</option><option value="weekly">Per week</option><option value="monthly">Per month</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Refillable</label><select id="beRefill"><option value="">keep</option><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Cancelable</label><select id="beCancel"><option value="">keep</option><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Badge</label><select id="beBadge"><option value="">keep</option><option value="__clear">— remove badge —</option>' +
        BADGES.filter(b => b.id).map(b => '<option value="' + b.id + '">' + b.label + '</option>').join('') + '</select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Average time</label><input id="beTime" placeholder="keep"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="bePreview" class="tsmx-note n-info" style="margin-top:14px"></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.bePreview()">🔍 Preview</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.beApply()">💾 Apply to ' + list.length + '</button>',
      onOpen: () => { ['beMode', 'beVal', 'beRound', 'beMin', 'beMax', 'beStep'].forEach(i => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.addEventListener('input', TSMX.bePreview); }); TSMX.bePreview(); }
    });
  };

  function bulkCompute(p) {
    const mode = (document.getElementById('beMode') || {}).value;
    const val = TSMX.num((document.getElementById('beVal') || {}).value);
    const rd = Number((document.getElementById('beRound') || {}).value || 4);
    const round = v => rd === 0 ? Math.round(v) : rd === 2 ? Math.round(v * 100) / 100 : R4(v);
    let price = p.price, base = p.base;
    if (mode === 'pct') price = round(p.price * (1 + val / 100));
    else if (mode === 'flat') price = round(p.price + val);
    else if (mode === 'set') price = round(val);
    else if (mode === 'free') { price = 0; base = 0; }
    else if (mode === 'margin' && Number.isFinite(p.base)) price = round(p.marginType === 'percent' ? p.base * (1 + p.marginValue / 100) : p.marginType === 'fixed' ? p.base + p.marginValue : p.base);
    return { price: Math.max(0, price), base: base };
  }

  TSMX.bePreview = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('bePreview'); if (!box) return;
    const list = selected().slice(0, 6);
    const mode = (document.getElementById('beMode') || {}).value;
    if (!mode) { box.innerHTML = 'No price change selected. Only the fields you fill in below will be updated.'; return; }
    box.innerHTML = '<b>Preview (first ' + list.length + '):</b><br>' + list.map(p => {
      const n = bulkCompute(p);
      return esc(p.name) + ': ' + TSMX.rate4(p.price) + ' → <b style="color:' + (n.price < p.price ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981') + '">' + (n.price <= 0 ? 'FREE' : TSMX.rate4(n.price)) + '</b>';
    }).join('<br>');
  };

  TSMX.beApply = function () {
    const list = selected(); if (!list.length) return;
    const g = id => { const v = (document.getElementById(id) || {}).value; return v === '' ? null : v; };
    const mode = g('beMode');
    const up = {}, hist = [];
    list.forEach(p => {
      const path = 'services/' + p.sid + '/packages/' + p.pid + '/';
      if (mode) { const n = bulkCompute(p); up[path + 'pricePerK'] = n.price; if (mode === 'free') up[path + 'basePricePerK'] = 0; if (n.price !== p.price) hist.push({ sid: p.sid, pid: p.pid, name: p.sname + ' · ' + p.name, from: p.price, to: n.price }); }
      const num = (id, key, min0) => { const v = g(id); if (v !== null) { const n2 = Math.max(min0 ? 0 : -1e12, Math.round(N(v))); if (Number.isFinite(n2)) up[path + key] = n2; } };
      num('beMin', 'min', 1); num('beMax', 'max', 1); num('beStep', 'qtyStep', 1); num('beUnit', 'quantity', 1); num('beLimit', 'usageLimit', 1);
      const per = g('bePeriod'); if (per) up[path + 'limitPeriod'] = per;
      const rf = g('beRefill'); if (rf !== null) up[path + 'refillable'] = rf === '1';
      const cn = g('beCancel'); if (cn !== null) up[path + 'cancelable'] = cn === '1';
      const bd = g('beBadge'); if (bd) up[path + 'badge'] = bd === '__clear' ? null : bd;
      const tm = g('beTime'); if (tm) up[path + 'avgTime'] = tm;
    });
    if (!Object.keys(up).length) return TSMX.toast('Nothing to change — fill at least one field.', 'error');
    // sanity: never leave min > max
    list.forEach(p => {
      const path = 'services/' + p.sid + '/packages/' + p.pid + '/';
      const mn = up[path + 'min'] != null ? up[path + 'min'] : p.min;
      const mx = up[path + 'max'] != null ? up[path + 'max'] : p.max;
      if (mn > mx) { up[path + 'min'] = mx; }
    });
    TSMX.closeModal();
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
      hist.forEach(h => DB().ref('price_history').push({ ...h, at: Date.now(), by: TSMX.adminEmail(), source: 'bulk' }).catch(() => { }));
      TSMX.audit('service.bulkedit', list.length + ' packages · ' + (mode || 'fields only'));
      TSMX.toast('✅ Updated ' + list.length + ' package(s) — live now', 'success');
      TSMX.stLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Bulk update failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.stBulkToggle = function (on) {
    const list = selected(); if (!list.length) return;
    const up = {}; list.forEach(p => up['services/' + p.sid + '/packages/' + p.pid + '/enabled'] = on);
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => { TSMX.audit('service.bulktoggle', (on ? 'enable ' : 'disable ') + list.length); TSMX.toast('✅ ' + list.length + ' package(s) ' + (on ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'), 'success'); TSMX.stLoad(); });
  };

  TSMX.stBulkDelete = function () {
    const list = selected(); if (!list.length) return;
    TSMX.confirm('Delete ' + list.length + ' package(s)?', 'This cannot be undone. Existing orders are not affected.', () => {
      const up = {}; list.forEach(p => up['services/' + p.sid + '/packages/' + p.pid] = null);
      DB().ref().update(up).then(() => { TSMX.audit('service.bulkdelete', list.length + ' packages'); TSMX.toast('🗑 Deleted ' + list.length, 'success'); TSMX.stLoad(); });
    }, true);
  };

  /* ---------- CLONE ---------- */
  TSMX.stCloneOne = function (key) { SEL.clear(); SEL.add(key); TSMX.stClone(); };
  TSMX.stClone = function () {
    const list = selected(); if (!list.length) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '📋 Clone ' + list.length + ' package(s)',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">Creates an exact copy of each selected package, including price, limits, badge and quantity rules.</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Copy into</label><select id="clTarget"><option value="">— same service as the original —</option>' +
        SVCS.map(s => '<option value="' + esc(s.id) + '">' + esc(s.name) + '</option>').join('') + '</select></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Name suffix</label><input id="clSuffix" value=" (Copy)"><div class="hint">Appended to each copied package name.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Price adjustment %</label><input type="number" id="clPct" value="0" step="0.01"><div class="hint">0 = same price. 10 = 10% more expensive.</div></div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="clDisabled"><span><span class="sw-t">Create the copies disabled</span><span class="sw-h">Safer — review and enable them afterwards.</span></span></label>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.stCloneGo()">📋 Clone</button>'
    });
  };
  TSMX.stCloneGo = function () {
    const list = selected();
    const target = document.getElementById('clTarget').value;
    const suffix = document.getElementById('clSuffix').value;
    const pct = TSMX.num(document.getElementById('clPct').value);
    const dis = document.getElementById('clDisabled').checked;
    TSMX.closeModal();
    const up = {};
    list.forEach(p => {
      const sid = target || p.sid;
      const key = DB().ref('services/' + sid + '/packages').push().key;
      up['services/' + sid + '/packages/' + key] = {
        name: (p.name + suffix).slice(0, 220),
        pricePerK: R4(p.price * (1 + pct / 100)),
        basePricePerK: Number.isFinite(p.base) ? R4(p.base * (1 + pct / 100)) : null,
        marginType: p.marginType, marginValue: p.marginValue,
        quantity: p.qty, min: p.min, max: p.max, qtyStep: p.step,
        avgTime: p.avgTime, description: p.description,
        enabled: !dis, cancelable: p.cancelable, refillable: p.refillable,
        usageLimit: p.usageLimit, limitPeriod: p.limitPeriod,
        badge: p.badge || null, badgeText: p.badgeText || null,
        order: 999999, createdAt: Date.now(), clonedFrom: p.sid + '/' + p.pid
      };
    });
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('service.clone', list.length + ' packages cloned' + (target ? ' into ' + target : ''));
      TSMX.toast('✅ Cloned ' + list.length + ' package(s)', 'success'); TSMX.stLoad();
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Clone failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  /* ---------- CSV IMPORT / EXPORT ---------- */
  const CSV_COLS = ['service_id', 'service_name', 'package_id', 'package_name', 'price_per_unit', 'base_price', 'margin_type', 'margin_value',
    'unit_quantity', 'min', 'max', 'qty_step', 'usage_limit', 'limit_period', 'enabled', 'refillable', 'cancelable', 'badge', 'badge_text', 'avg_time', 'description', 'sort_order'];

  TSMX.stExport = function () {
    const rows = [CSV_COLS].concat(VIEW.length ? VIEW.map(rowOf) : PKGS.map(rowOf));
    TSMX.csv('service_catalogue_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv', rows);
    TSMX.audit('service.export', rows.length - 1 + ' packages');
  };
  function rowOf(p) {
    return [p.sid, p.sname, p.pid, p.name, p.price, Number.isFinite(p.base) ? p.base : '', p.marginType, p.marginValue,
    p.qty, p.min, p.max, p.step, p.usageLimit, p.limitPeriod, p.enabled ? 'yes' : 'no', p.refillable ? 'yes' : 'no',
    p.cancelable ? 'yes' : 'no', p.badge, p.badgeText, p.avgTime, p.description, p.order];
  }

  TSMX.stImportOpen = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('services')) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      wide: true, title: '📤 Import Catalogue from CSV',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn"><b>How it works:</b> export first to get the exact format. Rows with an existing ' +
        '<code>package_id</code> are <b>updated</b>; rows with a blank <code>package_id</code> are <b>created</b>. ' +
        'A blank <code>service_id</code> with a <code>service_name</code> creates a new service.</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Paste CSV here</label><textarea id="imData" rows="10" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" placeholder="' + CSV_COLS.join(',') + '"></textarea></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Or choose a .csv file</label><input type="file" id="imFile" accept=".csv,text/csv"></div>' +
        '<label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="imDry" checked><span><span class="sw-t">Dry run first (recommended)</span><span class="sw-h">Shows exactly what would change without writing anything.</span></span></label>' +
        '<div id="imOut" style="margin-top:12px"></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.stImportGo()">▶ Run Import</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        const f = document.getElementById('imFile');
        f.onchange = () => { const file = f.files[0]; if (!file) return; const r = new FileReader(); r.onload = () => { document.getElementById('imData').value = r.result; }; r.readAsText(file); };
      }
    });
  };

  function parseCSV(text) {
    const rows = []; let row = [], cur = '', q = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const c = text[i];
      if (q) { if (c === '"') { if (text[i + 1] === '"') { cur += '"'; i++; } else q = false; } else cur += c; }
      else if (c === '"') q = true;
      else if (c === ',') { row.push(cur); cur = ''; }
      else if (c === '\n') { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); row = []; cur = ''; }
      else if (c !== '\r') cur += c;
    }
    if (cur !== '' || row.length) { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); }
    return rows.filter(r => r.some(x => String(x).trim() !== ''));
  }

  TSMX.stImportGo = function () {
    const raw = (document.getElementById('imData').value || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
    const out = document.getElementById('imOut');
    if (!raw) { out.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note n-dgr">Paste some CSV first.</div>'; return; }
    const rows = parseCSV(raw);
    if (rows.length < 2) { out.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note n-dgr">Need a header row plus at least one data row.</div>'; return; }
    const head = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
    const idx = k => head.indexOf(k);
    if (idx('package_name') < 0) { out.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-note n-dgr">Missing required column <code>package_name</code>.</div>'; return; }
    const dry = document.getElementById('imDry').checked;
    const up = {}, log = [], newSvc = {};
    let created = 0, updated = 0, skipped = 0;

    rows.slice(1).forEach((r, i) => {
      const g = k => { const j = idx(k); return j < 0 ? '' : String(r[j] == null ? '' : r[j]).trim(); };
      const name = g('package_name'); if (!name) { skipped++; return; }
      let sid = g('service_id');
      const sname = g('service_name');
      if (!sid) {
        const found = SVCS.find(s => s.name.toLowerCase() === sname.toLowerCase());
        if (found) sid = found.id;
        else if (sname) {
          sid = newSvc[sname.toLowerCase()] || (newSvc[sname.toLowerCase()] = DB().ref('services').push().key);
          up['services/' + sid + '/name'] = sname;
          up['services/' + sid + '/enabled'] = true;
          up['services/' + sid + '/order'] = 999999;
          up['services/' + sid + '/createdAt'] = Date.now();
        } else { skipped++; log.push('Row ' + (i + 2) + ': no service — skipped'); return; }
      }
      const pid = g('package_id') || DB().ref('services/' + sid + '/packages').push().key;
      const isNew = !g('package_id');
      const num = (k, d) => { const v = N(g(k)); return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d; };
      const yn = (k, d) => { const v = g(k).toLowerCase(); return v === '' ? d : (v === 'yes' || v === 'true' || v === '1'); };
      let mn = Math.max(0, Math.round(num('min', 1))), mx = Math.max(0, Math.round(num('max', 1000)));
      if (mn > mx) { const t = mn; mn = mx; mx = t; }
      const rec = {
        name: name.slice(0, 220),
        pricePerK: Math.max(0, R4(num('price_per_unit', 0))),
        basePricePerK: g('base_price') === '' ? null : Math.max(0, R4(num('base_price', 0))),
        marginType: g('margin_type') || 'none', marginValue: num('margin_value', 0),
        quantity: Math.max(1, Math.round(num('unit_quantity', 1000))),
        min: mn, max: mx,
        qtyStep: Math.max(0, Math.round(num('qty_step', 0))),
        usageLimit: Math.max(0, Math.round(num('usage_limit', 0))),
        limitPeriod: g('limit_period') || 'life',
        enabled: yn('enabled', true), refillable: yn('refillable', false), cancelable: yn('cancelable', false),
        badge: g('badge') || null, badgeText: g('badge_text') || null,
        avgTime: g('avg_time') || '', description: g('description') || '',
        order: Math.round(num('sort_order', 999999))
      };
      if (isNew) rec.createdAt = Date.now();
      Object.keys(rec).forEach(k => { up['services/' + sid + '/packages/' + pid + '/' + k] = rec[k]; });
      isNew ? created++ : updated++;
      if (log.length < 12) log.push((isNew ? '➕ create' : '✏️ update') + ' — ' + (sname || sid) + ' · ' + name + ' @ ' + TSMX.rate4(rec.pricePerK) + ' (' + rec.min + '–' + rec.max + ')');
    });

    const summary = '<div class="tsmx-note ' + (skipped ? 'n-warn' : 'n-ok') + '">' +
      '<b>' + created + '</b> to create · <b>' + updated + '</b> to update · <b>' + skipped + '</b> skipped' +
      (Object.keys(newSvc).length ? ' · <b>' + Object.keys(newSvc).length + '</b> new service(s)' : '') + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;max-height:200px;overflow:auto;background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc);padding:10px;border-radius:9px">' +
      log.map(esc).join('<br>') + (created + updated > 12 ? '<br>… and ' + (created + updated - 12) + ' more' : '') + '</div>';

    if (dry) { out.innerHTML = summary + '<div class="tsmx-note n-info" style="margin-top:10px">Dry run only — nothing was written. Untick “Dry run” and press Run Import again to apply.</div>'; return; }
    out.innerHTML = summary + '<div class="tsmx-load"><div class="tsmx-spin"></div>Writing…</div>';
    DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('service.import', created + ' created, ' + updated + ' updated');
      out.innerHTML = summary + '<div class="tsmx-note n-ok" style="margin-top:10px">✅ Import complete and live.</div>';
      TSMX.toast('✅ Imported ' + (created + updated) + ' package(s)', 'success');
      TSMX.stLoad();
    }).catch(e => { out.innerHTML = summary + '<div class="tsmx-note n-dgr" style="margin-top:10px">❌ ' + esc(e.message) + '</div>'; });
  };

  /* ---------- PRICE HISTORY ---------- */
  TSMX.phLoad = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('phList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Loading price history…');
    TSMX.guard('phList', 'TSMX.phLoad()', () => DB().ref('price_history').orderByChild('at').limitToLast(300).once('value').then(s => {
      HIST = Object.entries(s.val() || {}).map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id }, v)).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
      if (!HIST.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '🕓', 'No price changes recorded yet. Bulk edits are logged here automatically.');
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Package</th><th style="text-align:right">From</th><th style="text-align:right">To</th><th style="text-align:right">Change</th><th>By</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        HIST.map(h => {
          const diff = TSMX.num(h.to) - TSMX.num(h.from);
          const pct = TSMX.num(h.from) ? (diff / TSMX.num(h.from)) * 100 : 0;
          return '<tr><td style="font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap">' + TSMX.dt(h.at) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:12px">' + esc(h.name || '') + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.rate4(h.from) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.rate4(h.to) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:' + (diff > 0 ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') + '">' + (diff > 0 ? '+' : '') + (Math.round(pct * 10) / 10) + '%</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(h.by || '') + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }));
  };
  TSMX.phExport = () => TSMX.csv('price_history_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['When', 'Package', 'From', 'To', 'By', 'Source']].concat(HIST.map(h => [TSMX.dt(h.at), h.name, h.from, h.to, h.by, h.source || ''])));

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxServiceToolkitPage', title: 'Service Toolkit', html: HTML,
      group: 'business', icon: '🧰', label: 'Service Toolkit',
      onEnter: () => { TSMX.stLoad(); TSMX.phLoad(); }
    });
    setTimeout(mountPro, 1100);
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v29 service toolkit loaded ', 'background:#0369a1;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 14-operations-pro.js ---------- */

   v29 ADMIN · PART 14 — OPERATIONS PRO

     duplicate-link window, new-account hold
   • Quick Actions bar on the dashboard
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  /* ══════════ COMMAND PALETTE ══════════ */
  const CSS = `
  .tsmx-cp{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);z-index:99995;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:9vh 16px 16px}
  .tsmx-cp.on{display:flex}
  .tsmx-cpbox{background:var(--card-bg,#fff);border-radius:16px;width:100%;max-width:600px;box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);overflow:hidden}
  .tsmx-cpin{width:100%;padding:17px 20px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);font-size:16px;
    background:transparent;color:var(--text-primary,#0f172a);font-family:inherit;outline:none}
  .tsmx-cplist{max-height:56vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px}
  .tsmx-cpitem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-primary,#0f172a)}
  .tsmx-cpitem.sel{background:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9);color:#fff}
  .tsmx-cpitem .ic{font-size:17px;width:22px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0}

  let cpIdx = 0, cpList = [];
  function cpBuild() {
    let m = document.getElementById('tsmxCp');
    if (m) return m;
    m = document.createElement('div');
    m.className = 'tsmx-cp'; m.id = 'tsmxCp';
    m.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-cpbox">' +
      '<input class="tsmx-cpin" id="tsmxCpIn" placeholder="Type a page or action…  (try: orders, discount, coupon, rules)" autocomplete="off">' +
      '<div class="tsmx-cplist" id="tsmxCpList"></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-cpfoot"><span>↑ ↓ navigate</span><span>↵ open</span><span>esc close</span><span style="margin-left:auto">Ctrl / ⌘ + K</span></div></div>';
    m.onclick = e => { if (e.target === m) TSMX.paletteClose(); };
    document.body.appendChild(m);
    const inp = m.querySelector('#tsmxCpIn');
    inp.addEventListener('input', () => cpRender(inp.value));
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); cpIdx = Math.min(cpList.length - 1, cpIdx + 1); cpPaint(); }
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); cpIdx = Math.max(0, cpIdx - 1); cpPaint(); }
      else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); cpRun(cpIdx); }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') TSMX.paletteClose();
    });
    return m;
  }
  function cpRender(q) {
    q = (q || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    cpList = ACTIONS.filter(a => !q || (a.t + ' ' + a.s).toLowerCase().includes(q));
    cpIdx = 0; cpPaint();
  }
  function cpPaint() {
    const box = document.getElementById('tsmxCpList'); if (!box) return;
    if (!cpList.length) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:26px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-gray)">No match</div>'; return; }
    box.innerHTML = cpList.map((a, i) =>
      '<div class="tsmx-cpitem' + (i === cpIdx ? ' sel' : '') + '" onclick="TSMX.paletteRun(' + i + ')" onmouseenter="TSMX.paletteHover(' + i + ')">' +
      '<span class="ic">' + a.ic + '</span><span class="tx"><b>' + esc(a.t) + '</b><small>' + esc(a.s) + '</small></span>' +
      (i === cpIdx ? '<span class="kb">↵</span>' : '') + '</div>').join('');
    const sel = box.querySelector('.sel'); if (sel && sel.scrollIntoView) sel.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
  TSMX.paletteHover = i => { cpIdx = i; cpPaint(); };
  TSMX.paletteRun = function (i) {
    const a = cpList[i]; if (!a) return;
    TSMX.paletteClose();
    setTimeout(() => { try { a.go(); } catch (e) { TSMX.toast('Could not open: ' + e.message, 'error'); } }, 60);
  };
  TSMX.paletteOpen = function () {
    const m = cpBuild(); m.classList.add('on');
    const inp = document.getElementById('tsmxCpIn'); inp.value = ''; cpRender('');
    setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 40);
  };
  TSMX.paletteClose = () => { const m = document.getElementById('tsmxCp'); if (m) m.classList.remove('on'); };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K')) { e.preventDefault(); TSMX.paletteOpen(); }
  });

  /* ══════════ ORDER RULES / ANTI-ABUSE ══════════ */
  const RULES_HTML = `
  <div class="card">
    <h3 class="card-title">⚙️ Order Rules &amp; Anti-Abuse</h3>
    <div class="tsmx-note n-info">
      Panel-wide guard rails applied before any order is accepted. They work alongside per-package usage limits
      and the existing duplicate-order check. Every rule is enforced live on the user panel.
    </div>
    <div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Cooldown between orders (seconds)</label><input type="number" id="orCooldown" min="0" max="3600" step="1">
        <div class="hint">Stops rapid-fire ordering. 0 = no cooldown. 30–60 is typical.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum orders per user per day</label><input type="number" id="orDailyCap" min="0" step="1">
        <div class="hint">0 = unlimited. Counts every order placed since midnight.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Minimum order value (₹)</label><input type="number" id="orMinValue" min="0" step="0.01">
        <div class="hint">Blocks tiny orders. FREE packages are always exempt.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Maximum order value (₹)</label><input type="number" id="orMaxValue" min="0" step="0.01">
        <div class="hint">0 = no cap. Useful against stolen-balance abuse.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>Block the same link for (minutes)</label><input type="number" id="orLinkWindow" min="0" step="1">
        <div class="hint">Extra to the existing duplicate check — blocks the same link on ANY service for this long. 0 = off.</div></div>
      <div class="tsmx-f"><label>New account hold (hours)</label><input type="number" id="orNewHold" min="0" step="1">
        <div class="hint">New accounts cannot order for this many hours after signup. 0 = off.</div></div>
    </div>
    <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="orFreeExempt"><span><span class="sw-t">Exempt FREE packages from value rules</span><span class="sw-h">Recommended — otherwise a minimum order value would block every free service.</span></span></label>
    <label class="tsmx-sw"><input type="checkbox" id="orResellerExempt"><span><span class="sw-t">Exempt users with a reseller discount</span><span class="sw-h">Trusted resellers skip the cooldown and daily cap.</span></span></label>
    <div class="tsmx-f" style="margin-top:12px"><label>Message shown when a rule blocks an order</label>
      <input id="orMessage" placeholder="Please wait a moment before placing another order."></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px">
      <button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.orSave()">💾 Save Order Rules</button>
      <button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.orLoad()">↺ Reload</button>
      <span id="orStatus" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  TSMX.orLoad = function () {
    DB().ref('settings/orderRules').once('value').then(s => {
      const v = s.val() || {};
      const set = (i, x) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.value = x; };
      set('orCooldown', TSMX.num(v.cooldownSec)); set('orDailyCap', TSMX.num(v.dailyCap));
      set('orMinValue', TSMX.num(v.minValue)); set('orMaxValue', TSMX.num(v.maxValue));
      set('orLinkWindow', TSMX.num(v.linkWindowMin)); set('orNewHold', TSMX.num(v.newAccountHoldHours));
      set('orMessage', v.message || 'Please wait a moment before placing another order.');
      const a = document.getElementById('orFreeExempt'); if (a) a.checked = v.freeExempt !== false;
      const b = document.getElementById('orResellerExempt'); if (b) b.checked = v.resellerExempt === true;
    }).catch(() => { });
  };
  TSMX.orSave = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('settings')) return;
    const g = i => TSMX.num((document.getElementById(i) || {}).value);
    const p = {
      cooldownSec: Math.max(0, g('orCooldown')), dailyCap: Math.max(0, g('orDailyCap')),
      minValue: Math.max(0, g('orMinValue')), maxValue: Math.max(0, g('orMaxValue')),
      linkWindowMin: Math.max(0, g('orLinkWindow')), newAccountHoldHours: Math.max(0, g('orNewHold')),
      freeExempt: document.getElementById('orFreeExempt').checked,
      resellerExempt: document.getElementById('orResellerExempt').checked,
      message: document.getElementById('orMessage').value.trim() || 'Please wait a moment before placing another order.',
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/orderRules').update(p).then(() => {
      const s = document.getElementById('orStatus'); if (s) s.textContent = '✅ Live on the user panel';
      TSMX.audit('orderrules.save', 'cooldown ' + p.cooldownSec + 's · cap ' + p.dailyCap + ' · min ' + p.minValue);
      TSMX.toast('✅ Order rules are live', 'success');
    }).catch(e => TSMX.toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  /* ══════════ DASHBOARD QUICK ACTIONS ══════════ */

      '<button onclick="TSMX.paletteOpen()">⌘K  Command Palette</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxOrderSearchPage\')">🔎 Find an order</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxUsersPage\')">🧑‍💼 Users</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxServiceToolkitPage\')">🧰 Service Toolkit</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxPricingPage\')">💎 Reseller Pricing</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxAnalyticsPage\')">📈 Analytics</button>' +
      '<button onclick="navigatePage(\'tsmxBroadcastPage\')">📢 Broadcast</button>';
    dash.insertBefore(d, dash.firstChild);
  }

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxOrderRulesPage', title: 'Order Rules & Anti-Abuse', html: RULES_HTML,
      group: 'order-control', icon: '⚙️', label: 'Order Rules', onEnter: TSMX.orLoad
    });

        cooldownSec: 0, dailyCap: 0, minValue: 0, maxValue: 0, linkWindowMin: 0,
        newAccountHoldHours: 0, freeExempt: true, resellerExempt: false,
        message: 'Please wait a moment before placing another order.', seeded: true
      }).catch(() => { });
    }).catch(() => { });
  });

/* ---------- 15-support-desk-pro.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v34 ADMIN · PART 15 — SUPPORT DESK PRO
   • Priority column, filter and SLA "waiting / overdue" badges
   • Canned replies (manage + one-click insert)
   • Internal notes the customer never sees
   • Response-time target, auto-acknowledgement text, priority toggle
   • Desk KPIs: open, overdue, average first reply, satisfaction
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };

  const PRI = { low: ['Low', '#64748b'], normal: ['Normal', '#0ea5e9'], high: ['High', '#f59e0b'], urgent: ['Urgent', '#ef4444'] };

  const CSS = `
  .tsmx-sla{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-left:5px}
  .tsmx-canned{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 9px}
  .tsmx-canned button{padding:6px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);
    background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-secondary,#475569);font-family:inherit}
  .tsmx-canned button:hover{border-color:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9);color:var(--primary-color,#0ea5e9)}
  .tsmx-note-int{background:rgba(245,158,11,.09);border-left:3px solid #f59e0b;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;margin:6px 0}
  `;
  const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);

  TSMX.deskCfg = {};
  const cfg = (k, d) => { const v = (TSMX.deskCfg || {})[k]; return v === undefined || v === null || v === '' ? d : v; };

  /* ═══════ 1. TICKET LIST: priority + SLA badges + desk KPIs ═══════ */
  function slaBadge(t) {
    const status = String(t.status || '').toLowerCase();
    if (status === 'closed') return '';
    const answered = !!t.firstReplyAt || status === 'answered';
    if (answered) return '<span class="tsmx-sla" style="background:#64748b">ANSWERED</span>';
    if (!TSMX.num(t.createdAt) && !TSMX.num(t.dueAt)) return '';
    const due = TSMX.num(t.dueAt) || (TSMX.num(t.createdAt) + TSMX.num(cfg('responseHours', 6)) * 3600000);
    const left = due - Date.now();
    if (left < 0) return '<span class="tsmx-sla" style="background:#ef4444">OVERDUE ' + Math.round(-left / 3600000) + 'h</span>';
    if (left < 3600000) return '<span class="tsmx-sla" style="background:#f59e0b">DUE SOON</span>';
    return '<span class="tsmx-sla" style="background:#10b981">' + Math.round(left / 3600000) + 'h LEFT</span>';
  }

  wrap('displaySupportTicketsAdmin', orig => function (tickets) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const list = Array.isArray(tickets) ? tickets : (TSMX._deskTickets || []);
      TSMX._deskTickets = list;
      const host = document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage'); if (!host) return;
      host.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(tr => {
        tr.querySelectorAll('.tsmx-sla, .tsmx-pri').forEach(x => x.remove());          // always refresh
        const txt = tr.textContent || '';
        const t = list.find(x => x.ticketNumber && txt.indexOf(String(x.ticketNumber)) >= 0);
        if (!t) return;
        const cell = tr.querySelector('td'); if (!cell) return;
        const p = PRI[t.priority] || null;
        let html = '';
        if (p && t.priority !== 'normal') html += '<span class="tsmx-sla tsmx-pri" style="background:' + p[1] + '">' + p[0] + '</span>';
        html += slaBadge(t);
        if (t.rating) html += '<span class="tsmx-sla" style="background:#7c3aed">' + t.rating + '/5</span>';
        if (html) cell.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ' ' + html);
      });
      paintDeskKpis(list);
    }, 260);
    return r;
  });

  function paintDeskKpis(list) {
    const page = document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage'); if (!page) return;
    let box = document.getElementById('tsmxDeskKpis');
    if (!box) {
      box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'tsmxDeskKpis'; box.className = 'tsmx-grid tsmx-g4';
      box.style.margin = '0 0 16px';
      const card = page.querySelector('.card'); if (card) card.insertBefore(box, card.firstChild); else return;
    }
    const open = list.filter(t => String(t.status).toLowerCase() !== 'closed').length;
    const overdue = list.filter(t => {
      if (String(t.status).toLowerCase() === 'closed' || t.firstReplyAt) return false;
      const due = TSMX.num(t.dueAt) || (TSMX.num(t.createdAt) + TSMX.num(cfg('responseHours', 6)) * 3600000);
      return due < Date.now();
    }).length;
    const replied = list.filter(t => t.firstReplyAt && t.createdAt);
    const avg = replied.length ? replied.reduce((a, t) => a + (TSMX.num(t.firstReplyAt) - TSMX.num(t.createdAt)), 0) / replied.length : 0;
    const rated = list.filter(t => TSMX.num(t.rating) > 0);
    const csat = rated.length ? (rated.reduce((a, t) => a + TSMX.num(t.rating), 0) / rated.length) : 0;
    const k = (c, l, v, s) => '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + l + '</div><div class="k-v">' + v + '</div><div class="k-s">' + s + '</div></div>';
    box.innerHTML = k('#0ea5e9', 'Open Tickets', TSMX.int(open), list.length + ' total') +
      k(overdue ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981', 'Overdue', TSMX.int(overdue), 'past the ' + TSMX.num(cfg('responseHours', 6)) + 'h target') +
      k('#7c3aed', 'Avg First Reply', avg ? (Math.round(avg / 360000) / 10) + ' h' : '—', replied.length + ' measured') +
      k('#f59e0b', 'Satisfaction', csat ? (Math.round(csat * 10) / 10) + ' / 5' : '—', rated.length + ' rating(s)');
  }

  /* priority filter added to the toolbar */
  function mountFilter() {
    const page = document.getElementById('supportTicketsPage'); if (!page || document.getElementById('tsmxDeskFilter')) return;
    const bar = page.querySelector('.filter-bar') || page.querySelector('.card');
    if (!bar) return;
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.id = 'tsmxDeskFilter'; d.className = 'tsmx-fbar'; d.style.marginTop = '10px';
    d.innerHTML = '<div class="fld"><label>Priority</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxPriFilter">' +
      '<option value="">All priorities</option>' + Object.keys(PRI).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '">' + PRI[k][0] + '</option>').join('') +
      '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="fld"><label>SLA</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxSlaFilter">' +
      '<option value="">Any</option><option value="overdue">Overdue only</option><option value="waiting">Awaiting first reply</option></select></div>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.deskApply()">Apply</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.deskClear()">Clear</button>' +
      '<div style="flex:1"></div><span id="tsmxDeskCount" style="align-self:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>';
    bar.parentNode.insertBefore(d, bar.nextSibling);
  }
  TSMX.deskApply = function () {
    const p = (document.getElementById('tsmxPriFilter') || {}).value || '';
    const s = (document.getElementById('tsmxSlaFilter') || {}).value || '';
    const list = TSMX._deskTickets || [];
    let shown = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#supportTicketsPage tbody tr').forEach(tr => {
      const txt = tr.textContent || '';
      const t = list.find(x => x.ticketNumber && txt.indexOf(String(x.ticketNumber)) >= 0);
      let on = true;
      if (t) {
        if (p && (t.priority || 'normal') !== p) on = false;
        if (s === 'overdue') {
          const due = TSMX.num(t.dueAt) || (TSMX.num(t.createdAt) + TSMX.num(cfg('responseHours', 6)) * 3600000);
          if (t.firstReplyAt || String(t.status).toLowerCase() === 'closed' || due > Date.now()) on = false;
        }
        if (s === 'waiting' && (t.firstReplyAt || String(t.status).toLowerCase() === 'closed')) on = false;
      }
      tr.style.display = on ? '' : 'none';
      if (on) shown++;
    });
    const c = document.getElementById('tsmxDeskCount'); if (c) c.textContent = shown + ' ticket(s) shown';
  };
  TSMX.deskClear = function () {
    const a = document.getElementById('tsmxPriFilter'), b = document.getElementById('tsmxSlaFilter');
    if (a) a.value = ''; if (b) b.value = '';
    TSMX.deskApply();
  };

  /* ═══════ 2. CONVERSATION: canned replies + internal notes ═══════ */
  wrap('renderAdminTicketReplyArea', orig => function (t) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => mountReplyTools(t), 200);
    return r;
  });

  function mountReplyTools(t) {
    const area = document.getElementById('adminTicketReplyArea') ||
                 document.querySelector('#adminTicketConvoPage .ticket-reply-area') ||
                 document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoPage');
    if (!area || document.getElementById('tsmxCanned')) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'tsmxCanned';
    const list = Object.entries(cfg('canned', {}) || {});
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin:0 0 6px">Quick replies</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-canned">' +
      (list.length ? list.map(([k, v]) => '<button type="button" onclick="TSMX.insertCanned(\'' + esc(k) + '\')">' + esc(v.title || k) + '</button>').join('')
        : '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">No quick replies yet — add them in Ticket Settings.</span>') +
      '<button type="button" onclick="navigatePage(\'ticketSettingsPage\')">&#9881;&#65039; Manage</button></div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:9px">' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.addInternalNote()">&#128273; Add internal note</button>' +
      '<select class="tsmx-sel" id="tsmxSetPri" style="min-width:150px" onchange="TSMX.setPriority()">' +
      '<option value="">Set priority…</option>' + Object.keys(PRI).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '">' + PRI[k][0] + '</option>').join('') +
      '</select></div>';
    area.insertBefore(box, area.firstChild);
    TSMX._deskTicket = t;
  }

  TSMX.insertCanned = function (key) {
    const c = (cfg('canned', {}) || {})[key]; if (!c) return;
    const ed = document.getElementById('adminTicketReplyEditor') ||
               document.querySelector('#adminTicketConvoPage [contenteditable]');
    if (!ed) return TSMX.toast('Reply box not found', 'error');
    const t = TSMX._deskTicket || {};
    const body = String(c.body || '')
      .replace(/\{name\}/g, t.userName || 'there')
      .replace(/\{ticket\}/g, t.ticketNumber || '')
      .replace(/\{order\}/g, (t.orderIds && t.orderIds[0]) || '');
    ed.innerHTML = (ed.innerHTML && ed.textContent.trim() ? ed.innerHTML + '<br>' : '') + esc(body).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    ed.focus();
  };

  TSMX.setPriority = function () {
    const v = (document.getElementById('tsmxSetPri') || {}).value; if (!v) return;
    const t = TSMX._deskTicket; if (!t || !t.id) return;
    DB().ref('tickets/' + t.id + '/priority').set(v).then(() => {
      TSMX.audit('ticket.priority', v, t.ticketNumber || t.id);
      TSMX.toast('Priority set to ' + PRI[v][0], 'success');
    });
  };

  TSMX.addInternalNote = function () {
    const t = TSMX._deskTicket; if (!t || !t.id) return TSMX.toast('Open a ticket first', 'error');
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '🔐 Internal Note (the customer never sees this)',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-warn">Visible only to your admin team. Use it for context, refund decisions or hand-overs.</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Note</label><textarea id="tsmxIntNote" rows="4" placeholder="e.g. Refunded manually, provider issue on their side"></textarea></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.saveInternalNote()">💾 Save Note</button>'
    });
  };
  TSMX.saveInternalNote = function () {
    const t = TSMX._deskTicket;
    const v = (document.getElementById('tsmxIntNote') || {}).value.trim();
    if (!v || !t) return;
    DB().ref('tickets/' + t.id + '/internalNotes').push({
      text: v, by: TSMX.adminEmail(), at: Date.now()
    }).then(() => { TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('🔐 Internal note saved', 'success'); TSMX.audit('ticket.note', v.slice(0, 60), t.ticketNumber || t.id); renderNotes(t); });
  };
  function renderNotes(t) {
    if (!t || !t.id) return;
    DB().ref('tickets/' + t.id + '/internalNotes').once('value').then(s => {
      const host = document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoThread') || document.getElementById('adminTicketConvoPage');
      if (!host) return;
      let box = document.getElementById('tsmxIntNotes');
      if (!box) { box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'tsmxIntNotes'; host.parentNode.insertBefore(box, host.nextSibling); }
      const rows = [];
      s.forEach(c => { const v = c.val() || {}; rows.push('<div class="tsmx-note-int">🔐 <b>' + esc(v.by || '') + '</b> · ' + TSMX.dt(v.at) + '<br>' + esc(v.text) + '</div>'); });
      box.innerHTML = rows.length ? '<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-gray);margin:10px 0 4px">Internal notes</div>' + rows.join('') : '';
    }).catch(() => { });
  }

  /* stamp the first reply time + clear the user's unread flag correctly */
  wrap('submitAdminTicketReply', orig => async function () {
    const t = TSMX._deskTicket || {};
    const out = await orig.apply(this, arguments);
    try {
      if (t.id) {
        const up = { userHasUnread: true, adminHasUnread: false, updatedAt: Date.now() };
        if (!t.firstReplyAt) up.firstReplyAt = Date.now();
        await DB().ref('tickets/' + t.id).update(up);
      }
    } catch (e) { }
    return out;
  });
  wrap('loadAdminTicketConversation', orig => function (id) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      DB().ref('tickets/' + id).once('value').then(s => {
        TSMX._deskTicket = Object.assign({ id: id }, s.val() || {});
        mountReplyTools(TSMX._deskTicket);
        renderNotes(TSMX._deskTicket);
        DB().ref('tickets/' + id + '/adminHasUnread').set(false).catch(() => { });
      }).catch(() => { });
    }, 400);
    return r;
  });

  /* ═══════ 3. TICKET SETTINGS: SLA, ack text, priority, canned replies ═══════ */
  function mountSettings() {
    const page = document.getElementById('ticketSettingsPage');
    if (!page || document.getElementById('tsmxDeskSettings')) return;
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'card'; d.id = 'tsmxDeskSettings';
    d.innerHTML = '<h3 class="card-title">🎧 Support Desk Standards</h3>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">These control what the customer is promised and how your team replies. Everything is live on the user panel.</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>First-reply target (hours)</label><input type="number" id="dkHours" min="1" max="168" step="1">' +
      '<div class="hint">Shown to the customer as “we reply within …” and used for the OVERDUE badge.</div></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Show priority selector</label><select id="dkPri"><option value="1">Yes — let customers choose</option><option value="0">No — everything is Normal</option></select></div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Ask for a proof link</label><select id="dkProof"><option value="1">Yes — screenshot field</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Automatic acknowledgement posted in the ticket</label>' +
      '<textarea id="dkAck" rows="3" placeholder="Leave blank for the default message, or type “off” to disable."></textarea>' +
      '<div class="hint">Posted instantly so the customer knows the ticket was received.</div></div>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.deskSave()">💾 Save Desk Standards</button>' +
      '<span id="dkStatus" style="margin-left:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)"></span>' +
      '<h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin:22px 0 10px">⚡ Quick Replies</h4>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">One click inserts these into the reply box. Use <code>{name}</code>, <code>{ticket}</code> and <code>{order}</code> as placeholders.</div>' +
      '<div class="tsmx-toolbar"><button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.cannedAdd()">➕ Add Quick Reply</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.cannedSeed()">✨ Add 5 Starter Replies</button></div>' +
      '<div id="dkCanned"></div>';
    page.appendChild(d);
    TSMX.deskLoad();
  }

  TSMX.deskLoad = function () {
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem').once('value').then(s => {
      const v = s.val() || {}; TSMX.deskCfg = v;
      const set = (i, x) => { const e = document.getElementById(i); if (e) e.value = x; };
      set('dkHours', TSMX.num(v.responseHours, 6));
      set('dkPri', v.priorityEnabled === false ? '0' : '1');
      set('dkProof', v.proofEnabled === false ? '0' : '1');
      set('dkAck', v.ackMessage || '');
      paintCanned(v.canned || {});
    }).catch(() => { });
  };
  TSMX.deskSave = function () {
    if (!TSMX.require('tickets')) return;
    const p = {
      responseHours: Math.max(1, TSMX.num((document.getElementById('dkHours') || {}).value, 6)),
      priorityEnabled: (document.getElementById('dkPri') || {}).value === '1',
      proofEnabled: (document.getElementById('dkProof') || {}).value === '1',
      ackMessage: (document.getElementById('dkAck') || {}).value.trim(),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem').update(p).then(() => {
      const e = document.getElementById('dkStatus'); if (e) e.textContent = '✅ Live on the user panel';
      TSMX.audit('desk.settings', p.responseHours + 'h target');
      TSMX.toast('✅ Support desk standards saved', 'success');
    });
  };
  function paintCanned(map) {
    const box = document.getElementById('dkCanned'); if (!box) return;
    const rows = Object.entries(map || {});
    if (!rows.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '⚡', 'No quick replies yet.');
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Message</th><th style="text-align:right">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      rows.map(([k, v]) => '<tr><td style="font-weight:700">' + esc(v.title || k) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-size:12px;max-width:420px">' + esc(String(v.body || '').slice(0, 150)) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:right"><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.cannedAdd(\'' + esc(k) + '\')">✏️</button> ' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.cannedDel(\'' + esc(k) + '\')">🗑</button></td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  TSMX.cannedAdd = function (key) {
    const cur = (cfg('canned', {}) || {})[key] || {};
    TSMX.modal({
      title: key ? '✏️ Edit Quick Reply' : '➕ New Quick Reply',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Title (button label)</label><input id="ckTitle" value="' + esc(cur.title || '') + '" placeholder="e.g. Order is processing"></div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-f"><label>Message</label><textarea id="ckBody" rows="5" placeholder="Hi {name}, your order {order} is being processed…">' + esc(cur.body || '') + '</textarea>' +
        '<div class="hint">Placeholders: {name} {ticket} {order}</div></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="tsmx-btn ok" onclick="TSMX.cannedSave(' + (key ? "'" + key + "'" : 'null') + ')">💾 Save</button>'
    });
  };
  TSMX.cannedSave = function (key) {
    const title = (document.getElementById('ckTitle') || {}).value.trim();
    const body = (document.getElementById('ckBody') || {}).value.trim();
    if (!title || !body) return TSMX.toast('Title and message are required', 'error');
    const k = key || ('c' + Date.now().toString(36));
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem/canned/' + k).set({ title: title, body: body, updatedAt: Date.now() })
      .then(() => { TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('✅ Quick reply saved', 'success'); TSMX.deskLoad(); });
  };
  TSMX.cannedDel = key => TSMX.confirm('Delete this quick reply?', 'It will no longer appear in the reply box.', () =>
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem/canned/' + key).remove().then(() => { TSMX.toast('🗑 Deleted', 'success'); TSMX.deskLoad(); }), true);
  TSMX.cannedSeed = function () {
    const seed = {
      c_ack: { title: 'Working on it', body: 'Hi {name}, thank you for your patience. We are checking your request right now and will update you shortly.' },
      c_proc: { title: 'Order is processing', body: 'Hi {name}, order {order} is currently being processed by the provider. Delivery usually completes within the stated average time. We will keep an eye on it for you.' },
      c_refill: { title: 'Refill started', body: 'Hi {name}, a refill has been started for order {order}. Please allow some time for the count to recover.' },
      c_refund: { title: 'Refunded to wallet', body: 'Hi {name}, we have refunded this order back to your wallet balance. You can use it for a new order straight away. Sorry for the trouble.' },
      c_close: { title: 'Closing the ticket', body: 'Hi {name}, we believe this is now resolved so we are closing ticket {ticket}. If anything is still wrong, just reply here and it will reopen.' }
    };
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem/canned').update(seed).then(() => { TSMX.toast('✨ 5 starter replies added', 'success'); TSMX.deskLoad(); });
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem').on('value', s => { TSMX.deskCfg = s.val() || {}; }, () => { });
    const nav = window.navigatePage;
    if (typeof nav === 'function') {
      window.navigatePage = function (pg) {
        const r = nav.apply(this, arguments);
        if (pg === 'ticketSettingsPage') setTimeout(mountSettings, 300);
        if (pg === 'supportTicketsPage') setTimeout(() => { mountFilter(); paintDeskKpis(TSMX._deskTickets || []); }, 300);
        return r;
      };
    }
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v34 support desk pro loaded ', 'background:#db2777;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 16-platforms.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v35 ADMIN · PART 16 — SOCIAL NETWORKS (PLATFORM MANAGER)
     • Create / edit / reorder / enable / disable every platform shown in
       the user panel's "Select a Social Network" bar
     • Icon: built-in brand SVG logo · emoji · or image URL
     • Assign services to platforms (one by one, in bulk, or auto-detect)
     • Full control of where the bar appears and how it looks
     • Live preview of exactly what the user will see
   DB:  platforms/{id}          {name,logo,emoji,img,color,keywords,order,enabled}
        services/{id}/platform  = platform id  ('__none__' = deliberately none)
        settings/platformBar    = display configuration
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };

  const DEF_CFG = {
    enabled: true, onOrder: true, onCatalog: true, autoDetect: true,
    title: 'Select a Social Network', allLabel: 'All Services',
    showAll: true, showCounts: true, hideEmpty: true, showUnassigned: false,
    filterSearch: true, remember: true
  };

  const PM = TSMX.PM = { list: [], byId: {}, cfg: Object.assign({}, DEF_CFG), services: [], counts: {}, filter: '' };

  /* ─────────────── the same auto-detect table the user panel uses ─────────────── */
  const AUTO = {
    instagram: ['instagram', 'insta', ' ig ', 'reels'],
    facebook: ['facebook', ' fb ', 'fb '],
    youtube: ['youtube', 'yt ', 'shorts'],
    telegram: ['telegram', ' tg '],
    telegram_premium: ['telegram premium'],
    whatsapp: ['whatsapp', 'wa '],
    tiktok: ['tiktok', 'tik tok'],
    twitter: ['twitter'],
    x_services: [' x ', 'x services'],
    linkedin: ['linkedin'], spotify: ['spotify'], snapchat: ['snapchat', 'snap '],
    discord: ['discord'], pinterest: ['pinterest'], reddit: ['reddit'],
    threads: ['threads'], likee: ['likee'],
    website: ['website', 'traffic', 'seo'], google: ['google', 'gmb', 'maps'],
    apple: ['apple', 'itunes', 'app store'], crypto: ['crypto', 'bitcoin', 'coin'],
    mobile_app: ['app install', 'mobile app', 'play store']
  };

  function platformOf(svc) {
    if (!svc) return '';
    const manual = String(svc.platform || '').trim();
    if (manual === '__none__') return '';
    if (manual && PM.byId[manual]) return manual;
    if (!PM.cfg.autoDetect) return '';
    const logo = String(svc.logo || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (logo && logo !== 'none') { const hit = PM.list.find(p => String(p.logo || '').toLowerCase() === logo); if (hit) return hit.id; }
    const name = ' ' + String(svc.name || '').toLowerCase() + ' ';
    for (let i = 0; i < PM.list.length; i++) {
      const p = PM.list[i];
      const words = String(p.keywords || '').split(',').map(w => w.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)
        .concat(AUTO[String(p.logo || '').toLowerCase()] || AUTO[String(p.name || '').toLowerCase()] || []);
      for (let k = 0; k < words.length; k++) if (words[k] && name.indexOf(words[k]) >= 0) return p.id;
    }
    return '';
  }
  TSMX.platformOf = platformOf;

  function iconHTML(p) {
    if (!p) return '<span style="font-size:19px">🌐</span>';
    if (p.img) return '<img src="' + esc(p.img) + '" alt="" style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;display:block">';
    if (p.emoji) return '<span style="font-size:22px;line-height:1">' + esc(p.emoji) + '</span>';
    const logo = String(p.logo || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (logo && logo !== 'none' && window.getServiceLogoHTML) { const h = window.getServiceLogoHTML(logo); if (h) return h; }
    return '<span style="font-size:20px;line-height:1">🌐</span>';
  }
  TSMX.platformIcon = iconHTML;

  /* ─────────────── styles ─────────────── */
  const CSS = `
  .pm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(232px,1fr));gap:12px}
  .pm-card{border:2px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:14px;padding:13px;background:var(--card-bg,#fff);position:relative}
  .pm-card.off{opacity:.55;border-style:dashed}
  .pm-card .pm-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .pm-card .pm-h .svc-logo-badge{width:28px;height:28px}
