  .pm-card .pm-n{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-primary,#0f172a);line-height:1.2}
  .pm-card .pm-s{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:2px}
  .pm-card .pm-a{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}
  .pm-dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:-1px;margin-right:5px}
  .pm-prev{border:2px dashed var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc)}
  .pm-prev-scroll{display:flex;gap:9px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 2px 8px}
  .pm-chip{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:84px;padding:10px 9px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);
    background:#fff;text-align:center}
  .pm-chip .c-i{height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:4px}
  .pm-chip .c-i .svc-logo-badge{width:28px;height:28px}
  .pm-chip .c-i img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover}
  .pm-chip .c-n{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#0f172a;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .pm-chip .c-c{font-size:9.5px;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
  .pm-pick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(94px,1fr));gap:8px;max-height:260px;overflow:auto;padding:4px}
  .pm-pick button{padding:9px 5px;border:2px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#475569;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px}
  .pm-pick button.on{border-color:#0ea5e9;background:rgba(14,165,233,.08);color:#0369a1}
  .pm-pick button .svc-logo-badge{width:26px;height:26px}
  `;
  const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'tsmxPlatformStyles'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);

  /* ─────────────── page markup ─────────────── */
  const HTML = [
    '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">🌐 <b>Social Networks</b> are the icon buttons your users tap at the top of the New Order form and on the Services page ',
    '(All Services · Instagram · Facebook · YouTube · WhatsApp · Telegram …). Create the networks you sell, give each one an icon, then assign every ',
    'service to its network below. Tapping a network shows only that network&#39;s services and packages.</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">⚙️ Display settings</h3>',
      '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Show the network bar</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmEnabled"><option value="1">Yes — show it</option><option value="0">No — hide it completely</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>On the New Order form</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmOnOrder"><option value="1">Show</option><option value="0">Hide</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>On the Services page</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmOnCatalog"><option value="1">Show</option><option value="0">Hide</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Bar title</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmTitle" maxlength="60" placeholder="Select a Social Network"></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>&quot;All&quot; button label</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmAllLabel" maxlength="40" placeholder="All Services"></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Show the &quot;All&quot; button</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmShowAll"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Show service counts</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmShowCounts"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Hide empty networks</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmHideEmpty"><option value="1">Yes — hide a network with 0 services</option><option value="0">No — always show</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Show an &quot;Others&quot; button</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmShowUnassigned"><option value="0">No</option><option value="1">Yes — for services with no network</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Auto-detect network</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmAutoDetect"><option value="1">Yes — guess from logo &amp; name</option><option value="0">No — only what I assign</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Filter search results too</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmFilterSearch"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>&nbsp;</label><button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.pmSaveCfg()">💾 Save display settings</button></div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">👁️ Live preview — exactly what the user sees</h3>',
      '<div class="pm-prev">',
        '<div id="pmPrevTitle" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:8px"></div>',
        '<div class="pm-prev-scroll" id="pmPreview"></div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🌐 Networks</h3>',
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:13px">',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.pmEdit()">＋ Add network</button>',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.pmSeed()">⚡ Add the standard set</button>',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.pmAutoAssign()">🪄 Auto-assign services</button>',
      '</div>',
      '<div id="pmList"></div>',
    '</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🔗 Service → Network assignment</h3>',
      '<div class="tsmx-toolbar">',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmSvcSearch" placeholder="Search services…" oninput="TSMX.pmPaintServices()"></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Bulk action</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmBulkTarget"></select></div>',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.pmBulkApply()">Apply to checked</button>',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.pmExport()">⬇️ CSV</button>',
      '</div>',
      '<div id="pmServices"></div>',
    '</div>'
  ].join('');

  /* ─────────────── loading ─────────────── */
  function sortRows(obj) {
    return Object.entries(obj || {}).filter(([, v]) => v && typeof v === 'object')
      .map(([id, v]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, v, { _o: Number.isFinite(Number(v.order)) ? Number(v.order) : 999999 }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a._o - b._o) || String(a.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || '')));
  }

  TSMX.pmLoad = function () {
    const list = document.getElementById('pmList'); if (list) TSMX.loading(list, 'Loading networks…');
    DB().ref('platforms').on('value', s => {
      PM.list = sortRows(s.val());
      PM.byId = {}; PM.list.forEach(p => { PM.byId[p.id] = p; });
      paintAll();
    }, e => { const l = document.getElementById('pmList'); if (l) TSMX.fail(l, e, 'TSMX.pmLoad()'); });

    DB().ref('settings/platformBar').on('value', s => { PM.cfg = Object.assign({}, DEF_CFG, s.val() || {}); paintCfg(); paintAll(); }, () => { });

    DB().ref('services').on('value', s => {
      const v = s.val() || {};
      PM.services = Object.entries(v).filter(([, x]) => x && typeof x === 'object')
        .map(([id, x]) => Object.assign({ id: id }, x))
        .sort((a, b) => (TSMX.num(a.order, 9e5) - TSMX.num(b.order, 9e5)) || String(a.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.name || '')));
      paintAll();
    }, () => { });
  };

  function recount() {
    const c = {}; let un = 0;
    PM.services.filter(s => s.enabled !== false).forEach(s => { const p = platformOf(s); if (p) c[p] = (c[p] || 0) + 1; else un++; });
    c.__unassigned__ = un; PM.counts = c;
  }

  function paintAll() { recount(); paintList(); paintPreview(); TSMX.pmPaintServices(); paintBulkTarget(); }

  function paintCfg() {
    const set = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.value = v ? '1' : '0'; };
    const txt = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.value = v || ''; };
    set('pmEnabled', PM.cfg.enabled); set('pmOnOrder', PM.cfg.onOrder); set('pmOnCatalog', PM.cfg.onCatalog);
    set('pmShowAll', PM.cfg.showAll); set('pmShowCounts', PM.cfg.showCounts); set('pmHideEmpty', PM.cfg.hideEmpty);
    set('pmShowUnassigned', PM.cfg.showUnassigned); set('pmAutoDetect', PM.cfg.autoDetect); set('pmFilterSearch', PM.cfg.filterSearch);
    txt('pmTitle', PM.cfg.title); txt('pmAllLabel', PM.cfg.allLabel);
  }

  TSMX.pmSaveCfg = function () {
    const g = id => (document.getElementById(id) || {}).value === '1';
    const t = id => String((document.getElementById(id) || {}).value || '').slice(0, 60);
    const cfg = {
      enabled: g('pmEnabled'), onOrder: g('pmOnOrder'), onCatalog: g('pmOnCatalog'),
      showAll: g('pmShowAll'), showCounts: g('pmShowCounts'), hideEmpty: g('pmHideEmpty'),
      showUnassigned: g('pmShowUnassigned'), autoDetect: g('pmAutoDetect'), filterSearch: g('pmFilterSearch'),
      title: t('pmTitle') || DEF_CFG.title, allLabel: t('pmAllLabel') || DEF_CFG.allLabel,
      remember: true, updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
    DB().ref('settings/platformBar').update(cfg)
      .then(() => { TSMX.toast('Display settings saved — the user panel updated instantly.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.settings', 'Updated the social-network bar settings'); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  function paintList() {
    const box = document.getElementById('pmList'); if (!box) return;
    if (!PM.list.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-empty"><span class="e-i">🌐</span><div style="font-weight:700">No networks yet</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12.5px">Tap <b>Add the standard set</b> to create Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram and more in one click.</div></div>';
      return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="pm-grid">' + PM.list.map((p, i) => {
      const n = PM.counts[p.id] || 0;
      return '<div class="pm-card' + (p.enabled === false ? ' off' : '') + '">' +
        '<div class="pm-h">' + iconHTML(p) +
        '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><div class="pm-n">' + esc(p.name || 'Network') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="pm-s"><span class="pm-dot" style="background:' + esc(p.color || '#0ea5e9') + '"></span>' + n + ' service' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') +
        (p.enabled === false ? ' · <b style="color:#ef4444">hidden</b>' : '') + '</div></div></div>' +
        (p.keywords ? '<div class="pm-s" style="margin-top:8px">🔎 ' + esc(p.keywords) + '</div>' : '') +
        '<div class="pm-a">' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.pmMove(\'' + esc(p.id) + '\',-1)"' + (i === 0 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>↑</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.pmMove(\'' + esc(p.id) + '\',1)"' + (i === PM.list.length - 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>↓</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" onclick="TSMX.pmEdit(\'' + esc(p.id) + '\')">✏️ Edit</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm ' + (p.enabled === false ? 'ok' : 'warn') + '" onclick="TSMX.pmToggle(\'' + esc(p.id) + '\')">' +
        (p.enabled === false ? 'Show' : 'Hide') + '</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.pmDelete(\'' + esc(p.id) + '\')">🗑️</button>' +
        '</div></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }

  function paintPreview() {
    const box = document.getElementById('pmPreview'); if (!box) return;
    const t = document.getElementById('pmPrevTitle');
    if (t) t.textContent = PM.cfg.enabled ? (PM.cfg.title || DEF_CFG.title) : 'The network bar is switched OFF — users will not see it.';
    const chip = (name, icon, count) =>
      '<div class="pm-chip"><div class="c-i">' + icon + '</div><div class="c-n">' + esc(name) + '</div>' +
      (PM.cfg.showCounts ? '<div class="c-c">' + count + (count === 1 ? ' service' : ' services') + '</div>' : '') + '</div>';
    let html = '';
    if (PM.cfg.showAll) html += chip(PM.cfg.allLabel || 'All Services', '<span style="font-size:21px">🗂️</span>', PM.services.filter(s => s.enabled !== false).length);
    PM.list.filter(p => p.enabled !== false).forEach(p => {
      const n = PM.counts[p.id] || 0;
      if (PM.cfg.hideEmpty && !n) return;
      html += chip(p.name || 'Network', iconHTML(p), n);
    });
    if (PM.cfg.showUnassigned && PM.counts.__unassigned__) html += chip('Others', '<span style="font-size:21px">📦</span>', PM.counts.__unassigned__);
    box.innerHTML = html || '<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:#64748b;padding:8px">Nothing to show yet — add a network below.</div>';
  }

  function paintBulkTarget() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('pmBulkTarget'); if (!sel) return;
    const cur = sel.value;
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Move checked services to… —</option>' +
      PM.list.map(p => '<option value="' + esc(p.id) + '">' + esc(p.name || p.id) + '</option>').join('') +
      '<option value="__none__">No network (hide from every network)</option>' +
      '<option value="">Clear assignment (use auto-detect)</option>';
    if (cur) sel.value = cur;
  }

  TSMX.pmPaintServices = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('pmServices'); if (!box) return;
    const q = String((document.getElementById('pmSvcSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const rows = PM.services.filter(s => !q || String(s.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0);
    if (!rows.length) { TSMX.empty(box, '🔗', 'No services found'); return; }
    const opts = sid => '<option value="">— auto-detect —</option>' +
      PM.list.map(p => '<option value="' + esc(p.id) + '">' + esc(p.name || p.id) + '</option>').join('') +
      '<option value="__none__">No network</option>';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th style="width:34px"><input type="checkbox" onchange="TSMX.pmCheckAll(this.checked)"></th>' +
      '<th>Service</th><th>Packages</th><th>Assigned network</th><th>Shown under</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      rows.map(s => {
        const resolved = platformOf(s);
        const p = PM.byId[resolved];
        const manual = String(s.platform || '');
        const pkgs = Object.keys(s.packages || {}).length;
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td><input type="checkbox" class="pm-chk" data-sid="' + esc(s.id) + '"></td>' +
          '<td><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">' + (window.getServiceLogoHTML ? (getServiceLogoHTML(s.logo) || '') : '') +
          '<div><div style="font-weight:700">' + esc(s.name || s.id) + '</div>' +
          (s.enabled === false ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">disabled</span>' : '') + '</div></div></td>' +
          '<td>' + pkgs + '</td>' +
          '<td><select class="tsmx-sel" style="min-width:170px" onchange="TSMX.pmAssign(\'' + esc(s.id) + '\',this.value)">' + opts(s.id) + '</select></td>' +
          '<td>' + (p ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-blue">' + esc(p.name || p.id) + '</span>' + (manual && manual !== '__none__' ? '' : ' <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#64748b">(auto)</span>')
            : manual === '__none__' ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">none</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">unassigned</span>') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    // set the current value of each select after insertion (avoids HTML escaping issues)
    rows.forEach(s => { });
    box.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach((tr, i) => {
      const sel = tr.querySelector('select'); if (sel) sel.value = String(rows[i].platform || '');
    });
  };

  TSMX.pmCheckAll = on => document.querySelectorAll('.pm-chk').forEach(c => { c.checked = !!on; });

  TSMX.pmAssign = function (sid, pid) {
    DB().ref('services/' + sid + '/platform').set(pid || null)
      .then(() => { TSMX.toast('Network updated — live in the user panel.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.assign', 'Service ' + sid + ' → ' + (pid || 'auto')); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pmBulkApply = function () {
    const val = (document.getElementById('pmBulkTarget') || {}).value || '';
    const ids = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pm-chk:checked'), c => c.dataset.sid);
    if (!ids.length) return TSMX.toast('Tick at least one service first.', 'error');
    const up = {}; ids.forEach(id => { up['services/' + id + '/platform'] = val || null; });
    DB().ref().update(up)
      .then(() => { TSMX.toast(ids.length + ' service(s) updated.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.bulk', ids.length + ' services → ' + (val || 'auto')); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pmAutoAssign = function () {
    if (!PM.list.length) return TSMX.toast('Create at least one network first.', 'error');
    const up = {}; let n = 0;
    PM.services.forEach(s => {
      if (String(s.platform || '')) return;              // never overwrite a manual choice
      const guess = platformOf(s);
      if (guess) { up['services/' + s.id + '/platform'] = guess; n++; }
    });
    if (!n) return TSMX.toast('Nothing to do — every service already has a network.', 'success');
    TSMX.confirm('Auto-assign services', 'Assign <b>' + n + '</b> service(s) to the network detected from their logo and name? Services you assigned by hand are never changed.', () => {
      DB().ref().update(up)
        .then(() => { TSMX.toast(n + ' service(s) auto-assigned.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.auto', n + ' services auto-assigned'); })
        .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
    });
  };

  TSMX.pmExport = () => TSMX.csv('service_networks_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['Service', 'Service ID', 'Packages', 'Assigned', 'Resolved network']].concat(
      PM.services.map(s => {
        const r = PM.byId[platformOf(s)];
        return [s.name || '', s.id, Object.keys(s.packages || {}).length, s.platform || 'auto', r ? (r.name || r.id) : 'none'];
      })));

  /* ─────────────── create / edit ─────────────── */
  /* these are declared with const at script top level, so they live in the
     lexical scope and are NOT on window — read them through the bridge */
  const LOGO_KEYS = () => {
    const k = TSMX.G('SERVICE_LOGO_KEYS');
    if (k && k.length) return Array.prototype.slice.call(k);
    const d = TSMX.G('SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS');
    return d ? ['none'].concat(Object.keys(d)) : ['none'];
  };
  const LOGO_LABEL = k => { const d = TSMX.G('SERVICE_LOGO_DEFS') || {}; return d[k] ? d[k].label : k; };

  TSMX.pmEdit = function (id) {
    const p = id ? (PM.byId[id] || {}) : { color: '#0ea5e9', enabled: true, logo: 'none' };
    const keys = LOGO_KEYS();
    const picker = '<div class="pm-pick" id="pmLogoPick">' + keys.map(k =>
      '<button type="button" data-k="' + esc(k) + '" class="' + (String(p.logo || 'none') === k ? 'on' : '') + '" onclick="TSMX.pmPickLogo(\'' + esc(k) + '\')">' +
      (k === 'none' ? '<span style="font-size:20px">🚫</span>' : (window.getServiceLogoHTML ? getServiceLogoHTML(k) : '')) +
      '<span>' + esc(k === 'none' ? 'None' : LOGO_LABEL(k)) + '</span></button>').join('') + '</div>';

    TSMX.modal({
      title: id ? '✏️ Edit network' : '＋ Add a social network',
      wide: true,
      body:
        '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g2">' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Display name *</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmFName" maxlength="40" placeholder="Instagram" value="' + esc(p.name || '') + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Highlight colour</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmFColor" type="color" value="' + esc(p.color || '#0ea5e9') + '" style="height:42px;padding:4px"></div>' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Emoji icon (optional)</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmFEmoji" maxlength="4" placeholder="📸" value="' + esc(p.emoji || '') + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Image icon URL (optional)</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pmFImg" placeholder="https://…/icon.png" value="' + esc(p.img || '') + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="fld" style="grid-column:1/-1"><label>Auto-detect keywords (comma separated)</label>' +
        '<input class="tsmx-in" id="pmFKeys" placeholder="instagram, insta, reels" value="' + esc(p.keywords || '') + '">' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray);margin-top:4px">Any service whose name contains one of these words is placed in this network automatically (only when auto-detect is ON and the service has no manual assignment).</div></div>' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Visible to users</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pmFEnabled"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No — hidden</option></select></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:12px"><label class="tsmx-lbl" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;color:var(--text-gray)">Brand logo</label>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray);margin:4px 0 8px">Priority: image URL → emoji → brand logo below.</div>' + picker + '</div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" id="pmSaveBtn">💾 Save network</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('pmFEnabled'); if (e) e.value = p.enabled === false ? '0' : '1';
        PM._pickedLogo = String(p.logo || 'none');
        document.getElementById('pmSaveBtn').onclick = () => TSMX.pmSave(id);
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.pmPickLogo = function (k) {
    PM._pickedLogo = k;
    document.querySelectorAll('#pmLogoPick button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.k === k));
  };

  TSMX.pmSave = function (id) {
    const v = i => String((document.getElementById(i) || {}).value || '').trim();
    const name = v('pmFName').slice(0, 40);
    if (!name) return TSMX.toast('A display name is required.', 'error');
    const img = v('pmFImg');
    if (img && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(img) && !/^data:image\//i.test(img)) return TSMX.toast('The image URL must start with http:// or https://', 'error');
    const row = {
      name: name,
      color: v('pmFColor') || '#0ea5e9',
      emoji: v('pmFEmoji').slice(0, 4),
      img: img,
      keywords: v('pmFKeys').slice(0, 200),
      logo: PM._pickedLogo || 'none',
      enabled: (document.getElementById('pmFEnabled') || {}).value !== '0',
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    };
    const ref = id ? DB().ref('platforms/' + id) : DB().ref('platforms').push();
    if (!id) { row.order = PM.list.length; row.createdAt = Date.now(); }
    (id ? ref.update(row) : ref.set(row))
      .then(() => { TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('Network saved — live in the user panel.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.save', (id ? 'Updated' : 'Created') + ' network ' + name); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pmToggle = function (id) {
    const p = PM.byId[id]; if (!p) return;
    DB().ref('platforms/' + id + '/enabled').set(p.enabled === false)
      .then(() => TSMX.toast(p.enabled === false ? 'Network is now visible.' : 'Network hidden from users.', 'success'))
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pmMove = function (id, dir) {
    const i = PM.list.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
    const j = i + dir;
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= PM.list.length) return;
    const ids = PM.list.map(p => p.id);
    ids.splice(j, 0, ids.splice(i, 1)[0]);
    const up = {}; ids.forEach((x, n) => { up['platforms/' + x + '/order'] = n; });
    DB().ref().update(up).catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pmDelete = function (id) {
    const p = PM.byId[id]; if (!p) return;
    const n = PM.counts[id] || 0;
    TSMX.confirm('Delete network', 'Delete <b>' + esc(p.name || id) + '</b>?' +
      (n ? '<br><br>' + n + ' service(s) are shown under it — they will simply move back to "All Services". No service or package is deleted.' : ''), () => {
        const up = { ['platforms/' + id]: null };
        PM.services.forEach(s => { if (String(s.platform || '') === id) up['services/' + s.id + '/platform'] = null; });
        DB().ref().update(up)
          .then(() => { TSMX.toast('Network deleted.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.delete', 'Deleted network ' + (p.name || id)); })
          .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
      }, true);
  };

  /* ─────────────── one-click standard set ─────────────── */
  const SEED = [
    ['Instagram', 'instagram', '#d62976', 'instagram,insta,reels'],
    ['Facebook', 'facebook', '#1877f2', 'facebook,fb'],
    ['YouTube', 'youtube', '#ff0000', 'youtube,yt,shorts'],
    ['WhatsApp', 'whatsapp', '#25d366', 'whatsapp'],
    ['Telegram', 'telegram', '#229ed9', 'telegram,tg'],
    ['TikTok', 'tiktok', '#000000', 'tiktok,tik tok'],
    ['Twitter / X', 'twitter', '#1d9bf0', 'twitter,x services'],
    ['Threads', 'threads', '#111111', 'threads'],
    ['Snapchat', 'snapchat', '#fffc00', 'snapchat,snap'],
    ['LinkedIn', 'linkedin', '#0a66c2', 'linkedin'],
    ['Spotify', 'spotify', '#1db954', 'spotify'],
    ['Discord', 'discord', '#5865f2', 'discord'],
    ['Website Traffic', 'website', '#0ea5e9', 'website,traffic,seo'],
    ['Google', 'google', '#4285f4', 'google,maps,gmb'],
    ['Others', 'none', '#64748b', '']
  ];

  TSMX.pmSeed = function () {
    TSMX.confirm('Add the standard set',
      'Create the ' + SEED.length + ' most common networks (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, TikTok and more) with their brand logos? Networks you already created are skipped.', () => {
        const have = PM.list.map(p => String(p.name || '').toLowerCase());
        const up = {}; let n = PM.list.length, added = 0;
        SEED.forEach(([name, logo, color, keys]) => {
          if (have.indexOf(name.toLowerCase()) >= 0) return;
          const k = DB().ref('platforms').push().key;
          up['platforms/' + k] = { name: name, logo: logo, color: color, keywords: keys, emoji: '', img: '', enabled: true, order: n++, createdAt: Date.now() };
          added++;
        });
        if (!added) return TSMX.toast('Every standard network already exists.', 'success');
        DB().ref().update(up)
          .then(() => { TSMX.toast(added + ' networks created. Now press "Auto-assign services".', 'success'); TSMX.audit('platform.seed', added + ' standard networks created'); })
          .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not save: ' + e.message, 'error'));
      });
  };

  /* ─────────────── platform picker inside the service modals ─────────────── */
  function optionsHTML(sel) {
    return '<option value="">— auto-detect from logo &amp; name —</option>' +
      PM.list.map(p => '<option value="' + esc(p.id) + '"' + (String(sel || '') === p.id ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(p.name || p.id) + '</option>').join('') +
      '<option value="__none__"' + (String(sel || '') === '__none__' ? ' selected' : '') + '>No network</option>';
  }

  function mountServiceField(prefix, sel) {
    const logoSel = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ServiceLogo'); if (!logoSel) return;
    const holder = logoSel.closest('.form-group') || logoSel.parentNode;
    let fld = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ServicePlatformWrap');
    if (!fld) {
      fld = document.createElement('div');
      fld.className = 'form-group'; fld.id = prefix + 'ServicePlatformWrap';
      fld.innerHTML = '<label class="form-label">🌐 Social Network</label>' +
        '<select class="form-select" id="' + prefix + 'ServicePlatform"></select>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5">Which network button this service appears under in the user panel.</div>';
      holder.parentNode.insertBefore(fld, holder.nextSibling);
    }
    const s = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ServicePlatform');
    if (s) s.innerHTML = optionsHTML(sel);
  }

  wrap('openAddServiceModal', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => mountServiceField('new', ''), 60);
    return r;
  });
  wrap('openEditServiceModal', orig => function (service) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => mountServiceField('edit', service && service.platform), 60);
    return r;
  });
  /** read by the source-patched addNewService / updateService */
  TSMX.pickedPlatform = function (prefix) {
    const e = document.getElementById(prefix + 'ServicePlatform');
    return e ? String(e.value || '') : '';
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxPlatformsPage', title: 'Social Networks', html: HTML,
      group: 'business', icon: '🌐', label: 'Social Networks',
      onEnter: () => { TSMX.pmLoad(); paintCfg(); }
    });
    // keep the platform list warm so the service modals can offer it instantly
    setTimeout(() => {
      DB().ref('platforms').on('value', s => {
        PM.list = sortRows(s.val()); PM.byId = {}; PM.list.forEach(p => { PM.byId[p.id] = p; });
      }, () => { });
      DB().ref('settings/platformBar').on('value', s => { PM.cfg = Object.assign({}, DEF_CFG, s.val() || {}); }, () => { });
    }, 900);
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v35 social networks loaded ', 'background:#d62976;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 17-wishlist.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v35 ADMIN · PART 17 — WISHLIST INTELLIGENCE
     • See every package your users saved to their wishlist
     • Ranked demand list: which package is wanted by the most users
     • Per-user view: open any user and see their exact wishlist
     • Conversion: how many wishlist savers actually ordered it
     • Act on it: notify the savers, jump to the package, export CSV
   Reads   wishlist/{serviceId__packageId}/{uid}   (written by the user panel)
   and falls back to scanning users/{uid}/favourites for older accounts.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();

  const WL = TSMX.WL = { rows: [], byPkg: {}, byUser: {}, services: {}, orders: [], q: '', tab: 'demand', loaded: false };

  const CSS = `
  .wl-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
  .wl-tabs button{padding:9px 15px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);background:var(--card-bg,#fff);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-secondary,#475569)}
  .wl-tabs button.on{border-color:#f59e0b;background:rgba(245,158,11,.1);color:#92400e}
  .wl-rank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;
    background:var(--border-light,#f1f5f9);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text-secondary,#475569)}
  .wl-rank.top{background:#f59e0b;color:#fff}
  .wl-users{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);line-height:1.6}
  `;
  const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'tsmxWishlistStyles'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);

  const HTML = [
    '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">⭐ Every time a user taps <b>save</b> on a package it is recorded here. ',
    'This is real demand data: the packages at the top are the ones your users want most — perfect for a price drop, a coupon or a broadcast.</div>',
    '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g4" id="wlKpis" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>',
    '<div class="wl-tabs">',
      '<button id="wlTabDemand" class="on" onclick="TSMX.wlTab(\'demand\')">🔥 Most wanted packages</button>',
      '<button id="wlTabUsers" onclick="TSMX.wlTab(\'users\')">👥 By user</button>',
      '<button id="wlTabRecent" onclick="TSMX.wlTab(\'recent\')">🕒 Recently saved</button>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="tsmx-toolbar">',
      '<div class="fld"><label>Search</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="wlSearch" placeholder="Package, service, user email…" style="min-width:240px" oninput="TSMX.wlRender()"></div>',
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.wlLoad(true)">🔄 Refresh</button>',
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.wlExport()">⬇️ Export CSV</button>',
    '</div>',
    '<div id="wlBody"></div>'
  ].join('');

  /* ─────────────── load ─────────────── */
  TSMX.wlLoad = function (force) {
    const body = document.getElementById('wlBody');
    if (WL.loaded && !force) { TSMX.wlRender(); return; }
    if (body) TSMX.loading(body, 'Reading wishlists…');

    Promise.all([
      DB().ref('wishlist').once('value').then(s => s.val() || {}).catch(() => ({})),
      DB().ref('services').once('value').then(s => s.val() || {}).catch(() => ({})),
      DB().ref('users').once('value').then(s => s.val() || {}).catch(() => ({}))
    ]).then(([mirror, services, users]) => {
      WL.services = services;
      // orders live under users/{uid}/orders in this panel
      WL.orders = [];
      Object.keys(users || {}).forEach(uid => {
        const uo = (users[uid] || {}).orders || {};
        Object.keys(uo).forEach(k => { const o = uo[k]; if (o && typeof o === 'object') WL.orders.push({ userId: uid, packageId: o.packageId, serviceId: o.serviceId, status: o.status }); });
      });

      const rows = [];
      const seen = {};
      Object.keys(mirror || {}).forEach(key => {
        const holders = mirror[key] || {};
        Object.keys(holders).forEach(uid => {
          const r = holders[uid] || {};
          const parts = String(key).split('__');
          rows.push({
            key: key, sid: r.sid || parts[0], pid: r.pid || parts[1], uid: uid,
            email: r.email || ((users[uid] || {}).email || ''),
            user: r.name || (users[uid] || {}).name || '',
            pkg: r.pkg || '', service: r.service || '', price: TSMX.num(r.price), at: TSMX.num(r.at)
          });
          seen[key + '|' + uid] = 1;
        });
      });
      // fallback: accounts saved before the mirror existed
      Object.keys(users || {}).forEach(uid => {
        const favs = (users[uid] || {}).favourites || {};
        Object.keys(favs).forEach(key => {
          if (seen[key + '|' + uid]) return;
          const f = favs[key] || {}, parts = String(key).split('__');
          rows.push({
            key: key, sid: f.sid || parts[0], pid: f.pid || parts[1], uid: uid,
            email: (users[uid] || {}).email || '', user: (users[uid] || {}).name || '',
            pkg: f.name || '', service: f.service || '', price: TSMX.num(f.price), at: TSMX.num(f.at), legacy: true
          });
        });
      });

      // enrich from the live service tree
      rows.forEach(r => {
        const svc = WL.services[r.sid];
        const pkg = svc && svc.packages ? svc.packages[r.pid] : null;
        r.serviceName = (svc && svc.name) || r.service || 'Removed service';
        r.pkgName = (pkg && pkg.name) || r.pkg || 'Removed package';
        r.live = !!(svc && pkg && svc.enabled !== false && pkg.enabled !== false);
        r.rate = pkg ? TSMX.num(pkg.pricePerK) : NaN;
        r.gone = !pkg || !svc;
      });

      WL.rows = rows;
      WL.byPkg = {};
      rows.forEach(r => {
        const g = WL.byPkg[r.key] || (WL.byPkg[r.key] = {
          key: r.key, sid: r.sid, pid: r.pid, pkgName: r.pkgName, serviceName: r.serviceName,
          rate: r.rate, live: r.live, gone: r.gone, users: [], last: 0
        });
        g.users.push(r);
        g.last = Math.max(g.last, r.at);
      });
      WL.byUser = {};
      rows.forEach(r => { (WL.byUser[r.uid] = WL.byUser[r.uid] || { uid: r.uid, email: r.email, name: r.user, items: [] }).items.push(r); });

      // conversion: did the saver ever order that package?
      const ordered = {};
      WL.orders.forEach(o => { if (o.userId && o.packageId) ordered[o.userId + '|' + o.packageId] = 1; });
      Object.values(WL.byPkg).forEach(g => {
        g.converted = g.users.filter(u => ordered[u.uid + '|' + g.pid]).length;
      });

      WL.loaded = true;
      TSMX.wlRender();
    }).catch(e => { if (body) TSMX.fail(body, e, 'TSMX.wlLoad(true)'); });
  };

  TSMX.wlTab = function (t) {
    WL.tab = t;
    ['demand', 'users', 'recent'].forEach(x => {
      const b = document.getElementById('wlTab' + x.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + x.slice(1));
      if (b) b.classList.toggle('on', x === t);
    });
    TSMX.wlRender();
  };

  function q() { return String((document.getElementById('wlSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase().trim(); }

  TSMX.wlRender = function () {
    const body = document.getElementById('wlBody'); if (!body) return;
    const kp = document.getElementById('wlKpis');
    const term = q();

    if (kp) {
      const uniqUsers = Object.keys(WL.byUser).length;
      const week = Date.now() - 7 * 864e5;
      const recent = WL.rows.filter(r => r.at >= week).length;
      const conv = Object.values(WL.byPkg).reduce((a, g) => a + (g.converted || 0), 0);
      kp.innerHTML =
        kpi('Saved items', WL.rows.length, 'across all accounts', '#f59e0b') +
        kpi('Users with a wishlist', uniqUsers, 'active savers', '#0ea5e9') +
        kpi('Distinct packages', Object.keys(WL.byPkg).length, 'wanted right now', '#7c3aed') +
        kpi('Saved this week', recent, conv + ' later ordered', '#10b981');
    }

    if (!WL.rows.length) {
      TSMX.empty(body, '⭐', 'No wishlist activity yet',
        'As soon as a user taps the save button on a package it appears here.');
      return;
    }

    if (WL.tab === 'demand') {
      let list = Object.values(WL.byPkg).sort((a, b) => b.users.length - a.users.length || b.last - a.last);
      if (term) list = list.filter(g => (g.pkgName + ' ' + g.serviceName).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) >= 0);
      if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(body, '🔍', 'Nothing matches that search');
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th style="width:44px">#</th><th>Package</th><th>Service</th><th style="text-align:right">Saved by</th>' +
        '<th style="text-align:right">Ordered</th><th style="text-align:right">Rate</th><th>Status</th><th>Action</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.map((g, i) =>
          '<tr>' +
          '<td><span class="wl-rank' + (i < 3 ? ' top' : '') + '">' + (i + 1) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><div style="font-weight:700">' + esc(g.pkgName) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="wl-users">' + esc(g.users.slice(0, 3).map(u => u.email || u.name || u.uid).join(', ')) +
          (g.users.length > 3 ? ' +' + (g.users.length - 3) + ' more' : '') + '</div></td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(g.serviceName) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800">' + g.users.length + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right">' + (g.converted || 0) + ' <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">(' +
          Math.round(((g.converted || 0) / g.users.length) * 100) + '%)</span></td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-family:monospace">' + (Number.isFinite(g.rate) ? (TSMX.rate4 ? TSMX.rate4(g.rate) : g.rate.toFixed(4)) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (g.gone ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">removed</span>' : g.live ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">live</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">disabled</span>') + '</td>' +
          '<td><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.wlPkg(\'' + esc(g.key) + '\')">View</button></td>' +
          '</tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
      return;
    }

    if (WL.tab === 'users') {
      let list = Object.values(WL.byUser).sort((a, b) => b.items.length - a.items.length);
      if (term) list = list.filter(u => ((u.email || '') + ' ' + (u.name || '') + ' ' + u.uid).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) >= 0);
      if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(body, '🔍', 'No user matches that search');
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>User</th><th style="text-align:right">Items</th><th>Wants</th><th>Last saved</th><th>Action</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.map(u =>
          '<tr>' +
          '<td><div style="font-weight:700">' + esc(u.name || 'User') + '</div><div class="wl-users">' + esc(u.email || u.uid) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:800">' + u.items.length + '</td>' +
          '<td class="wl-users">' + esc(u.items.slice(0, 4).map(i => i.pkgName).join(' · ')) + (u.items.length > 4 ? ' …' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(Math.max.apply(null, u.items.map(i => i.at))) + '</td>' +
          '<td><button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.wlUser(\'' + esc(u.uid) + '\')">Open</button></td>' +
          '</tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
      return;
    }

    let list = WL.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
    if (term) list = list.filter(r => (r.pkgName + ' ' + r.serviceName + ' ' + (r.email || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(term) >= 0);
    list = list.slice(0, 400);
    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(body, '🔍', 'Nothing matches that search');
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>When</th><th>User</th><th>Package</th><th>Service</th><th>Status</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + list.map(r =>
        '<tr><td style="white-space:nowrap;font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(r.at) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.email || r.user || r.uid) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:700">' + esc(r.pkgName) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.serviceName) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (r.gone ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">removed</span>' : r.live ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">live</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">disabled</span>') + '</td></tr>').join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>';
  };

  function kpi(l, v, s, c) {
    return '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + esc(l) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="k-v">' + esc(String(v)) + '</div><div class="k-s">' + esc(s) + '</div></div>';
  }

  TSMX.wlPkg = function (key) {
    const g = WL.byPkg[key]; if (!g) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '⭐ ' + (g.pkgName || 'Package'),
      wide: true,
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info"><b>' + g.users.length + '</b> user(s) saved this package · <b>' + (g.converted || 0) +
        '</b> of them already ordered it · service <b>' + esc(g.serviceName) + '</b>' +
        (Number.isFinite(g.rate) ? ' · current rate <b>' + (TSMX.rate4 ? TSMX.rate4(g.rate) : g.rate) + '</b>' : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>User</th><th>Email</th><th>Saved</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        g.users.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at).map(u =>
          '<tr><td>' + esc(u.user || 'User') + '</td><td>' + esc(u.email || u.uid) + '</td><td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(u.at) + '</td></tr>').join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Close</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.wlCopyEmails(\'' + esc(key) + '\')">📋 Copy emails</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.wlNotify(\'' + esc(key) + '\')">📣 Notify these users</button>'
    });
  };

  TSMX.wlUser = function (uid) {
    const u = WL.byUser[uid]; if (!u) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '⭐ Wishlist of ' + (u.name || u.email || uid),
      wide: true,
      body: '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr><th>Package</th><th>Service</th><th>Rate</th><th>Saved</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        u.items.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at).map(i =>
          '<tr><td style="font-weight:700">' + esc(i.pkgName) + '</td><td>' + esc(i.serviceName) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-family:monospace">' + (Number.isFinite(i.rate) ? (TSMX.rate4 ? TSMX.rate4(i.rate) : i.rate.toFixed(4)) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(i.at) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (i.gone ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-red">removed</span>' : i.live ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">live</span>' : '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">disabled</span>') + '</td></tr>').join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Close</button>' +
        (TSMX.ucOpen ? '<button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.closeModal();TSMX.ucOpen(\'' + esc(uid) + '\')">👤 Open full user profile</button>' : '')
    });
  };

  TSMX.wlCopyEmails = function (key) {
    const g = WL.byPkg[key]; if (!g) return;
    const txt = g.users.map(u => u.email).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
      TSMX.toast('Copied ' + g.users.length + ' email address(es).', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
      TSMX.modal({ title: 'Emails', body: '<textarea class="tsmx-in" style="width:100%;height:150px">' + esc(txt) + '</textarea>' });
    }
  };

  /** Send an in-app broadcast to exactly the users who saved this package. */
  TSMX.wlNotify = function (key) {
    const g = WL.byPkg[key]; if (!g) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '📣 Notify the users who want "' + (g.pkgName || '') + '"',
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">This message appears in the notification bell of the ' + g.users.length + ' user(s) who saved this package.</div>' +
        '<div class="fld"><label>Title</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="wlNTitle" style="width:100%" maxlength="80" value="Good news about ' + esc(g.pkgName || 'your saved package') + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="fld" style="margin-top:10px"><label>Message</label><textarea class="tsmx-in" id="wlNMsg" style="width:100%;height:110px" maxlength="500">The package you saved is available now. Open your wishlist to order it.</textarea></div>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" id="wlNSend">📣 Send</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        document.getElementById('wlNSend').onclick = () => {
          const t = String((document.getElementById('wlNTitle') || {}).value || '').trim();
          const m = String((document.getElementById('wlNMsg') || {}).value || '').trim();
          if (!t || !m) return TSMX.toast('Title and message are both required.', 'error');
          const up = {}; const now = Date.now();
          g.users.forEach(u => {
            const k = DB().ref('notifications').push().key;
            up['notifications/' + k] = {
              user_id: u.uid, title: t, message: m, type: 'wishlist',
              is_read: false, read: false, created_at: now, timestamp: now,
              source: 'wishlist', meta: { packageId: g.pid, serviceId: g.sid }
            };
          });
          DB().ref().update(up)
            .then(() => { TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('Sent to ' + g.users.length + ' user(s).', 'success'); TSMX.audit('wishlist.notify', 'Notified ' + g.users.length + ' savers of ' + g.pkgName); })
            .catch(e => TSMX.toast('Could not send: ' + e.message, 'error'));
        };
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.wlExport = function () {
    TSMX.csv('wishlist_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
      [['Saved at', 'User', 'Email', 'UID', 'Package', 'Service', 'Service ID', 'Package ID', 'Current rate', 'Status']].concat(
        WL.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at).map(r => [
          TSMX.dt(r.at), r.user || '', r.email || '', r.uid, r.pkgName, r.serviceName, r.sid, r.pid,
          Number.isFinite(r.rate) ? r.rate.toFixed(4) : '', r.gone ? 'removed' : r.live ? 'live' : 'disabled'
        ])));
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxWishlistPage', title: 'Wishlist Intelligence', html: HTML,
      group: 'business', icon: '⭐', label: 'Wishlist Insights',
      onEnter: () => TSMX.wlLoad()
    });
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v35 wishlist intelligence loaded ', 'background:#f59e0b;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();


/* ---------- 18-payments-pro.js ---------- */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   v37 ADMIN · PART 18 — PAYMENTS PRO & PANEL CONTROLS
     • Real brand icons for payment methods (UPI, PhonePe, Paytm, GPay,
       Amazon Pay, BHIM, Navi, BharatPe, Binance, USDT …) — picked from a
       grid inside the Add / Edit Payment Method modal
     • Auto-approve WAIT TIME per method (seconds or minutes) — the wallet
       is credited automatically only after that wait
     • A sweeper that finishes any scheduled approval whose user is offline
     • Welcome-popup control (on/off, delay, show once per N days)
     • Ticket auto-reply delay
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const TSMX = window.TSMX, esc = TSMX.esc;
  const DB = () => TSMX.db();
  const wrap = (n, f) => { if (typeof window[n] !== 'function') return false; window[n] = f(window[n]); return true; };
  const B = () => window.TSMBRANDS;

  const CSS = `
  .pmb-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(92px,1fr));gap:8px;max-height:280px;overflow:auto;padding:4px;
    border:1px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);border-radius:12px;background:var(--border-light,#f8fafc)}
  .pmb-grid button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 5px;border-radius:11px;cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid transparent;background:var(--card-bg,#fff);font-family:inherit;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#475569;text-align:center}
  .pmb-grid button.on{border-color:#0ea5e9;background:rgba(14,165,233,.09);color:#0369a1}
  .pmb-grid .topsmm-brand{width:30px;height:30px}
  `;
  const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'tsmxPayStyles'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);

  /* ═══════ 1. BRAND PICKER INSIDE THE PAYMENT-METHOD MODAL ═══════ */
  let picked = '';
  TSMX.pmPickBrand = function (k) {
    picked = (picked === k) ? '' : k;
    document.querySelectorAll('#pmBrandGrid button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.k === picked));
    const hid = document.getElementById('pmBrand'); if (hid) hid.value = picked;
    const prev = document.getElementById('pmBrandPreview');
    if (prev) prev.innerHTML = picked && B() ? B().plain(picked, 34) : '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">No brand icon — the emoji below will be used.</span>';
  };
  TSMX.pmBrandValue = () => picked;

  function mountBrandPicker(current) {
    const iconInput = document.getElementById('pmIcon');
    if (!iconInput || !B()) return;
    picked = String(current || '');
    let box = document.getElementById('pmBrandBlock');
    if (!box) {
      const holder = iconInput.closest('.form-group') || iconInput.parentNode;
      box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'form-group'; box.id = 'pmBrandBlock';
      box.innerHTML =
        '<label class="form-label">💳 Brand icon (recommended)</label>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-bottom:7px">Pick the real logo of this payment method. It is shown to your users instead of an emoji.</div>' +
        '<div id="pmBrandPreview" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:8px;min-height:36px"></div>' +
        '<div class="pmb-grid" id="pmBrandGrid"></div>' +
        '<input type="hidden" id="pmBrand" value="">';
      holder.parentNode.insertBefore(box, holder);
    }
    const grid = document.getElementById('pmBrandGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = B().keys.map(k =>
      '<button type="button" data-k="' + esc(k) + '" class="' + (k === picked ? 'on' : '') + '" onclick="TSMX.pmPickBrand(\'' + esc(k) + '\')">' +
      B().plain(k, 30) + '<span>' + esc(B().label(k)) + '</span></button>').join('');
    const hid = document.getElementById('pmBrand'); if (hid) hid.value = picked;
    const prev = document.getElementById('pmBrandPreview');
    if (prev) prev.innerHTML = picked ? B().plain(picked, 34) : '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-gray)">No brand icon — the emoji below will be used.</span>';
    // the emoji field is now optional
    iconInput.required = false;
    if (!iconInput.value) iconInput.value = '💳';
  }

  /* ═══════ 2. AUTO-APPROVE WAIT TIME ═══════ */
  function mountDelay(method) {
    const modeSel = document.getElementById('pmApprovalMode');
    if (!modeSel) return;
    let box = document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayBlock');
    if (!box) {
      const holder = modeSel.closest('.form-group') || modeSel.parentNode;
      box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'form-group'; box.id = 'pmAutoDelayBlock';
      box.innerHTML =
        '<label class="form-label">⏱️ Auto-approve after</label>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">' +
        '<input type="number" class="form-input" id="pmAutoDelayValue" min="0" step="1" style="max-width:130px" placeholder="0">' +
        '<select class="form-select" id="pmAutoDelayUnit" style="max-width:150px">' +
        '<option value="sec">seconds</option><option value="min">minutes</option><option value="hour">hours</option></select>' +
        '<span id="pmAutoDelayHint" style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b)"></span></div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray,#64748b);margin-top:5px">0 = credit the wallet instantly. Any other value holds the request as pending and credits it automatically after that wait, with a live countdown for the user.</div>';
      holder.parentNode.insertBefore(box, holder.nextSibling);
      ['pmAutoDelayValue', 'pmAutoDelayUnit'].forEach(id => {
        const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.addEventListener('input', paintDelayHint);
        if (e) e.addEventListener('change', paintDelayHint);
      });
      modeSel.addEventListener('change', paintDelayHint);
    }
    const secs = TSMX.num(method && method.autoApproveDelaySec, 0);
    const v = document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayValue'), u = document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayUnit');
    if (secs && secs % 3600 === 0) { v.value = secs / 3600; u.value = 'hour'; }
    else if (secs && secs % 60 === 0) { v.value = secs / 60; u.value = 'min'; }
    else { v.value = secs || ''; u.value = 'sec'; }
    paintDelayHint();
  }
  function paintDelayHint() {
    const hint = document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayHint'); if (!hint) return;
    const mode = (document.getElementById('pmApprovalMode') || {}).value;
    const s = TSMX.pmDelaySeconds();
    const block = document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayBlock');
    if (block) block.style.opacity = mode === 'manual' ? '.45' : '1';
    hint.textContent = mode === 'manual' ? 'Manual approval — the wait time is ignored.'
      : !s ? 'Instant credit.'
        : s < 60 ? 'Credited ' + s + ' seconds after submission.'
          : s < 3600 ? 'Credited ' + Math.round(s / 60) + ' minutes after submission.'
            : 'Credited ' + (Math.round(s / 360) / 10) + ' hours after submission.';
  }
  TSMX.pmDelaySeconds = function () {
    const v = TSMX.num((document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayValue') || {}).value);
    const u = (document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayUnit') || {}).value || 'sec';
    if (v <= 0) return 0;
    return Math.round(v * (u === 'hour' ? 3600 : u === 'min' ? 60 : 1));
  };

  wrap('openAddPaymentMethodModal', orig => function () {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => { mountBrandPicker(''); mountDelay(null); }, 70);
    return r;
  });
  wrap('openEditPaymentMethodModal', orig => function (method) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => { mountBrandPicker(method && method.brand); mountDelay(method); }, 70);
    return r;
  });
  /* read by the source-patched save handler */
  TSMX.pmExtras = () => ({ brand: picked || null, autoApproveDelaySec: TSMX.pmDelaySeconds() });

  /* show the brand icon in the admin list too */
  wrap('displayPaymentMethods', orig => function (methods) {
    const r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!B()) return;
      (methods || []).forEach(m => {
        if (!m || !m.brand) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('#paymentMethodsContainer div').forEach(d => {
          if (d.dataset.brandDone) return;
          const t = (d.textContent || '').trim();
          if (d.children.length === 0 && t.indexOf(m.name) >= 0) {
            d.dataset.brandDone = '1';
            d.innerHTML = B().plain(m.brand, 22) + ' <span style="vertical-align:middle">' + esc(m.name) + '</span>';
          }
        });
      });
    }, 60);
    return r;
  });

  /* ═══════ 3. SWEEPER — finish scheduled approvals even if the user left ═══════ */
  TSMX.autoApproveSweep = function () {
    const now = Date.now();
    return DB().ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByChild('status').equalTo('pending').once('value').then(s => {
      const v = s.val() || {}; const jobs = [];
      Object.keys(v).forEach(k => {
        const r = v[k] || {};
        if (!r.autoApprove || !r.autoApproveAt || r.autoApproveAt > now || !r.userId || !r.requestKey) return;
        jobs.push({ adminKey: k, uid: r.userId, key: r.requestKey, amount: TSMX.num(r.amount) });
      });
      if (!jobs.length) return 0;
      return jobs.reduce((p, j) => p.then(() => creditOne(j)), Promise.resolve()).then(() => jobs.length);
    }).catch(() => 0);
  };
  function creditOne(j) {
    const base = 'users/' + j.uid + '/fundRequests/' + j.key;
    return DB().ref(base + '/status').transaction(v => (v === 'pending' ? 'approved' : undefined)).then(res => {
      if (!res.committed) return;
      return DB().ref('users/' + j.uid + '/balance').transaction(v => TSMX.num(v) + j.amount).then(() => {
        const now = Date.now(), up = {};
        up[base + '/approvedAt'] = now; up[base + '/balanceCredited'] = true; up[base + '/autoApproved'] = true;
        up['adminPanel/fundRequests/' + j.adminKey + '/status'] = 'approved';
        up['adminPanel/fundRequests/' + j.adminKey + '/approvedAt'] = now;
        up['adminPanel/fundRequests/' + j.adminKey + '/autoApproved'] = true;
        const nk = DB().ref('notifications').push().key;
        up['notifications/' + nk] = {
          user_id: j.uid, title: '✅ Funds Added', message: 'Your payment of ₹' + j.amount + ' was approved automatically and added to your balance.',
          type: 'fund', is_read: false, read: false, created_at: now, timestamp: now
        };
        return DB().ref().update(up);
      });
    }).catch(e => console.warn('[TSMX sweep]', e.message));
  }

  /* ═══════ 4. PANEL CONTROLS PAGE ═══════ */
  const HTML = [
    '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">⚙️ Small switches that make the website feel professional: the welcome popup, the automatic ticket reply, and the wait time before an automatic payment approval.</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🪧 Welcome popup (special updates)</h3>',
      '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Show the popup</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pcPopupOn"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No — never show it</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Delay before it appears</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pcPopupDelay" type="number" min="0" step="100" placeholder="1000"><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-gray);margin-top:4px">milliseconds (1000 = 1 second)</div></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>How often</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pcPopupOnce"><option value="0">Every time the site opens</option><option value="1">Once per user per day</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Days between repeats</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pcPopupDays" type="number" min="1" step="1" placeholder="1"></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>&nbsp;</label><button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.pcSavePopup()">💾 Save popup settings</button></div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">🎫 Automatic ticket reply</h3>',
      '<div class="tsmx-grid tsmx-g3">',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Send an automatic reply</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pcAckOn"><option value="1">Yes</option><option value="0">No</option></select></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>Send it after</label><div style="display:flex;gap:7px"><input class="tsmx-in" id="pcAckDelay" type="number" min="0" step="1" placeholder="0" style="max-width:110px"><select class="tsmx-sel" id="pcAckUnit" style="max-width:130px"><option value="sec">seconds</option><option value="min">minutes</option></select></div></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>First-reply promise (hours)</label><input class="tsmx-in" id="pcSla" type="number" min="1" step="1" placeholder="6"></div>',
        '<div class="fld" style="grid-column:1/-1"><label>Message</label><textarea class="tsmx-in" id="pcAckMsg" style="width:100%;height:80px" placeholder="Ticket received. Our team will reply within 6 hours."></textarea></div>',
        '<div class="fld"><label>&nbsp;</label><button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.pcSaveTickets()">💾 Save ticket settings</button></div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>',

    '<div class="card"><h3 class="card-title">⚡ Scheduled automatic approvals</h3>',
      '<div id="pcAutoList"></div>',
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px">',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.pcLoadAuto()">🔄 Refresh</button>',
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" onclick="TSMX.pcRunSweep()">⚡ Approve everything that is due now</button>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ].join('');

  TSMX.pcLoad = function () {
    DB().ref('settings/updatePopup').once('value').then(s => {
      const c = Object.assign({ enabled: true, delayMs: 1000, once: false, onceDays: 1 }, s.val() || {});
      const g = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.value = v; };
      g('pcPopupOn', c.enabled === false ? '0' : '1'); g('pcPopupDelay', TSMX.num(c.delayMs, 1000));
      g('pcPopupOnce', c.once ? '1' : '0'); g('pcPopupDays', TSMX.num(c.onceDays, 1));
    }).catch(() => { });
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem').once('value').then(s => {
      const c = s.val() || {};
      const g = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.value = v; };
      g('pcAckOn', c.ackEnabled === false ? '0' : '1');
      const secs = TSMX.num(c.ackDelaySec, 0);
      if (secs && secs % 60 === 0) { g('pcAckDelay', secs / 60); g('pcAckUnit', 'min'); } else { g('pcAckDelay', secs || 0); g('pcAckUnit', 'sec'); }
      g('pcSla', TSMX.num(c.responseHours, 6));
      g('pcAckMsg', c.ackMessage || '');
    }).catch(() => { });
    TSMX.pcLoadAuto();
  };

  TSMX.pcSavePopup = function () {
    const v = id => (document.getElementById(id) || {}).value;
    DB().ref('settings/updatePopup').update({
      enabled: v('pcPopupOn') === '1',
      delayMs: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(v('pcPopupDelay'), 1000)),
      once: v('pcPopupOnce') === '1',
      onceDays: Math.max(1, TSMX.num(v('pcPopupDays'), 1)),
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    }).then(() => { TSMX.toast('Popup settings saved.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('popup.settings', 'Welcome popup updated'); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pcSaveTickets = function () {
    const v = id => (document.getElementById(id) || {}).value;
    const n = TSMX.num(v('pcAckDelay'));
    const secs = v('pcAckUnit') === 'min' ? n * 60 : n;
    DB().ref('settings/ticketSystem').update({
      ackEnabled: v('pcAckOn') === '1',
      ackDelaySec: Math.max(0, Math.round(secs)),
      responseHours: Math.max(1, TSMX.num(v('pcSla'), 6)),
      ackMessage: String(v('pcAckMsg') || '').slice(0, 400),
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    }).then(() => { TSMX.toast('Ticket settings saved.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('ticket.settings', 'Auto-reply settings updated'); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.pcLoadAuto = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('pcAutoList'); if (!box) return;
    TSMX.loading(box, 'Reading scheduled approvals…');
    DB().ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').orderByChild('status').equalTo('pending').once('value').then(s => {
      const v = s.val() || {};
      const rows = Object.keys(v).map(k => Object.assign({ id: k }, v[k])).filter(r => r.autoApprove);
      if (!rows.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '⚡', 'No payment is waiting for an automatic approval');
      const now = Date.now();
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="tsmx-tblwrap"><table class="tsmx-tbl"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>User</th><th>Method</th><th style="text-align:right">Amount</th><th>Submitted</th><th>Credits in</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        rows.sort((a, b) => TSMX.num(a.autoApproveAt) - TSMX.num(b.autoApproveAt)).map(r => {
          const left = TSMX.num(r.autoApproveAt) - now;
          return '<tr><td>' + esc(r.userEmail || r.userId || '') + '</td><td>' + esc(r.method || '') + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700">' + TSMX.money(r.amount) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:11.5px">' + TSMX.dt(r.createdAt) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + (left <= 0 ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-amber">due now</span>' : '<b>' + Math.ceil(left / 1000) + 's</b>') + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    }).catch(e => TSMX.fail(box, e, 'TSMX.pcLoadAuto()'));
  };

  TSMX.pcRunSweep = function () {
    TSMX.autoApproveSweep().then(n => {
      TSMX.toast(n ? n + ' payment(s) approved and credited.' : 'Nothing was due yet.', 'success');
      TSMX.pcLoadAuto();
    });
  };

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxPanelControlsPage', title: 'Panel Controls', html: HTML,
      group: 'system', icon: '🎛️', label: 'Panel Controls', onEnter: TSMX.pcLoad
    });
    // keep scheduled approvals moving while an admin has the panel open
    setTimeout(() => { TSMX.autoApproveSweep(); }, 4000);
    setInterval(() => { TSMX.autoApproveSweep(); }, 30000);
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v37 payments pro loaded ', 'background:#059669;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();

        '<option value="published">🌟 On the review wall</option><option value="waiting">🕓 Waiting to be published</option></select></div>',
      '<div class="fld"><label>Rating</label><select class="tsmx-sel" id="fdRating" onchange="TSMX.fdRender()">',

  function paintCfg() {
    const g = (id, v) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.value = v; };
    g('fdEnabled', FD.cfg.enabled === false ? '0' : '1');
    g('fdWall', FD.cfg.wallEnabled === false ? '0' : '1');
    g('fdReq', FD.cfg.requireRating === false ? '0' : '1');

    g('fdMin', TSMX.num(FD.cfg.minChars, 10));
    g('fdCatsCfg', FD.cfg.categories || DEF.categories);
    g('fdIntro', FD.cfg.intro || DEF.intro);
    g('fdThanks', FD.cfg.thanks || DEF.thanks);
  }

  TSMX.fdSaveCfg = function () {
    const v = id => (document.getElementById(id) || {}).value;
    DB().ref('settings/feedback').update({
      enabled: v('fdEnabled') === '1',
      wallEnabled: v('fdWall') === '1',
      requireRating: v('fdReq') === '1',
      autoPublishFrom: TSMX.num(v('fdAuto'), 0),
      minChars: Math.max(0, TSMX.num(v('fdMin'), 10)),
      categories: String(v('fdCatsCfg') || DEF.categories).slice(0, 300),
      intro: String(v('fdIntro') || '').slice(0, 200),
      thanks: String(v('fdThanks') || '').slice(0, 200),
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: TSMX.adminEmail()
    }).then(() => { TSMX.toast('Feedback settings saved.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('feedback.settings', 'Feedback page settings updated'); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };

  TSMX.fdRender = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('fdList'); if (!box) return;
    const f = (document.getElementById('fdFilter') || {}).value || 'all';
    const r = (document.getElementById('fdRating') || {}).value || '';
    const q = String((document.getElementById('fdSearch') || {}).value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    // KPIs
    const all = FD.rows;
    const kp = document.getElementById('fdKpis');
    if (kp) {
      const rated = all.filter(x => TSMX.num(x.rating) > 0);
      const avg = rated.length ? rated.reduce((a, x) => a + TSMX.num(x.rating), 0) / rated.length : 0;
      const week = Date.now() - 7 * 864e5;
      kp.innerHTML =
        kpi('Average rating', (Math.round(avg * 10) / 10) + ' ★', rated.length + ' rated', '#f59e0b') +
        kpi('Total feedback', all.length, all.filter(x => TSMX.num(x.createdAt) >= week).length + ' this week', '#0ea5e9') +
        kpi('Waiting for a reply', all.filter(x => x.status !== 'replied').length, 'answer them to build trust', '#ef4444') +
        kpi('On the review wall', all.filter(x => x.published).length, 'visible to every visitor', '#10b981');
    }
    // spread + categories
    const sp = document.getElementById('fdSpread');
    if (sp) {
      const total = all.length || 1;
      sp.innerHTML = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(n => {
        const c = all.filter(x => TSMX.num(x.rating) === n).length;
        return '<div class="fd-bar"><span style="width:42px;color:#f59e0b">' + n + ' ★</span>' +
          '<span class="t"><span class="f" style="width:' + Math.round((c / total) * 100) + '%"></span></span>' +
          '<b style="width:34px;text-align:right">' + c + '</b></div>';
      }).join('');
    }
    const cb = document.getElementById('fdCats');
    if (cb) {
      const map = {};
      all.forEach(x => { const c = x.category || 'General'; map[c] = (map[c] || 0) + 1; });
      const keys = Object.keys(map).sort((a, b) => map[b] - map[a]);
      const max = keys.length ? map[keys[0]] : 1;
      cb.innerHTML = keys.length ? keys.map(k =>
        '<div class="fd-bar"><span style="width:120px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">' + esc(k) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="t"><span class="f" style="width:' + Math.round((map[k] / max) * 100) + '%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0ea5e9,#38bdf8)"></span></span>' +
        '<b style="width:34px;text-align:right">' + map[k] + '</b></div>').join('')
        : '<div class="tsmx-empty" style="padding:16px">No data yet</div>';
    }

    let list = all.slice();
    if (f === 'new') list = list.filter(x => x.status !== 'replied');
    else if (f === 'replied') list = list.filter(x => x.status === 'replied');
    else if (f === 'published') list = list.filter(x => x.published);
    else if (f === 'waiting') list = list.filter(x => !x.published && x.allowPublic !== false);
    if (r) list = list.filter(x => String(TSMX.num(x.rating)) === r);
    if (q) list = list.filter(x => ((x.name || '') + ' ' + (x.email || '') + ' ' + (x.message || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0);
    list.sort((a, b) => TSMX.num(b.createdAt) - TSMX.num(a.createdAt));

    if (!list.length) return TSMX.empty(box, '💬', 'No feedback matches this view');
    box.innerHTML = list.map(x =>
      '<div class="fd-card ' + (x.status === 'replied' ? 'replied' : 'new') + '">' +
      '<div class="fd-top">' +
      '<b style="font-size:13px">' + esc(x.name || 'User') + '</b>' +
      '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + esc(x.email || '') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="fd-stars">' + stars(x.rating) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="tsmx-pill p-gray">' + esc(x.category || 'General') + '</span>' +
      (x.published ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-green">on the wall</span>' : '') +
      (x.featured ? '<span class="tsmx-pill p-violet">featured</span>' : '') +
      '<span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-gray)">' + TSMX.dt(x.createdAt) + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="fd-msg">' + esc(x.message || '') + '</div>' +
      (x.proof ? '<div style="margin-top:7px;font-size:11.5px">📎 <a href="' + esc(x.proof) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:#0ea5e9;word-break:break-all">' + esc(x.proof) + '</a></div>' : '') +
      (x.reply ? '<div class="fd-reply"><b>Your reply:</b> ' + esc(x.reply) + '</div>' : '') +
      '<div class="fd-act">' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sm" onclick="TSMX.fdReply(\'' + x.id + '\')">💬 ' + (x.reply ? 'Edit reply' : 'Reply') + '</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sm ' + (x.published ? 'warn' : 'ok') + '" onclick="TSMX.fdPublish(\'' + x.id + '\',' + (x.published ? 'false' : 'true') + ')">' +
      (x.published ? '🚫 Remove from wall' : '🌟 Publish to wall') + '</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sm sec" onclick="TSMX.fdFeature(\'' + x.id + '\',' + (x.featured ? 'false' : 'true') + ')">' + (x.featured ? '📌 Unfeature' : '📌 Feature') + '</button>' +
      '<button class="tsmx-btn sm dgr" onclick="TSMX.fdDelete(\'' + x.id + '\')">🗑️</button>' +
      '</div></div>').join('');
  };

  function kpi(l, v, s, c) {
    return '<div class="tsmx-kpi" style="--k:' + c + '"><div class="k-l">' + esc(l) + '</div><div class="k-v">' + esc(String(v)) +
      '</div><div class="k-s">' + esc(s) + '</div></div>';
  }
  const row = id => FD.rows.find(x => x.id === id);

  TSMX.fdReply = function (id) {
    const x = row(id); if (!x) return;
    TSMX.modal({
      title: '💬 Reply to ' + (x.name || 'user'),
      body: '<div class="tsmx-note n-info">' + stars(x.rating) + ' · ' + esc(x.category || 'General') + '<br>' + esc(x.message || '') + '</div>' +
        '<textarea class="tsmx-in" id="fdReplyText" style="width:100%;height:120px" placeholder="Write your reply…">' + esc(x.reply || '') + '</textarea>',
      footer: '<button class="tsmx-btn sec" onclick="TSMX.closeModal()">Cancel</button>' +
        '<button class="tsmx-btn" id="fdReplySend">Send reply</button>',
      onOpen: () => {
        document.getElementById('fdReplySend').onclick = () => {
          const t = String((document.getElementById('fdReplyText') || {}).value || '').trim();
          if (!t) return TSMX.toast('Write something first.', 'error');
          const now = Date.now(), up = {};
          up['feedback/' + id + '/reply'] = t;
          up['feedback/' + id + '/repliedAt'] = now;
          up['feedback/' + id + '/repliedBy'] = TSMX.adminEmail();
          up['feedback/' + id + '/status'] = 'replied';
          if (x.uid) {
            const nk = DB().ref('notifications').push().key;
            up['notifications/' + nk] = {
              user_id: x.uid, title: '💬 Reply to your feedback', message: t.slice(0, 300),
              type: 'feedback', is_read: false, read: false, created_at: now, timestamp: now
            };
          }
          DB().ref().update(up).then(() => {
            TSMX.closeModal(); TSMX.toast('Reply sent.', 'success');
            TSMX.audit('feedback.reply', 'Replied to feedback from ' + (x.email || x.uid || ''));
            TSMX.fdLoad();
          }).catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
        };
      }
    });
  };

  TSMX.fdPublish = function (id, on) {
    const x = row(id); if (!x) return;
    if (on && x.allowPublic === false)
      return TSMX.confirm('Publish without consent?', 'This user did not tick "show my review publicly". Publish it anyway?', () => doPublish(id, true), true);
    doPublish(id, on);
  };
  function doPublish(id, on) {
    DB().ref('feedback/' + id).update({ published: !!on, publishedAt: on ? Date.now() : null })
      .then(() => { TSMX.toast(on ? 'Published to the review wall.' : 'Removed from the wall.', 'success'); TSMX.fdLoad(); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  }
  TSMX.fdFeature = function (id, on) {
    DB().ref('feedback/' + id).update({ featured: !!on, published: on ? true : undefined })
      .then(() => { TSMX.toast(on ? 'Featured at the top of the wall.' : 'No longer featured.', 'success'); TSMX.fdLoad(); })
      .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
  };
  TSMX.fdDelete = function (id) {
    TSMX.confirm('Delete feedback', 'Delete this feedback permanently?', () => {
      DB().ref('feedback/' + id).remove()
        .then(() => { TSMX.toast('Deleted.', 'success'); TSMX.audit('feedback.delete', 'Deleted feedback ' + id); TSMX.fdLoad(); })
        .catch(e => TSMX.toast(e.message, 'error'));
    }, true);
  };
  TSMX.fdExport = () => TSMX.csv('feedback_' + TSMX.dayKey(Date.now()) + '.csv',
    [['When', 'Name', 'Email', 'Rating', 'Category', 'Message', 'Reply', 'Published']].concat(
      FD.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => TSMX.num(b.createdAt) - TSMX.num(a.createdAt)).map(x =>
        [TSMX.dt(x.createdAt), x.name || '', x.email || '', TSMX.num(x.rating), x.category || '', x.message || '', x.reply || '', x.published ? 'yes' : 'no'])));

  TSMX.onReady(function () {
    TSMX.registerPage({
      id: 'tsmxFeedbackPage', title: 'Feedback Desk', html: HTML,
      group: 'business', icon: '💬', label: 'Feedback Desk', onEnter: TSMX.fdLoad
    });
  });

  console.log('%c TSMX v37 feedback desk loaded ', 'background:#db2777;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px');
})();

<script id="ipsAdminV38">
(function(){

  window.__TSM_ADMIN_BUILD='v38';

  /* Complete delayed automatic ticket acknowledgements even when the user left.
     Claim transaction + ackState makes it exactly-once across user/admin tabs. */
  X.ticketAckSweep=async function(){
    const db=DB();if(!db)return 0;let count=0;
    const s=await db.ref('tickets').once('value').catch(()=>null);if(!s)return 0;
    const jobs=[];s.forEach(c=>{const t=c.val()||{};if(t.ackPending&&Number(t.ackDueAt||0)<=Date.now())jobs.push(send(c.key,t))});
    await Promise.all(jobs);return count;
    async function send(id,t){
      const base='tickets/'+id;let won=false;
      const claim=await db.ref(base+'/ackState').transaction(v=>{
        if(v&&v.status==='sent')return;
        if(v&&v.status==='sending'&&Date.now()-Number(v.claimedAt||0)<60000)return;
        won=true;return{status:'sending',claimedAt:Date.now()};
      }).catch(()=>null);
      if(!claim||!claim.committed||!won)return;
      const k=db.ref(base+'/messages').push().key,now=Date.now(),up={};
      up[base+'/messages/'+k]={sender:'system',senderName:'Support Team',message:String(t.ackText||'Ticket received. Our team will reply shortly.'),createdAt:now,auto:true};
      up[base+'/ackState']={status:'sent',sentAt:now};up[base+'/ackPending']=false;up[base+'/ackSentAt']=now;
      up[base+'/updatedAt']=now;up[base+'/lastMessageAt']=now;up[base+'/lastMessageBy']='system';up[base+'/userHasUnread']=true;
      try{await db.ref().update(up);count++}catch(e){await db.ref(base+'/ackState').remove().catch(()=>{})}
    }
  };

  /* Make payment brand/delay controls robust if a modal is repainted. */
  function verifyPaymentControls(){
    const modal=document.getElementById('paymentMethodModal');if(!modal||getComputedStyle(modal).display==='none')return;
    const brand=document.getElementById('pmBrandBlock'),delay=document.getElementById('pmAutoDelayBlock');
    if((!brand||!delay)&&typeof X.pmExtras==='function'){
      // Re-open wrappers normally mount them; this warning is visible only in diagnostics.
      modal.dataset.v38Controls=brand&&delay?'ready':'waiting';
    }
  }
  function boot(){X.ticketAckSweep();verifyPaymentControls()}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();
  setInterval(()=>{X.ticketAckSweep();verifyPaymentControls()},15000);
  console.log('%c Top SMM Admin v38 reliability active ','background:#0f766e;color:#fff;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold');
})();
