X.reconcileFundRequests=async function(){
 const db=DB();if(!db)return 0;const s=await db.ref('adminPanel/fundRequests').once('value').catch(()=>null);if(!s)return 0;const jobs=[];
 s.forEach(c=>{const a=c.val()||{};if(!a.userId||!a.requestKey)return;jobs.push(db.ref('users/'+a.userId+'/fundRequests/'+a.requestKey).once('value').then(u=>{const r=u.val();if(!r)return;const up={};if(a.status!==r.status)up.status=r.status;if(a.balanceCredited!==r.balanceCredited)up.balanceCredited=!!r.balanceCredited;if(!r.adminKey)db.ref('users/'+a.userId+'/fundRequests/'+a.requestKey+'/adminKey').set(c.key).catch(()=>{});if(Object.keys(up).length)return c.ref.update(Object.assign(up,{updatedAt:Date.now()}))}))});
 await Promise.all(jobs);return jobs.length;
};

function e(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function source(){const url=(e('hblUrl')||{}).value?.trim()||'',file=(e('hblFile')||{}).value?.trim()||'';return uploaded||file||url||''}
function paint(){const w=Number((e('hblWidth')||{}).value)||260,h=Number((e('hblHeight')||{}).value)||52,s=source(),im=e('hblPreview');if(e('hblWidthVal'))e('hblWidthVal').textContent=w;if(e('hblHeightVal'))e('hblHeightVal').textContent=h;if(im){im.style.width=w+'px';im.style.height=h+'px';if(s){im.src=s;im.style.display='block'}else im.style.display='none'}if(e('hblSource'))e('hblSource').textContent=uploaded?'Uploaded file':((e('hblFile')||{}).value?'Local path':((e('hblUrl')||{}).value?'URL':'Fallback'));if(e('hblShell'))e('hblShell').classList.toggle('dark',!!(e('hblDark')||{}).checked)}
X.hblLoad=function(){uploaded='';DB().ref('settings/headerBrandLogo').once('value').then(s=>{const c=s.val()||{};e('hblUrl').value=c.url||'https://i.ibb.co/JjHPShVq/file-0000000038d882118a294865d795db51.png';e('hblFile').value=c.file||'';uploaded=c.dataUrl||'';e('hblWidth').value=Number(c.width)||260;e('hblHeight').value=Number(c.height)||52;paint()});['hblUrl','hblFile','hblWidth','hblHeight','hblDark'].forEach(id=>{const n=e(id);if(n&&!n.dataset.hblWired){n.dataset.hblWired='1';n.addEventListener('input',paint)}});const uploadEl=e('hblUpload');if(uploadEl&&!uploadEl.dataset.hblWired){uploadEl.dataset.hblWired='1';uploadEl.addEventListener('change',ev=>{const f=ev.target.files&&ev.target.files[0];if(!f)return;if(f.size>450*1024){ev.target.value='';return X.toast('Image is larger than 450 KB. Optimize it first to keep the website fast.','error')}if(!/^image\//.test(f.type)){ev.target.value='';return X.toast('Choose a valid image file.','error')}const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{uploaded=String(r.result||'');paint();X.toast('Image ready. Press Publish Header Logo.','success')};r.onerror=()=>X.toast('Could not read the image.','error');r.readAsDataURL(f)});}};
X.hblClearUpload=function(){uploaded='';if(e('hblUpload'))e('hblUpload').value='';paint();X.toast('Uploaded image cleared locally. Press Publish to save this change.','success')};
X.hblSave=function(){const url=e('hblUrl').value.trim(),file=e('hblFile').value.trim(),w=Math.max(100,Math.min(520,Number(e('hblWidth').value)||260)),h=Math.max(28,Math.min(96,Number(e('hblHeight').value)||52));if(url&&!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)&&!/^data:image\//i.test(url))return X.toast('Logo URL must start with http:// or https://','error');if(!uploaded&&!file&&!url)return X.toast('Add a URL, local file path or upload an image.','error');DB().ref('settings/headerBrandLogo').set({url,file,dataUrl:uploaded||null,width:w,height:h,logoOnly:true,fit:'contain',updatedAt:Date.now(),updatedBy:X.adminEmail()}).then(()=>{X.toast('✅ Header brand logo published live. Landing page was not changed.','success');X.audit('header.logo','Dedicated header logo updated')}).catch(err=>X.toast('Save failed: '+err.message,'error'))};
X.hblReset=function(){if(!confirm('Remove the dedicated header logo settings? The previous Header Logo fallback will be used.'))return;DB().ref('settings/headerBrandLogo').remove().then(()=>{uploaded='';e('hblUrl').value='';e('hblFile').value='';paint();X.toast('Dedicated header logo reset.','success')}).catch(err=>X.toast(err.message,'error'))};
X.onReady(()=>X.registerPage({id:'tsmxHeaderBrandLogoPage',title:'Header Brand Logo',html:HTML,group:'design',icon:'🖼️',label:'Header Brand Logo',onEnter:X.hblLoad}));
console.log('%c Admin v43 Header Brand Logo loaded ','background:#b45309;color:#fff;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold');
})();
